notes.title: Version 1.9.5 - P2P Networking Added, Leaderboard Reset, New Ranked Season
notes.content:
[h1]Peer to Peer Networking[/h1]

We've added Peer To Peer Networking support. Both public and LAN options are available. Public is for playing with anyone anywhere. LAN is for private lobbies within an internal network.

It's seamless, just select the appropriate region in game settings. When you do so, a small application is launched in the background (ElementServer.exe). This is a build of the game server running on your computer. [b]If Windows asks for internet/firewall access, please allow it.[/b] 

For those concerned about privacy, it uses the same port as Steam. And if you don't want it running, just change your region back to something non-P2P and the server will be stopped. It only runs when you have set the region to P2P.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Peer to Peer Networking Support Added
[*]Updated Unity game engine version
[*]Updated networking code libraries
[*]New hotkeys added for Select Previous Tower (F6), Next Tower (F7), and Similar Tower (F8)
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Co-op Creep HP multiplier reduced from 1.153 to 1.15
[*] Co-op Boss HP multiplier reduced from 1.25 to 1.2
[*] Water tower damage increased from 90 / 540 / 3240 / 38880 to 95 / 570 / 3420 / 41040
[*] Earth tower shockwave damage increased from 35 / 210 / 1260 / 15120 to 40 / 240 / 1440/ 17280
[*] Poison tower base damage increased from 130 / 520 / 2080 to 150 / 600 / 2400
[*] Poison tower DoT increased from 65 / 260 / 1040 to 70 / 280 / 1120
[*] Nova tower damage increased from 260 / 1040 to 300 / 1200
[*] Windstorm tower damage increased from 300 / 1200 to 350 / 1400
[*] Root tower DoT increased from 35 / 140 to 40 / 160
[*] Wisp tower damage increased from 850 / 3400 to 950 / 3800
[*] Archdruid tower damage bonus multiplier increased 20%
[*] Archdruid tower base damage reduced from 25000 to 15000
[*] Obelisk tower base damage reduced from 9000 to 7500
[*] Obelisk explosion damage build up reduced from 4000 to 3600
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[b]There is a leaderboard reset with these balance changes.[/b]

[h2][b]Season 8 of Ranked has also started![/b][/h2]

[h1]Looking Ahead[/h1]

Development is active on our next game and I'm personally very excited about how it is taking shape. This is cliche to say but we really are applying what we've learned from Element TD 2 and Axon TD to our next game. We'll have more to share next year.

I want to take a moment to acknowledge our more casual and co-op players. We have learned from experience that prioritizing new content over fine tuning balance is the way to go. You can expect us to focus on keeping things fresh by adding content in our next game.

notes.title: A note on Cheating, Leaderboards, and Bans
notes.content:
Let me start by saying that we don't condone cheating. That said, we don't care if you cheat in singleplayer. But when you cheat for the leaderboard or multiplayer then it hurts other players.

If you want to cheat in Element TD 2 and not get banned please keep the below in mind.

[list]
[*] Campaign is only singleplayer so you can do whatever you want.
[*] Survival you can exit the match anytime before you die. Leaderboard submission happens upon death.
[*] Alternatively, you can turn on God Mode in Survival.
[*] Mega Survival is the same as Survival for this.
[*] Ranked, FFA, Co-op, Teams, and War are all multiplayer and completely off-limits. Do not play these.
[/list]

We added an option in Axon TD to disable all leaderboard submissions based on player feedback. It has worked out well so we're going to add this to Element TD 2 in 1.9.5. That way you can play Survival without any concern.

We have a three strike policy. First time cheat entries appear on the leaderboard we simply delete them. Second time cheat entries appear we ban the player. The player can appeal either on Discord or Steam Forums to get a second chance.

If you're intending to cheat singleplayer only and accidentally get an entry on the leaderboard, please reach out to us on either Discord or Steam Forums. We're not looking to ban people for accidents. We're looking to ban people trying to cheat others.

For the other side of players, those who worry about cheating in multiplayer, we'll have something in 1.9.5 for you too. We're trying some anti-cheat with Axon TD and what ends up working we'll add to Element TD 2.

notes.title: Version 1.9.4
notes.content:
What's this? A new update for Element TD 2? That's right, we're back with some significant changes! We've got performance improvements, quality of life, a bunch of balance updates, and a new difficulty to test your skills against. Read on for the full notes!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Spatial Hash applied. In short, this results in major performance improvements, especially on the CPU end.
[*] Singleplayer games no longer need to connect online to submit to leaderboard. As a result, we've removed the "online" checkbox in singleplayer entirely, because it's no longer necessary.
[*] Legendary difficulty added (250% HP, 15x Score)
[*] Czech and Italian localization updated
[*] When a player leaves in co-op, their towers are no longer sold and instead ownership is transferred
[*] There is now a ready button before first wave start in all modes except Ranked
[*] Ranked match desync detector relaxed a bit
[*] Ranked has been adjusted from Very Hard to Insane Difficulty
[/list]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Disconnected from Steam message no longer blocks the game by spamming
[*] Fixed Tesla Tree connections broken on load checkpoint
[*] Fixed bug with achievements for mission 7 and 9 in campaign
[*] Fixed Corrosion and Incantation not being impacted by Diminishing Returns
[*] Fixed a bug with Nuclear tower where % of HP damage was calculated based on each creep itself not the target creep
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Global[/b][/h3]
Most towers are receiving range buffs across the board, increasing their overall usability. [b]Essence[/b] picks are indirectly buffed from [b]Level 4 Singles[/b] being cheaper and (mostly) more powerful. You have more starting gold, and [b]Level 3 Elementals[/b] are a little easier to kill.

On the nerf side of things, [b]6 Element[/b] has remained a dominant build due to the potency of stacking all their support towers ([b]Triples & Quads[/b]), as well as [b]Periodic[/b] being exceedingly powerful. We've made some adjustments there.
[list]
[*] Interest rate pick bonus reduced from 0.65% to 0.6%
[*] Diminishing Returns increased from 12% to 13%
[*] Diminishing Returns stack cap increased from 6 to 7
[*] The following Quads now contribute to Diminishing Returns: Phantom Zone, Rage, Nuclear, Shredder, Gravity Cannon, Singularity
[*] Periodic and Level 4 Single Element total cost reduced from 16000 to 13750
[*] 750 range towers increased to 850 range
[*] 900 range towers increased to 1000 range
[*] 1150 range towers remain the same
[*] 1500 range towers reduced to 1450 range
[*] Some towers that were previously 1500 range are now 1750 range. These are listed in tower notes below.
[*] Starting gold increased from 250 to 300
[*] Mazing bonus starting gold increased from 350 to 375
[*] Ranked starting gold increased from 1300 to 1500
[*] Extra Short starting gold increased from 7000 to 7500
[*] Boss Hunt starting gold increased from 120000 to 130000
[*] Elemental Level 3 Base HP reduced from 22500 to 20000
[*] Elemental HP wave multiplier increased from x1.5 to x1.515
[*] Healing creep heal rate reduced from 30% to 25%
[/list]

[h3][b]Base Towers[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Arrow tower range increased from 900 to 1150
[*] Arrow tower damage increased from 60 to 62
[*] Periodic tower damage reduced from 52000 to 39000
[/list]

[h3][b]Single Element Towers[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Light increased from 1500 to 1750 range
[*] Darkness increased from 1150 to 1450 range
[*] Level 4 Water tower damage increased from 35640 to 38880
[*] Level 4 Fire tower damage increased from 14040 to 17280

[*] Level 4 Light tower damage increased from 56160 to 70200
[*] Level 4 Light tower consecutive bonus damage increased from 1404 to 1620
[*] Level 4 Darkness tower damage increased from 129600 to 151200
[/list]

[h3][b]Dual Element Towers[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Geyser tower ability AoE increased from 300 to 300 / 350 / 400
[*] Lightning tower bounce damage retained increased from 85% / 88% / 91% to 85% / 90% / 95%
[*] Infernal tower given 75 AoE
[*] Ice tower damage reduced from 850 / 3400 / 13600 to 700 / 2800 / 11200
[*] Howitzer tower range increased from 1500 to 1750
[*] Howitzer tower damage reduced from 190 / 760 / 3080 to 175 / 700 / 2800
[*] Well, Blacksmith, and Trickery range increased from 900 to 1150
[/list]

[h3][b]Triple Element Towers[/b][/h3]
Mostly buffs here. Except [b]Money Tower[/b]. It no longer grants additional gold over time.[list]
[*] Ethereal tower damage increased from 900 / 3600 to 950 / 3800
[*] Ethereal tower bonus damage increased from 75 / 300 to 95 / 380

[*] Runic tower damage reduced from 1125 / 4500 to 925 / 3700
[*] Flamethrower tower Napalm damage increased from 210 / 840 to 230 / 920
[/list]

[h3][b]Triple Element Support Towers[/b][/h3]
Many of these towers were close if not matching effectiveness in damage to the [b]Triple Element Damage Towers[/b]. This contributed heavily to [b]6 Element[/b] dominance. As a result, we've severely reduced their damage.[list]
[*] Corrosion tower damage reduced from 140 / 560 to 90 / 360
[*] Incantation tower damage reduced from 475 / 1900 to 375 / 1500

[*] Muck tower damage reduced from 900 / 3600 to 600 / 2400

[h3][b]Quad Element Towers[/b][/h3]
As mentioned earlier, numerous [b]Support Quads[/b] now contribute to Diminishing Returns. Some have received buffs; others nerfs. On the whole, [b]Damage Quads[/b] are buffed. This should result in [b]6 Element[/b] no longer being overwhelmingly powerful while retaining their usability in [b]4 Element[/b] and [b]5 Element[/b] builds.[list]

As per usual, with a balance update, [b]Leaderboards[/b] have been reset. Additionally, [b]Ranked Season 7[/b] has begun!

[hr][/hr]
We hope you enjoy this latest update to the game. Try out all kinds of new strategies, and see how much better the game performs (especially in [b]Co-op[/b]). Let us know what you think of the update on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url]!

After this update, we have one more major update planned, which will cover long-term server support. You can read about those details [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1018830/view/4205876369762836448]here[/url].
[hr][/hr]
Lastly, [b]Element TD 2[/b] is on sale for the [b]Steam Summer Sale 2024[/b]! Let your friends (and enemies) know they can pick up both the base game and the [b]Mazing DLC[/b] for 50%!

notes.title: Another Major Update
notes.content:
It turns out that there will be another major update after version 1.9.4!

Our backend developer has decided to rewrite the game server code. This will improve the performance allowing for a smoother multiplayer experience. But more exciting is that we'll be making the game server portable as well.

As a result, peer to peer networking will be added to the game! You'll be able to host a lobby with you being the game server that everyone connects to. Playing with friends? Skip connecting to a regional server and keep it local. At a LAN? Even better, say goodbye to latency.

The game server will be shipped alongside the main game so the experience will be seamless.

Just to be clear, the regional game servers are not going anywhere. We will be supporting the standard multiplayer experience for at least a decade.

Version 1.9.5 will be coming by the end of the summer.

notes.title: Next Version Update
notes.content:
We hired a couple of performance consultants for our other game, Axon TD: Uprising. Thankfully some of the findings there can be applied to Element TD 2! Of particular note is an algorithm change for the unit search function. For those who get low FPS late game, especially in co-op, you will see huge FPS gains.

That algorithm change slightly alters the balance of the game. So we will take the opportunity to do a few tower balance changes (leaning towards buffs). As a result the leaderboards will be reset. We'll also start a new season of Ranked play.

One quality of life change is very noteworthy. This is a long overdue feature that we're lifting from Axon TD. Singleplayer will be able to submit to leaderboards without having to be online. That means no latency when going for leaderboard runs. And also no disconnects.

The update is a few months out so please join the balance discussion on Discord to contribute your feedback in the meantime!

notes.title: 2nd Non-Mazing Tournament
notes.content:
We've got another [b]Element TD 2 Tournament[/b] coming up, this time for [b]Non-Mazing Pick[/b]! Sign-ups start now. Though before we move on to the rules, let's address a little something...

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Why isn't it Mazing?[/b][/h2]
For those of you on our [b]Discord[/b], you may recall us doing a poll sometime back asking if you'd prefer this tournament to be [b]Mazing[/b] or [b]Non-Mazing[/b], and the response was majority [b]Mazing[/b] by a long shot. We want it to be [b]Mazing[/b] as well, but unfortunately, there's a bug that we have no explanation for that only happens in multiplayer.

Numerous folks have reported this issue where, in [b]Mazing[/b], creeps will spontaneously just ignore the grid. Sometimes it involves walking through your towers, and sometimes it involves walking over the terrain itself. The weirdest part about this bug is that it doesn't happen in [b]Replays[/b], meaning that on the client, it's working perfectly fine.

Because of that, we've decided we cannot, in good conscience, run this tournament as [b]Mazing[/b]. Should we ever find a fix for this bug, then we may consider running a [b]Mazing[/b] tourney in the future, but for now, this one in particular will be [b]Non-Mazing[/b]. We apologize for the false promise.

Now without further ado, let's move on to sign-ups and rules!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]How to Sign Up[/b][/h2]
[b]Sign-ups[/b] for the [b]2nd Element TD 2 Tournament[/b] are now live! We'll be organizing the tournament through the [b]Discord[/b]. That said, here's how to enter:[list]
[*]If you haven't already, [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]join our Discord[/url].
[*]Next, there's a channel on there called [b]#tournament-signup[/b]. Go there and comment with your name in that channel.[list]
[*]Please note that the name you enter here should be the name you use on both Discord and Steam during the event.
[/list][/list]
Signups will close on [b]June 3rd[/b] or when a maximum of 128 participants have entered.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]When and Where?[/b][/h2]
The tournament will be played online, and it'll run [u]June 17th-18th[/u]. Each day of the event, we'll start at the following time:[list]
[*]10am PDT (US)
[*]7pm CET (EU)
[*]1am CST (Asia)
[/list]
On the first day of the event, players are expected to check in half an hour before the first match starts.

Depending on the number of participants, the number of matches per set may vary. Each day is expected to run upwards of 4-6 hours.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Rules[/b][/h2]
All matches shall be played in accordance with the established rules of a [b]Ranked Pick[/b] game:[list]
[*][b]Map[/b]: Random, Non-variant
[*][b]Difficulty[/b]: Very Hard
[*][b]Element[/b]: Pick
[*][b]Length[/b]: Short
[*][b]Paths[/b]: Standard
[*][b]Game Speed[/b]: Turbo Lite (x1.5)
[*][b]Interest[/b]: Enabled
[*][b]Tower Ban Phase[/b]: Enabled
[/list]
[b]Conditions[/b]:[list]
[*]Anything possible within the bounds of the game mechanics is allowed.
[*]The winner is determined by which player lives the longest before the boss waves, or scores the highest if the game reaches boss waves.
[*]At the end of a match all players must submit a screenshot of the results, along with a replay of the match in the dedicated channel or thread on the discord to confirm the results.
[*]In the event of a [b]Desync[/b], the following applies:[list]
[*]The one with the [b]Most Lives[/b] before the [b]Desync[/b] wins that match.
[*]If lives are identical, we go by number of [b]First Wave Clears[/b].
[/list]
[*]Using the in-game chat for [u]any kind of harassment[/u] over the course of a game is warrant for [u]immediate disqualification[/u].
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Discord Info[/b][/h2]
The [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Discord[/url] will have three channels dedicated to the tournament that will later be closed when the tournament is over:[list]
[*][b]#tournament-info[/b] - Used for tournament information updates. Participants will be tagged in important posts.
[*][b]#tournament-signup[/b] - Sign up here! You have until [b]June 3rd[/b] to do so.
[*][b]#tournament-discussion[/b] - Feel free to ask questions, hype up the tournament, talk about past matches, etc. As long as it's relevant to the [b]Tournament[/b].
[*][b]#tournament-matches[/b] - Here, threads will be created for each match. These threads are then used to organize the games, communicate with the other players, and post the results at the end of each game.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Prizes[/b][/h2]
The Top 3 will receive an [b]Element TD T-Shirt[/b] as well as cash prizes:[list]
[*][b]1st Place[/b]: $250
[*][b]2nd Place[/b]: $100
[*][b]3rd Place[/b]: $50
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Casting[/b][/h2]
Lastly, if you are interested in [u]casting/streaming[/u] these matches, please reach out and let us know on the [b]Discord[/b]. We'd love to have as many games casted as possible!

[hr][/hr]
Once again, we apologize that it's not [b]Mazing[/b]. Regardless, we hope you'll enter the tournament and ultimately have fun!

notes.title: Version 1.9 - New Co-op Mazing Maps, Balance, Fixes
notes.content:
It's been a little while in here, but we're back, and we've brought [b]Version 1.9[/b] with us! Contained within are a couple new [b]Mazing Co-op Maps[/b], fixes, and the last balance update for a while. Read on for more info!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]2 New Mazing Co-op Maps[/b][/h2]
For those of you that have the [b]Mazing DLC[/b], we've added a pair of new [b]Co-op Maps[/b]!

[h3][b]Gemini[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/d00fa4dcaa400ba23fba552cdf348614e5ecf28f.jpg[/img]

A map composed of 4 large islands, each containing two spawns. For those of you that love the abusable nature of checkpoints in the [b]Space[/b] map, in [b]Gemini[/b], creeps head for a checkpoint before proceeding to the end. Enjoy breaking this map!


[h3][b]Mega Spiral[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/d44b913f0463de7255d37ff9b6244e286c00595a.jpg[/img]

A massive spiral connects each area. Each player's spawn goes through their area + the next player's area before they reach the end. Except the last player, theirs teleports to the middle area. While not quite as abusable as [b]Gemini[/b], it has a lot of flexibility for building your maze how you please.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h2][list]
[*][b]Unity Version[/b] upgraded from [b]2020.3.21[/b] to [b]2020.3.42[/b].
[*]You now start the [b]Campaign[/b] with 1 extra point.
[*]Fixed "pink portals" on Mission 25 of the [b]Campaign[/b].
[*]Fixed [b]Jinx[/b] effect not applying to creeps that have been split by [b]Shredder Tower[/b].
[*]Fixed [b]Polar[/b] effect not working on creeps once they reach a high enough HP.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2]

[b]General[/b][list]
[*][b]Tower Build Times[/b] have been increased by 0.5 seconds per tier.[list]
[*]This should make building/upgrading towers a bit riskier and easier to push. And in [b]Random[/b], this will also make [b]Buy/Sell[/b] spam much easier to punish.
[/list]
[*][b]Interest Upgrade[/b] increased from 0.6% to 0.65%. 
[*]You are now granted two freebie [b]Essences[/b]: one after clearing Wave 50, and another after clearing Wave 55.
[*][b]Essence Upgrade[/b] can now only be picked once, and grants [b]2 Essences[/b].
[/list]

[b]Tower Balance[/b][list]
[*][b]Light Level 4[/b] damage increment for consecutive hits increased from 1296 to 1404.
[*][b]Darkness[/b] on-kill HP removal increased from 9% to 12%
[*][b]Water Level 4[/b] damage reduced from 38880 to 35640
[*][b]Fire Level 4[/b] damage increased from 12960 to 14040[list]
[*]Damage gain per second increased from 432 to 468
[/list]
[*][b]Nature Level 4[/b] damage reduced from 41040 to 37620
[*][b]Earth Level 4[/b] shockwave damage increased from 15120 to 17640
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Lightning Level 3[/b] bounces reduced from 6 to 5
[*][b]Bloom[/b] attack speed recharge rate reduced from 1 to 0.9 per second
[*][b]Mushroom[/b] damage reduced from 490 to 450
[*][b]Poison[/b] damage-over-time reduced from 65 to 60
[*][b]Solar[/b] debuff duration from 5 to 6
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Flooding[/b] damage increased from 470 to 500
[*][b]Root[/b] damage per second reduced from 100 to 90
[*][b]Muck[/b] damage reduced from 1000 to 900
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Obelisk[/b] AoE increment gain reduced from 50 to 25
[*][b]Archdruid[/b] attack speed increased from 0.33 to 0.4
[/list]

As usual, [b]Score Leaderboards[/b] have been reset. We'll be doing a follow-up patch next weekend to properly reset [b]Ranked Leaderboards[/b]. This may be the last time that [b]Leaderboards[/b] are reset for a long, long time.

[hr][/hr]
A few weeks ago, we announced [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2296550/Axon_TD_Uprising__Tower_Defense/]Axon TD: Uprising[/url], and at this point, just about all of our efforts have shifted over there. As thus, this is our last big update for [b]Element TD 2[/b]. There will be future hotfixes for bugs, quality of life changes, and additional localization.

We do still have a [b]Mazing Tournament[/b] coming up though. This will require you to have the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2177070/Element_TD_2__Mazing_Expansion/]Mazing DLC[/url], so if you don't have that and you're interested in joining, hop onto the bandwagon! For now, just know that once again, it'll be free to enter, and we'll be announcing sign-ups sometime in [b]May[/b]. We'll fill you in with all the information then.

In the meantime, we hope you enjoy the new maps and balance, and to all of you who are still around, thanks for sticking with us and playing [b]Element TD 2[/b] for so long!

[b]Finally, Karawasa will be doing an AMA on Reddit next Saturday starting at 12 PM CST. It will be in the gamedev subreddit. Questions about any of the mod versions are welcome too as he has been there for all of them.[/b]

notes.title: Axon TD: Uprising - New Game Announcement
notes.content:
[i]"It was supposed to be a simple mission. Get in, defend the colony, and get paid. Instead, I found myself trapped on the planet, caught in a war between mankind and a robot uprising. In the end, I'm not sure who I should be fighting for..."[/i]

[h1][b]Axon TD: Uprising[/b][/h1]

[previewyoutube=Cuj6uUswkb4;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]What is Axon TD?[/b][/h3]
[b]Axon TD[/b] is a mazing-centric tower defense where you manipulate the map layout to your advantage. Build towers, make the longest maze, and survive against an onslaught of enemies!

In the [b]Campaign[/b], you'll play as a defense contractor on a routine mission. But when you arrive, your ship is shot down, and you're attacked by a robotic force called the [b]Axons[/b]. Your only way off the planet now is to fight. Build towers, secure each location, and push back against the [b]Axons[/b]! And perhaps, find out the truth behind the war...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/7aef87a9cc0eb077a592aa477ecedfd9ec5c102b.gif[/img]
[i]Be free of your restrictions and maze how you please![/i]


[h3][b]Ways to Play[/b][/h3]
Outside of the [b]Campaign[/b], there's three major modes:[list]
[*][b]Quick Play[/b]: Pick a level, choose your [b]Tower Loadout[/b], and try to beat it!
[*][b]Survival Mode[/b]: A longform mode that has you start with minimal towers and space, but throughout the course of the game, you'll receive randomized expansions that you can place where you please, and slowly grow your loadout. Just beating all the waves is a challenge in of itself.
[*][b]Online Co-op[/b]: These are larger levels designed for 2, 3, or 4 players. Each of you chooses your [b]Tower Loadout[/b] before the game begins, and then you're free to build where you please. Coordinate with your team, transfer resources, and try to clear each level!
[/list]All three of these modes support [b]Global Leaderboards[/b].


[h3][b]When will it release?[/b][/h3]
[b]Axon TD[/b] will release in [b]Early Access[/b] in Q3. By then, it will contain the following:[list]
[*]32 Towers, Traps, and Mines
[*]8 Castable Abilities
[*]Chapters 1 & 2 of the Campaign
[*]Numerous Quick Play Levels
[*]Survival Mode
[*]Co-op with up to 4 Players
[*]Leaderboards for Quick Play, Survival, and Co-op
[*]And an actual Tutorial
[/list]
[h3][b]How does this game differ from Element TD 2?[/b][/h3]
The speed, scale, and style of the game is very different, even from [b]Element TD 2's Mazing Mode[/b]. You choose your Towers at the start of the game. You've got unlimited time between each waves. You have a limit to how much you can sell, making each placement really matter. And you can directly manipulate the map to add pathways that didn't exist before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/3f014796e95a2e8cf18ceb336f34576382e8b7e3.gif[/img]
[i]On some levels, you can even change where the "end" is.[/i]


[h3][b]Will there be Workshop Support?[/b][/h3]
Hypothetically, this would include the ability to create custom maps for [b]Quick Play[/b] and [b]Co-op[/b]. [u]We don't know when it'll happen, but we're making [b]Workshop Support[/b] a top priority for this game.[/u]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Wishlist Axon TD[/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2296550/Axon_TD_Uprising__Tower_Defense/
[i]Arriving in Q3 2023.[/i]

[h2][b]Join our Discord Server[/b][/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/6460cafa0c36dc4fbc000e60d43299651e16e134.png[/img][/url]
[i]We'll be providing smaller weekly updates on here. Hop on in![/i]

notes.title: Element Studios Plans for 2023
notes.content:
Greetings! It's been a little while since we last posted. 2 months ago, we released the [b]Mazing DLC[/b], and it's gotten overall positive reception. Player counts for the game have been up since then, and we've seen a good influx of new and returning players.

As for us, we've been working quietly in the background, both on [b]Element TD 2[/b]... and maybe a new project. Below is a list of upcoming things we're working on:

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Version 1.9[/b][/h2]
Coming on Friday, March 31st, we'll be releasing [b]Version 1.9[/b]. This will be the last major patch for the game (for the foreseeable future). Contained within it will be [b]2 More Mazing Co-op Maps[/b], one last round of [b]Cosmetics[/b], balance updates, resets for [b]Ranked & Score Leaderboards[/b], and various fixes.

Speaking of those [b]Co-op Mazing Maps[/b], we're looking for designs to implement. If you've got a cool idea you want to see added to the game, hop onto [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url] and post it in #map-ideas! Some things to consider:[list]
[*]People really like the [b]Space[/b] map, especially due to how open it is plus how abusable the [b]Checkpoints[/b] are. We want to make use of [b]Checkpoints[/b] for at least one of these two maps.
[*]Path lengths can only go so long before it imposes a framerate drop. So for example, if all the paths are capable of circling the map twice over, that's unfortunately a no-go.
[/list]
We'll be locking in which designs we implement within the next 2 weeks.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Another Tournament![/b][/h2]
Sometime during Q2 2023, we'll be doing another [b]Tournament[/b]. This time, the settings will be:[list]
[*][b]Map[/b]: Random, Non-Variant
[*][b]Difficulty[/b]: Very Hard
[*][b]Element Selection[/b]: [u]Pick[/u]
[*][b]Length[/b]: Full
[*][b]Paths[/b]: Standard
[*][b]Wave Order[/b]: [u]Normal[/u]
[/list]
As for whether it's [b]Mazing[/b] or not, we'd actually like your input on that. On one hand, the game is not balanced around [b]Mazing[/b]. On the other hand, it's fresh and seems to be the preferable game mode. Be aware that [b]Casual[/b] will [u]not[/u] be on, meaning you can't immediately go for the longest maze and stall a ton of interest.

That said, comment below which you'd prefer! We'll also be running a poll on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url].

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Next Project Announcement![/b][/h2]
By the end of Q1 2023, we'll be formally announcing out next game project! We've been silently working on it on the background for some time now. For the time being, know that it's a [b]Tower Defense[/b], and it's [u]not related[/u] to [b]Element TD 2[/b]. When we announce it, expect a short trailer, some info, and a release window!

Fret not, although our resources are shifting to the next project, [b]Element TD 2[/b] is not forgotten! We've got a few more things to look forward to over here.

[hr][/hr]
Just to clarify, we'll continue updating [b]Element TD 2[/b] throughout the year, it's just that after 1.9, the fixes will be focused on bug fixes and quality of life. Otherwise, that's what we've been working on lately! Apologies if we've been quiet on that front, but with work split between two game projects, we've been quite busy. Look forward to our upcoming stuff this year!

notes.title: Mazing DLC Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]At last, the time has come. [b]The [b]Mazing Expansion[/b] has finally released![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2177070/Element_TD_2__Mazing_Expansion/
From now through December 9th, you can get the DLC on sale for 20% off at $5.59!

We've also got a fancy trailer for it, courtesies of community member [b]wadebbqwall2[/b]. Check it out below!

[previewyoutube=rj-hz7_smjA;full][/previewyoutube]

For the full details of what this expansion entails, read on for the full notes!

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Mazing Mode[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]How Does Mazing Work?[/b][/h2]
Located on the left of your [b]Build Bar[/b], you have access to the [b]Blocker[/b]. This is a limited resource that costs no gold, meant to make the path longer.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/k61zZE1.gif[/img]
[i]As you place [b]Blockers[/b], the path will automatically adjust.[/i]


By default, you'll start with [b]20 Blockers[/b]. Each wave you clear, you gain [b]1 Blocker[/b], and every 5 waves, you gain [b]2 Blockers[/b] instead.[list]
[*]The bonus you get every 5 waves increases over time.
[*]The number of [b]Blockers[/b] you have also acts as your [b]Tower Limit[/b].
[*]In [b]Co-op[/b], you start with [b]30 Blockers[/b].
[/list]
However, these aren't just for increasing the path length. They also let you build [b]Towers[/b] directly on them.[list]
[*]Selling a [b]Tower[/b] will always leave a [b]Blocker[/b] behind. This way, you don't accidentally open up a hole in your path.
[*]Changes made to the maze mid-wave won't cement in place until the next wave starts.[list]
[*]This prevents you from accidentally opening a hole mid-wave, or routing creeps through an infinite loop via buy/sell abuse of [b]Blockers[/b].
[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/fc8c56fd49d6c3153b6ea8eff50a924680700f69.jpg[/img]
[i]What are those yellow portals?[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]What's in the Mazing DLC?[/b][/h2]
The expansion contains the following:[list]
[*]A [b]Mazing Campaign[/b] featuring 14 Missions[list]
[*]This has its own Loadout & Progression, separate from the Main Campaign
[/list][*][b]10 New FFA/Teams[/b] Mazing Maps
[*][b]4 New Co-op[/b] Mazing Maps
[*][b]Mazing Leaderboards[/b] for each of the new maps[list]
[*]With 10 Pick + 10 Random + 10 Teams + 4 Co-op Leaderboards, that's a total of [b]34 Mazing Leaderboards[/b]!
[*]Tack that on to the existing leaderboards, and we've got 72 + 34 = [b]106 Total Leaderboards[/b]
[/list][*][b]New Achievements[/b] specific to [b]Mazing[/b][list]
[*]To be precise, including multi-tiered Achievements and "clones" for each map, there are [b]174 Mazing Achievements[/b]. Happy hunting!
[/list][/list]
In order to access any of the singleplayer content or host games, you need the expansion.

However, [i]you do not need the expansion to [u]join[/u] [b]Mazing[/b] lobbies online[/i].[list]
[*]You're also not restricted from getting [b]Mazing Achievements[/b] or getting entries on the leaderboard. It's just going to be a lot harder to practice any of that relying solely on others to host lobbies though.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/01ff11eff947df4a2f7703fedc4786b6073866cb.jpg[/img]
[i]Check out this magical [b]Railgun[/b] snipe that perfectly avoids clipping the terrain or architecture.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Mazing Q&A[/b][/h2]
Below is a list of questions and technicalities we've seen people ask about over the last few months.

[u]What are those yellow Portals I see on certain maps?[/u]
Those are [b]Teleporters[/b]. When creeps pass through one, they appear through a different [b]Teleporter[/b]. You'll be able to see based on how the path line goes through them.


[u]Is it possible to completely block the path?[/u]
No. The game will prevent you from placing the tower or blocker that would block the path. It'll also give you a pop-up message.


[u]Can I build a tower without a blocker beneath?[/u]
Yes! Well, to clarify, if you build a tower on a space without a blocker, it'll build the tower with a blocker beneath it.


[u]How does drag building work in Mazing?[/u]
It works two ways:[list]
[*]If you're drag-building over open space, it'll drag-build over that open space.
[*]However, if you're drag-building and **any blockers** are under the selection box, it'll only build towers on blockers.
[/list]Also, if your drag-build would happen to block the path in any way, it'll cancel your entire drag-build order and give you a message.


[u]I don't have enough Blockers. Why is there a limit at all?[/u]
We chose to have a limit that scales over time so that the game isn't a complete joke at the start of the game due to having a ridiculous path length.

However, there is an option that lets you turn the [b]Blocker Limit[/b] [u]off[/u], and it's accessible in multiplayer, even in [b]Co-op[/b]. Do note that toggling this option will make the run illegible for leaderboard.


[u]Is it me, or do the creeps speed up over time?[/u]
That is not your imagination. Each wave, the creeps speed up just slightly. Their spawn interval also decreases a bit. This way, when you do eventually gain a ludicrous maze, it doesn't take 3 minutes for creeps to get all the way to the end. Even with this in, [b]Mazing[/b] takes longer to clear than the standard game, especially in [b]Co-op[/b].


[u]Is there a separate balance for Mazing?[/u]
No. We decided to keep the balance the same for the whole game. In fact, we actually made some changes back in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1018830/view/6052302851600718389]Version 1.8[/url] to account for [b]Mazing[/b] while also keeping it (theoretically) balanced for the rest of the game. In particular, the shockwave changes on [b]Earth, Quake, & Nova[/b], and the adjustment to [b]Mushroom's[/b] damage formula.


[u]How does Multiplayer work?[/u]
In [b]Mazing FFA & Teams[/b], we've made it so that [b]Casual Mode[/b] is on by default. This means you're not at risk at getting rushed out by someone camping the entrance, which in [b]Mazing[/b], is kind of counterintuitive anyways because you naturally want to make really long mazes. Of course, you're welcome to turn [b]Casual Mode[/b] off and experience the rather... unique game style.

That said though, there's a chance we may do a [b]Mazing Tournament[/b] in a few months, and if we do, [b]Casual Mode[/b] will be off for that.


[u]In Co-op, am I restricted to my color zone?[/u]
You are not. We decided to colorcode the build zones in [b]Mazing Co-op[/b] because A, the maps are way bigger than the standard game, and B, they're a little less intertwined than the standard game. This way, it kind of provides a guide for each player.

However, there's no actual restrictions. You can build in other color zones, and heck, you can even build your towers on allied blockers.


[u]I feel like I've seen the [b]Avalanche[/b] map somewhere before. Is it based off something?[/u]
For those of you that played tower defenses during the [b]Warcraft 3[/b] days, there was a popular map called [b]Wintermaul[/b]. [b]Avalanche's[/b] map design is based off of that, with some tweaks.


[u]I'm one of the crazy people that plays the Co-op Boss Mode. Will there be support for it Mazing?[/u]
For now, no. However, whenever we get around to [b]Version 1.9[/b], we may look into adding it.


[u]Is there a Ranked Mazing?[/u]
For now, no. We're not sure [b]Mazing[/b] is properly balanced, especially since it's not getting a separate balance adjustment. If it plays well over the next few months and there's enough demand for it, we'll consider it.


[u]What about War Mazing?[/u]
Between it being a buggy massacre that'd be a huge pain to fix, and the fact that it's easily the least popular part of the game, probably not. Honestly, we think it would be cool to see it happen, but the truth of the matter is that the mode has numerous design problems that conflict with [b]Element TD 2[/b]. Unless we figure those problems out, we're unlikely to add [b]Mazing War Mode[/b].


If you have any more questions about technical details or suggestions, feel free to ask about them in the comments, on the Steam Forums, or [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url]. There's even a dedicated #mazing channel on there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/0c2f687fa4fd4553657e9e3d8edd63382e767173.jpg[/img]
[i]Yep, this map looks familiar alright.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
Additionally today, we're releasing [b]Version 1.8.3[/b], which contains numerous fixes and improvements, [b]Specialization[/b] tweaks, and *le-gasp* some new [b]Cosmetics[/b]. Read on the full notes!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Version 1.8.3[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Cosmetics[/b][/h3][list]
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Level 45 Demon Watcher
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Level 55 Gyrobot
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Level 65 Lava Ray
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Level 90 Cutie
[*][b]New Hat[/b]: Level 65 Cookie Hat
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/a80a7588684612d97c99952efd7a68a34a39a742.jpg[/img]
[i]The [b]Cookie Hat[/b]: Makes towers 100% tastier! But not necessarily more edible.[/i]


[h3][b]Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Added the ability to adjust [b]Hats on Towers[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Everyone[/b]: See everyone's hats on their towers. This is the default option.
[*][b]Self Only[/b]: Only see your hats on your towers.
[*][b]Nobody[/b]: Hats on towers are hidden. Not that you should do this, unless you're trying to save a bit on performance.
[/list][*][b]Campaign[/b] - You can now toggle [b]Tower Recommendations[/b] on and off in the [b]Loadout[/b].
[*][b]Campaign[/b] - Whenever you press the [b]Ready[/b] button, the game will save state again, so that if you made a bunch of changes during the wave break, you don't have to redo them all on loading checkpoint.
[*][b]Campaign[/b] - There's now an indicator of the mission-specific [b]Achievement[/b] in-game, and whether you've flunked it or not.
[*]When in-game, the [b]Game Mode UI[/b] has been updated to display the primary mode in the middle of the screen. Upon hovering over it, you'll see a list of all the game's modes and modifiers.
[*]The game now remembers the state of the [b]Play Offline[/b] setting in the [b]Singleplayer[/b] menu.
[*]Managed to dampen the snow effect on wintery maps so that it's less foggy on towers and creeps.
[*]Fixed [b]Cannon Tower's[/b] cannons tilting up/down on creeps.
[*]Fixed [b]Impulse Tower[/b] not being highlighted on the [b]Tower Table[/b] when hovering over the 1500 range setting.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Geyser Specialization 1[/b] wasn't reducing its damage by the intended 25%.
[*]Fixed a bug in [b]Mega Survival[/b] where your camera and builder would not start in the proper location on certain maps.
[*]Fixed a bug where, when viewing the [b]Map Previews[/b] in [b]Teams[/b], if you clicked the magnifying glass to zoom in, it'd display the incorrect preview image.
[*]Fixed a visual error between water and [b]Fog of War[/b] that'd make it unusually dark depending on the camera angle.
[/list]

[h3][b]Specializations[/b][/h3]
As we were testing and polishing the [b]Mazing Campaign[/b] out, we ran across numerous [b]Tower Specializations[/b] that were either underwhelming or blatantly silly.[list]
[*][b]Astral[/b][list]
[*][b]Specialization 1[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] Damage increased by 50%. Range reduced to 900.
 -- [b]New:[/b] Damage increased by 60%. Range reduced to 900.
[*][b]Specialization 2[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] Every 9 seconds, this tower shoots up to 12 creeps at once.
 -- [b]New:[/b] Every 12 seconds, this tower shoots at up to 12 creeps at once. Attacks can stack on one creep.
[/list]
[*][b]Darkness[/b][list]
[*][b]Specialization 1[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] Damage increased by 35%. However, attack doesn't bounce on kill.
 -- [b]New:[/b] Damage increased by 40%. However, attack doesn't bounce on kill.
[/list]
[*][b]Poison[/b][list]
[*][b]Specialization 2[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] Damage-per-second reduced by 40%. Duration increased to 35 seconds.
 -- [b]New:[/b] Damage-per-second reduced by 35%. Duration increased to 35 seconds.
[/list]
[*][b]Disease[/b][list]
[*][b]Specialization 1[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] Damage reduced by 25%, but Range increased to 1150.
 -- [b]New:[/b] Damage reduced by 20%, but Range increased to 1150.
[*][b]Specialization 2[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] Damage increased by 25%, but Range reduced to 750.
 -- [b]New:[/b] Damage increased by 30%, but Range reduced to 750.
[/list]
[*][b]Runic[/b][list]
[*][b]Specialization 2[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] Damage increased by 300%, but AoE reduced to 0.
 -- [b]New:[/b] Damage increased by 225%. AoE reduced to 0.
[/list]
[*][b]Vapor[/b][list]
[*][b]Specialization 2[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] Range increased to 1500. Bonus damage per creep reduced to 0%.
 -- [b]New:[/b] Range increased to 1500. Bonus damage per creep reduced to 1% / 2% / 3%.
[/list]
[*][b]Corrosion[/b][list]
[*][b]Specialization 2[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] Damage Amplification increased to 25% / 50%.
 -- [b]New:[/b] Damage Amplification increased to 25% / 50%, but Duration reduced to 4 seconds.
[/list]
[*][b]Mushroom[/b][list]
[*][b]Specialization 2[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] Damage reduced by 30%. Primary target is slowed by 10% / 20% / 30% for 1 second.
 -- [b]New:[/b] Damage reduced by 20%. Primary target is slowed by 20% / 30% / 40% for 1 second.
[/list]
[*][b]Impulse[/b][list]
[*][b]Specialization 1[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] Range increased to 1750, but Damage reduced by 20%.
 -- [b]New:[/b] Range increased to 1900, but Damage reduced by 25%.
[/list]
[*][b]Root[/b][list]
[*][b]Specialization 2[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] Slow is doubled, but Duration is reduced to 2 seconds.
 -- [b]New:[/b] Slow increased to 30% / 60%, but Duration reduced to 3 seconds.
[/list]
[*][b]Geyser[/b][list]
[*][b]Specialization 1[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] Damage is reduced by 25%, but every 3rd attack does a 300 AoE attack.
 -- [b]New:[/b] Damage is reduced by 20%, but every 3rd attack does a 300 AoE attack.
[/list]
[*][b]Muck[/b][list]
[*][b]Specialization 2[/b]
 -- [b]Old:[/b] AoE reduced to 0, but Slow increased to 32% / 64%.
 -- [b]New:[/b] AoE reduced to 0, but Slow increased to 40% / 80%.
[/list][/list]
Lastly, regarding [b]Localization[/b], we're aware it's not fully up to date, especially with the [b]Mazing DLC[/b] and the above changes. We'll be getting it properly updated next week.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Special Thanks[/b][/h2]
We'd like to give a shoutout to everyone that helped us test the [b]Mazing DLC[/b] during the [b]Open Alpha & Beta[/b] periods, as well as everyone that's continued to support the game. Special kudos to [b]wadebbqwall2[/b], for doing the trailer, screenshots, and any promo art you've seen in the past year!

[hr][/hr]

[h2][b]What's Next?[/b][/h2]
Now that we've released the [b]Mazing Expansion[/b], what's next for us? We can't provide too many details yet, but we're working on our next project already. Expect to see a formal announcement about it in [b]Q1 2023[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/f3042a8563b4962b5af91913395290e452246028.jpg[/img]
[i]Well, it's official. [b]Element TD 2[/b] is now a sci-fi game. Have fun mazing![/i]

notes.title: Mazing DLC - Date, Price, and More
notes.content:
Alright, let's get straight to the point here:

The [b]Mazing Expansion[/b] launches on [b]Friday, December 2nd[/b] for $6.99! You can go ahead and [b]Wishlist[/b] the DLC by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2177070/Element_TD_2__Mazing_Expansion/]clicking here[/url].

On top of that, you can get the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1018830/Element_TD_2__Tower_Defense/]base game for 40% off[/url], so if you know any friends you'd like to turn into enemies for a discounted price, now's the best time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/7717d59230e4a88556cd67cfea4eb89505169dbb.jpg[/img]
[i]Coming soon to a Steam Storefront near you![/i]

[hr][/hr]
[b][u]What is the Mazing Expansion?[/u][/b]
This is a DLC that adds a new mode to the game called [b]Mazing[/b]. Here, you build directly on the path, and your towers act as blockers that obstruct and extend the path that creeps must travel to reach the end. This mode is fully supported in both Singleplayer and Multiplayer.

[b][u]What's included in the expansion?[/u][/b][list]
[*][b]Mazing Campaign[/b] featuring 14 Missions, each with their own [b]Achievements[/b]
[*][b]10 New FFA/Teams[/b] Mazing Maps
[*][b]4 New Co-op[/b] Mazing Maps
[*][b]Mazing Leaderboards[/b] for each of the new maps
[*][b]New Achievements[/b] specific to [b]Mazing[/b]
[/list]
[b][u]Do I need the expansion to play online?[/u][/b]
In order to access any of the singleplayer content or host games, you need the expansion.

However, [i]you do not need the expansion to join [b]Mazing[/b] lobbies online[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/1825325eea6bd9426cabbe4cd0bcb3de78d59c3c.jpg[/img]
[i]Mazes in Co-op can get pretty ludicrous.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
That's it for our last info dump before the DLC releases. Thank you to everyone that participated in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1018830/view/3307353067756983979]Open Alpha[/url] / [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1018830/view/3365904302143619029]Open Beta[/url] and assisted in testing and feedback. Just over a week remains till it releases. Look forward to it!

[hr][/hr]
[b][u]Thank you to everyone that participated in the Tournament![/u][/b]
Our first [b]Same Random Tournament[/b] was held this past weekend to great success! 40 people ended up participating in it, helping to give a resurgence in the game and community as a whole. Congratulations to our Top 3 Winners:[olist]
[*]_Tobias_
[*]YOYO
[*]Scamper9
[/olist]
In all likelihood, we'll be running another [b]Same Random Tournament[/b] in a few months, probably following [b]Version 1.9[/b] and another host of balance adjustments. We will also likely do something to make buy/sell abuse riskier in [b]Random[/b] in that version.

In the meantime, [b]Version 1.8.2[/b] (to be released with the [b]Mazing Expansion[/b]) will see [b]Ranked Random[/b] starting from [b]Short Length[/b]. The first 10 waves are basically unpushable and too good for "farming", so cutting them should help for now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/63fc92098e3de86e9c78259769675a5cecdd247d.jpg[/img]
[i]See that horrible use of mazing up top? Don't maze like that. You'll make our designer cry.[/i]

notes.title: Version 1.8.1 - Notifications and Ban Fix
notes.content:
[h2][b]Improvements & Fixes[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Streamlined the [b]Notifications Menu[/b] into a toggle on/off, with a [b]Settings[/b] gear to pull open its own menu

notes.title: Version 1.8 - Turbo Lite, Casual Mode, Spectators, and more
notes.content:
With less than a month left until the [b]Mazing DLC[/b] releases, we're choosing to release [b]Version 1.8[/b] a bit early. It adds some long requested features to the game, like [b]Turbo Lite[/b] and [b]Casual Mode[/b]. Additionally, it brings fixes, improvements, and balance adjustments.

Before we move on to the notes, one last reminder, the [b]Same Random Tournament[/b] will be running next weekend on November 19th-20th. At this point, sign-ups are closed, and we have a total of 48 participants. To those of you that have joined, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1018830/view/6052302851596704379]refresh yourself on the rules[/url]. If you have any questions, please ask on the #tournament-discussion channel on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord server[/url].


With that out of the way, onto the patch notes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/d0598946b3715a632089ce60ba91e43e0b95ef28.jpg[/img]
[i]Just a couple of surf bros vibing to the chaos.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][list]
[*][b]Turbo Lite[/b] added![list]
[*]Game runs at x1.5 Timescale.
[*]This is now on by default for [b]Ranked Pick[/b]
[/list]
[*][b]Casual Mode[/b] added![list]
[*]This is a modifier you can turn on for FFA/Team games. When on, everyone plays the game at their own pace. Clearing the wave first will [u]not[/u] cause the next wave to start for everyone else.
[/list]
[*][b]Spectator Functionality[/b] added![list]
[*]When you're in lobby, you can define yourself as a [b]Spectator[/b], allowing you to [strike]copy[/strike] observe everyone else in the game.
[/list]
[*][b]Mega Survival[/b] added![list]
[*]You can now play the [b]Co-op Maps[/b] from the [b]Singleplayer Menu[/b], allowing you to play it [b]Offline[/b] or even with [b]God Mode[/b] on.
[*]Instead of a "Balanced" path option, you get "2-Path" instead.
[/list][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Improvements & Fixes[/b][/h2][list]
[*][b]Same Random Teams[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Before, everyone had the same set of random elements, which in [b]Teams[/b], was somewhat pointless.
[*]Now, each team will have two sets of elements, which is consistent across all teams.
[/list]
[*][b]Fog of War[/b] can now be turned on/off in Graphics Settings. Set to On by default.
[*]On the end-screen, there's now a statistic for [b]# of First Wave Clears[/b]
[*]Pressing F2 in Co-op should now bounce between each player area, instead of always reverting to the center of the map
[*]Viewing a replay that has [b]Turbo[/b] on no longer locks out viewing at x1 or x0.5
[*]Fixed [b]Front Targeting[/b] not working properly on creeps that have been Shredded, spawned by Spawner, or Resurrected
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Builders[/b] wouldn't properly react to the map terrain on some maps
[*]Fixed an issue where [b]Slingshot Bosses[/b] could only speed up creeps once[list]
[*]In exchange, the effect can no longer stack.
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/cc12916d441ef68028a360ccdd2f8ee44a5465ec.jpg[/img]
[i]Yo dawg, we heard you like [b]Slingshots[/b], so we stuck [b]Slingshots[/b] in your [b]Slingshots[/b] so you can [b]Slingshot[/b] while you [b]Slingshot[/b].[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2][list]
[*][b]Earth[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Shockwave now hits for full damage instead of full/half
[*]Shockwave damage reduced from 50 to 35
[/list]
[*][b]Nature[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 85 to 95
[*]Buff duration reduced from 3 seconds to 1 second
[/list]
[*][b]Disease[/b] damage increased from 150 to 155
[*][b]Solar[/b] buffed:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 230 to 240
[*]Damage-per-second increased from 115 to 120
[/list]
[*][b]Mushroom[/b] formula adjusted:[list]
[*]Previously, it would deal more damage if a creep's speed was below 300, and less damage if it was above 300.
[*]Now it deals 2% more damage per 1% of slow on the creep, and it no longer suffers a damage penalty if a creep is faster than default speed (300)
[*]Damage reduced from 500 to 490
[/list]
[*][b]Nova[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Shockwave now hits for full damage instead of full/half
[*]Shockwave damage reduced from 700 to 500
[/list]
[*][b]Runic[/b] damage reduced from 1150 to 1125
[*][b]Quake[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Shockwave now hits for full damage instead of full/half
[*]Shockwave damage reduced from 1600 to 1250
[/list]
[*][b]Impulse[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Range increased from 1500 to 1650
[/list]
[*][b]Obelisk[/b] explosion and increment damage reduced from 4750 to 4500
[/list]

As usual, courtesies of the balance update, [b]Score Leaderboards[/b] have been reset. Additionally, we've moved on to [b]Ranked Season 5[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/06fa629d6eb225cd7cbeb198509550f306e6ef2d.jpg[/img]
[i]Nope, this isn't [b]War Mode[/b]. That's just a really big [b]Obelisk[/b] explosion.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
That's it for today's notes! We'd like to thank everyone that participated in the recent [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1018830/view/3365904302143619029]Mazing Open Beta[/url]. Lots of fun bugs were fixed over that period, and we're hacking away at making the [b]Mazing DLC[/b] a grand release. Look forward to it [b]December 2nd[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/a812aeba4608ccb399164717066ec9ad4ae057a5.jpg[/img]
[i]Somehow, this was taken using the game's built-in camera controls. [strike]Blame[/strike] Thank [b]Wade[/b] on our [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Discord[/url].[/i]

[hr][/hr]
EDIT: Applied a hotfix that fixes the following:[list]
[*]Toned down lighting on Main Menu backdrop
[*]Optimized damage number display
[*]Fixed an issue where Portals would be gone when viewing a Teams replay
[*]Fixed Teams Portals using the wrong color on some maps
[*]Fixed dark shadows appearing when using Very Low graphics settings
[*]Fixed in-game Menu button pausing the game in Co-op
[/list]

notes.title: Reminder - Tournament on Nov 19th - 20th
notes.content:
For those of you interested in joining the [b]Same Random Tournament[/b], it's your last chance! Tournament sign-ups will close [b]November 11th[/b] at 10am PDT. How to enter:[list]
[*]If you haven't already, [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]join our Discord[/url].
[*]Next, there's a new channel on there called [b]#tournament-signup[/b]. Go there and comment with your name in that channel.[list]
[*]Please note that the name you enter here should be the name you use on both Discord and Steam during the event.
[/list][/list]

And for those of you already signed up, here's a refresher of the details. We also have an update on the tournament structure, game setup, and what to do in case of a desync.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]When and Where?[/b][/h2]
The tournament will be played online, and it'll run from [u]November 19th - 20th[/u]. Each day of the event, we'll start at the following time:[list]
[*]10am PDT (US)
[*]7pm CET (EU)
[*]1am CST (Asia)
[/list]

[h2][b]Tournament Structure[/b][/h2]
As this tournament is being played with less than 64 players, some players are advancing to Round 2 by default. This is determined by sign-up order. If you signed up to the tournament early, congratulations, you automatically advanced to Round 2!

On [b]Day 1[/b], covering Rounds 1 through 4, matches will be [u]Best of 1[/u]. This day will last upwards of 4-6 hours. Players will be expected to check in a half hour before the first match starts.[list]
[*]Some of these matches will have a caster streaming the matches.
[*][b]Round 1[/b] will consist of 32 Players across 16 Matches. The winning 16 will move on to [b]Round 2[/b].
[*][b]Round 2[/b] will consist of 32 Players across 16 Matches. The winning 16 will move on to [b]Round 3[/b].
[*][b]Round 2[/b] will consist of 16 Players across 8 Matches. The winning 8 will move on to [b]Round 4[/b].
[*][b]Round 2[/b] will consist of 8 Players across 4 Matches. The winning 4 will move on to the [b]Semi-Finals[/b].
[/list]
On [b]Day 2[/b], covering Semi-Finals, Bronze Match, and Finals, matches will be [u]Best of 3[/u].[list]
[*]All of these matches will have a caster streaming the matches.
[*][b]Semi-Finals[/b] will consist of 4 Players across 2 Matches. The winning 2 will move on to the [b]Finals[/b]. The losing 2 will move on to the [b]Bronze Match[/b].
[*]The winner of the [b]Bronze Match[/b] will determine [b]Third Place[/b].
[*]The winner of the [b]Finals[/b] will determine [b]First & Second Place[/b].
[/list]

[h2][b]Game Setup[/b][/h2]
First up, for those in the tournament, make sure you're on the [b]Tournament Branch[/b]. The password to get in is restricted to those signed up on the [b]Discord[/b]. Once in:[list]
[*]Once the bracket is posted, the first listed player in their match will host the game. The other player in that match will need to find the game with the correct player's name in the lobby list.
[*]All matches have to be hosted 10 minutes before the game is supposed to start.
[*]Setting up a match is the responsibility of the players, and in the case of any dispute, contact a tournament admin in the relevant match thread. 
[*]In resolving these situations, the rules will be your first place to look. After that a tournament admin makes a ruling and that ruling is final.
[/list]

[h2][b]Rules[/b][/h2]
Each match will be a 1v1 played with the following [b]Settings[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Map[/b]: Random, Non-variant
[*][b]Difficulty[/b]: Very Hard
[*][b]Element[/b]: Same Random
[*][b]Length[/b]: Full
[*][b]Paths[/b]: Standard
[*][b]Game Speed[/b]: Normal
[*][b]Chaos[/b]: Enabled
[/list]
[b]Conditions[/b]:[list]
[*]Anything possible within the bounds of the game mechanics is allowed.
[*]The winner is determined by which player lives the longest before the boss waves, or scores the highest if the game reaches boss waves.
[*]An individual shall be allowed a 10-minute grace period after the scheduled match start time before it is considered that they have failed to show.[list]
[*]In the event of a failure to show, the individual in question will forfeit the game and be considered eliminated from the tournament.
[/list]
[*]At the end of a match all players must submit a screenshot of the results, along with a replay of the match in the dedicated channel or thread on the discord to confirm the results.
[*]Using the in-game chat for [u]any kind of harassment[/u] over the course of a game is warrant for [u]immediate disqualification[/u].
[/list]
[b]In Case of a Desync[/b]:[list]
[*]If there is a [b]Desync[/b], the match will immediately end. Consider that game null, and do a rematch.
[*]If it happens [u]twice[/u], then go by the following:[list]
[*]The one with the most lives before the desync wins that match.
[*]If lives are identical, we go by number of first wave clears. 
[/list][/list]

[h2][b]Prizes[/b][/h2]
The Top 3 will receive an [b]Element TD T-Shirt[/b] as well as cash prizes:[list]
[*][b]1st Place[/b]: $250
[*][b]2nd Place[/b]: $100
[*][b]3rd Place[/b]: $50
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
Lastly, if you are interested in [u]casting/streaming[/u] these matches, please reach out and let us know on the [b]Discord[/b]. We'd love to have as many games casted as possible![list]
[*]Do note, we'll have a [b]Spectator[/b] feature implemented into the game by then, which'll make this a lot easier.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

And that's it for the tournament! [b]Version 1.8[/b] drops tomorrow, and yes, it does include balance adjustments. Ideally, we wouldn't do this right before a tournament, but several features from 1.8 are required to run the tournament properly. Plus said balance adjustments aren't anything too major, and the tournament is [b]Same Random[/b].

notes.title: Mazing Open Beta - Oct 29th to Nov 7th
notes.content:
Welcome to the second open test of the [b]Mazing DLC[/b]. This time, we're opening it up to [b]6 FFA Maps & 3 Co-op Maps[/b], with their visuals fully implemented!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/dbede6741981d83263b76f58d4645a421eb8a3b9.jpg[/img]
[i]Now featuring 50% more trees![/i]

To jump in, [u]just grab the alpha branch[/u] and hit play![list]
[*]To do so, right-click [b]Element TD 2[/b] in your library
[*]Select "Properties"
[*]Go to the "Betas" tab
[*]Select "alpha - Mazing Test this weekend!"
[*]Once downloaded, play at will!
[*][u]Make sure you change your server to DEV[/u]; if you turn on any of [b]Version 1.8's[/b] features, they all require DEV server, or things will break when playing online.
[/list]
This second open test for [b]Mazing[/b] will last until [u]Wednesday, Nov 2nd at 1pm PST[/u].

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]What's New?[/b][/h2]
First off, if you didn't try the first test, check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1018830/view/3307353067756983979]Mazing Open Alpha[/url] post to see how [b]Mazing[/b] works.

Otherwise, we've applied numerous fixes since the last test:[list]
[*]Maps now have visuals!
[*]Maps also have proper previews and mini-maps.
[*]The [b]Blocker[/b] has an updated visual, and it has a bit of height now.
[*]The path will now lock in at the start of the wave, as opposed to "redetermined per creep as they spawn".
[*]The builder now needs to move to build on a blocker.
[*]In [b]Teams[/b], you can now build on allied blockers.
[*]When a player leaves in [b]Teams & Co-op[/b], it will now sell their towers, but not their blockers.[list]
[*]Said blockers should then be selectable by anyone and not contribute towards anyone else's blockers.
[*]Their current blocker limit [u]will not[/u] be redistributed to everyone else. However, future blockers gained will be increased, as there's one less player to divvy to.
[/list]
[*]Fixed an issue where drag-building more blockers than your current limit would result in "invisible blockers".
[*]Fixed creeps going "up" when trying to go through a Yellow Portal on certain maps
[*]Lastly, [b]Version 1.8's[/b] changes are also applied. Check below for the preview!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/3304980e481cd54d76fad9a47c6462793067574c.jpg[/img]
[i]Mazes can get pretty complex. What crazy long mazes can you make?[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Open Beta Feedback[/b][/h2]
To give us feedback, drop a comment below, make a steam thread, or post on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url]. We have a dedicated #mazing channel that you can drop your feedback in and ask questions.

We're looking on feedback on the following things:[list]
[*]How does the difficulty curve feel?[list]
[*]To clarify, in [b]Mazing[/b], creeps move faster than the standard game, and they gradually speed up per wave.
[*]Does this feel fair at the start of the game? Does it scale up too hard?
[/list]
[*]Do you start with too few or many [b]Blockers[/b]? Do you gain enough over time?
[*]Do the maps feel good to play? Do any of them have infuriating quirks that need to be fixed?
[*]What bugs are you running into it?
[*]Does rushing in multiplayer feel bad to play against?[list]
[*]We're considering turning [b]Casual Mode[/b] on for [b]Multiplayer Mazing[/b] by default. For reference, this is a new checkbox that sets everyone at their own pace, meaning the first person to clear the wave [u]doesn't[/u] start the next wave for everyone else.
[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/5a2b34d379e2f92c0ba51f072f60f270da5686dc.jpg[/img]
[i]Something about this map seems... familiar.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Tournament Update[/b][/h2]
Up next a little update on the [b]Tournament[/b]. We'd like to thank everyone that's signed up for the [b]Tournament[/b]! As a result of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1018830/view/6366426385493832583]recent change[/url] to reduce the cap to 64 participants and shorten the period to the 19th-20th, we've got 46 sign-ups so far, leaving 18 spots left. Only 2 weeks left to sign up, so claim your spot!

Secondly, there's some features that are necessary for the [b]Tournament[/b] to run smoothly that are not in the live version of the game. To that end, we've decided we'll be releasing [b]Version 1.8[/b] before the [b]Tournament[/b] instead of after. As for what's included in that update...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/e71798de22f62985a6b014fb5b2021b93013c1a5.jpg[/img]
[i]Who knows, maybe there could be a [b]Mazing Tournament[/b] in the future?[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Version 1.8[/b][/h2]
Expect the following features:[list]
[*][b]Casual Mode[/b][list]
[*]Everyone plays the game at their own pace. Clearing the wave first will [u]not[/u] cause the next wave to start for everyone else.
[/list]
[*][b]Turbo Lite[/b][list]
[*]Game runs at x1.5 Timescale.
[*]This is now on by default for [b]Ranked Pick[/b]
[/list]
[*][b]Same Random Teams[/b][list]
[*]Before, everyone had the same set of random elements, which in [b]Teams[/b], was somewhat pointless.
[*]Now, each team will have two sets of elements, which is consistent across all teams.
[/list]
[*][b]Co-op Sync (attempt #2)[/b][list]
[*]We tried adding a feature in the past version or so that would sync up everyone in a [b]Co-op[/b] game to the host's gamestate each wave. Unfortunately, it was rife with bugs, so it was removed.
[*]That said, we've done some fixes and updates to it, and we're going to try again with it!
[/list]
[*][b]Spectator Functionality[/b][list]
[*]When you're in lobby, you can define yourself as a [b]Spectator[/b], allowing you to [strike]copy[/strike] observe everyone else in the game.
[/list] 
[*][b]Balance Tweaks[/b][list]
[*]In a nutshell, [b]Nature[/b] adjusted for the 2058th time, [b]Mushroom[/b] formula adjusted to no longer suffer from speed boosts, shockwave damage towers hitting for full damage instead of full/half, [b]Impulse[/b] range buff, and other minor buffs.
[/list][/list]
Lastly, there'll be both a [b]Score Leaderboard[/b] reset and [b]Ranked Season 5[/b].

Once the open beta period ends, we'll be shifting testing for the next two weeks to [b]Version 1.8[/b]. Otherwise, [b]Version 1.8[/b] will be releasing on [b]Friday, November 11th[/b]!

[hr][/hr]
We're still on track to release it on [b]Friday, December 2nd[/b]. Expect an info dump next week confirming the [b]Mazing DLC's[/b] price and features. In the meantime, enjoy the open beta!


EDIT: There's a few standout bugs in the Mazing Beta that we're still trying to fix; that said we'll be keeping it open till Monday the 7th. Thanks for the feedback so far, and enjoy the extension!

notes.title: Mazing Open Alpha - Sept 9th to 13th
notes.content:
Can't wait for the [b]Mazing DLC[/b]? You don't have to anymore! At least, for this weekend. Welcome to the first open test of our upcoming [b]Mazing Mode[/b]! Included in it is:[list]
[*]5 FFA/Teams Mazing Maps
[*]2 Co-op Mazing Maps
[*]You can play the above in Singleplayer and Multiplayer
[*]Casual Mode
[/list]
Do note, these maps do not have terrain yet; that's still being worked on.

To jump in, [u]just grab the alpha branch[/u] and hit play![list]
[*]To do so, right-click [b]Element TD 2[/b] in your library
[*]Select "Properties"
[*]Go to the "Betas" tab
[*]Select "alpha - Mazing Alpha this weekend!"
[*]Once downloaded, play at will!
[/list]
This first open test for [b]Mazing[/b] will last until [u]Tuesday, September 13th at 1pm PST[/u].

If you want a preview of how this works, read on below for the details!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]What is the Mazing DLC?[/b][/h2]
This will be a paid expansion that adds a new mode to the game, [b]Mazing Mode[/b]. In the standard game, creeps take a predetermined path to reach the end. In [b]Mazing[/b], the towers you place act as blockers that change the path creeps take to reach the end.

This DLC will contain the following:[list]
[*]Mazing Mode
[*]A 14-Mission long Mazing Campaign
[*]10 FFA/Teams Mazing Maps
[*]4 Co-op Mazing Maps
[*]Leaderboards for Mazing
[/list]
Additionally, it'll be paired with [b]Version 1.8[/b], which will include [b]Turbo Lite[/b], [b]Casual Mode[/b], [b]New Cosmetics & Achievements[/b], and more!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]How Mazing Works[/b][/h2]
While you can place towers down directly, there's a far more efficient way to maze, and that's with the [b]Blocker[/b]. Located on the left side of your [b]Build Bar[/b], you can use this to quickly build up a maze.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YfNrWwv.gif[/img]
[i]As you place [b]Blockers[/b], the path will automatically adjust.[/i]

By default, you'll start with [b]20 Blockers[/b]. Each wave you clear, you gain [b]1 Blocker[/b], and every 5 waves, you gain [b]2 Blockers[/b] instead.[list]
[*]The number of [b]Blockers[/b] you have also acts as your [b]Tower Limit[/b].
[*]These are values we may adjust over time.
[/list]
However, these aren't just for increasing the path length. They also let you build [b]Towers[/b] directly on them.[list]
[*]Selling a [b]Tower[/b] will always leave a [b]Blocker[/b] behind. This way, you don't accidentally open up a hole in your path.
[*]If you place or sell [b]Blockers[/b] in the middle of the wave, they'll be ignored by all currently active creeps.[list]
[*]This prevents you from accidentally opening a hole mid-wave, or routing creeps through an infinite loop via buy/sell abuse of [b]Blockers[/b].
[/list][/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Yd23o3d.gif[/img]
[i]If you place [b]Blockers[/b] mid-wave, they'll be highlighted red, and creeps will walk through them.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Open Alpha Feedback[/b][/h2]
If you'd like to give us feedback on the [b]Mazing Open Alpha[/b], drop a comment below, make a steam thread, or post on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url]. We'll have a dedicated #mazing channel that you can drop your feedback in and ask questions.

For now, we're looking on feedback on the following things:[list]
[*]How does the difficulty curve feel?
[*]Do you start with too few or many [b]Blockers[/b]? Do you gain enough over time?
[*]Do the maps feel good to play? Do any of them have infuriating quirks that need to be fixed?
[*]What bugs are you running into it?
[*]Does rushing in multiplayer feel bad to play against?[list]
[*]We're considering turning [b]Casual Mode[/b] on for [b]Multiplayer Mazing[/b] by default. For reference, this is a new checkbox that sets everyone at their own pace, meaning the first person to clear the wave [u]doesn't[/u] start the next wave for everyone else.
[/list][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]DLC Release Date[/b][/h2]
Although this first test of the mode is fully playable, we are still a few months out from release. Some internal delays pushed us back on our estimates, but now we're back in full force. That said, we still have a number of things we're trying to finish, including:[list]
[*]Finalizing map designs
[*]Actual terrain for each map
[*]Mazing Campaign
[*]Polish and other fixes
[/list]
The [b]Mazing DLC[/b] is expected to release [u]Friday, December 2nd[/u]!

We'll be dropping more details about it in the coming months, including price and other stuff. There will also be more open tests down the road. In the meantime, try out the [b]Open Alpha[/b] this weekend!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gUxN36I.gif[/img]
[i]What are you waiting for? Grab the alpha and hop on in![/i]

[hr][/hr]
EDIT: The latest batch of fixes have made [b]Teams & Co-op[/b] properly playable now. As a result, we've extended the open play period by another day. Have fun mazing!

notes.title: Version 1.7.5 - Interim Balance Update
notes.content:
It's been a while, but we're still here! Today, we're just releasing a balance patch meant to dial in the unstoppable [b]Nature[/b] spam, as well as reduce the overly straightforward spam across the [b]Score Leaderboards[/b].

Note, this does mean there's a [b]Score Leaderboard[/b] reset (but not a [b]Ranked[/b] reset).

Read on for the full page of notes!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2]

[b]General[/b][list]
[*][b]Build Times[/b] adjusted increased by 0.5 seconds across the board, including [b]Upgrade Times[/b]:[list]
[*]For example, this means a [b]Level 1 Single[/b] went up by 0.5 seconds, but a [b]Level 3 Single[/b] went up by a total of 1.5 seconds
[*]Additionally, [b]Level 4 Singles/Periodic[/b] total build time is now 15 seconds
[/list]
[*]HP Scaling in Co-op lowered by 5%

[*][b]Atlantis Co-op Map[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Creeps no longer move 10% faster
[*]Creeps now have 5% more HP
[/list]
[*]The [b]Inferno Boss[/b] (both in [b]Co-op & Campaign[/b]) no longer blows up towers. It now stuns them for 10 seconds, preventing them from shooting, activating abilities, being upgraded, or being sold.
[/list]

[b]Towers[/b][list]
[*][b]Nature[/b] bonus ability damage reduced from +300% to +150% / +175% / +200% / +250%
[*][b]Atom[/b] damage increased from 310 to 315
[*][b]Bloom[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Now starts at max charge when built. Do note, this does not apply to [b]Trickery Clones[/b].
[*]Damage reduced from 360 to 355
[/list]
[*][b]Lightning[/b] nerfed:[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 185 to 180
[*]Level 3 damage reduction per bounce increased from 8% to 9%
[*][b]Vapor[/b] damage bonus per creep reduced from 3% / 6% / 9% to 3% / 5% / 8%
[/list]
[*][b]Solar[/b] buffed:[list]
[*]Impact damage increased from 230 to 240

[/list]
[*][b]Crystal Spire[/b] adjusted:[list]

That's it for this patch! However, before we go today, we have one other thing to bring up...

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Where is the Mazing DLC?[/b][/h2]
We've been teasing it for a long time, and admittedly, there've been some internal delays that keep pushing this back. But rest assured, not only are we working on it and will be able to show you previews soon - you'll be able to play it soon.

Next week, we'll be pushing our first big preview, and with it, we'll be running a weekend-long [b]Open Alpha Test[/b] of the DLC! We'll also be providing you details of what you can expect from the DLC as a whole, as well as the estimated release date.
