notes.title: Version 1.7 - Balance and Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.7[/b] has arrrived! This is a relatively small patch that consists mostly of balance adjustments, fixes and improvements, and by popular demand, the [b]Interest Upgrade[/b] is back! Read on for the full notes.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Improvements & Fixes[/b][/h2][list]
[*][b]Interest Upgrade[/b] is back![list]
[*]Increases your [b]Interest[/b] from 2% to 2.6%
[*]Capped at 1 upgrade
[*]Cannot be randomed
[/list]
[*]The [b]Ban Phase[/b] of [b]Ranked Pick[/b] has been adjusted:[list]
[*]Each player now takes turns banning towers in the order of P1, P2 P2, P1 P1, P2
[*]Each player gets a total of 1 minute across all their bans
[*]If no tower is chosen, or a player presses Confirm, nothing is banned
[/list]
[*][b]Ranked Pick[/b] now starts from [b]Short Length[/b]
[*][b]Short Length[/b] starting gold increased from 1200 to 1300
[*][b]Short Length[/b] can now get Perfection score bonus
[*][b]Short Length[/b] starting score multiplier increased from x3.6 to x3.8
[*]In [b]Co-op[/b], the game state now equalizes after the end of each wave[list]
[*]This should reduce the amount of desyncs in Co-op. In theory. We'll be working on improving this feature more in the coming weeks.
[/list]
[*][b]Replays[/b] will no longer be saved if the game doesn't progress past Wave 1
[*]Fixed an issue that was desyncing [b]Ranked Replays[/b]
[*]Fixed an issue where the [b]Splitter Boss[/b] creeps would remain after a player was eliminated in [b]Co-op[/b]
[*]Fixed [b]Splitter Boss[/b] sub-divisions not being selectable
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2]

[b]General Balance[/b][list]
[*]Fixed an issue where [b]Diminishing Returns[/b] was reducing the damage of all towers
[*][b]Diminishing Returns[/b] increased from 6% to 12% per stack
[/list]

[b]Single Element Towers[/b][list]
[*][b]Level 3 Singles[/b] total cost increased from 2500 to 2750
[*][b]Level 4 Singles/Periodic[/b] total cost increased from 15000 to 16000
[*][b]Light[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 120 to 130
[*]Consecutive damage bonus reduced from 5 to 3
[/list]
[*][b]Darkness[/b] bounce damage increased from 8% to 9%
[*][b]Nature[/b] damage reduced from 95 to 85
[/list]

[b]Dual Element Towers[/b][list]
[*][b]Atom[/b] consecutive damage bonus reduced from 15% to 10%
[*][b]Geyser[/b] adjusted:[list] 
[*]Damage reduced from 1100 to 1050
[*]Ability AoE reduced from 300 / 325 / 350 to 300
[/list]
[*][b]Howitzer[/b] adjusted:[list] 
[*]Damage reduced from 200 to 190
[*]Max AoE reduced from 500 / 600 / 750 to 400 / 500 / 650
[*][b]Infernal[/b] damage increased from 725 to 800
[/list]
[*][b]Lightning[/b] adjusted:[list] 
[*]Damage reduced from 190 to 185
[*]Damage reduction per bounce adjusted from 15% to 15% / 12% / 8%
[*][b]Poison[/b] duration reduced from 17 to 15 seconds
[/list]
[*][b]Solar[/b] adjusted:[list] 
[*]AoE reduced to 0
[*]Impact damage increased from 90 to 230
[*]Debuff damage increased from 90 to 115
[/list]
[*][b]Trickery[/b] duration reduced from 10 / 20 / 60 seconds to 6 / 18 / 54 seconds
[/list]

[b]Triple Element Towers[/b][list]
[*][b]Astral[/b] damage increased from 2100 to 2250
[*][b]Flooding[/b] damage increased from 440 to 470
[*][b]Golem[/b] damage increased from 2400 to 2700
[*][b]Haste[/b] Level 2 max attack speed increased from 5.5 to 6.5
[*][b]Impulse[/b] damage increased from 2850 to 3000
[*][b]Incantation[/b] adjusted:[list] 
[*]Damage increased from 450 to 475
[*]Base amp increased from 10% / 20% to 13% / 26%
[*]Isolated amp reduced from 32% / 64% to 26% / 52%
[/list]
[*][b]Money[/b] damage increased from 3200 to 3300
[*][b]Nova[/b] damage increased from 700 to 750
[*][b]Runic[/b] damage reduced from 1200 to 1150
[*][b]Windstorm[/b] damage-per-second increased from 700 to 725.
[/list]

[b]Quad Element Towers[/b][list]
[*][b]Crystal Spire[/b] adjusted:[list] 
[*]Damage increased from 32000 to 36000
[*]Max spirits reduced from 11 to 10
[/list]
[*][b]Doom[/b] impact damage increased from 1000 to 2000
[*][b]Life Altar[/b] damage and attack speed buff reduced from 40% to 30%
[*][b]Nuclear[/b] radiation damage-per-second increased from 5000 to 6000
[*][b]Obelisk[/b] AoE damage gain per second increased from 6000 to 6250
[*][b]Plague[/b] adjusted:[list] 
[*]Projectile speed increased by 25%
[*]Damage reduced from 700 to 675
[*]Stack duration reduced from 25 to 20 seconds
[*]Now has a max cap of 800 stacks
[*]Plague stacks now persist through Undead’s first death
[*]Plague stacks can now jump to Shielded targets
[*]Fixed an issue where its Plague stacks sometimes wouldn’t find valid targets to jump to
[/list]
[*][b]Rage[/b] adjusted:[list] 
[*]Damage-per-second increased from 4000 to 4500
[*]Damage amp reduced from 25% to 20%
[*]Speed bonus reduced from 60% to 25%
[*]Fixed an issue where the debuff’s duration didn’t refresh when hitting an already affected target
[/list]
[*][b]Railgun[/b] adjusted:[list] 
[*]Max charge increased from 100 to 200
[*]Passive charge rate increased from 10 to 25
[*]Main gun damage increased from 57500 to 62500
[/list]
[*][b]Shredder[/b] adjusted:[list] 
[*]Damage reduced from 16000 to 13000
[*]Split HP increased from 55% to 60%
[/list]
[*][b]Tesla Tree[/b] adjusted:[list] 
[*]Damage increased from 7500 to 8000
[*]Fixed an issue where Tesla Tree could target a Phasing Boss while it’s invulnerable 
[/list][/list]

As per usual, courtesies of the balance update, [b]Score Leaderboards[/b] have been reset. Good luck climbing the ranks again!

Regarding [b]Ranked Season 4[/b], that will start next week on [b]Friday, July 15th[/b]. Apologies for the inconvenience on that.

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Summoner Plushie[/b][/h2]

That's right, we have a plushie. The [b]Summoner[/b] is a design based off the art done for [b]Element TD Mobile[/b]. It's got our logo on the back, and on the front, it's got a nose that might haunt your nightmares.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/12b99dc50c6bda9070fcb28a2afadaef01e9af93.jpg[/img]
[i]Yes, this is a real thing... in theory. Assuming 200 people fund it within the next 20 days.[/i]

If you're interested in acquiring said plushie, [url=https://shop.makeship.com/39sItOP]click here to check it out[/url].

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Mazing DLC Release Window[/b][/h2]

And now for the important news. A while back, we announced we were doing a [b]Mazing DLC[/b] for the game. Although it's been pushed back on more than one occasion, do know it's still coming. Look forward to its release in [b]Early November[/b]! Also look forward to more previews in the coming months. We'll announce the price closer to release.

In the meantime, here's a little teaser of what to expect:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/310ec08187ed3d2ea27c20ffb1c138d8b9bba460.jpg[/img]
[i]No, it's not just a flat plane. At least, not this map.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
Lastly, we'd like to give a special shout-out to [b]Taencred[/b]. A longtime member of [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord server[/url], he's been running QA and testing for us for a long time, and as of more recently, he's been helping us develop future content. [b]Taencred[/b] has been instrumental in the release of [b]Version 1.7[/b], and without him, the game wouldn't be anywhere near as polished, so extra kudos to him!

Other than that, look forward to some potential hotfixes in the next month as we iron our anti-desync measures in [b]Co-op[/b], among other stuff.

notes.title: Interest Upgrade Coming Back
notes.content:
We removed the income upgrade in version 1.6 due to both balance and performance (co-op creep count) reasons.

A lot of players have expressed disappointment with this. I want to apologize for that. An alternative to element upgrades that gives you more gold seems to be what many people want. We have decided to bring back the classic interest upgrade instead.

Coming in version 1.7.

notes.title: Version 1.6.2 - Fixed the Split Game Issue!
notes.content:
For the past few months, [b]Element TD 2[/b] has been plagued by a bug where, when a game loads, half the players would somehow get split into a separate game instance, making them appear as though they're AFK at the start and then die.

We've been doing some heavy debugging recently, and we believe we've found the issue. As it turns out, it wasn't caused by us, but rather, a change from our server backend that interacted poorly with our setup.

A fix has been applied in [b]Version 1.6.2[/b]. If anyone is still encountering this issue, please let us know! In the meantime, we're still working on fixes for the following:[list]
[*]Desyncs in Ranked
[*]MMR search range being off
[*]Being able to pause after you've died
[*]Chaos being incompatible with Co-op Boss Variants
[/list]

We hope have fixes for these out within the next week.

There's also a few other long-time bugs that have been popping up, like the ghost lobby issue, or replays not loading properly, which we're also investigating.

notes.title: Version 1.6 - New Maps!
notes.content:
It's Friday the 13th, and you know what that means? That's right, it's patch time! [b]New Maps[/b],  [b]Map Variants[/b] have [b]Leaderboards[/b], [b]Ranked[/b] now has a [b]Tower Ban Phase[/b], some overdue [b]Lobby UI[/b] updates, tons of bug fixes, the usual balance shenanigans, some love for [b]War Mode[/b], and more!


[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]New Maps[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Cave[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/f010efd339b8d8d72e6fad73205bcca504e3dfb3.jpg[/img]
[i]That's right, we actually added a simple spiral map, which surprisingly was not in the game already.[/i]

[h3][b]Cave Variant[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/a5d1486bbabed13b8204e290ced6084a373bc9e1.jpg[/img]
[i]This map actually comes courtesies of our #map-ideas channel on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url]! With some tweaks, of course.[/i]

[h3][b]Space[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/444add0993d93fd47bdbfd5a9ec5ea5b2a340e14.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Element TD 2[/b]... in space?[/i]

[h3][b]Space Variant[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/f2f7a1c7a896351e3d00eb71e394b4b2b93cc9c3.jpg[/img]
[i]Do I want to know how this map even works?[/i]

[h3][b]Lowlands Co-op Map[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/90fad596598d83710404703d6b2c8a6a00ea019f.jpg[/img]
[i]What a calm, peaceful map! Would be a shame if it was covered in creeps.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Map Variants Updated[/b][/h1]
[b]Variants[/b] now have their own [b]Leaderboards[/b]! And the map selection UI has been improved to help highlight their existence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/fb0089b415913190046322f9ca1c2b37b6d96ac8.jpg[/img]
[i]That's a lot of leaderboards. Start climbing![/i]

Additionally, two of the existing [b]Map Variants[/b] have been switched out for better versions from the [b]Campaign[/b], adapted for FFA/Teams.

[h3][b]Temple Variant[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/9d01548151c48687c45e7bff00a048df1922e803.jpg[/img]
[i]It's like someone took the [b]Temple Map[/b] from [b]Mission 20[/b] and lopped off the sides.[/i]

[h3][b]Wasteland Variant[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/6b4148ceea7c755b000d67b561947dd8b2926013.jpg[/img]
[i]4 separate paths in a FFA Map? Can you even cover everything on the first wave?[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Co-op Boss Versions[/b][/h1]
You'll notice that instead of [b]Co-op Map Variants[/b], we now have [b]Co-op Boss Variants[/b]. Each of these has their own wave order, including some [b]Campaign[/b]-only creeps. Additionally, at the start of every 5th wave, a [b]Boss[/b] will precede the wave.

And yes, these also have their own [b]Leaderboards[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/8cd8ec3486e210ca4be7657dc84a5e4bf7dadba9.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Transference[/b] is here to make everyone suffer.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/759c38ff8d49e014914aef7b8fbb789835534e0a.jpg[/img]
[i]Engage Warp Speed![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/cabd28352518fa58d5a34da3f1e796aaa817c46b.jpg[/img]
[i]Yes, even this diabolical boss has been added on some maps.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Ranked Ban Phase[/b][/h1]

At the start of a [b]Ranked Pick[/b] or [b]Ranked War[/b] match, there's now a 1 minute ban phase:[list]
[*]Both players choose 3 towers to ban, 1 minute to select bans
[*][b]Singles & Support Towers[/b] cannot be banned (1st, 3rd, and 5th rows on Tower Table).
[*]Once both players have chosen their bans (or after a minute has passed), it'll reveal the towers that are banned.
[*]Note, it is possible for both players to ban the same tower. Banning is also optional. That said, 0 to 6 towers can be banned.
[*]A banned tower cannot be built or upgraded to.
[/list]

Additionally:[list]
[*][b]Ranked[/b] now requires both players to accept the match within 30 seconds
[*]Some backend adjustments have been made, which should reduce the chance of desyncs.
[*]In [b]Ranked[/b], if a game desyncs, it'll now compare networths between both players. If the difference in networths is below 1%, it won't kill the game and should instead keep going.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/1ff1085e3b5835fec3a811b764fd9e6434af72d3.jpg[/img]
[i]Now if a tower is OP, you can just ban it. All our balance problems solved![/i] ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list]
[*][b]Lobby & Lobby List UI[/b] updates:[list]
[*]Selecting a map pulls up its own menu.
[*]There is now a magnifying glass icon on the map preview, letting you [b]Zoom In[/b].
[*][b]Co-op Map Previews[/b] show each players' paths as colored lines.
[*]Map previews actually update when you turn on [b]Advanced Paths[/b]. Doesn't apply to [b]Co-op[/b].
[*][b]Lobby List[/b] cleaned up, allowing for all [b]Settings[/b] to be properly visible now.
[/list]
[*]When placing a tower on a spot where another tower already exists, an indicator will tell you that you can't build there.
[*][b]Co-op Portals[/b] now have a different color glow around them, dependent on the player color they're supposed to match.
[*]If a player disconnects, their builder should now vanish.
[*]When viewing a replay, there's now a UI for switching player perspectives.
[*][b]Ranked Replays[/b] should now end when the game ends instead of going further. This includes when a desync happens in the original game.
[*][b]MMR Search Range[/b] no longer scales by games played, everyone gets to search everyone within 375 MMR.
[*][b]Leaderboards[/b] now only show 50 entries instead of 100, halving the load time.
[*]Adjusted how creeps scale visually over time. Should be more consistent than before, and in [b]Chaos[/b] in particular, they'll actually grow properly instead of be all over the place.
[*][b]Campaign[/b] adjustments:[list]
[*]Insane Difficulty option added
[*][b]Inferno Boss[/b] fireball now has a max range of 2000
[*]Halved the number of bosses in the last 5 waves of [b]Mission 25[/b] to account for [b]Inferno Boss[/b] no longer being cheesable
[/list]
[*][b]War Mode[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*][b]Elemental Bosses[/b] are freebies, meaning you don't have to kill the bosses
[*]As a result, there's no longer 30 second breaks every 4 waves
[*]Additionally, you can't get Level 2 Elements until the 4th Pick, Level 3 Elements until the 8th Pick, and Essence Upgrade until the 10th Pick
[*]Non-damage effects no longer affect allied creeps
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/340c1eda86c7b3a2d6ef2cd5125589340c275a2c.jpg[/img]
[i]Wait, there's a second row of maps? Since when were these in the game?[/i]

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][list]
[*]Potentially fixed mid-game spontaneous disconnects, particularly in laggy co-op games
[*]Fixed an issue where people would desync at the start of the game, causing some players to look like they've gone AFK and die immediately
[*]Fixed an issue where the game pausing caused people to get stuck between the loading screen and the game
[*]Fixed a bug in [b]Ranked[/b] where the end-screen wouldn't show up
[*]Fixed a rare bug where a [b]Ranked Game[/b] could somehow be set to Normal Difficulty
[*]In the off-chance a [b]Ranked Game[/b] doesn't load properly, it should no longer count as a win/loss
[*]Fixed an issue where you could see who your ranked opponent is before the match locks in, which allowed you to Alt+F4 and dodge a guaranteed loss vs. HD
[*]Fixed a bug in [b]Boss Hunt Length[/b] where the speed multiplier would decrease over time
[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn't kick someone in lobby under specific circumstances
[*]Fixed FFA lobby settings carrying over into [b]War Mode[/b]
[*]Fixed Advanced Paths, No Interest, & No Sell not showing up as settings in the [b]Lobby List[/b]
[*]Fixed [b]Ronalds[/b] somehow spamming the log
[*]Fixed nullref error on [b]Tropical[/b]
[*]Fixed the [b]Tower Table in Menu[/b] bugging out if you did 11 element picks and pressed reset
[*]Fixed "Aftersock" tooltip
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/3d00e2185c3b484e1841a808eb989dd75c6dad6b.jpg[/img]
[i]Now you can walk away for 30 minutes and return without a loss![/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2]

[b]General[/b][list]
[*][b]Income Upgrade[/b] has been removed from the game[list]
[*]Rather than being an "interesting choice" alongside the [b]Element Picks[/b], it's just money with no real downside. We tried various iterations of it, but as the balance kept shifting, trying to get this right was a real pain. Ultimately, we decided to gut it from the game, in favor of "do something more interesting with that 11th Element Pick".
[*]To clarify, the version that's in the [b]Campaign[/b] still exists.
[/list]
[*][b]Periodic[/b] damage reduced from 55000 to 52000
[*][b]FFA Base HP[/b] increased from 120 to 125
[*][b]Co-op Base HP[/b] increased from 150 to 160
[*][b]War Base HP[/b] increased from 125 to 150
[*]The backend adjustments made to reduce desyncs affected the accuracy of range and AoE. It's relatively minor, but you may notice towers clipping spots a little easier than before.
[/list]

[b]Duals[/b][list]
[*][b]Atom[/b] damage reduced from 330 to 310
[*][b]Poison[/b] duration increased from 16 to 17 seconds
[*][b]Disease[/b] reworked:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 95 to 150
[*][b]Old Effect[/b]: Deals more damage the lower the target's HP is. Formula = [(Max HP/Current HP) + 1]
[*][b]New Effect[/b]: Deals 2.5% / 3% / 4% more damage per 1% HP the target is missing
[/list]
[*][b]Vapor[/b] damage increased from 1100 to 1150
[*][b]Ice[/b] damage increased from 825 to 850
[*][b]Solar[/b] damage-per-second reduced from 120 to 110
[*][b]Infernal[/b] damage increased from 700 to 750

notes.title: Version 1.666 - Added Rollback!
notes.content:
Do you hate desyncs? Then hate no longer, because as of this update, [b]Desyncs[/b] are a thing of the past. We've gone and replaced our unstable netcode with [b]Rollback[/b]! But what exactly is [b]Rollback[/b]?

In a nutshell, [b]Rollback[/b] netcode is a way to send commands instantly, by assuming you're doing what you did last, and in the off-chance you do something different, things might jump around here or there a bit, but only by a few frames.

But what if you desync? Fear not, feeble minds, because [b]Rollback[/b] will just roll back the desync to when it didn't happen, and everyone will be [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Eo-KmOd3i7s]in sync[/url]. That is 100% how it works and if you doubt us, try it for yourself on our alpha branch. Just right-click [b]Element TD 2[/b] --> Properties --> Betas, and switch to the alpha branch.

In addition to [b]Rollback[/b], we're adjusting the game's balance, particularly with [b]Quad Element Towers[/b]. They're not quite living up to their roles, so we're giving them some minor improvements that should allow each one to truly feel unique.

[hr][/hr]

[h2][b]Quad Balance[/b][/h2][list]
[*][b]Quad Elements[/b] can now go on double dates.
[*][b]Railgun's[/b] main gun now has truly global range and can snipe creeps from one game to another. This is what cross-region play was meant for.
[*][b]Singularity[/b] now pulls nearby towers into it, exploding once it reaches a certain threshold. Damage and area is proportional to the total value consumed.
[*]Selling a [b]Doom[/b] tower no longer nets you gold, but instead reduces an opponent's life by 1.
[*][b]Phantom Zone[/b] tower has been renamed to the [b]Twilight Zone[/b] tower. It will now question the moral sanctity of everything you believed was real, and more.
[*][b]Plague[/b] can be found in the decontamination wing, next to the corpses of [b]Poison & Disease[/b] towers.
[*][b]Crystal Spire[/b] no longer has a cap to its spirit count.
[*][b]Tsunami's[/b] tidal wave improved to wash creeps off the path. Spamming it too much will flood the map and drown your towers.
[*][b]Obelisk[/b] has been adjusted:[list]
[*]Base damage reduced from 4000 to 0
[*]Range increased from 900 to 3000
[*]Should it train on a single target long enough to trigger an explosion capable of enveloping the map, it will now crash the game.
[/list]
[*][b]Rage[/b] now attacks nearby towers, and if there's no towers in range, it'll free itself from the ground and go after your [b]Builder[/b].
[*][b]Archdruid[/b] has been improved to be able to throw your towers into other locations. Relocate with ease!
[*][b]Life Altar[/b] no longer costs lives to activate its ability. Instead, it gives lives to your opponents. There's no need for sacrifice here.
[*]Due to lack of use, [b]Tesla Tree[/b] has been removed from the game and been replaced with [b]An Actual Tree[/b]. Plant more to save the world.
[*][b]Gravity Cannon[/b] can now adjust the gravitational constant of the universe. It's quite simple, really.
[*]Building a [b]Nuclear[/b] will cause a meltdown that annihilates your map and causes you to forfeit. What did you think would happen if you built it?
[*][b]Shredder[/b] can now split creeps indefinitely, halving their size every time. Observe as thousands of miniature [b]Ronalds[/b] take over the game!
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

Lastly, we'd like to address the release date for this patch. Normally, when we drop patch notes, we release the patch at the same time. However, in an effort to help hype everyone up, we've decided to post these notes early.

[u]You can expect to play [b]Version 1.6 w/ Rollback[/b] on Friday, May 6th, 2666[/u]. The added years is just to make sure we release on time. As you well know, we have a tendency to miss our estimates. However, we have a fallback. In case we somehow miss that date, we'll just [u]roll it back[/u], and it'll be out on time.

notes.title: Try to desync on Alpha Branch!
notes.content:
Since before release, [b]Element TD 2[/b] has suffered from desyncs, a problem where the game state isn't synced up by the end. We've tried numerous fixes to hack it down over time, but we were never successful.

However, in our upcoming [b]Version 1.6[/b], we've made some more adjustments, and so far from testing, we have yet to desync. This isn't the first time this has happened from testing though, so in order to help cement this (or debunk it), we'd like to ask you all to help.

To try it out, first switch to [b]Alpha Branch[/b]!


[h2][b]Alpha Branch[/b][/h2]
We're opening this to the public! No more password, and no more [b]Discord[/b] only. To access the [b]Alpha Branch[/b], right-click [b]Element TD 2[/b] --> Properties --> Betas. Once you have it, you'll be able to try all the latest changes from our upcoming version!

However, it comes with some limitations:[list]
[*]Finding multiplayer games is version locked. If you're on alpha, you'll only be able to find and play with others on alpha.
[*]Scores pulled off on alpha won't submit to the [b]Score Leaderboard[/b].
[*][b]Ranked Games[/b] will not affect your MMR.
[*]Replays from older versions will not run properly due to balance adjustments.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b]Testing Desyncs[/b][/h2]
You don't have to do anything special to try and desync the game. Just hop onto alpha branch, convince your friends to join, and play together! If the game does desync, [u]a pop-up will appear and let you know[/u]. Should this happen, please let us know and post logs of it on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url].[list]
[*][b]Logs[/b] can be found here - C:\Users\%username%\AppData\LocalLow\Element Studios\Element TD 2
[*]Post your [u]player.log[/u] and said [u]replay file[/u] to the [b]#alpha-bugs[/b] channel
[*]If multiple people from the same desynced game could also post a screenshot of the end score screen, that would also help considerably
[/list]
Our hope is that desyncs are at least minimized compared to before. If you play on alpha branch and don't encounter any desyncs, consider that a win!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Version 1.6.alpha Changes[/b][/h2]
In addition to our desync fixes, the upcoming version contains some other new features, some that you can try out right now! Included so far is:[list]
[*][b]Ranked Mode[/b] requires a double-accept confirmation prompt
[*][b]Ranked Mode[/b] now has a [b]Ban Phase[/b]!
[*]Numerous WIP balance adjustments
[/list]
You can read all the changes on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url] in the [b]#alpha-notes[/b] channel. If you have any feedback on the changes so far, let us know in the [b]#testers[/b] channel. We also have regular test games in that channel, so if you're looking for players to play with on alpha branch, try there!

We also have a few more features we plan to add by the time [b]Version 1.6[/b] officially launches, like new maps and improved Lobby UI, so look forward to that!

notes.title: Mazing DLC & More Maps coming!
notes.content:
It's been close to year since [b]Element TD 2[/b] officially released. Since then, we've added [b]Quad Element Towers[/b], applied numerous balance patches, added tons of Quality-of-Life features, done a bunch of bug fixes, and more!

However, we still have plans for more content. We did some posts last year about this ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1018830/view/3077622559087688041]What's next for Element TD 2[/url] & [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1018830/announcements/detail/2959410043901560991]Roadmap - Next Few Versions[/url]); this post will be also addressing those things + other stuff we're unfortunately not committing to, and reasons for said things.

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Mazing DLC[/b][/h1]
Since our announcement last year about [b]Mazing DLC[/b], many of you have expressed curiosity and excitement about it, and thus far we've remained largely silent. Most of our work in the past half year has gone to [b]Version 1.4's Quad Towers[/b] and addressing fixes for it, so we still don't have anything to show you for [b]Mazing[/b] yet; however, we can confirm it's in-progress and in a working state.

Due to the amount of content we're packing into this mode, it will be sold as a [b]DLC[/b]. We don't have an exact price for it yet, but we can confirm it'll contain the following things:[list]
[*][b]2 Chapters[/b] worth of a [b]Mazing Campaign[/b]
[*]Mazing versions of at least 8 FFA/Teams Maps & 3 Co-op Maps
[*][b]Mazing Leaderboards[/b]
[*]For multiplayer, only the host will be required to have the [b]Mazing DLC[/b]; everyone without the DLC will be able to join their games.
[/list]
Expect [b]Mazing DLC[/b] to release [b]Q3 2022[/b]!

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]More Maps[/b][/h1]
Our [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url], we recently announced we'll be adding new maps to the game, and have since created a #map-ideas channel for people to post their ideas. Many of you have responded with numerous map designs, both for [b]FFA/Teams & Co-op[/b].

Not every one of these will be included (that'd be way too many), but we're looking to add a good few in the next update. In addition to these maps, this update will also include:[list]
[*][b]Variants & Reversed[/b] versions of maps given new wave orders
[*]Improved [b]Map Selection[/b]
[*]Improved [b]Lobby & Lobby List UI[/b]
[*]More balance updates tailored towards making [b]Quads[/b] a supplement to the game, not a requirement
[/list]
With this update, not only will there be new maps to play with, but some of the existing maps that have been overshadowed will receive some love, too.

The [b]More Maps Update[/b] is coming in [b]Version 1.6[/b] and will see a release by [b]Early May[/b], possibly sooner.

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Cancelled Plans[/b][/h1]
Now to address the downer news. In the past, we've promised updates to certain parts of our game that we wanted to add more of. However, in the interests of prioritizing stuff that benefits the larger playerbase (like the above two updates), or things that are simply "too late to add", we've had to cancel plans for these things.

[h2]Chapter 5 of the Campaign[/h2]
For those of you that have played all the way through the [b]Campaign[/b], you'll know that the later missions are somewhat ridiculous in scale, especially all of [b]Chapter 4[/b]. Not only that, but the amount of upgrade points you eventually get lets you create some truly game-breaking builds by the end (if you know what you're doing).

In order to extend the [b]Campaign[/b] by another full [b]Chapter[/b], it'd involve maintaining a somewhat similar scale, while also addressing how powerful your upgrades are at that point. Each mission of [b]Chapter 4[/b] already took an insane amount of time to create, and that'd only get worse for [b]Chapter 5[/b]. Ultimately, we've deemed it's not worth the roughly estimated 4-6 months it'd take to extend the existing [b]Campaign[/b].

Instead, we'll be pouring our efforts into the [b]Mazing Campaign[/b] that'll be introduced in the [b]Mazing DLC[/b], as noted above. It'll start the upgrade tree over but progress faster than the original campaign. Expect that to be roughly the length of [b]Chapters 2 & 3[/b] combined.


[h2]Ranked Teams[/h2]
This one's been requested quite a bit. The reason we haven't added this though is because our backend for [b]Ranked[/b] only supports 1v1, and the effort it'd take to support 2v2 is more than it sounds like. Plus, until we figure out the eternal [b]Desync Issue[/b], [b]Ranked Teams[/b] would suffer from that far more than current [b]Ranked[/b] already does.


[h2]An Actual Tutorial[/h2]
To be frank about this one, the main reason we haven't added a full-blown tutorial to the game is, well... it should've been implemented from the start. We know the game is fairly unintuitive to learn, and while the early [b]Campaign[/b] somewhat addresses some basics, it's a far cry from what's necessary.

However, that doesn't mean we're giving up on this entirely. Expect to see more tips on the loading screen, as well as tips in the [b]Customize Towers[/b] section of the game. We may also find other UI upgrades to the game that could help out. There's also a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2360427994]Beginner's Guide[/url] in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1018830/guides/#scrollTop=0]Steam Guides[/url] section.


[h2]Expanding War Mode[/h2]
Contrary to the lack of support on our end for [b]War Mode[/b], we actually really like this mode. Unfortunately, it hasn't exactly taken off, and it has its own set of problems that make it more problematic to deal with than the standard game. We do have a few things left we're going to try for fixing this mode (like higher Base HP & HP Scaling), but other than that, plans for [b]4v4 War Mode[/b] and other expansions to it have been dropped, sadly.


[h2]Workshop Support[/h2]
This has easily been the most requested feature to get added to the game. Ultimately, the reason we can't add it though is because our backend does not support it at all. In order to do so, we'd have to do some major overhauls, which would not only take forever, but would be likely to break a lot of things, thus taking yet more time.

[hr][/hr]

As always, we'll continue to support the game with our usual updates. Balance, QoL, bug fixes, new cosmetics, etc. And we're still trying to track down that elusive [b]Desync Issue[/b], as always. If you've got any logs and replays that can help us track it down, hop onto our [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Discord Server[/url] and post them in #bug-reports.

Thanks for reading our giant wall-of-text, and hope you look forward to our future updates!

notes.title: Version 1.5 - Quad Balance and Ranked S3
notes.content:
Welcome to [b]Version 1.5[/b]! It's been a few months since we added [b]Quad Element Towers[/b], and overall, the reception has been decent. Build options were expanded, creative compositions were invented, and as per usual, you all broke the game. Instead of filling more specific roles, certain [b]Quads[/b] ended up soloing the game. And some [b]Quads[/b] were just outright bad.

To that end, balance this patch was focused on bringing down the outliers while giving some love to underpowered towers. Not just [b]Quads[/b], but everything.

Other than that, we've got [b]Ranked Season 3[/b], various fixes and improvements, and a couple new builders. Without further ado, read on for the notes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/722f772cf9fcf949c80d6f8bfe80a1b7b58ad817.jpg[/img]
[i]Accurate rendition of how [b]Version 1.4[/b] was played.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Features & Improvements[/h2][list]
[*][b]Ranked Season 3[/b] has begun! Climb up the ladder in a hopefully more balanced game than before.
[*]Two new [b]Builders[/b] added:[list]
[*][i]Level 60[/i] - Bone Drake
[*][i]Level 70[/i] - Demon Summoner
[/list]
[*]In [b]Co-op[/b], Path Indicators are now color-coded, move faster, and linger longer.
[*][b]Element Prompt[/b] now continues to remain up and doesn't act as an input blocker. Has an X button to manually close it out.
[*]When building a Buff Tower ([b]Blacksmith, Well, Trickery & Life Altar[/b]), it'll now highlight towers in range of its buff.[list]
[*]You can also see this by hovering over its ability icon.
[/list]
[*]When hosting a lobby, it'll keep your settings from the last time.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/29a09445f6106b2d77c826b0a97130f56827600a.jpg[/img]
[i]Who knows, [b]Crystal Spire[/b] might actually be useful afterall? Nah, probably not.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where a tower would continue to exist way off-screen for about 10-15 seconds after it was sold.[list]
[*]This included [b]Trickery Clones[/b] when they expire.
[*]Since it's way off-screen, it's not in-range for most towers... but certain ones were coded a bit differently and didn't care. Particularly [b]Railgun, Crystal Spire, & Obelisk[/b]. All three of these, in conjunction with [b]Trickery[/b], resulted in basically double damage output. [i]Especially[/i] [b]Railgun[/b].
[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug with [b]Railgun[/b] where its main gun would be hitting twice.[list]
[*]So instead of dealing 75k damage, it was dealing 150k damage.
[*]This + the [b]Sell-Trickery[/b] bug resulted in extreme silliness.
[/list]
[*]Fixed not being able to select and kick someone in lobby.
[*]Fixed a bug where ctrl+upgrade building from [b]Tower Table[/b] wouldn't update the [b]Damage Table[/b].
[*]Fixed an issue with the Average Damage checkbox on the [b]Damage Table[/b] where, at the end of the game, it'll list stuff like "In,fin,ity Damage" and -1 on tower counts and the like.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could bypass the tower limit in non-FFA by holding Shift.
[*]Fixed [b]Life Altar[/b] listing 0 + 200 for its AoE stat, instead of just 200.
[*]Fixed a bug where, if multiple [b]Trickeries[/b] were in range of a chain of [b]Tesla Trees[/b] and you switched them from manual to auto-cast, they would all clone the [b]Tesla Tree[/b] chain, resulting in a hilariously laggy amount of clones, depending on how much multiplication you did.
[*]Fixed being able to get the [b]Monument[/b] Achievement on [b]Easy[/b].
[*]In [b]War[/b], fixed a rare issue where creeps stop spawning.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/b29721bb74b2914d6f4701d76c18dc4338252d23.jpg[/img]
[i]This caption is here just to confuse you.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Balance[/h2]

[b]General Balance[/b][list]
[*]Fixed ridiculously stupid logic error that applied Teams Base HP & HP Scaling to FFA. This was legitimately in place since 1.4.2. Words cannot describe.[list]
[*]Expect the game to be up to 10% easier through Wave 55, and start 30% easier from the first Boss Wave.
[/list]
[*][b]Diminishing Returns[/b] bumped back up from 5% to 6%
[*][b]Level 3 Boss HP[/b] reduced by 10%
[/list]

[b]Co-op[/b][list]
[*]Wave timer reduced from 8 to 5 seconds
[*][b]Atlantis[/b] creep movespeed increased by 10%
[*][b]Tundra[/b] creep HP increased by 20%
[*][b]Pinnacle[/b] creep movespeed & HP increased by 10% (except on the long paths)
[/list]

[b]Singles & Duals[/b][list]
[*][b]Light[/b] projectile speed increased by 10%
[*][b]Darkness[/b] projectile speed increased by 15%
[*][b]Nature[/b] damage increased from 90 to 95
[*][b]Atom[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 315 to 330
[*]Stack carryover rate increased from 25% to 30%
[/list]
[*][b]Lightning[/b] damage increased from 180 to 190
[*][b]Trickery[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Clone damage reduced from 40% / 120% / 360% to 30% / 90% / 270%
[*]Clone duration increased from 15 to 20
[*]Clones now carry over [b]Cursed[/b] stacks from the original tower
[/list]
[*][b]Poison[/b] duration increased from 15 to 16
[*][b]Ice[/b] damage increased from 800 to 825
[*][b]Vapor[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 2000 to 1100
[*]Damage bonus per creep increased from -4% / 0% / 4% to 3% / 6% / 9%
[/list]
[*][b]Solar[/b] damage-per-second increased from 110 to 120
[*][b]Bloom[/b] damage increased from 350 to 360
[*][b]Geyser[/b] ability AoE increased from 300 to 300 / 325 / 350
[/list]

[b]Triples[/b][list]
[*][b]Laser[/b] damage loss per nearby creep reduced from 1000 to 750
[*][b]Haste[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Projectile speed increased by 33%
[*]Attack speed gain per attack reduced from 7% to 6%
[*]Max attack speed increased from 5 to 5.5
[/list]
[*][b]Golem[/b] damage increased from 2300 to 2400
[*][b]Money[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 3400 to 3200
[*]Damage gain based on unspent gold increased from 15% / 30% to 20% / 40%
[*]Tower now passively gives you 5 / 20 gold every 15 seconds
[/list]
[*][b]Corrosion[/b] damage-per-second reduced from 160 to 150
[/list]

[b]Quads[/b][list]
[*][b]Railgun[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Static field range reduced from 900 to 750
[*]Main gun damage reduced from 75000 to 57500
[*]Passive charge rate increased from 7 to 10
[/list]
[*][b]Doom[/b] debuff damage reduced from 7500 to 7000
[*][b]Phantom Zone[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Shockwave now applies damage in Full/Half AoE, just like all other AoE in the game
[*]Shockwave damage conversion reduced from 30% to 25%
[/list]
[*][b]Plague[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage no longer reduces by 2% per second
[*]Duration increased from 20 to 25 seconds
[*]Bounce range increased from 1200 to 1500
[/list]
[*][b]Crystal Spire[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 22000 to 32000
[*]Attack speed reduced from 0.66 to 0.5

[/list]
[*][b]Tsunami[/b] clones will now try to automatically trigger their shockwave right before they expire
[*][b]Archdruid[/b] damage now scales by the amount of path skipped. For reference, skipping half the path on Forest will result in a 50% damage increase
[*][b]Life Altar[/b] adjusted:[list]

As per usual, with all our major balance patches, [b]Score Leaderboards[/b] have been reset. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/293ed01fa2fe33abc2050300b4305baebc2d7885.jpg[/img]
[i]Maybe now that he generates a small amount of actual money, this bad boy could have a comeback! Or not.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
That's it for [b]Version 1.5[/b]! I know it's lighter than our usual fare, but that's because we're working on larger things in the background. We'll have a post up later this month detailing more post-release content for [b][strike]Railgun TD 2[/strike] [strike]Tesla Tree TD 2[/strike] Element TD 2[/b]. In the meantime, enjoy the patch!

notes.title: Version 1.4.4 - Hotfixing Campaign Fog and War Mode
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]In Campaign, fixed [b]Fog of War[/b] restarting to what it looks like Wave 1 when you load a checkpoint
[*]In War, fixed an issue where [b]Dimensional Rift[/b] can start two waves at once
[*]Added an in-game clickable [b]Menu Button[/b], in case you find your keyboard randomly disconnecting in the middle of a match
[*]In the Ranked tab, added a text blurb that mentions [b]Ranked Season 3[/b] will be starting [b]March 4th[/b].
[/list]

That's all for the hotfix, and the above date is also when [b]Version 1.5[/b] will be dropping. This will largely just be fixes, quality of life, balance, and cosmetics. The attempt at adding [b]15 Quad Element Towers[/b] may have broken more things than we thought, and said patch will be addressing all of that, so look forward to that!

notes.title: Version 1.4.3 - Hotfixing Exploits and More
notes.content:
Since [b]Version 1.4's[/b] release, we've seen numerous bugs and exploits get reported. Some of these took a little longer to get fixed, but with this hotfix, hopefully they're gone for good! At least until the next time we break things with a big update.

[h2]Fixes & More Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Abilities can no longer be cast while a tower is under construction
[*]Fixed a major exploit with upgrade-cancelling that could be used to refresh abilities, like [b]Windstorm[/b] tornado, [b]Astral[/b] extra shots, etc.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could upgrade-cancel [b]Astral[/b] or [b]Runic[/b] to refresh their ability cooldowns
[*]Fixed a bug where upgrade-cancel removes [b]Cursed[/b] stacks & the [b]Cannot-be-cloned[/b] debuff
[*]Fixed a bug where upgrading/sidegrading a tower removes buffs from it
[*]Fixed a bug where an incomplete buff tower will cast its buff before construction finishes
[*]Fixed a bug where towers can be buffed while in mid construction/upgrade
[*]Fixed a bug where loading a checkpoint in Campaign would "break [b]Tesla Trees[/b]"
[*]Fixed a bug in Campaign with AMD FSR offsetting spawn indicators
[*]Fixed a bug in Campaign with AMD FSR offsetting everything in Mission 6
[*]Fixed [b]Quake[/b] Earthshaker Specialization not increasing shockwave AoE
[*]Fixed [b]Life Altar[/b] not recovering your lives over 50 in the Campaign
[*]Fixed [b]Elemental Diversity[/b] Achievement in War requiring you to cast all 8 abilities, it now just requires casting each of the elemental abilities once
[*]Fixed tower count on [b]Damage Table[/b] being bugged if you did a max-level tower upgrade from tower table
[*]Fixed an issue where increasing the timescale in a replay would be inconsistent with the actual result.[list]
[*]This [i]might[/i] be related to a somewhat common desync problem.[/list]
[*]Fixed an issue in [b]Ranked[/b] where the game could desync and you could still somehow gain or lose MMR
[*]Additional fix in [b]Ranked[/b], in the case you desync but you try to leave to the main menu before the desync detector kicks in and nulls the match, it should no longer count as a loss
[*]In [b]Ranked[/b], if you die first but win by score, you're no longer listed as Rank 2
[*]On the [b]Ranked Leaderboards[/b] screen, added a notification that tells you when the current season ends.
[/list]

On that last point, we're trying to lock down some consistency for [b]Ranked[/b] seasons. Each season reset will either line up with a new patch or be released close to one. And the date will always been active. In general, expect about 4-month long season resets going forward.

Regarding [b]Version 1.5[/b], it's going to be a somewhat light patch as we transition into our next goal. Expect a mix of balance adjustments, bug fixes, optimizations and cosmetics. We're intending on releasing it sometime in the second half of [b]February[/b]. We'll also have an update on our future plans by then, so look forward to all of that!

notes.title: Version 1.4.2 - Hotfix
notes.content:
This past week, we released [b]Version 1.4[/b], which introduced [b]Quad Element Towers[/b] to the game! So far, they've been received quite positively. However, in our testing for the big release, we overlooked a few interactions, which led to some massively skewed balance. We were expecting various abuse tricks to be found over the next month or so, just not to this extent:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/384e174eacb0a060cf39956095439f122fae78bd.jpg[/img]
[i]They look like [b]Co-op[/b] scores, but they're in fact [b]Pick[/b] scores.[/i]

Today's hotfix fixes the overly busted interactions, as well as optimizing certain lag issues. Because the fixes will break most existing replays, [u]we had to reset the [b]Score Leaderboards[/b][/u]. We apologize for this inconvenience, but we shouldn't need to reset again until the next major version.

[h2]Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]In [b]Teams/Co-op[/b], if a player leaves or disconnects and fails to reconnect, the following should happen now:[list]
[*]Their towers are sold
[*]Their unspent gold is evenly distributed among all allies
[/list]
[*]Fixed difficulty column showing up as blank for [b]Co-op & Teams Leaderboards[/b]
[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn't manually target with [b]Gravity Cannon[/b]
[*][b]Gravity Cannon[/b] VFX should look fancier and 50% more performant
[*]Fixed [b]Trickery[/b] casting its buff VFX for each clone in a [b]Tesla Tree[/b] chain, resulting in both a bright flare and extreme lag
[*]Cast VFX for [b]Blacksmith, Well & Trickery[/b] have been updated
[*]Toned down mega-brightness of [b]Tesla Tree[/b], especially when you had a whole lot of them
[*]Drastically optimized [b]Tesla Tree[/b], it was using a laggy shader on its beams, as well as its water effect
[*]Drastically optimized [b]Railgun[/b], it had an issue with its garbage collection which caused the game to get progressively laggier
[*]Optimized [b]Rage[/b], replaced a laggy shader on its lava
[*]Fully updated the Romanian localization
[*]Updated French and Russian localization
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2][list]
[*]In [b]Teams[/b], solo players no longer have a lower HP scaler than team players[list]
[*]Due to the lower HP scaler, solo players could rack up a massive interest advantage and somehow end up with higher scores, despite the potential team synergy
[*]Dialed down [b]Teams[/b] HP Scaler just slightly, regardless of team size
[/list]
[*][b]Vapor[/b] damage reduced from 1650 to 1600
[*][b]Railgun[/b] has been adjusted:[list]
[*]Railgun damage increased from 75000 to 80000
[*]Railgun passive charge rate increased from 5 to 7 per second
[*]When its Static Shockwave gains enough charge to reach 100 and fire the Railgun, excess charge now carries over instead of restarting from 0
[/list]
[*][b]Singularity[/b] has been adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 14000 to 15000
[*]There's now a 2 second pull-immunity duration after getting hit by [b]Singularity[/b]
[/list]
[*][b]Life Altar[/b] can now cast its ability at [b]1 Life[/b][list]
[*]To clarify, it'll only buff what it has the life capacity to buff. If you're at 1 Life and you try to activate [b]Life Altar[/b], it'll just buff itself because that costs 0 Lives.
[/list]
[*][b]Tesla Tree[/b] has been adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 8000 to 7500[list]
[*]This was applied in the [b]1.4.1 Hotfix[/b], just noting it here for consistency
[/list]
[*]If [b]Tesla Tree[/b] or any of its clones within that chain are affected by [b]Cursed[/b] in any way, it now treats the chain as one big tower and purges all clones, regardless of proximity.
[*]Additionally, [b]Cursed AoE[/b] now triggers around the [b]Tesla Tree[/b] that made the killing blow, not the "first tower" in the chain.
[/list]
[*]Buff Priority of [b]Level 4 Singles & Periodic[/b] raised to be higher than [b]Tesla Tree[/b]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

Lastly, there have been reports of the servers being a bit wonky this week. Unfortunately, this one's out of our control. Our servers are based in [b]Azure[/b], and something appears to have happened on their end. As soon as the issue is fixed and we're able to make an update, we'll update this post to let you know.


We hope the new [b]Quad Element Towers[/b] have been fun for everyone, and wish everyone the best for the holidays! As for what's next, we'll provide an update in [b]January[/b]. In the meantime, see you all in-game!

notes.title: Version 1.4 - Quad Element Towers
notes.content:
It's been 16 years since [b]Element TD[/b] was originally released back in WarCraft III. Since then, we've ported it many times, eventually leading to [b]Element TD 2[/b]. In all that time, some towers were changed out, but we never truly added new ones.

[u]Until now.[/u]

After 16 years, [b]Element TD 2[/b] finally adds [b]15 New Towers[/b]! Combine 4 different elements to form powerful [b]Quad Element Towers[/b]! From global ranged snipers, to revamped classics, to chucking creeps forward, we've got a lot of brand new effects ready to change how you approach your favorite builds! Except [b]3 Element Builds[/b]. They've got enough love already.

On top of that, we have a new GPU performance feature called [b]AMD FSR[/b]. There's also [b]New Cosmetics, Improvements, Fixes,[/b] and a host of [b]Balance Changes[/b] (which means another [b]Score Leaderboard Reset[/b]). Oh, and we have a fancy trailer for the new [b]Quad Element Towers[/b]. Check it out below, and read on for the full notes!

[previewyoutube=7IbG42AGF1w;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Quad Element Towers[/h1]
Countless amounts of people have been requesting new towers for years, and at last, we're finally delivering on that! Each one requires [b]4 Different Elements[/b] and costs 4000 Gold (or 2500 Gold when upgraded from a [b]Triple[/b]). All of them have their unique roles, but in terms of what this overall adds to the game:[list]
[*]Fills out gaps in their associated [b]4 Element Builds[/b]
[*]Expands build orders
[*]Allow "weird element combinations" that rely more on Level 1 Towers to scale into the endgame
[*]And more!
[/list]
With that, let's get on with the details!


[h2][b]Railgun Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/2b5221cf2756887c157608625f9973fcfdc46ce7.jpg[/img]

Our first [b]Quad[/b] is a [b]Light-based[/b] hybrid tower! It zaps everything around it with a static field, softening the wave and building charge. The more creeps it hits, the more charge it builds. Once charged, it fires a powerful global-ranged laser, which can be used to cut down Elemental Bosses and pick off creeps that are about to leak.

Technically, you can stick it anywhere, but it's best on peninsulas where it can hit the whole wave with its static field. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zq4jVHf.gif[/img]
[i]Even when it's not zapping nearby creeps, [b]Railgun[/b] will slowly build charge and fire from afar![/i]


[h2][b]Singularity Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/0ac712a11441168cbd30299c87725f34f087ddff.jpg[/img]

This one was routinely suggested on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1018830/discussions/1/1750150188482518613/]our forums[/url] and in the #tower-ideas channel on [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url]. It's a [b]Light-based[/b] tower that hits in a wide AoE, pulling surrounding creeps inwards. It's slow firing, but it can clump up creeps for your other AoE towers, which is especially great when paired with [b]Runic & Windstorm[/b].

If you get enough of them, you can pull the entire wave into a single clump, which can be great... or a giant boon when [b]Healing Creeps[/b] are involved.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SsETzWK.gif[/img]
[i]Clump them together, then blast away![/i]


[h2][b]Doom Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/3cf4ec6efb6023590729dcd539bcf5d2f3f9b921.jpg[/img]

A [b]Darkness-based[/b] tower that initially deals no damage, instead placing a debuff on creeps. Over time, the debuff grows in its own damage, and if it becomes enough to finish the creep off, it instantly triggers and kills the creep.

In a way, it's like a focused [b]Flamethrower[/b] tower, but with the goal of tagging creeps and building damage over time for a big finish. It's best to keep the debuff active for as long as possible, so get a few more [b]Doom Towers[/b] to keep refreshing the duration.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RI4vbOT.gif[/img]
[i]When combined with [b]Flamethrower[/b], it can make for some great chain reactions.[/i]


[h2][b]Phantom Zone Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/26f832dbdac83849645bc7706c5eac19e3724af9.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the void! [b]Phantom Zone[/b] is a [b]Darkness-based[/b] tower that temporarily places a creep in stasis, storing all incoming damage. After a few seconds, it's released from stasis with an explosion, spreading the stored damage into an area.

Effectively, it can convert your single-target damage into AoE damage. It does have a cooldown before it can stasis the same creep again, so it can't be used to stunlock, but it can buy you time and separate the creep wave out, allowing for towers like [b]Laser[/b] to dish out major damage with [b]Phantom Zone[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PJeMgQe.gif[/img]
[i]Let the void consume all.[/i]


[h2][b]Plague Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/41e3bf6c5561f2af483a0492963e73325b90eaa3.jpg[/img]

A [b]Darkness-based[/b] tower that deals damage over time to its target. If the target dies within 20 seconds, the debuff bounces over to another target, refreshing its duration.

Not only can this stack up and eventually clear the wave, but if you're behind, it may even jump into the next wave, powered up from the current one.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nWqiPwj.gif[/img]
[i]It's like a cross between [b]Poison & Lightning[/b]. As creeps succumb to its damage, the rest continue to fall, faster and faster.[/i]


[h2][b]Crystal Spire Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/30d34d620d8a558bfe3825e09a6f270164236b4d.jpg[/img]

A [b]Water-based[/b] tower that spawns spirits over time, rotating around the tower. When a creep comes in range, they seek in and explode. It's a finisher tower that can build up over time, then unleash everything at once!

It's kind of similar to [b]Bloom[/b], but it's more focused and can reach across lanes with the same flexibility as 1150 range towers.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mWkzeS2.gif[/img]
[i]As fancy as it looks, it's surprisingly more performant than some of our basic towers.[/i]


[h2][b]Tsunami Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/03fd753dd1e48eff27970ef43d33e302218c8480.jpg[/img]

Anyone remember the classic [b]Tidal Tower[/b]? Well, it's back and better than ever! [b]Tsunami[/b] is a [b]Water-based[/b] tower with a single-target attack, which builds charge over time. Once you gain enough, you can manually activate it to unleash a powerful Tidal Wave, hitting all creeps in range.

It's got 4 Charge levels, and at its most potent, it can even deal significant damage to [b]Boss Waves[/b]. With proper timing, you can alternate a pair of [b]Tsunamis[/b] and delete most waves in the mid-game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X3ZnIRv.gif[/img]
[i]Just wait for them to get in range, and ta-da, they're all dead![/i]


[h2][b]Obelisk Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/f138d84ea119d7944f95d5c9442ba5f397a42e4b.jpg[/img]

A [b]Fire-based[/b] tower that fires a continuous beam at a creep. Upon switching targets, it triggers an explosion with more damage and AoE based on how long it channeled. Multiple Obelisks can trigger explosions on the same creep, allowing it to deal some serious AoE damage.

Pair it with some slows like [b]Nova & Windstorm[/b], and you can trigger some insanely large and powerful explosions!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CAFxmc2.gif[/img]
[i]Whether the creep dies, goes out of range, or even pops a [b]Shield[/b], [b]Obelisk[/b] will still trigger an explosion.[/i]


[h2][b]Rage Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/4d967d338810148a7ccd32a5c0e6ee3573e57bbb.jpg[/img]

This one's a simple [b]Fire-based[/b] tower, but effective at its role, nonetheless. [b]Rage[/b] sets a creep on fire, dealing damage over time and amplifying damage taken. However, it also drastically speeds the creep up, which can be used to intentionally separate creeps out and benefit from [b]Incantation's[/b] solo bonus.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aisTbGv.gif[/img]
[i]Before you ask, speed buffs from multiple sources do stack.[/i]


[h2][b]Archdruid Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/1a5cead734b6177272e5b009059de6293fdf45f6.jpg[/img]

This [b]Nature-based[/b] tower may seem counterintuitive, as it chucks creeps forward at the front-most creep in range. However, it can be used to clumps creeps really tightly together, pairing great with [b]Solar & Vapor[/b].

Of all the [b]Quad Towers[/b] added, [b]Archdruid[/b] has the potential to be the most game-changing. The conventional rules of tower positioning go out the window, as it's capable of turning "bad spots" on maps into fast kill zones. Just be careful not to accidentally chuck creeps from the start to the end in your defense.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hA3pdtg.gif[/img]
[i]Launch 'em high and slam them into another creep![/i]


[h2][b]Life Altar Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/753f2db9e92cafa77e49140bfa397e86aee3403f.jpg[/img]

By popular demand, [b]Life Tower[/b] is back! Well, with a sacrificial twist. [b]Life Altar[/b] is a [b]Nature-based[/b] tower capable of buffing all nearby towers in range, giving them a damage and attack speed bonus for a short duration. They even recover your lives back for every few kills.

However, the more towers in range, the more lives it costs to activate the ability. Time it right to get as many of your lives back as possible!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mZ0JyqN.gif[/img]
[i]It can reach up to 2 Tiles out, letting it get around [b]Cursed[/b] creeps.[/i]


[h2][b]Tesla Tree Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/2a4b2fcf4587fdb0e60e76cb435eb434cb794f82.jpg[/img]

Over the years, we've received many tower suggestions, but there was one that was suggested every single year by numerous people: the "Prism Tower" idea. Towers link together and "fire through" one another, in a sense. It's a ridiculous idea, so of course, we added it.

[b]Tesla Tree[/b] is a [b]Nature-based[/b] tower. When you place them in range of other [b]Tesla Trees[/b], they chain together, combining the damage, attack speed, range, buffs and debuffs together.

If you get enough of them in a long chain, it can hit the whole map! You'll need a lot for [b]Co-op[/b] though.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YD1KT8r.gif[/img]
[i]As you add or remove [b]Tesla Trees[/b] in range, beams automatically connect between the towers. They also have a particularly fun interaction with [b]Trickery Tower[/b].[/i]


[h2][b]Gravity Cannon Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/023226d36e40f164c67452289dde557325c76335.jpg[/img]

An [b]Earth-based[/b] tower with really long range, drastically speeding up its target. However, if it the target passes other creeps, it slows them down.

A multi-purpose tower that can target the back, clumping creeps together, or target the front to separate them out. Works great with [b]Incantation[/b] and other finishers.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MPkHCus.gif[/img]
[i]Drag 'em down, or push 'em forward! Either way, they're going to die... hopefully.[/i]


[h2][b]Nuclear Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/447610997fb5b33441c9b305ade870ebd19cf8df.jpg[/img]

An [b]Earth-based[/b] tower that mutates its target, doubling its HP while also slowing it down and dealing heavy damage over time. This is a permanent effect, and as thus, it can only apply it once per creep.

This tower can be used as a slow, or a means of separating creeps out, while also dealing heavy damage.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BOpx3Bb.gif[/img]
[i][b]Bulky[/b] creeps not big enough for you? Just add some [b]Nuclear[/b] mutations![/i]


[h2][b]Shredder Tower[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/51625d9d0776e47c978f53ba42d0bbfdf3981a59.jpg[/img]

And lastly, we have [b]Shredder[/b], an [b]Earth-based[/b] tower that splits creeps in two new creeps, each with half health, bounty and score. Cannot split a creep more than once.

The split acts as a "kill", which can preemptively trigger on-death effects for Flamethrower and Ethereal. And by doubling the creep count, towers that scale off creep count can have a field day. Just be careful of [b]Cursed[/b] and [b]Healing[/b] waves. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZuK2izk.gif[/img]
[i]Its attack strikes right after the split, so it can kill the newly split creeps in the same attack that splits them.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]AMD FSR[/h1]

This is a new feature under [b]Graphics Settings[/b]. In a nutshell, it'll reduce visual clarity in exchange for a performance boost. If you're familiar with DLSS, it's similar to that. At the lower end, the visual clarity loss is barely noticeable while FPS goes up by 10-20%, and at the higher end, the visuals are definitely less clear, but we've gotten reports of performance doubling on that option.

Do note, turning on AMD FSR requires [b]Anti-Aliasing[/b] to be turned on, which has also been improved to higher quality.

[h1]New Cosmetics[/h1]
[b]5 New Trails[/b] have been added! All of these are based on the new [b]Quads[/b].[list]
[*][i]Level 75[/i] - Phantom Wave
[*][i]Level 80[/i] - Static Shock
[*][i]Level 85[/i] - Spiritual Trifecta
[*][i]Level 90[/i] - Singularity
[*][i]Level 95[/i] - Tsunami
[*][b]Elemental Master Trail[/b] is now the [i]Level 100[/i] [b]Trail[/b].
[/list]
[b]5 New Wings[/b] have been added! Based on a mix of new [b]Quads[/b] and updated effects.[list]
[*][i]Level 80[/i] - Burning Wisps
[*][i]Level 85[/i] - Tesla Branches
[*][i]Level 90[/i] - Star Rose Wings
[*][i]Level 95[/i] - Wings of Doom
[*][i]Level 100[/i] - Eternal Blaze
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/8aaa29f8e1e95835180720d55eacaa2fb939ff1e.jpg[/img]
[i]Ride the wave into battle![/i]


[h1]Improvements[/h1][list]
[*]Unity Version bumped from 2020.3.11 to 2020.3.21
[*][b]Localizations updated[/b] for: German, Chinese, Spanish, Russian, Turkish, Korean, Swedish, Dutch, French, Portuguese
[*][b]Main Menu[/b] reorganized:[list]
[*][b]Extras[/b] menu has been nuked
[*][b]Singleplayer[/b] now has a [b]Replays[/b] tab, which contains:[list]
[*][b]Ghost Mode[/b] against Leaderboard Replays
[*][b]Ghost Mode[/b] against Local Replays
[*][b]View[/b] Local Replays
[/list]
[*][b]Profile[/b] has been renamed to [b]Customize[/b], and now contains the following menus:[list]
[*][b]Customize Builder[/b]
[*][b]Customize Towers[/b]
[*][b]Tower Table[/b], which now lets you directly select a tower from here to customize it
[*][b]Stats[/b]
[*][b]Achievements[/b]
[/list]
[*][b]Credits[/b] has been moved to [b]Settings[/b]
[/list]
[*]Attack & Ability VFX for numerous towers have been updated. This should result in less "glow stacks" while also looking more visually consistent and more performant.[list]
[*]This includes [b]Blacksmith, Well, Trickery, Poison, Ice, Vapor, Geyser, Nova, Runic, Flooding, Wisp, Polar, Flamethrower, Haste, Root, Muck, & Periodic[/b].
[/list]
[*]Adjusted options for [b]Damage Number Pop-ups[/b]:[list]
[*][b]On Towers[/b]: Replaces "Primary Target", this now places damage number pop-ups over towers instead of creeps
[*][b]On Creeps[/b]: Relabel of "All Targets"
[*][b]Off[/b]: Same as before
[/list]
[*][b]War Mode[/b] has received some adjustments:[list]
[*][b]Summon Swarm[/b] now requires at least 3 Different Elements before it becomes available
[*][b]Summon Mega[/b] now requires a Level 2 Element before it becomes available
[*]HP scaling increased from 20% to 21% per wave, and 25% starting from Wave 45 onwards. That doesn't sound like much, but by Wave 44, it's roughly 40% higher than before.
[*][b]Composite + Healing[/b] moved from Wave 45 to Wave 44, replacing [b]Composite + Regeneration[/b]
[*][b]Boss Creeps[/b] now start at Wave 45
[*]Bounty now caps at Wave 44's bounty amount of 482 per creep
[/list]
[*]In [b]Ranked[/b], if the opponent has died and you overtake them in [b]Score[/b], you now get the victory instantly instead of having to play the rest of the game out.
[*]Towers that are in-construction can no longer be buffed by [b]Blacksmith, Well & Trickery[/b].
[*][b]Damage Chart[/b] now has an "Average Damage" checkbox.
[*]Selecting a tower now lists the total damage it's ever done, right below total kills.
[*][b]Trickery Clones[/b] are no longer nuked when you build over them
[*][b]Variant Map[/b] selection in [b]Lobby[/b] moved to be below [b]Map[/b]
[*][b]Boss Hunt[/b] game length starting gold increased from 120k to 125k
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed a bug in [b]Ranked[/b] where both players could end up in the same slot
[*]All range & AoE related values have been changed back from Floats to FixedPoint. This should reduce the frequency of desyncs.
[*]Variant column on the Leaderboards removed. Replaced with a Difficulty column.
[*]Fixed [b]Jinx[/b] doing the Michael Jackson when rotating
[*]Fixed [b]Transference[/b] tooltip missing in Status Bar
[*]Fixed a bug in [b]Ghost Mode[/b] where, if you outlast a ghost during the Boss Waves, the game freezes instead of going on
[*]Fixed a rare nullref freeze error with the [b]Boss Hunter[/b] achievements in [b]Teams[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/427eb03a7c7dda81143f7d5ba39e27e9424d3f13.jpg[/img]
[i]Showing off some of the new VFX in action. It's a bit cluttered here, but it'll get blown up soon anyways.[/i]


[h1]Balance[/h1]

[h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Starting from Wave 46 to the end, the game now scales up by 19% HP per wave, up from the usual rate of 15.7% per wave.[list]
[*]For reference, in [b]Version 1.3[/b], we made it so it'd go up by 20% HP per wave starting from Wave 51. In general, the late-game scales up to be up to 10% harder than the previous version, since most builds are now better equipped to handle it.
[*][b]Wave 56+[/b] still goes up at a rate of 25% HP per wave.
[/list]
[*][b]Level 3 Elemental Boss[/b] HP increased by roughly 4%
[*][b]Income Upgrade[/b] passive gold bonus increased from +5% to +6%
[*]Slows applied from AoE attacks won't be reppalied through [b]Shields[/b]
[*][b]Fast[/b] creeps no longer ignore other speed boosts
[*][b]Temporal[/b] creeps can no longer trigger their ability and survive through an attack that would kill them
[*][b]Periodic[/b] damage reduced from 56000 to 55000
[/list]
[h3][b]Single Element[/b][/h3][list]
[*][b]Light[/b] damage increased from 110 to 120
[*][b]Darkness[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 280 to 300
[*]Bounce range increased from 500 to 750
[*]HP Removal increased from 7.5% to 8%
[/list]
[*][b]Water[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Bounce range increased from 100 to 125
[*]Bounce damage reduced from 45% to 40%
[/list]
[*][b]Nature[/b] damage increased from 85 to 90
[/list]
[h3][b]Dual Element[/b][/h3][list]
[*][b]Atom[/b] damage increased from 300 to 315
[*][b]Lightning[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 145 to 180
[*]Bounce count reduced from 4 / 5 / 7 to 3 / 4 / 6
[/list]
[*][b]Ice[/b] default priority changed from Near to Front
[*][b]Infernal[/b] damage increased from 650 to 700
[*][b]Solar[/b] damage-per-second increased from 105 to 110
[*][b]Bloom[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 375 to 350
[*]Recharge delay is now affected by [b]Well Buff[/b]
[*]Recharge delay increased from 1 / 0.66 / 0.33 to 1 / 0.7 / 0.4 seconds
[/list]
[*][b]Geyser[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 1000 to 1050
[*]Ability AoE reduced from 300 / 350 / 400 to 300
[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Triple Element[/b][/h3][list]
[*][b]Astral[/b] damage increased from 1900 to 2000
[*][b]Runic[/b] ability AoE increased from 250 to 300
[*][b]Wisp[/b] reset time reduced from 7 to 6 seconds
[*][b]Polar[/b] HP Removal reduced from 12% / 24% to 11% / 22%
[*][b]Haste[/b] attack speed gain per hit increased from 6% to 7%
[*][b]Impulse[/b] damage increased from 2400 to 2700
[*][b]Quake[/b] shockwave damage increased from 2500 to 2600
[*][b]Muck[/b] damage increased from 650 to 1000
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/1080da1b186eaa83cd57a1615a2c81065cb46ba7.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Periodic[/b] got some love on its visuals this patch in the form of blinding rainbow blasts![/i]

[hr][/hr]
This patch has been in the making for quite a while, and we'd like to put out a special thanks to certain community members that went above and beyond to help us pull off this monumental release:[list]
[*][b]Taencred[/b] - For always being there to test each alpha build, post bugs, and confirm when things are finally working right
[*][b]wadebbqwall2[/b] - For making the fancy trailer as well as helping on GIFs and presentation
[*][b]Minacious Grace[/b] - For constant balance input and testing
[*][b]Scamper9[/b] - For joining on test sessions, and finding a way to break the game with the most unlikely element combination
[*]And everyone else that chipped in on testing and giving us feedback!
[/list]
We hope you all enjoy trying out the new [b]Quad Element Towers[/b], plus enhanced performance options and all the other things we snuck in. With [b]15 New Towers[/b] at your disposal, you'll have all the tools in your arsenal needed to conquer your friends and foes!


Or get confused when you have all [b]6 Elements[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/c712d37c050578a6eeb6e9ebbe97f25c2a7c968d.jpg[/img]
[i]That's a lot of towers. Have fun learning them all![/i]

notes.title: Quad Preview - Nuclear & Phantom Zone
notes.content:
Coming in [b]Version 1.4[/b], we're adding [b]15 New Towers[/b] to the game, each of which requires [b]4 Different Elements[/b]. For this week's preview, we're showing off [b]Nuclear & Phantom Zone[/b]! Plus an update on the release window.


[h2][b]Nuclear Tower[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/c1f7bbfac9a1476330c37b554e030575aef4a37c.png[/img]

[b]Elements[/b]: Light, Darkness, Nature, Earth
[b]Damage Type[/b]: Earth

[b]Effect[/b]: Primary target's HP is doubled and proportionally slowed by up to 40%. Target then emits radiation around it, dealing 0.25% of target's Current HP and 5000 damage-per-second in 100 AoE. Duration is permanent and cannot stack.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2Whlpgr.gif[/img]
[i]Supersize those creeps! And slow them down. And give them radiation poisoning. And kill them.[/i]

This is one of two new towers that applies permanent one-time effects. It can significantly slow creeps and apply a powerful DoT effect, but it also bumps their HP up. The slow scales up proportionally to the amount of HP increased:[list]
[*]Hypothetically, if the target's HP jumps from 100% to 200%, it'll apply a 40% slow. However, this will never happen, because it applies its own damage first.
[*]More realistically, you're likely to see 70% to 140% HP, applying a proportional 28% slow.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sab1yEg.gif[/img]
[i]It's a slow attack, but it makes up for it with a wide shockwave![/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Phantom Zone Tower[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/dfddb9c5315b362090a9fbebbcf64ef3cc0dd50c.png[/img]

[b]Elements[/b]: Light, Darkness, Water, Earth
[b]Damage Type[/b]: Darkness

[b]Effect[/b]: Holds a creep in place for 2 seconds. During this time, it stores all damage it takes. At the end of its duration, 40% of the damage that was stored hits in a 300 AoE shockwave. Can't stasis the same creep for another 8 seconds.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T2DvYSh.gif[/img]
[i]Is that a stun lasting longer than 0.24 seconds? How is this balanced?[/i]

In a way, this tower can be used as a stun. However, since the outgoing damage will reduce it considerably, it's more so meant to take your single-target damage and convert it to AoE damage.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FpkBbpm.gif[/img]
[i]Thanks to this tower, its [b]Element Combination[/b] is no longer absolutely horrible.[/i]

Please note that the damage and effect numbers listed for the above two towers are not final and could change by release. Speaking of which...

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Release Window[/b][/h2]

We were originally planning on releasing in late [b]November[/b], but we still have a mix of visuals, audio, and polish that need to be finished up, not to mention balance testing. That said, we're now aiming to release by the [u]middle of [b]December[/b][/u]!

In the meantime, you can try [b]Quad Element Towers[/b] early, which is [u]now available for public alpha testing[/u]. The steps are simple:[list]
[*]Join our [b]Discord[/b] ([url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]click here[/url])
[*]Check the pinned post in the #testers channel
[*]That's it! If you can, please post your impressions and feedback in said #testers channel
[/list]

notes.title: Quad Preview - Crystal Spire & Singularity Towers
notes.content:
Coming in [b]Version 1.4[/b], we're adding [b]15 New Towers[/b] to the game, each of which requires [b]4 Different Elements[/b]. For this week's preview, we've got a double feature, with [b]Crystal Spire[/b] and [b]Singularity[/b]!


[h2]Crystal Spire Tower[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/cbaa2d74de256996a0231b92822edd35054ad678.jpg[/img]

[b]Elements[/b]: Darkness, Water, Fire, Earth
[b]Damage Type[/b]: Water

[b]Effect[/b]: Every few seconds, it spawns a spirit that circles it, up to a max of 7 spirits. When a spirit impacts a creep, it explodes, dealing damage. Spirits themselves have a 600 Search Range where they auto-seek in on their target.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jEo4nbx.gif[/img]

[b]Crystal Spire[/b] is a finisher tower that can build up over time, then unleash everything at once! It's kind of similar to [b]Bloom[/b], but it's more focused and can reach across lanes with the same flexibility as 1150 range towers.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0QsFYgo.gif[/img]
[i]As fancy as it looks, it's surprisingly more performant than some of our basic towers.[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Singularity Tower[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/116f3d78c4f1a850e51acc125e7c5ca0161071d2.jpg[/img]

[b]Elements[/b]: Light, Darkness, Water, Fire
[b]Damage Type[/b]: Light

[b]Effect[/b]: Creeps hit by its attack are pulled towards the primary target for 0.25 seconds.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NI3oxDF.gif[/img]

It's a fairly simple effect, but quite significant. Its main focus is clumping creeps together, allowing other AoE towers to take advantage of it. If it happens to hit a single isolated target (like an [b]Elemental Boss[/b]), it won't mysteriously pull it.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XSKeTpj.gif[/img]
[i]Clump them together, then blast away! You also might notice a new hit VFX for [b]Runic[/b] here.[/i]


We hope you enjoyed this preview! Look forward to more previews in the future, as we show off more [b]Quad Element Towers[/b], coming in late [b]November[/b]!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Testing Quads Early[/h2]
Interested in trying out [b]Quad Element Towers[/b] early? [u]It's now available for public alpha testing![/u] The steps are simple:[list]
[*]Join our [b]Discord[/b] ([url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]click here[/url])
[*]Check the pinned post in the #testers channel
[*]And that's it!
[/list]
Presently, all [b]15 Quad Element Towers[/b] are functionally implemented, and balance has at least been roughly tested. However, they of course have bugs (which we're in the process of fixing, thanks for the feedback we've already received!), and their visuals/audio are not yet complete. Other than that, we'd highly appreciate it if you can join on testing and give us feedback on what you think of them so far!
