notes.title: Version 1.3 - Big Balance Update!
notes.content:
As usual, it only took 285309 years, but [b]Version 1.3[/b] is finally here, bringing with it lots of nifty features! We've got [b]Reconnect Support[/b], [b]Ranked Season 2[/b] with a [b]Desync Detector[/b], there's a [b]Same Pick Modifier[/b], and you can pseudo play against replays in [b]Ghost Mode[/b]. On top of that, we've got a lengthy list of [b]Balance Changes[/b], [b]Specializations[/b] have received some overdue love, as well as numerous fixes and improvements. Enjoy the long list of patch notes below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/ebbd0f337e0d259c6cd46b528ee3fdf7c6007553.jpg[/img]
[i]RIP [b]Vapor[/b] washing machine. In exchange, it's actually useful past [b]Wave 10[/b] now.[/i]


[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]Reconnect Support[/b] added![list]
[*]If you disconnect in the middle of a game, it'll now attempt to reconnect you within a 90 second window.
[*]In the meantime, for everyone else, the game will be paused, and they'll get a [b]Votekick[/b] dialogue, giving everyone a chance to vote for you to stay or get kicked. Obviously, if you don't return within 90 seconds, you'll get kicked anyways.
[*]To be clear, if you return to the [b]Main Menu[/b], [u]you can't actually get back into the game[/u]. This moreso addresses "oh, my internet dropped for a few seconds" or some other temporary disconnect issue.
[/list]
[*][b]Ranked Season 2[/b] has begun![list]
[*]For now, nothing special has been added. Everyone gets to start from 300 MMR again and work their way back up to the top!
[*]However, rankings from [b]Season 1[/b] have been preserved.
[*]There's now new [b]Achievements[/b] for going up a [b]Rank[/b]. This is retroactive with [b]Season 1[/b], so if you had say [b]700 MMR[/b] in [b]Season 1[/b], you'll get the respective [b]Achievements[/b].
[*]Additionally, a [b]Desync Detector[/b] has been added! If you're in a [b]Ranked Game[/b] and a desync is detected, the game will end, and neither player will gain or lose any MMR.[list]
[*]For those of you that have experienced [b]Ranked Games[/b] in the past where you won but somehow lost MMR, this was the cause.
[/list][/list]
[*][b]Same Pick[/b] Modifier added! This is Multiplayer only:[list]
[*]How it works is that people take turns picking the next element. Everyone gets that same element.
[*]If the player doesn't choose the element by the end of the wave break, it should pick an element at random. 
[/list]
[*][b]Ghost Mode[/b] added![list]
[*]On the Leaderboard, when selecting a Replay, you try [b]Ghost Mode[/b] instead.
[*]Doing so will let you play as a ghost, meaning whenever you clear a wave, it won't trigger the next wave's start, but actual players in the replay will. This way, you can pseudo-play against existing replays.
[*]Note, this only works for FFA replays. You can also access local replays in the [b]Ghost Mode[/b] using the [b]Extras[/b] menu.
[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/510cae79cd15906d3529f056cf2bc2f767feab36.jpg[/img]
[i]Hopefully, you don't actually see this, but if you do, know that you'll no longer suffer from incorrectly lost [b]Ranked[/b] matches.[/i]


[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]Some of the game's [b]FixedPoint[/b] calculations now use [b]Floats[/b]:[list]
[*]This includes Creep HP, Damage Calculations, Gold, and Score Multipliers.
[*]Most notably, this means that [b]Wave 56+[/b] no longer cuts HP down by a factor of 10, and that [b]Boss Armor[/b] now just takes 100% damage from all types. That was our way of masking some annoying technical limitations, but now those limitations are gone, so hooray!
[*]That said, the game will no longer freeze if you get far enough into the game, particularly in [b]God Mode[/b].
[/list]
[*]Improved LODs, increasing performance by up to 10%.
[*][b]Horizontal Upgrading[/b] now works for the following:[list]
[*]Level 2 Single --> Level 2 Dual
[*]Level 2 Dual --> Level 2 Triple
[*]Level 3 Single --> Level 3 Dual
[/list]
[*]When placing a tower or hovering over a tower upgrade, it'll now display the [b]Gold Cost[/b] next to the cursor.[list]
[*]This includes if you have multiple towers selected, or if you're holding [b]Ctrl[/b] to max-upgrade towers.
[*]If you don't have enough gold for it, the text will instead flash red.
[/list]
[*]You can now select a tower from the [b]Build Row/Tower Table[/b] even if you don't have the gold for it. It will now block you when you attempt to actually place the tower.[list]
[*]This means you can now preview the range of a tower before you have the gold available for it.
[/list]
[*]In [b]Ranked[/b], if the other player outright quits to the main menu, the game will immediately end.
[*][b]Speed Score Multiplier[/b] has been made more granular and will change by the second. Still the same rate as before.
[*][b]In-game Timer/Speed Multiplier[/b] no longer starts until the first wave starts spawning
[*][b]Replay Name[/b] now mentions the map and mode.
[*][b]Temple[/b] has been made [b]2-Path[/b] by default.[list]
[*]Its [b]Advanced[/b] paths is now [b]1-Path[/b] but it's 20% faster.
[/list]
[*][b]Desert[/b] has received some changes, both gameplay-wise and visually.
[*][b]Bloom Level 2[/b] scale reduced by about 15%, should be easier to tell each level apart.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/bfc6a6e35b44d6b18067fcb0dc3fc49899da2e69.jpg[/img]
[i]About 6 seconds have been shaved off the path length, there's more useful build locations, and it looks better![/i]


[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Tower [b]Target Priority & Focus Settings[/b] from the Tower Customization menu now work properly[list]
[*]In theory, this was fixed in 1.2.4, but for some people, it wasn't. It should be fixed now, and in the off-chance it still isn't, use the [b]Reset Tower Settings[/b] button in that menu.
[/list]
[*]Fixed [b]Kick Player[/b] button disappearing when host changes
[*]Fixed [b]Kick Player[/b] being based on join order instead of the current occupant
[*]Fixed an issue where the [b]Sell Value Tooltip[/b] would be incorrect when selecting different towers
[*]Fixed an issue where the [b]Challenger & Royalty Achievements[/b] wouldn't trigger outside of the [b]FFA Leaderboard[/b].
[*]Fixed placement range indicator differing from range indicator of an existing tower.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RY93yJp.gif[/img]
[i]Another quality-of-life feature that we can't believe wasn't in the game from the start.[/i]


[h2]Balance[/h2]
The majority of these changes can be attributed to community member [b]MinaciousGrace[/b], who's spent a ton of time into improving the balance and testing it out quite thoroughly. Most towers received buffs; a handful of counterbalances were made in the late-game, but overall, the game should be easier. However, in [b]Multiplayer[/b], expect it to also be faster.

As usual with our balance patches, [b]Score Leaderboards[/b] have been reset.

[h3]General[/h3][list]
[*][b]Cannon Tower[/b] AoE increased from 200 to 300

notes.title: Quad Preview - Obelisk Tower
notes.content:
Coming in [b]Version 1.4[/b], we're adding [b]15 New Towers[/b] to the game, each of which requires [b]4 Different Elements[/b]. For this week's preview, we're showing off [b]Obelisk Tower[/b], a Fire-based Tower with a powerful on-kill effect.


[h2]Obelisk Tower[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/7705f5361235aa24d0e023cbabe0f388e7ebaf88.png[/img]

[b]Elements[/b]: Light, Water, Fire, Nature
[b]Damage Type[/b]: Fire

[b]Effect[/b]: Fires a constant beam at the target. If the target dies, it explodes. The longer the beam channels when it explodes, the more damage and AoE it does.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CmwELSY.gif[/img]

On-kill effects usually fall off as the game progresses, as creeps get harder to kill, and thus they don't trigger as easily. However, because this one scales the longer it shoots at a creep, it comes with a risk/reward payoff. If you shoot at a creep for a really long time, you can get a really big explosion... if the target dies. If the creep escapes before the tower changes targets, there's no explosion.

[b]Obelisk[/b] does not have to be one to land the killing blow for its explosion to go off. In fact, you can even have multiple [b]Obelisks[/b] shooting the same creep, and when it dies, it'll trigger an explosion for each beam on that creep.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AO6FBvz.gif[/img]
[i]What's this? An on-kill tower that can scale into the end-game? Nonsense![/i]



We hope you enjoyed this preview! Look forward to more previews in the future, as we show off more [b]Quad Element Towers[/b], coming later in [b]November[/b]!


[hr][/hr]

[h2]Version 1.3[/h2]
This was [i]supposed[/i] to be released by now, buuut we're getting held up on a particular bug. We think we've found the cause, but it's gonna take a little more time to test and confirm it. In theory, the patch should release this coming weekend. [i]In theory[/i]. A reminder that when it does arrive, [u][b]Score & Ranked Leaderboards[/b] will be reset[/u].

If you'd like to help us test, [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]join our [b]Discord[/b][/url], check the #roles channel, and tag yourself as part of the [b]@Testers[/b] so that you'll be pinged when we run testing sessions.

notes.title: Quad Preview - Railgun Tower
notes.content:
Today, we're showcasing the first of our [b]Quad Element Towers[/b]! Coming in [b]Version 1.4[/b], we're adding [b]15 New Towers[/b] to the game, each of which requires [b]4 Different Elements[/b]. Over the coming weeks, we'll be showing previews of some of the upcoming towers, as well as other tidbits of info for our monumental new release.


[h2]Railgun Tower[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/013739fe2dd4c9bd65e91c1381a4ad378212eb6f.png[/img]

[b]Elements[/b]: Light, Water, Fire, Earth
[b]Damage Type[/b]: Light

[b]Effect[/b]: Hits all creeps in range with a Static Discharge. Gains 1 Charge per creep hit. Passively gains 10 Charge per second. When it reaches 100 Charge, it fires a high-powered shot with global range, dealing insane damage.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qMmzxjL.gif[/img]
[i]Z-z-zap![/i]

The idea behind this tower is that it softens creeps up with its [b]Static Discharge[/b], and then uses the [b]Railgun[/b] to pick off leaks. It's also stellar for killing off [b]Elemental Bosses[/b].

Unlike most towers where [b]Double Pass[/b] locations are preferable, [b]Railgun Tower[/b] actually enjoys [b]Peninsula[/b] locations. You'll want to have the [b]Static Discharge[/b] hit as much of the wave as possible at once, so that you can charge the [b]Railgun[/b] faster.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2Wygf9O.gif[/img]
[i]Even when it's not zapping nearby creeps, the [b]Railgun[/b] will slowly build charge and fire from afar![/i]


[hr][/hr]

Some more info about [b]Quad Element Towers[/b]:[list]
[*]They cost [b]4000 Gold[/b] total, or a [b]2500 Gold[/b] upgrade cost from a [b]Triple Element Tower[/b]
[*]These are single level, meaning they won't include a [b]Level 2[/b] version.
[*][b]Quads[/b] are meant to fill in gaps in most [b]4 Element Builds[/b], where they're missing a particular [b]Damage Type[/b] or [b]Role[/b].
[*]On their own, they're a bit clunky, so rushing one immediately may not be the best idea. However, they scale well into the late-game, letting them contend with [b]Level 3 Duals[/b] and [b]Level 2 Triples[/b].
[*]Many of them come with trade-offs. Although this will give more power to [b]5-Ele & 6-Ele Compositions[/b] in particular, you won't necessarily want to include every single one in your build.
[/list]

We hope you enjoyed this preview! Look forward to more previews in the future, as we show off more [b]Quad Element Towers[/b], coming in [b]November[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rAfLZ7L.gif[/img]
[i]Spamming [b]Railguns[/b] in [b]Grand City[/b] makes for quite the sight.[/i]


[hr][/hr]

[h2]Version 1.3[/h2]
A reminder, before we get around to [b]Quads[/b], we'll be releasing a patch next week that addresses the game's dull meta, adds [b]Reconnect Support[/b], a new mode, and a bunch of other fixes and improvements! This patch will also mark the start of [b]Ranked Season 2[/b]. As a result, [u][b]Score & Ranked Leaderboards[/b] will be reset[/u].

notes.title: 1.3 and 1.4
notes.content:
For those you wondering where the next version is, we're still here and working on it! Below is an update on our next two releases, as well as their time tables.


[h2]Version 1.3 - Balance Overhaul[/h2]
Over the past month, community member [b]Minacious Grace[/b] has put in a lot of work towards making the game more balanced, both competitively and for [b]Scoreboard[/b] runs. A large number of towers received buffs, with some even getting reworks. All in all, this should result in a much more varied meta!

Also coming in this update:[list]
[*][b]Reconnect Support[/b]
[*]Finally using [b]Floats[/b] instead of [b]FixedPoint[/b] shenanigans
[*][b]Ghost Mode[/b] for Replays (e.g. allowing you to play against leaderboard entry)
[*][b]Same Pick[/b] in Multiplayer
[*]And more!
[/list]
In this update, not only will [b]Score Leaderboards[/b] be reset, but [u][b]Ranked Leaderboards[/b] are also getting reset[/u]. This balance update will mark the start of [b]Ranked Season 2[/b], starting everyone from 300 MMR again. [b]Season 1's[/b] values will be viewable from in-game.

We're expecting to release [b]Version 1.3[/b] in about 2-3 weeks!


[h2]Version 1.4 - Quad Towers[/h2]
Over the years, the most requested feature has been, by far, "more towers". Since the original version in [b]WC3[/b] over 16 years ago, the game has enjoyed a steady 44 tower count. However, that's finally going to change...

In [b]Version 1.4[/b], we're going to be adding [b]15 New Towers[/b]! Each of them requires [b]4 Different Elements[/b], with the goal being to fill numerous gaps in the balance, enabling new builds, build orders, new ways to think of positioning, and in general just adding all kinds of fun, wacky effects. Many of them have trade-off effects (ie, amplifies damage, but also speeds up the creep), or something else to make it unique.

Starting this weekend, we'll start doing previews for [b]Quad Towers[/b], one at a time, all the way up to their release.

Expect [b]Version 1.4 & Quad Element Towers[/b] to arrive in [b]November[/b]!


[h2]Other Stuff[/h2]
As stated in our last [b]Roadmap[/b] post, we were going to add [b]Specializations Mode[/b] for [b]Version 1.3[/b]. However, the solution we were going for would've ended up a bit rushed and half-baked. Fret not, we'll come back to it in a future update, just not now.

In the meantime, look forward to our next two big updates!

notes.title: Version 1.2 - War Revamp, Variants for Leaderboard, Balance
notes.content:
Once again, we thought "this patch won't include that much", and then a month and a half later, we've got a revamp for [b]War Mode[/b], Leaderboard Support for [b]Map Variants[/b], adjustments to [b]Teams & Co-op Modes[/b], various improvements and bug fixes, and of course, a bunch of [b]Balance[/b] tweaks. You know, the usual [b]Element TD 2[/b] treatment. Enjoy the big update!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/92a82fd0a6b6bb06c2b8499779e92145a35792e3.gif[/img]
[i]Yes. [b]Cows[/b] are in [b]War Mode[/b] now. Moo.[/i]

[h2]War Mode Revamp[/h2]
This is a fast-paced 1v1 mode where both players build towers in the same build area. Waves are split between enemy and allied creeps; your towers damage enemy creeps while they heal allied creeps. As you acquire and level up elements, you gain access to various abilities that can turn the tide of the battle. It's a constant push-and-pull where counterplay is the key to victory!

Over the past month, we've applied a number of changes that makes the mode much more accessible, as well as improving its pacing, flow, and counterplay. If you've never played it before, we encourage you to try it out! And for those of you that have played it, here's the list of changes below.

[b]War Changes[/b]:[list]
[*]Activating a [b]War Ability[/b] now triggers the cooldown for [i]all[/i] [b]War Abilities[/b].
[*]Existing [b]Cooldowns[/b] have been decreased to [b]20 Seconds[/b].
[*]Two new [b]War Abilities[/b] added, [b]Summon Mega & Summon Swarm[/b]. You have both of these from the start, and each has a [b]30 Second Cooldown[/b].
[*]Game now starts from [b]Wave 1[/b] with [b]1 Element Pick[/b] and 300 Gold.
[*]Waves reduced from 55 to 45 (before transitioning to Boss Waves). [b]HP & Bounty Scaling[/b] has been increased to compensate.
[*]You now gain a [b]New Element[/b] every 4 Waves, unlike the standard 5.
[*]The opponent's element picks are now only hidden on the [b]Scoreboard[/b] before Wave 1 starts, instead of the whole game.
[/list]
[b]War Abilities[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Summon Mega[/b]: Default Ability. Spawns a Mega Creep of the current wave with 500% HP, half move speed, takes 5 lives, and it's immune to War Abilities.
[*][b]Summon Swarm[/b]: Default Ability. Spawns 6 Creeps of the current wave with 75% HP and with decreased spacing.
[*][b]Hyper Boost[/b]: Light Ability. Creeps in an area of 400 AoE are sped up by 200% / 266% / 400% for 2 seconds.
[*][b]Dimensional Rift[/b]: Darkness Ability. Place creeps in 450 / 550 / 750 AoE into stasis, turning them invulnerable and removing them from the current wave for 30 seconds. The same creep can't be Rifted twice.
[*][b]Frost Zone[/b]: Water Ability. Disables build locations in a 300 / 400 / 500 AoE for 15 seconds. Any towers in the area lose 30% / 40% / 50% Attack Speed and cannot be sold or upgraded during that time.
[*][b]Flare Up[/b]: Fire Ability. Increase the damage of all towers in 200 / 300 / 400 AoE by 100% / 166% / 300% for 7 seconds.
[*][b]Rejuvenation[/b]: Nature Ability. Creeps in an area of 500 AoE are healed by 25% / 33% / 50% of their Maximum Health.
[*][b]Explode![/b]: Earth Ability. Damages creeps in an area of 350 / 450 / 600 AoE for 50% of their Maximum Health, stunning the survivors for 5 seconds.
[/list]
In addition to this, [b]Ranked War Mode[/b] has been added![list]
[*]Rules are set to [b]Pick + Very Hard[/b]
[*]Maps are randomized between [b]Wasteland, Autumn, Desert, Winter, & Temple[/b], aka all the symmetrical maps.
[*]For those of you that enjoy [b]Ranked Pick[/b] but want something with more interaction and counterplay, we highly recommend you try this out!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/1768bce33c2c8912d007594f0f739c6d66c36699.gif[/img]
[i]A special feature of [b]War Mode[/b] is the use of [b]War Abilities[/b], which are tied to the elements you have.[/i]

[h2]Leaderboard Support for Map Variants[/h2]
[b]Map Variants[/b] are now submittable to the [b]Leaderboard[/b]![list]
[*]To be clear, this doesn't double the [b]Leaderboard[/b] count. Instead, next to each [b]Leaderboard[/b] entry, it now denotes if it's a [b]Variant[/b] or not.
[*]While most [b]Variants[/b] are harder than the standard maps, it'll be interesting to see if any [b]Variants[/b] end landing top spots on the [b]Leaderboard[/b]!
[*]This also includes [b]Reversed[/b] versions of [b]Co-op Maps[/b].[list]
[*]That said, the [b]Reversed[/b] versions of [b]Grand City & Atlantis[/b] have had certain build locations blocked off, so that all the top entries aren't just [b]Runic[/b] entrance camps.
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/665106d949a3da28ebae59aad809c706fe69f2d6.jpg[/img]
[i]See all these confusingly designed maps? They're now eligible for [b]Leaderboard[/b]![/i]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]You can now only get a max of [b]1 Income[/b] in [b]Random[/b]
[*][b]Ranked Notifications[/b] has been split out between [b]Ranked Pick, Ranked Random, & Ranked War[/b]
[*]The [b]Lobby List[/b] is now disabled while you have [b]Ranked Search[/b] going.
[*][b]Co-op[/b] has been adjusted:[list]
[*]Creep count reduced by 20%
[*]HP increased by 20% towards the start of the game and roughly 10% by the end of the game
[*]Bounty rescaled so you get 10-20% more gold early but 10-20% less gold late
[*]In general, these tweaks should make [b]Co-op[/b] more active early, while trying to reduce the end-game lagfest.
[/list]
[*][b]Teams[/b] has been adjusted:[list]
[*]HP Multiplier increased from x1.6 to x1.65.
[*]Team HP Scaling reduced to be about 5% less by Wave 55.
[*]Team Boss Wave Scaling reduced from x1.3 to x1.25.
[*]As a result of these changes, Boss Waves in particular should be easier for Teams compared to Solo players.
[/list]
[*]Haste buff display now lists the bonus Attack Speed instead of a stack count that made no sense
[*]Dialed down brightness on [b]Forest[/b] slightly. Also removed weird green smog on some plants.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/aa67e735aa0cb40a20c2cecb1b54711031b6ea11.gif[/img]
[i][b]Dimensional Rift[/b] (one of the [b]War Abilities[/b]) is used to stall the creep wave, giving time to focus on the rest.[/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Attempt number #940385 at correcting MMR calculations at the end of a game
[*]Fixed a rare bug that could freeze a [b]Co-op[/b] game if [b]Interest[/b] was disabled
[*]Fixed hotkey nullreference error that would spam up the player.log
[*]Fixed countdown timer stopping at 2 seconds for host when a Ranked Game starts
[*]Fixed the Turbo setting carrying over into the Campaign when loading a checkpoint
[*]Fixed Haste 2 having dark circles of doom
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/62a0534c7e8c9cbe7cdbc5703bfd73d4e74954ff.gif[/img]
[i]You can also [b]Spawn Megas[/b] of the current wave. Time it to counter the opponent's weaknesses![/i]

[h2]Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Cannon[/b] damage increased from 75 to 80
[*][b]Atom[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Consecutive damage bonus reduced from 13% to 12%
[*]Max stacks reduced from 11 to 9
[*]Carryover stacks increased from 30% to 35% (so that it still carries 3 stacks over when at max stacks)
[*]Carryover stacks now round instead of floor
[*]Fixed an exploit that let you keep max stacks just by manually switching targets
[/list]
[*][b]Poison[/b] initial damage increased from 50 / 200 / 800 to 100 / 400 / 1600[list]
[*]To clarify, this doesn't affect the DoT
[/list]
[*][b]Ice[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 575 / 2300 / 9200 to 775 / 3100 / 12400
[*]Range reduced from 1150 to 900
[/list]
[*][b]Infernal[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 600 / 2400 / 9600 to 900 / 3600 / 14400
[*]Attack speed reduced from 1.5 to 1
[/list]
[*][b]Bloom[/b] damage increased from 350 / 1400 / 5600 to 375 / 1500 / 6000
[*][b]Mushroom[/b] damage increased from 135 / 540 / 2160 to 140 / 560 / 2240
[*][b]Howitzer[/b] damage increased from 160 / 640 / 2560 to 170 / 680 / 2720
[*][b]Geyser[/b] damage reduced from 1000 / 4000 / 16000 to 950 / 3800 / 15200
[*][b]Astral[/b] damage increased from 1700 / 6800 to 1750 / 7000
[*][b]Ethereal[/b] now gets damage stacks twice from Undead creeps
[*][b]Wisp[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage now actually goes up by 5% per stack, not 4.8%
[*]Max damage increased from x4 to x4.3
[/list]
[*][b]Flamethrower[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Flamethrower wouldn't add a stack of Napalm if it landed the killing blow
[*]Napalm now triggers twice from Undead creeps
[*]Napalm AoE increased from 400 to 450
[/list]
[*][b]Golem[/b] damage increased from 3000 / 12000 to 3200 / 12800
[*][b]Impulse[/b] damage increased from 2300 / 9200 to 2400 / 9600
[*][b]Money[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 3200 / 12800 to 3500 / 14000
[*]Damage bonus from gold reduced from 20% / 40% to 15% / 30%
[*]Damage cap reduced from x2 to x1.5 / x1.7
[*][b]1.1 Values[/b]: Damage was 3200 / 12800 and capped out at 6400 / 25600. Unspent gold required was 16000 / 32000.
[*][b]1.2 Values[/b]: Damage is 3500 / 14000 and caps out at 5250 / 23800. Unspent gold required now is 11667 / 26500.
[/list]
[*][b]Polar[/b] HP removal increased from 12% / 24% to 13% / 26%
[*][b]Incantation[/b] search radius for solo amp reduced from 300 to 250
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

That's a wrap for [b]Version 1.2[/b]! Initially, we weren't planning on it being a balance patch (we try to keep them 2-3 months apart), but since the [b]Quads[/b] update likely won't happen until later in [b]October[/b] (at earliest), we decided to run some adjustments. As usual, [u][b]Leaderboards[/b] have been reset[/u]. [b]Ranked Leaderboards[/b] won't receive a reset until the [b]Quads[/b] update.

In our next update, expect to see [b]Specializations Mode[/b] as well as the [b]Same Pick[/b] modifier. In theory, this should come out in the next 3-4 weeks, pending [b]WindStrike[/b]-time (which is comparable to [url=https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Valve_Time]Valve Time[/url], just 100% more random).

[b]We are aware that localization is needed for the War Mode abilities.[/b] That will be coming soon via hotfixes. We also plan to finally localize achievements during the hotfix period before 1.3.

notes.title: Roadmap - Next Few Versions
notes.content:
It's been a little while since our last update! This is just a progress update to keep you apprised of what we're working on for the next few versions. In a nutshell, we're in the process of implementing [b]Quad Element Towers[/b], but it's going to take some time, so we're working on a couple of versions before we get there.


[h3]Version 1.2[/h3]
Our next version is focused on updating [b]War Mode[/b]. Currently, it's a fun 1v1 mode, but it's got a bunch of flaws. Over the last few weeks, we've made a number of adjustments to it, and numerous tests on the alpha branch have proven it to be much easier to get into, while still being fast-paced and rife with counterplay!

In fact, we'd argue it's got the potential to be a better competitive option than the standard game, and to that end, this update will include [b]Ranked War[/b] as well.

On top of that, [b]Version 1.2[/b] will include:[list]
[*][b]Map Variant[/b] scores will be submittable to the [b]Leaderboard[/b]
[*]Balance fixes[list]
[*]Yes, this means a [b]Leaderboard Reset[/b][/list][*]Numerous bug fixes[list]
[*]We're aware of the random menu freezing, as well as an increased surge in desyncs, among other things. Hopefully we'll figure these things out soon![/list][/list]
Expect to see this update out within the next two weeks!


[h3]Version 1.3[/h3]
Many of you have been asking for a mode that brings the [b]Tower Specializations[/b] from the [b]Campaign[/b] in the game's multiplayer environment, and that's what we're going to do! This'll be a modifier that you can apply to every mode. Do note that turning this mode on will disable [b]Leaderboard Submissions[/b].

In addition to that modifier, we'll also be adding a [b]Same Pick[/b] option. How it'll work is that one player gets to choose the first element pick for everyone, next player chooses the next pick for everyone, and so on and so forth. Which player it starts on will be randomized, and it'll just cycle through each player until all 11 Picks are selected.

Expect to see these two modifiers up by early [b]September[/b]!


[h3]Quad Towers[/h3]
Meanwhile, while we're working on those two updates, we'll be working on the long-awaited [b]Quad Element Towers[/b]! We've perused through all the [b]Tower Suggestions[/b] you folks have posted on the [b]Forums[/b] and our [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Discord[/url], and some of them have made it into the list, with tweaks of course. At this point, the [b]Quads List[/b] is about finalized, but in off-chance we have to scrap an idea, keep posting more suggestions!

Expect [b]Quads[/b] to arrive sometime in Q4, along with the next major balance patch. Whether this means the start of [b]October[/b] or the end of [b]December[/b], it's hard to say right now. As we get closer though, we'll start dropping previews for these and get a better idea of its release window.

[hr][/hr]

Lastly, one thing we'd like to note is that although we are adding a [b]Ranked War[/b], we're not adding a [b]Ranked Teams[/b], at least not yet. The reason for this is that due to the increased player count (4 as opposed to 2), it'd require a lot of work on the backend to get up and running. We know this one's been highly requested, and it's not out of the question, but presently, we're holding off on it because it'd delay everything else by a considerable amount.


That's it for the preview! For now, given how god awful our time estimates tend to be, we're keeping this one vague and just detailing out the rest of the year. Odds are, [b]Mazing DLC[/b] won't be arriving till next year. Once we get these updates out the door, we'll get back to you folks on that one.

notes.content:

notes.title: 1.1 - Definable Hotkeys, 5th Co-op Map, Balance
notes.content:
After not one, not two, but three bloody delays, [b][strike]Version 1.03[/strike] Version 1.1[/b] has finally arrived! We apologize for the bad time estimates; we got delayed by some bugs, and we have yet to figure out how to time travel so that we can release a patch on-time even after its due date. In the future, we'll go with a "it's done when it's done" approach.

Anywho, in today's patch, we've got definable hotkeys, definable targeting priorities, a new co-op map, a bunch of quality-of-life improvements, more bug fixes, and nearly every tower in the game receiving a 5-10% buff or nerf. Onwards to the patch notes!


[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*]You can now define your own [b]Hotkeys[/b] in [b]Settings[/b]![list]
[*]This extends to all of the single-button keyboard inputs.
[*]As a result, the old "By Element" or "MOBA" hotkey option has been removed. If you were using the latter option, we recommend redefining your hotkeys.
[/list]
[*]You can also define your own [b]Default Targeting Priorities[/b] in [b]Tower Customization[/b]![list]
[*]This also lets you define whether each tower has [b]Focus On/Off[/b] by default.
[/list]
[*]On the [b]Scoreboard[/b], you can now [b]Mute[/b] other players, preventing certain players' toxicity from ruining the game.[list]
[*]Or you can just mute everyone and enjoy the sounds of silence. You monster.
[/list]
[*]5th Co-op Map added, [b]Pinnacle[/b]![list]
[*]If you've played all the way through the [b]Campaign[/b], this is the map from the final mission.
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/3861b16c01513f06a267af3034341355a1b35208.jpg[/img]
[i]An expanded [b]Tower Customization[/b] screen![/i]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*][b]Blacksmith, Well, Trickery, & Runic Towers[/b] can now have [b]Auto-cast[/b] turned off by right-clicking their ability icon:[list]
[*]Left-click the ability icon to [b]Manual Cast[/b] their ability.
[/list]
[*]You can now press 7 (default hotkey) to revert a tower's priority back to your defined default priority.
[*]Pressing F5 (default hotkey) selects all of your towers.
[*]Targeting priority hotkeys will now work without first opening the targeting menu.
[*]In [b]Co-op[/b], players now start near one of the existing portals.
[*]For the [b]Balanced Paths[/b] option in [b]Co-op[/b], changing the player slot will actually change what path is active
[*][b]Co-op Builder Movespeed[/b] increased by 15%
[*]On [b]Volcano Co-op[/b], the long paths now move at x1.5 speed (down from x2 speed), but have x1.5 HP
[*]On [b]Tundra Co-op[/b], flipped the Start/End positions for the 4th Path
[*]When drag-selecting or double-clicking towers, Trickery Clones will no longer be included in selection with the original towers.
[*]Default tab on [b]Damage Overview[/b] is now [b]Current[/b] instead of [b]Total[/b]
[*]Adjusted [b]MMR Search Range[/b] such that if you've played 10 or more matches, it'll expand to 375 up or down. If you've done less than 10 though, it'll stay at 225 up or down.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/cad4d815161eb4bb35824c05a830dc82607f4a9c.jpg[/img]
[i]Welcome to the [b]Pinnacle[/b]! Coordinating on this map will be quite the challenge.[/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a time format issue that was breaking the game for certain players.
[*]Fixed an issue where searching a Ranked Game by Queue would have a shorter [b]MMR Search Range[/b] than by Notification
[*]Fixed [b]Timescale[/b] resetting to x1 when Player 1 dies while viewing replays
[*]Fixed [b]Essence Upgrade[/b] showing up in the Scoreboard before killing the Essence Boss
[*]Fixed [b]Minimap Offset[/b] on Tundra
[*]Fixed [b]Right-Click Indicator[/b] getting swallowed by the high ground way on more vertical maps
[*]Fixed [b]Astral's[/b] extra projectiles ignoring its targeting setting
[*]Fixed a bug where if a tower gets too many [b]Cursed[/b] stacks, it'd stop attacking for a while. Cursed is now capped at 15 stacks, which shouldn't affect actual balance, given it's negligible at that point.
[*]Fixed [b]Temporal[/b] not triggering its ability within the first two seconds of it spawning
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/e68ae35e3e7d7a6584efc4dbffee1873af559c6f.jpg[/img]
[i]They can't all be blue now, can they?[/i]

[h2]Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Level 3 Elemental Boss & Essence Boss HP[/b] reduced by about 10%
[*][b]Bulky Creeps[/b] now move 10% slower
[*][b]Wave Times[/b] starting from Wave 56 onwards are now 3 seconds, matching the rest of the game
[*][b]Level 2 Dual Tower[/b] gold cost reduced from 800 to 750
[*][b]Level 3 Dual Tower[/b] gold cost reduced from 3300 to 3150
[*][b]Light[/b] damage increased from 100 / 600 / 3600 / 43200 to 110 / 660 / 3960 / 47520
[*][b]Light[/b] consecutive bonus reduced from 5 / 30 / 180 / 2160 to 4 / 24 / 144 / 1728
[*][b]Darkness[/b] damage reduced from 280 / 1680 / 10080 / 120960 to 270 / 1620 / 9720 / 116640
[*][b]Water[/b] damage increased from 85 / 510 / 3060 / 36720 to 90 / 540 / 3240 / 38880
[*][b]Water[/b] damage bonus reduced from 40% to 30%
[*][b]Fire[/b] damage reduced from 32 / 192 / 1152 / 13824 to 27 / 162 / 972 / 11664
[*][b]Fire[/b] damage stops growing after 60 seconds now, down from 120[list]
[*]You probably won't notice this anywhere now, outside of [b]Extreme[/b].
[/list]
[*][b]Nature[/b] effect duration increased from 3 to 4 seconds
[*][b]Atom[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 300 / 1200 / 4800 to 330 / 1320 / 5280
[*]Consecutive damage bonus increased from 10% to 13%
[*]Now only carries over 30% of its stacks when switching targets, down from 50%
[/list]
[*][b]Lightning[/b] damage reduced from 150 / 600 / 2400 to 145 / 580 / 2320
[*][b]Poison[/b] duration increased from 15 to 20 seconds
[*][b]Poison[/b] duration extender has been removed
[*][b]Ice[/b] damage reduced from 800 / 3200 / 12800 to 550 / 2200 / 8800
[*][b]Ice[/b] range increased from 900 to 1150
[*][b]Infernal[/b] damage reduced from 650 / 2600 / 10400 to 600 / 2400 / 9600
[*][b]Bloom[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 550 / 2200 / 8800 to 350 / 1400 / 5600
[*]AoE increased from 0 to 200
[*]Range reduced from 900 to 750
[*]Default targeting priority changed from Front to Near
[*]Attack is now a Beam, meaning it hits instantly (it's a [b]Laserplant[/b] now)
[*]Attack speed now increases by 1 per second while not attacking, and decreases by 0.5 per second while attacking.
[/list]
[*][b]Mushroom[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 125 / 500 / 2000 to 135 / 540 / 2160
[*]Effect reworked so that it now deals 100% more damage if the creep's health is above 50%
[/list]
[*][b]Geyser[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 900 / 3600 / 14400 to 1000 / 4000 / 16000
[*]Range reduced from 900 to 750
[*]Ability now triggers every 4 attacks, down from 5
[/list]
[*][b]Howitzer[/b] damage reduced from 170 / 680 / 2720 to 160 / 640 / 2560
[*][b]Ethereal[/b] damage increased from 900 / 3600 to 950 / 3800
[*][b]Ethereal[/b] stack duration increased from 3 to 4 seconds
[*][b]Runic[/b] ability search radius reduced from 300 to 250
[*][b]Wisp[/b] damage increased from 750 / 3000 to 800 / 3200
[*][b]Flooding[/b] damage increased from 400 / 1600 to 420 / 1680
[*][b]Flooding[/b] consecutive AoE bonus reduced from 15 to 12
[*][b]Windstorm[/b] damage-per-second increased from 550 / 2200 to 700 / 2800
[*][b]Windstorm[/b] AoE reduced from 600 to 400
[*][b]Polar[/b] damage increased from 1400 / 5600 to 1500 / 6000
[*][b]Haste[/b] attack speed gain rate reduced from 7% to 5%
[*][b]Haste[/b] attack speed now decays over 5 seconds, down from 7 seconds
[*][b]Impulse[/b] damage increased from 2200 / 8800 to 2300 / 9200
[*][b]Quake[/b] shockwave damage reduced from 3000 / 12000 to 2500 / 10000
[*][b]Quake[/b] shockwave now triggers every 8 attacks, down from 10
[*][b]Money[/b] damage increased from 3000 / 12000 to 3200 / 12800
[*][b]Money[/b] effect damage bonus increased from 15% / 30% to 20% / 40%[list]
[*]Damage cap remains unchanged
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/3d8e84535b9b0647053bc814498baf75d35cbc0a.jpg[/img]
[i]I reiterate. [b]Laserplant[/b].[/i]


That's it for [b]Version 1.1[/b]! As per usual, since there were a bunch of balance tweaks, [u][b]Score Leaderboards[/b] have been reset[/u].

From now on, if we do a small patch, it'll increment by 0.01, and when we do a larger patch, we'll round up to the next tenth. Speaking of, up next we'll be aiming to overhaul [b]War Mode[/b] into something more competitive and scalable to 8 players. We're also getting close to locking in [b]Quad Tower Design[/b], so hopefully in the coming weeks, we'll be able to start sharing those with you soon as well!

notes.title: Where is Version 1.03?
notes.content:
The weekend is gone and past, and many of you were probably wondering... where is [b]Version 1.03[/b]? Well, we're ironing out some bugs and balance still, and we decided to delay it a week. ... we just forgot to put up an announcement over here letting you know until now, so apologies about.

One more thing, we're adjusting how we're doing the version increments. Previously, we incremented by 0.01 because we wanted leeway prior to [b]Version 1.00[/b], but now that we're past [b]Official Release[/b], we're making a little tweak:[list]
[*]If it's a small release, it'll increment by 0.01
[*]If it's a larger release with more content and features, it'll round up to the next 0.1
[/list]
That said, [b]Version 1.03[/b] will in fact be [b]Version 1.1[/b], and it'll arrive for absolute sure by this [b]Friday[/b]!

notes.title: New Patch coming soon!
notes.content:
We know it's been quiet here, but fret not, we've been working on a new version. Coming in [b]Version 1.03[/b], expect to see:[list]
[*]5th Co-op Map
[*]Specific starting positions in Co-op
[*]Define your own Hotkeys!
[*]The ability to set your own default Focus/Priorities on towers
[*]Manual Cast for specific towers
[*]Balance shenanigans
[*]And more!
[/list]

As this is a balance patch, [u]expect the [b]Score Leaderboards[/b] to be reset[/u]. If you want to preview the patch, [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]hop onto our Discord[/url] and check the pinned post in #testers to gain access to the alpha branch.

[strike][b]Version 1.03[/b] will be released [b]this coming weekend[/b]![/strike]

EDIT: Sorry for the delay, [b][strike]Version 1.03[/strike] Version 1.1[/b] will be released this Friday, on the 18th!

notes.title: Version 1.02 - Optimizations and Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]Game engine changed from [b]Unity 2018.4[/b] to [b]Unity 2020.3[/b][list]
[*]As a result, this patch has an abnormally large download size, so just be aware of that.
[*]The game now loads much faster than before.
[*]This should also result in some degree of performance improvements. For some, it's minimal; for others, it seems like it may help more. In the off-chance it got worse, please let us know!
[/list]
[*]Added [b]Vsync[/b] graphics option, which is set to [b]Off[/b] by default[list]
[*]Turning it [b]On[/b] may or may not result in a performance improvement for you, give it a shot and see.
[*]Additionally, this will override the [b]Frame Cap[/b] setting, so if you want to rely on that instead, keep [b]Vsync[/b] turned [b]Off[/b]
[/list]
[*]Turned off some useless debugs in the output log[list]
[*]FYI, this is now known as player.log, instead of output_log.txt
[/list]
[*]On the final wave of M28, score moved from the creeps to the bosses, so technically, waiting will no longer be more beneficial for score
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed [b]Ranked Mode[/b] issue where you could load into a blank screen
[*]Fixed [b]Replay Browser[/b] being broken
[*]Fixed some tooltips on some settings
[*]Fixed [b]Temple Variant[/b] infinite loading bug in [b]War Mode[/b]
[*]Fixed [b]Self Leaderboard[/b] only listing yourself
[/list]

Although this patch comes with some degree of performance improvements, the game is still unfortunately intensive on the GPU. To that end, we've got more things we're going to try out over the next few months that will hopefully tone it down.

Now that we've gotten some backend stuff updated and out of the way, we can return to adding some content and other quality-of-life features! Coming next patch, we'll be adding some long-requested features, like customizable hotkeys, the ability to mute players, and more [b]Ranked Mode[/b] fixes, as well as the [b]5th Co-op Map[/b]! For those of you who have completed the [b]Campaign[/b], the map in question will be from that last mission.

notes.title: Version 1.01.a - Measures Against Cheating
notes.content:
We've made some changes to break existing cheat trainers and make future ones harder to develop. [b]THIS IS NOT DRM.[/b]

As an added bonus, there is actually a small CPU performance improvement!

Also the Swedish localization was improved.

notes.title: Version 1.01 - Fixes and More Fixes
notes.content:
It's been nearly a month since release, and while overall it's been fairly successful, there's been lots of bugs and other stuff that's been reported. This patch here aims to address some of it with a mix of quality-of-life updates, bug fixes, and tweaks to the [b]Campaign[/b].


[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]There's now an option to turn [b]In-Game Notifications[/b] off
[*][b]Essence Prompt[/b] replaced by flashing essence icon in the corner, so that it's much less intrusive/in your face
[*]The [b]Speed Score Multiplier[/b] is now listed in the corner next to the time
[*]Creeps now list the actual movement speed value, and if it goes up or down, it'll now list the % change
[*]If there's an [b]Elemental Boss[/b] next to a bunch of other creeps, it should be much easier to select the [b]Boss[/b] now
[*]Toggling [b]Ready On/Off[/b] in a lobby now has a 2 second cooldown
[*]Once the countdown begins in a lobby, the host can no longer kick/switch players (which previously led to breaking the lobby)
[*]Minor optimization improvements
[*][b]Max Sound Channels[/b] increased from 32 to 64
[*][b]Western Mode[/b] can now be toggled On/Off in-game (yeehaw)
[*][b]New Trail[/b] added: Fractal Squared
[*]Chinese Localization has been improved
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed being able to do an online singleplayer game while in [b]Ranked Queue[/b] at the same time, causing lots of disconnect shenanigans
[*]Fixed [b]Extreme Mode[/b] bug where creeps would mysteriously stop spawning at a certain point
[*]Fixed an issue where you could sometimes unintentionally "double-click" and select all towers of a type
[*]Fixed a bug where changing a tower's [b]Focus[/b] setting wouldn't transfer to a [b]Clone[/b]
[*]Fixed names not being colorized in replays
[*]Fixed [b]Random Map[/b] showing up in the [b]Co-op Leaderboards[/b]
[*]Fixed Co-op and Team Leaderboards cutting off before 100 entries are shown
[/list]

[h2]Campaign[/h2][list]
[*]In the [b]Campaign[/b], "Insufficient Requirements" now lists the actual requirements
[*]When you have a [b]Specialization[/b], affected stats are now green/red, depending on whether they were increased/decreased
[*]There's now an option to turn the [b]Hint Box[/b] off by default
[*][b]Transference[/b] stacks can no longer transfer to [b]Spawners[/b]
[*]M2 Score Thresholds reduced, that one was apparently sorta ridiculous
[*]Toned down the HP of the Light/Dark creeps at the end of M18, Wave 25
[*]M25 Speed Multiplier kicked down, shouldn't be nearly as easy to 4-star it
[*]Fixed M25 Achievement breaking if you built during the 10 seconds before Wave 25 actually starts
[*]Fixed M25 Achievement also breaking as a result of Trickery Clones
[*]Fixed a bug where multiple [b]Slingshot Bosses[/b] could launch a creep flying so fast that it flies off the map (and in some cases, resulted in it being unkillable because it was so far out-of-bounds)
[*]Fixed Income hover display resetting to 0 when loading Checkpoint
[*]Fixed loading Checkpoint resetting your available Essence
[/list]

That's it for [b]Version 1.01[/b]! It's not all the bugs that have been reported (we're still hacking away at them, keep your reports comin'), but it's a good start. There's also some more pressing concerns that we're going to try and in address in the coming weeks:[list]
[*]The game is a serious hog on the GPU
[*]Cheaters
[/list]
On the second point, we have noticed an influx of cheaters recently, both in [b]Ranked[/b] play and on the [b]Leaderboard[/b]. We've got some fixes in mind that should help mitigate that, if not erase it entirely. In the meantime, if we catch you cheating, be it raising your gold/elements in-game or plopping an impossible entry on the [b]Leaderboard[/b], [u]we will ban you[/u]. More automated measures will be coming soon.

notes.title: What's next for Element TD 2?
notes.content:
About two weeks ago, [b]Element TD 2[/b] officially released into [b]Version 1.00[/b], and we've seen a huge increase in the number of players! Reception has been generally positive, and for those not as happy with the game, we've been working on fixes to address those concerns.

Now that we've released though, folks have been wondering what's next for us. This isn't quite a [b]Roadmap[/b], but In this post, we'll be addressing both short-term and long-term plans. Read on for the full preview!


[h2][b]Short Term[/b][/h2]
[h3]Version 1.01[/h3]
Within the next few days, we'll be releasing the next version, which should contain a mix of bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements. Ranked disconnects, more options for fine-tuning notifications, Campaign tweaks, and more!

FYI, due to changes we're making on the backend, when this patch releases, if you have a [b]Checkpoint[/b] in the [b]Campaign[/b], it will unfortunately be nuked (meaning [b]Load Checkpoint[/b] from the menu won't be available until you reach a new [b]Checkpoint[/b]). We apologize in advance for this inconvenience.


[h3]Quality of Life Updates[/h3]
Over the next few months, expect to see the following:[list]
[*]Define your own [b]Hotkeys[/b]
[*]Improved [b]Localization[/b]
[*]5th [b]co-op map[/b]
[*]Set your own default [b]Targeting Priorities[/b]
[*]Improved [b]Tower Customization[/b] screen
[*]Performance [b]Optimization[/b]
[*]And more!
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
Unlike [b]Early Access[/b] where there were balance patches every 1-2 months, we're extending that period a bit and aiming for 2-3 months. The game's overall balance is pretty solid now, and while there are things to adjust, there isn't as much of a need to change it immediately. Like before, [b]Score Leaderboards[/b] will be reset whenever there's new balance.

Expect a [b]Balance Patch[/b] to arrive in [b]June[/b] or [b]July[/b]!


[h2][b]Long Term[/b][/h2]
[h3]Quad Element Towers[/h3]
Since the start of [b]Early Access[/b], we've long teased the idea of [b]Quad Element Towers[/b], and you folks have been posting a slew of ideas, both on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1018830/discussions/1/1750150188482518613/]our Forums[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url]. Obviously, this update will fundamentally change the game, as it'll add 15 towers to the game. Not only that, but we also plan to change the [b]Essence Upgrade[/b] into something much more interesting than its current incarnation.

[b]Quads[/b] are expected to release as a [b]Free Update[/b] by the end of the year. In the meantime, post your ideas to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1018830/discussions/1/1750150188482518613/]our Forums[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]our Discord[/url]!


[h3]Mazing DLC[/h3]
Later this year, we plan on adding [b]Mazing Mode[/b] to the game as a [b]DLC[/b]! In this mode, you'll be able to make your own mazes, rather than deal with a predetermined path. As this will be a paid expansion, this will be a larger update than the norm. Expect its own [b]Maps[/b], [b]Leaderboards[/b], and even a [b]Mazing Campaign[/b]!

We'll provide more info as we get closer to its release, which is expected by the end of the year. Whether it's before or after the [b]Quad Towers[/b] update, we can't confirm yet.


[h3]An Actual Tutorial[/h3]
Although the early part of the [b]Campaign[/b] sort of covers some basics, it's a farcry from an actual in-depth [b]Tutorial[/b], and there's [i]a lot[/i] of aspects of the game that aren't really covered well anywhere, like [b]UI[/b], how to use [b]Support Towers[/b], how to make use of 100% Sell in [b]Random[/b], etc.

Throughout the rest of the year, we'll be adding actual [b]Tutorials[/b] to the game, covering everything from [b]Basics[/b] to more [b]Advanced Tactics[/b].


[h2][b]Other Stuff[/b][/h2]
[h3]Ranked Mode[/h3]
A lot of people play this mode, both in [b]Pick & Random[/b], and while many certainly enjoy increasing their rank, it's not necessarily clear how that MMR is calculated. Or that the mode is locked into [b]Very Hard[/b]. Or if there's any rewards for reaching a higher rank. Or if- you get the point.

In general, expect to see a mix of UI and quality-of-life improvements to this mode throughout the year, an improved formula for going up or down in MMR, and eventually, actual rewards for going up in the ranks.

As for the possibility of other modes getting a [b]Ranked[/b] adaption - presently, we can't confirm if there'll be a [b]Ranked Teams[/b] or [b]Ranked War[/b] added.


[h3]Speaking of War Mode[/h3]
When hosting a game, you may have noticed something called [b]War Mode[/b] (or [b]Team War[/b]). The intent of this mode was to provide a 1v1 experience with very active counterplay. To that end, we [i]almost[/i] succeeded, but the mode is falling short of its full potential. Certain towers dominate it, the abilities become something of a waiting game, and in general, there's not enough to do in the mode, despite being more active than the standard game.

We intend on revamping this mode into something that achieves our original vision, and will be scalable to a higher player count. In the meantime though, it's still a fun and frantic mode. Find a friend and give it a try, and let us know what you'd like to see from it. The entire dev team considers it a hidden gem!


[h3]Will there be a Chapter 5?[/h3]
Most likely yes! However, this is a [i]long ways[/i] off and won't release until sometime next year. When it does, it'll be a [b]DLC[/b], but it'll also be the most significant chunk of the [b]Campaign[/b] yet. Look forward to it... eventually.


[h3]Regarding Workshop Support...[/h3]
More than anything on this list, we keep getting people asking if they could make their own maps for the game. Presently, [b]Workshop Support[/b] is not planned for this year. It's not entirely out of the question, but in order to support it, we'd need to completely overhaul our backend. If it happens, it would come after both [b]Quad Element Towers[/b] and [b]Mazing DLC[/b].

We know this is a highly requested feature, and yes, it would be really cool to see it implemented into the game. But it's also a large project that could take us many months to complete, and rather than have you guys waiting a really long time for that, we would rather push out more modes, towers, and other updates that can be completed in a significantly shorter amount of time. We'll continue to research it as we deliver more content to you.


[h2][b]In Conclusion[/b][/h2]
We hope this answers your questions about what's coming next. We know it's short on actual details, but fret not, we'll expand on those with proper previews as we get closer to the various updates.

notes.title: Version 1.00.a - Hotfixes
notes.content:
[h2]Campaign Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]The [b]AoE Upgrade[/b] now applies the gold cost increase to [i]all towers[/i], even though it only increases the AoE of AoE Towers.[list]
[*]This fixes an exploit where you could upgrade a Single-Target Tower to an AoE Tower, and then sell it for net profit. Or vice versa, where you could lose gold.
[*]To counterbalance this change, the [b]AoE Upgrade[/b] has been increased from 10% / 20% / 30% to 15% / 30% / 45%
[/list]
[*]Fixed upgrading from [b]Arrow/Cannon[/b] to [b]Elemental Towers[/b] not being affected by the gold cost increase of [b]Range/AoE Upgrades[/b]
[*]Fixed the Fire Spawners in [b]M25 - Wave 8[/b] having an extra 0 in its HP
[*]Fixed [b]Geyser Spec 1[/b] reducing range
[*]Fixed the giant bright flare of doom in Mission 23
[*]Fixed a bug where you could get a "free element pick" on certain missions, which could stack up over time
[*]Fixed a bug where, if you had the [b]Income Upgrade[/b], and you loaded from checkpoint, you'd lose the extra gold from the most recent wave.
[*]Toned down the last 5 waves of [b]Mission 6[/b], particularly the third path.
[/list]
[h2]Other Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a rare freeze error that could occur when selling a tower
[*]Fixed [b]Super Galaxy Hat[/b] for towers missing its icon
[*]Fixed not being able to see anything in [b]Tropical Variant[/b]
[*]Fixed a bug where, after you die, you can't select someone else's towers
[*]Fixed a bug in [b]Ranked[/b] where you could match with someone outside of the 150 MMR search range
[*]Fixed [b]Tundra[/b] minimap offset
[*]Fixed various tooltip errors

[*]Updated the VFX for the [b]Elemental Master[/b] trail
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.00 - Official Release!
notes.content:
After 13 months in [b]Early Access[/b], we're proud to announce that [b]Element TD 2[/b] has officially released! With it, the price has increased from $9.99 to $14.99, along with a host of new content and features. We also have a fancy new launch trailer, courtesies of community member [b]Wade[/b]. Check it out here:

[previewyoutube=hUO80FrK7kk;full][/previewyoutube]

And now onto the longest patch notes to date. Here's the full release notes for [b]Version 1.00[/b]!

[h2]Chapter 4[/h2][list]
[*][b]Chapter 4[/b] of the [b]Campaign[/b] is here, with 7 more missions to cap it out! The maps are bigger, the challenges are harder, and it packs some diabolical surprises, including:[list]
[*][b]Adaptive Creeps[/b]: Each wave, these become highly resistant to one of your elements. Whatever tower tops the damage tracker for the wave, [b]Adaptive Creeps[/b] will take 25% damage from that tower's element on the next wave.
[*][b]Spawners[/b]: Every 15 seconds, it spawns 3 small creeps with 15% HP each. There is no cap on the number of creeps these can spawn, so kill them fast!
[*]And [b]3 New Bosses[/b]!
[/list]
[*]New [b]Upgrade Column[/b] in the [b]Loadout[/b]. These are passive upgrades that can help bolster your defenses. Requires beating [b]Chapter 2[/b] before you gain access to them.[list]
[*][b]Income[/b]: At the end of each wave, gain 5% / 10% / 15% end-of-wave bonus.
[*][b]Extra Lives[/b]: Start with 10% / 20% / 30% more lives.
[*][b]Range Bonus[/b]: All towers gain 10% / 20% / 30% more range, but they cost 5% / 10% / 15% more gold.
[*][b]AoE Bonus[/b]: All AoE towers gain 10% / 20% / 30% more AoE, but they cost 5% / 10% / 15% more gold.
[*][b]Essence[/b]: Gain 1 / 2 / 3 Essence to be used for building Level 4 Single Element or Periodic Towers
[/list]
[*]New [b]Achievements[/b] for [b]Chapter 4[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Trebuchets Only[/b]: Clear Mission 22 on Hard using only Towers with 1250 Range or more (including Range upgrades)
[*][b]Splash Defense[/b]: Clear Mission 23 on Normal using only towers with 200 AoE or more
[*][b]Triad of Light[/b]: Clear Mission 24 on Normal using only Light, Water, and Nature Elements
[*][b]Set of Annihilation[/b]: Clear Mission 25 on Hard without building a single tower during the last wave
[*][b]Triad of Darkness[/b]: Clear Mission 26 on Normal using only Darkness, Fire, and Earth Elements
[*][b]Full Support[/b]: Clear Mission 27 on Normal using only Buff, Slow, and Damage Amp Towers
[*][b]Portal Master[/b]: Clear Mission 28 on Very Hard without using Infernal Towers
[*][b]Wizard Prime[/b]: Clear all Mission in Chapter 4
[*][b]Annihilator[/b]: Get 4 Stars on every Chapter 4 Mission
[*][b]Master of Elements[/b]: Clear all 28 Missions in the Campaign
[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/34a5e85e17e8a41f0171dfe48831934b8f1c17ac.jpg[/img]
[i]You can reach some pretty silly ranges on certain towers now, thanks to the new upgrades.[/i]


[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]4th Co-op Map[/b] added: [b]Tundra[/b]!
[*]In [b]Campaign[/b], you can now pick up where you last left off, thanks to a new [b]Continue[/b] button![list]
[*]How it works is whenever you reach a [b]Checkpoint[/b] (aka every [b]Wave Break[/b]), it'll save your progress for that mission, letting you quit the game and later continue where you last left off.
[*]However, you can only hold onto one [b]Checkpoint[/b] at a time, so if you try changing to a different mission, it'll warn you that it'll erase your previous [b]Checkpoint[/b].
[/list]
[*]In [b]Campaign[/b], there is now a [b]Hint Box[/b] in the bottom-left corner, which you can toggle on/off. This gives extra insights on the game and tips for specific missions.
[/list]
[*][b]New Cosmetics[/b]:[list]
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Master Captain
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Titan
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: An Actual Duck
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: ???
[*][b]New Hat[/b]: Super Galaxy
[*][b]New Trail[/b]: Nebula
[*][b]New Trail[/b]: Elemental Master
[*]Additionally, some of the high level [b]Cosmetics[/b] can now be unlocked by completing certain [b]Achievements[/b]. You'll still need to buy them with [b]Shop Points[/b] though.
[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/41cbe960b4dd341d0d2d7bd2b5726cd2523e4c21.jpg[/img]
[i]Introducing [b]Tundra[/b], the 4th Co-op Map! And one of the new missions in [b]Chapter 4[/b].[/i]


[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]When hosting a [b]Multiplayer[/b] lobby, the default map is now set to [b]Random Map[/b].
[*]Added a [b]Random Map[/b] option to [b]Co-op Mode[/b].
[*]In [b]Singleplayer[/b], the game now remembers the last Mission you were playing, as well as what difficulty.
[*][b]War Mode[/b] now gives you a primer about how the game works during the loading screen.
[*][b]UI[/b] shrunk by about 10%.
[*]Maps now have actual borders and skyboxes instead of the darkness of [b]Fog of War[/b]
[*]Switched [b]Tropical Variant[/b] out with the second version that shows up in the [b]Campaign[/b], which is a far more interesting map.
[*][b]Winter Variant[/b] is back to 2-Path by default, but its short path moves at 80% speed
[*]Adjusted [b]Advanced Paths[/b] for:[list]
[*][b]Wasteland[/b] now speeds up creeps by 20%
[*][b]Desert[/b] paths are asymmetrical
[*][b]Autumn[/b] paths are asymmetrical
[*][b]Winter[/b] paths are asymmetrical
[*][b]Forest Variant[/b] third path no longer pingpongs. Instead, it goes to its own portal at 75% speed.
[*][b]Winter Variant[/b] short path is reversed and moves at full speed
[/list]
[*]In [b]No Sell Mode[/b], you can now cancel building/upgrading. But once it finishes, you're locked in.
[*]Right-clicking on the [b]Mini-map[/b] no longer moves your camera
[*][b]Geyser[/b] bounce has been slowed and looks considerably smoother
[*][b]Earth, Fire, Bloom & Money Towers[/b] now have status icons that track their bonuses.
[*]Removed the [b]In Good Health[/b] Achievement from the game, as it no longer exists.
[*][b]Missions[/b] now give you a decent amount of XP when clearing them.
[*]When you clear a mission, it now displays a [b]Mission Cleared[/b] message.
[*][b]Chapter 2[/b] has been made roughly 10% easier
[*]The second half of [b]Mission 11[/b] has been redesigned, it should be much more fair than it was before
[*]The last wave of [b]Mission 18[/b] has also been toned down, particularly the boss
[*]Minor optimization improvements
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/cc9fa82c36001efc0199679140a73dadba190e46.jpg[/img]
[i]As you load into a [b]War Mode[/b] game, it now briefly tells you how it works.[/i]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Attempt #63849 on fixing the [b]Ranked Disconnect[/b] error.[list]
[*]We're pretty sure we nailed down the exact cause, and we've added some stopgaps that should prevent it. [i]Should[/i].
[/list]
[*]Coincidentally, fixed the zombie lobby bug.
[*]Fixed a bug where, if you upgrade a tower, then cancel the upgrade, it'd reset your changed target priority.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Fire Tower's[/b] damage could stop going up and get permanently stuck.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Wisp Tower[/b] was doing 40% less damage than intended.
[*]Fixed a bug where the VFX of [b]Fast Creeps[/b] would flash across the whole map on leak.
[*]Fixed a bug where winning a [b]Co-op[/b] game counted as 2 Wins instead of 1.
[*]Fixed checkpoints not saving [b]Damage Overview[/b] information.
[*]Fixed manual targeting not overriding your [b]Focus Target[/b] setting.
[*]Fixed loading from a checkpoint turning [b]Focus Target[/b] setting to off.
[*]Fixed loading from a checkpoint resetting statistics for Towers Built/Sold, Creeps Killed, and Total Interest statistics at the end of the mission.
[*]Fixed tooltips going off-screen,
[*]Fixed hover tooltips vanishing upon clearing the wave,
[*]Fixed Mission 10 Achievement being clearable on Normal Difficulty,
[*]Fixed [b]Geyser's[/b] AoE displaying 300 AoE for its standard attack and 0 AoE for its ability (this was purely a UI issue)
[*]Fixed toggling [b]Show VFX[/b] off not actually removing the Shoot/Hit effects. It should only be showing projectiles.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/fbdf26c7819bed17d94b4e7058e51261bb088cba.jpg[/img]
[i]One of the new missions features a spiral heading down several tiers, with interlacing paths on the corners.[/i]


[h2]General Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Income Upgrade[/b] extra creeps spawned reduced from 6 / 12 to 4 / 8. However, you now gain a 5% / 10% end-of-wave gold bonus.
[*][b]DIminishing Returns[/b] increased from 6% to 7% per stack
[*][b]Bulky[/b] HP Multiplier increased from x2.25 to x2.5
[*][b]Bulky[/b] creep spacing reduced from 1.5 to 0.75[list]
[*]For reference, all other waves have a spacing of 0.5
[/list]
[*][b]Temporal[/b] now triggers its ability when it loses 25% of its Max HP and only jumps half the distance.

[h2]Ranked & Leaderboards[/h2][list]
[*]First off, congratulations to [b]__Tobias__[/b], [b]HerrDirektor[/b], and [b]Funkelinchen[/b] and [b]wadebbqwall2[/b] for topping the [b]Ranked Leaderboards[/b]![list]

[/list]

[*]Rank up thresholds reduced to actually achievable values: 400, 600, 800, 1000 and 1200

It's been a long journey since the start of [b]Element TD 2[/b]. In the beginning, our vision was to make a faithful successor to original, but when we launched into [b]Early Access[/b], we found that alone wasn't enough. Over time, we've added an insane amount of content and features, including [b]Co-op, New Maps & Modes, Achievements, Cosmetics,[/b] and even a full on [b]Campaign[/b]. We've also seen tremendous growth in our community and our [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Discord Server[/url].

All in all, we couldn't have done it without you, so this is a thank you to everyone that's supported us along the way. Enjoy the [b]Official Release[/b], and we hope you'll stick around for a while longer as we transition into [b]Post-Release[/b]!

notes.title: Patch Preview - April Fools!
notes.content:
It's [b]April 1st[/b], and you know what that means? Yes, [b]Element TD 2[/b] is scheduled to release in exactly one day from now! To help hype you up, we've prepared a special patch preview of things you can expect in tomorrow's release. Read on for the full notes!


[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*]The [b]Campaign[/b] has been made a fully competitive experience, matching you up against other players doing the same respective mission.[list]
[*]Whoever clears the wave first starts the next wave for everybody.
[*]Whoever hits the "Ready" button first will end the wave break for everybody.
[*]This pulls the game closer towards a true [b]Multiplayer Tower Defense[/b] experience, and we think the game will greatly benefit from increased competition in all aspects of the game.
[/list]
[*][b]Chapter 4[/b] has been removed from the game and will return after a brief hiatus from its time-traveling journeys. Wish it luck.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]Constantly selling all of your towers prior to every [b]Interest[/b] tick is now mandatory. Failure to do so will give you a VAC ban.
[*]When hosting a [b]Multiplayer[/b] lobby, the default map is now set to [b]Random Game[/b]. Upon playing, you'll be thrown into a random game other than [b]Element TD 2[/b].
[*]Several players have complained that the game's [b]UI[/b] is too small and often unreadable, so we increased the size of it by 300%.
[*]The [b]Advanced Paths[/b] modifier improves the pathfinding of the creeps. They'll now use [i]Advanced Tactics[/i] and strike from multiple directions at once, even where there's no path. Where they're going, they don't need roads.
[*]Added a [b]True Sound Mode[/b] to the game, which unlocks the full potential of the game's sound. Instead of hearing drums, you'll hear towers in their native habitats. [i]That's a bad omen[/i].
[*]The [b]Fog of War[/b] on the edge of maps can now be revealed by sending your builder into the uncharted territories. Who knows what discoveries they'll find?
[*][b]No Sell Mode[/b] is now on by default, and it prevents you from selling and refunding this game. Attempting to turn it off will sell [i]you[/i].
[*]We've noticed the GPU usage of the game is startling high, but it provides little to no rewards. We've optimized it so that it will now mine bitcoin in the background. Now there's no reason to complain to about your GPU setting itself on fire, as long as you're able to make money while playing.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed you to successfully connect to a [b]Ranked Match[/b].
[*]Fixed a minor bug that allowed [b]WindStrike[/b] to balance the game.
[*]Fixed an issue that allowed players to select Normal Difficulty.
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed [b]Ronalds[/b] to die.
[/list]

[h2]General Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Difficulties[/b] have been revamped:[list]
[*][b]Normal[/b] has been changed to [b]Easy Mode[/b], which is required for anyone from [b]Element TD Mobile[/b] edition.
[*][b]Hard[/b] has been removed from the game.
[*][b]Very Hard[/b] is not a real word.
[*][b]Insane[/b] has been replaced with [b]Bullet Hell Lunatic Mode[/b], which requires your Builder to dodge and defeat creeps swarming from all directions simultaneously. Any time you get hit, one of your towers is randomly removed from the game's code.
[/list]
[*][b]Creep[/b] abilities were often deemed underpowered and uninteresting and hardly affected the game at all. To that end, we hope these changes will increase their challenge level slightly:[list]
[*]When an [b]Undead Creep[/b] revives, it now reduces your lives by 1.
[*][b]Healing Creeps[/b] now heal themselves upon death, reviving them to 30% HP. This can trigger multiple times.
[*][b]Fast Creeps[/b] have been removed from the game, due to speeding ticket costs.
[*][b]Slow Creeps[/b] have been removed from the game for not making it on time.
[*][b]Shield Creeps[/b] are now naturally invulnerable and only become vulnerable when you insult them. You monster.
[*][b]Temporal Creeps[/b] will now time travel to the past to prevent them from getting harmed in the first place, creating a temporal paradox where you never built that tower, because that creep was never there, and neither were you.
[*][b]Bulky Creeps[/b] now have collision detection and will physically shove all other creeps out of the way and tip over towers.
[*][b]Cursed Creeps[/b] permanently reduce the attack speed of your towers by 10% per stack.
[*][b]Transference Creeps[/b] can now transfer their buff to towers. If any tower becomes large enough to engulf its neighbors, it'll explode, causing you to lose the game instantly.
[/list]
[*][b]Extra Short Mode[/b] was rushed in development. We apologize for taking so much time on it. It has been changed to [b]Strolling Mode[/b]. All creeps will now take their time to appreciate the view and occasionally stop to check out your towers.
[*][b]Random Mode[/b] causes towers to appear, fire, disappear, move, and update the game at random times.
[*][b]Chaos Mode[/b] randomly causes the timescale to change to a random value between x0.01 and x100 every 5 seconds, giving you a real sense of control.
[*][b]Extreme Mode[/b] now summons [b]Ronalds[/b] starting from Wave 1.
[/list]

[h2]Tower Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]New Tower Added[/b]: An actual tree[list]
[*]It has no stats. It has no grace. It's just a tree. Get used to it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/ec743491df0e0f80a3786ad7c8a4448362fe1e74.jpg[/img]
[i]This tree is so stealthy, it can hide among the game's props. Can the real [b]An Actual Tree[/b] please stand up?[/i]
[/list]
[*][b]Single Element Towers[/b]:[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed [b]Single Elements[/b] to get married.
[*][b]Light[/b] is now weightless and will float into the sky like a balloon.
[*][b]Darkness[/b] now fires ninjas from within the shadows of its projectiles. If you can see them, it's because there's a knife in your back. If you can't see them, that's unfortunate. You might want to inspect the knife in your back.
[*][b]Water[/b] now quenches the thirst of creeps, causing them to stop for a moment and get a drink of water.
[*][b]Fire[/b] now sets itself on fire as it gradually burns to its own death.
[*][b]Nature[/b] damage increased from 80 / 480 / 2880 / 28800 to infinity. None dares to oppose [b]Mother Nature[/b] and the natural disasters she brings forth.
[*][b]Earth[/b] has been removed from the game after getting tossed around by [b]Mother Nature Tower[/b].
[/list]
[*][b]Dual Element Towers[/b]:[list]
[*]Fixed an exploit that allowed [b]Dual Elements[/b] to get divorced.
[*][b]Atom[/b]: All towers have been replaced by [b]Atom Tower[/b], and the game has been renamed to [b]Atom TD 2[/b].
[*][b]Lightning[/b] is lonely without its companion, [b]Rain Tower[/b], and has thus elected to leave the game.
[*][b]Trickery[/b] can now clone builders. However, they are controlled by a growing AI that will soon consume the game.
[*][b]Poison[/b] has poisoned itself and is now laying dead on the floor.
[*][b]Disease[/b] is right next to the dead [b]Poison Tower[/b]. What did you expect?
[*][b]Solar[/b] renamed to [b]Burning Plant[/b], which no longer exists because now it's just a pile of ash.
[*][b]Infernal's[/b] appendages have been replaced by spider legs. Good luck getting that image out of your head.
[*][b]Blacksmith[/b] buffs can now stack infinitely.
[*][b]Vapor[/b] can now be inhaled. Now comes in grape flavor!
[*][b]Ice[/b]: Every time it fires, it plays a random variation of [b]Let it Go[/b] from the wide assortment of the internet itself. In its full length. Every time, and even when the tower is gone. If you don't like it, that's too bad, you'll just have to let it go.
[*][b]Well[/b] well well...
[*][b]Mushroom[/b] can be paired with dead creeps to create some tasty dishes. Eating them may or may not create a sense of high though...
[*][b]Bloom[/b] now increases the game's bloom intensity with every shot. Here comes the sun!
[*][b]Life[/b]: Due to lack of use, [b]Life Tower[/b] has been removed from the game.
[*][b]Howitzer[/b] range increased from 1500 to 15000000 and can now be used to launch artillery strikes into other games.
[*][b]Geyser[/b] corpses that have been yeeted into the air will now fall back down. Falling corpses will inflict fall damage to other creeps proportionate to the height and speed at which they fall.
[/list]
[*][b]Triple Element Towers[/b]:[list]
[*]Polygamy between elements is now legal.
[*]Due to imbalance, Polygamy is no longer possible, but still legal.
[*][b]Astral[/b] now summons meteors on the Earth. No, not the one in-game, the one directly outside your window-
[*][b]Laser[/b] now focuses all incoming projectiles into its crystals and refracts them in all directions with the power of physics. Are we sure we just used the word "refract" correctly? Probably not, but at least everything is dead now.
[*][b]Nova[/b] range reduced from 900 to -900. It now sucks in all creeps and towers in range, transforming it into a [b]Black Hole Tower[/b] and sucking up everything until the game itself has been pulled into its wake. There goes your Steam Library as well...
[*][b]Ethereal[/b] is no longer visible.
[*][b]Runic[/b] isn't a real tower, stop asking about it.
[*][b]Jinx[/b]: Creeps killed by this tower come back to life as [b]Cursed Creeps[/b].
[*][b]Flooding[/b] now continuously floods the map, until it not only hits every creep on the map, but floods and drowns out your own towers.
[*][b]Wisp[/b] has smoked itself and no longer exists.
[*][b]Windstorm[/b] has been renamed to [b]WindStrike Tower[/b]. Every time you do or say anything, it's delayed by [b]WindStrike Time[/b], which is comparable to [url=https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Valve_Time]Valve Time[/url], but 100% more random.
[*][b]Polar[/b] renamed to [b]Bipolar Tower[/b] and randomly switches between attacking creeps and attacking your towers.
[*][b]Haste[/b] attack speed cap removed. Even when your computer inevitably suffers from its firepower, it'll continue to attack faster and faster and faster...
[*][b]Flamethrower[/b] has been banned for excessively flaming. It's against the rules, don't do it.
[*][b]Corrosion's[/b] attacks will now eat through the terrain, creating holes that creeps can fall through and descend until they reach the molten center of the Earth.
[*][b]Impulse[/b] now attacks impulsively and preemptively, in an attempt to preempt the preemptiveness. This should help fix its late-game issues of being late for the game.
[*][b]Golem[/b] can now animate itself, allowing it to freely move around the map. That makes more sense, doesn't it?
[*][b]Root[/b] exists to counterbalance [b]Golem[/b], restricting its freedom. There may be a revolution soon...
[*][b]Incantation[/b] is unbalanced and can kindly burn in a fire.
[*][b]Quake[/b] can only be built by [b]Karawasa[/b]. Despite this, he will still find a way to lose the game.
[*][b]Money[/b]: In an attempt to make it more relevant, it will now increase your [b]Interest Rate[/b] by 0.01% per kill it makes. If this is still considered underpowered, we'll give it the ability to mine bitcoin.
[*][b]Muck[/b] is now out of commission due to allergy season.
[/list]
[*][b]Periodic[/b] will now only periodically attack.
[*]Due to lack of use, the [b]Builder[/b] has been removed from the game.
[/list]


In all seriousness, we're working on the finishing touches of [b]Version 1.00[/b], and the game is set to transition from [b]Early Access[/b] to [b]Official Release[/b] tomorrow, as the price raises from $9.99 to $14.99. Don't worry, we didn't spend too much time on this patch preview, as we're more focused on getting the game up and ready for release. Look forward to it!

notes.title: March 26th --> April 2nd
notes.content:
I know you're looking to [b]Version 1.00[/b] everything that comes with it, but we've made the decision to push it back another week... again. [b]Chapter 4[/b] is genuinely almost finished; however, it's a little unpolished, there's some stuff on the presentation end that needs to be fixed up, and we still have a handful of bugs to iron out. We'd rather it release as a polished product rather than something that has to be hotfixed repeatedly after-the-fact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/fbdf26c7819bed17d94b4e7058e51261bb088cba.jpg[/img]
[i]The new missions in [b]Chapter 4[/b] are more complex and layered than ever before.[/i]


Once again, we apologize for yet another delay and bad time estimates. This is the last delay, we're really close to the finish line. Just one more sprint!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/41cbe960b4dd341d0d2d7bd2b5726cd2523e4c21.jpg[/img]
[i]One of the missions will be doubling up as our 4th Co-op Map - [b]Tundra[/b]![/i]

notes.title: Ranked Testing for 1.00
notes.content:
Over the past few months, we've been trying to fix the stability of [b]Ranked Mode[/b], and although we mostly got it in the recent patch, people are still reporting more and more disconnects. We think we've figured out the cause, but in order to confirm if we've fixed it, we need a lot of people.

On Saturday, March 20th at 4pm GMT, we'll be running a bunch of Ranked Games on our alpha branch. To join, check the [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]#testers channel on our Discord[/url], and we'll coordinate it from there. Also, you'll have the opportunity to try out [b]Version 1.00's[/b] balance, which is nearly locked in at this point (short of someone finding something as abusable as the current [b]Atom Tower[/b]).

notes.title: We release in 2 Weeks!
notes.content:
It's been a long road since the start of [b]Early Access[/b] (longer than we initially expected), but we're finally approaching a close. On Friday, March 26th, [b]Element TD 2[/b] will go into [b]Official Release[/b], and the price will increase to $14.99. Additionally, we'll jump the version straight to 1.00. In that release, you can expect the following:[list]
[*][b]Chapter 4[/b] of the Campaign, containing the final 7 Missions
[*][b]New Achievements[/b] based off of Chapter 4
[*][b]4th Co-op Map[/b]
[*]Balance Changes (we know about [b]Atom[/b], don't worry)
[*]Both Score & Ranked Leaderboards resetting
[*]More [b]Cosmetics[/b]
[*]Various optimizations, bug fixes, and quality-of-life improvements as per usual
[/list]
The majority of 1.00's balance changes are up and ready for testing already on the alpha branch - if you'd like to try it out early, check the pinned post of the #testers channel [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]on our Discord[/url].

Additionally, the first four missions of [b]Chapter 4[/b] should be playable this coming Monday or Tuesday, with the rest coming in the lead-up to release. They'll be a little rough around the edges, but we'd appreciate it if some of you could try it early and give us feedback, particularly on how it's balanced.

Next week, we'll do a more thorough patch preview, particularly what you can expect from [b]Chapter 4[/b] and some of those balance notes. Till next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/322aff44a04ea8a5ca681da96b66ac4ee73401b9.jpg[/img]
[i]Elevation changes? In my Element TD? What sacrilege is this?[/i]
