notes.title: Version 0.66 - Team & Co-op Leaderboards
notes.content:
Believe it or not, it's been exactly one year since [b]Element TD 2[/b] entered [b]Early Access[/b]! Since then, the game's content and replayability have about quintupled, we've grown a pretty active [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Discord Server[/url], and we've gotten enough players to have regular games every day! And now, with this last patch, we're finally adding [b]Teams & Co-op Leaderboards[/b], among a bunch of other fixes ([b]Ranked Mode[/b] in particular).

Without further ado, let's get onto to [b]Version 0.66's[/b] patch notes!


[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]Team & Co-op Leaderboards[/b] have finally been added to the game![list]
[*]You'll notice, with more players, that you'' see numbers higher than 3 for each element. This is the totals of everyone's picks.
[/list]
[*]A [b]Focus Toggle[/b] button has been added, next to the tower targeting options. Hotkey is set to V.[list]
[*][b]Focus On[/b]: The tower will shoot creeps until they're dead or out-of-range before deciding its next target.
[*][b]Focus Off[/b]: The tower will decide its next target on each attack.
[/list]
[*][b]3 Cosmetics[/b] added:[list]
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Reaper
[*][b]New Wings[/b]: Gaia Wings
[*][b]New Hat[/b]: Dino Hat
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/d2d2e749afbdc14247a3f4ce4153bc296b29e6bf.jpg[/img]
[i]It tooks a while, but you can finally top the [b]Co-op Leaderboards[/b] [strike]with [b]Money Towers[/b][/strike]! Wait, where'd all these entries come from?[/i]


[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*][b]Ranked[/b] games only become valid once both players load in (as in, get past the loading screen, and the wave timer starts counting down). If either player disconnects prior to that, it is no longer considered a loss. The other player will receive a "Game Abandoned" message and be booted back to main menu.
[*][b]Ranked[/b] MMR search range increased from 225 to 300.
[*][b]Ranked Notification[/b] window increased from 15 to 30 seconds.
[*][b]Game Notifications[/b] can now be disabled in Singleplayer in-game when paused.
[*][b]War Mode[/b] now has its own Wave Order, removing [b]Composite[/b] and replacing [b]Bulky[/b] with [b]Regeneration[/b].
[*][b]War Mode[/b] now spawns roughly 60% more creeps than before, increasing the frantic pacing of the mode.[list]
[*]The total bounty has been adjusted to be roughly 20% more than before.
[/list]
[*][b]Achievements[/b] have been tabbed out for improved organization.
[*]The [b]In Good Health[/b] achievement has been removed (for now).
[*]The [b]Greed is Good[/b] achievement now requires you to reach 50,000 Unspent Gold in a Very Hard game prior to Wave 55.
[*]In Singleplayer, there is now a red text warning that Achievements are disabled if you're playing on [b]Easy Difficulty[/b].
[*]A player leaving the lobby will no longer unready everyone.
[*]Targeting Options now have new icons to distinguish them easier.
[*][b]Ping[/b] in multiplayer now has a 3 second cooldown.
[*]Pressing Insert now zooms in
[*]Pressing Delete now zooms out
[*]Pressing any of the camera control buttons while you have the in-game chat open will no longer move the camera around
[*]Removed the [b]Utility[/b] button from the Tower Table.
[*]Minor optimizations have been made.
[*][b]Zoom/Scroll/Rotate[/b] increments scale at 5% instead of 10%.
[*]Fixed [b]Brightness[/b] slider not working
[*]Added [b]Saturation[/b] slider
[*]Added [b]Bloom[/b] On/Off toggle
[*]Updated and optimized visuals on [b]Forest[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where some players could load into the game before other players, resulting in disconnects on game start.
[*][b]Ranked Mode[/b] should be much more stable than before.[list]
[*]If you're [i]still[/i] running into disconnect shenanigans, please let us know.
[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug where pressing T to open the Targeting menu would block your input unless you pressed T or 1-6.
[*]In the [b]Damage Overview[/b], any damage that could past 0 HP is no longer counted.
[*]Tower healing in War Mode is now added as damage to the [b]Damage Overview[/b], instead of negating it.
[*]Pressing F9 while a tower is selected will no longer cause the builder to be on while the UI is off and vice versa.
[*]Fixed an issue where you wouldn't be given a [b]Shop Point[/b] after leveling up.
[*]Fixed the Boss Score text not being centered
[*]Fixed the [b]Win Streak[/b] achievement not having a description.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/f0a49a132893a0fd0d2c4854247c64b4490f91ec.jpg[/img]
[i]Gave a little bit of love to [b]Forest[/b], should look a bit cleaner in general.[/i]


[h2]Campaign[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a number of incorrect [b]Specialization[/b] tooltips
[*]Tweaked the message in Mission 1 so that players understand they have to sell to relocate.
[*]Toned down the boss' HP in Mission 18.
[*]Updated a number of [b]Campaign Specializations[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Water[/b] Splash (#1) reduces range to 750 instead of reducing bounce damage
[*][b]Earth[/b] Ground Breaker (#1) reduces damage to 0 while doubling Shockwave damage
[*][b]Earth[/b] Distant Rumble (#2) slows attack speed to 0.66, triples damage, and disables the shockwave
[*][b]Geyser[/b] Unstable (#1) damage is reduced by 30%, but the ability triggers every 3 attacks
[*][b]Geyser[/b] Mega Burst (#2) ability no longer hits in 300 AoE, but instead deals 300% damage
[*][b]Poison[/b] Pestilence (#1) now has 0 AoE but deals 125 / 500 / 2000 damage-per-second
[*][b]Bloom[/b] Thorned Rose (#1) reduces range to 750 but increases AoE to 200
[*][b]Bloom[/b] Longevity (#2) increases the max damage bonus to 500% but increases the decay rate to 50%
[*][b]Disease[/b] Long Decay (#1) reduces damage by 20% instead of 15%
[*][b]Disease[/b] Instant Decay (#2) now increases damage by 25% but reduces range to 750
[*][b]Atom[/b] High Capacity (#1) reduces attack speed to 1, but it retains 75% of its stacks on switching creeps
[*][b]Windstorm[/b] High Winds (#1) increases the duration to 10 seconds but reduces the slow to 10% / 20%
[*][b]Money[/b] Pay Day (#2) increases the unspent gold damage bonus to 20% / 40%
[*][b]Flamethrower[/b] Quick-Fire (#2) duration increased from 5 to 10 seconds
[/list][/list]

That's it for [b]Version 0.66[/b], the final patch of [b]Early Access[/b]! Well, other than hotfixes. Up next, we have the [b]Official Release[/b], as we jump forward to [b]Version 1.00[/b]! Though, it's going to take a tad bit longer than expected...


[h2]We need one more week[/h2]
The release date for the official launch of [b]Element TD 2[/b] has been pushed back a week, from [b]March 19th[/b] to [b]March 26th[/b]. We apologize for the minor delay, but we need it to give the last chapter a proper quality pass. These last 7 missions are pretty lengthy, with some hefty surprises in store. We'll be doing a preview in mid-March, so look forward to that!

notes.title: Team & Co-op Leaderboards plus Ranked Fix coming soon!
notes.content:
First off, we apologize for the troubles some of you have been having playing Ranked Mode. Rest assured this was a top priority and it's finally confirmed fix for this upcoming patch!

Many of you have been asking for [b]Leaderboard[/b] support for [b]Teams & Co-op[/b], and we thought that would require our own leaderboards and thus thought that would be further off. Well, we figured out a way to bypass the limitations of [b]Steam Leaderboards[/b], annnd behold:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/d2d2e749afbdc14247a3f4ce4153bc296b29e6bf.jpg[/img]
[i]They're finally arriving! Wait a minute, how did you generate all those entries?[/i]


We'll keep this brief, but a nutshell of what's arriving in [b]Version 0.66[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Team & Co-op Leaderboards[/b], finally!
[*][u][b]Ranked Mode[/b] finally being fixed[/u]
[*]Toggle [b]Focus Target[/b] On/Off
[*]Some love for [b]War Mode[/b]
[*]Out-of-date/boring [b]Campaign Specializations[/b] being updated
[*]Minor optimization tweaks
[*]The usual bout of bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements
[/list]

We're aiming to release [b]Version 0.66[/b] this weekend. Also, we're going to be running some server maintenance. This'll be happening [b]Friday, February 26th @ 6:00am GMT[/b]. [u]Servers will be down for roughly 30 minutes[/u]. Afterwards, you'll be able to resume your usual multiplayer shenanigans.


In regards to [b]Version 0.65's Balance Update[/b], the reception to it seems to be overall very positive. It's not perfect yet ([b]Money[/b] is still a bit problematic, and so is [b]Atom[/b]), but it's not too difficult to fix at this point. Expect to see another balance patch when the game officially releases next month. In the meantime, look forward to [b]Version 0.66[/b] this weekend!

notes.title: Version 0.65 - Balance Overhaul
notes.content:
Welcome to [b]Version 0.65[/b]! We're about 5 weeks from [b]Official Release[/b], so you know what we could use? A balance patch that fundamentally changes the game by fixing certain abused mechanics! Which, frankly we should have done some of these things much sooner, so for those of you that have to relearn some of the game for this patch, we do apologize.

But, after much testing, we can confirm it's a much more fair and balanced environment, especially in Multiplayer. Now, without further adieu, here's the patch notes!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/b5769eab6ddb2a0d2167d833026ee30c472e7d88.jpg[/img]
[i]Yep. This looks balanced.[/i]

[h2]Damage Overview[/h2][list]
[*]You've asked for it repeatedly, and we're finally delivering. On the right side, there's now a [b]Damage Overview[/b], telling you how much damage each tower type does.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/17b93b8427f5dfab36ec3fa470df2df85cd5008e.gif[/img][list]
[*]All towers of the same type (including all levels) are bundled together for an entry.
[*]Tower counts are also listed in here, so you know how many of each type you have.
[*]Only the top 10 entries are kept; after that, it prunes everything else off.
[*]You can switch between "Total", "Current", and "Previous".
[/list]
[*]In the future, we'll add the ability to select all towers of a type via the [b]Damage Overview[/b], among other tweaks. If you have any suggestions for it, let us know!
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]Korean localization added.
[*]Damage pop-ups are now color-coded by element type.
[*]While a tower is selected, pressing T will now open the targeting menu, and you can press 1-6 to select a targeting priority from there.
[*]In the [b]Customize Towers[/b] screen, there's now an option to equip a single hat to all towers.
[*]Added a x0.5 speed multiplier option (offline singleplayer only).
[*]Added support for 2560 x 1600 resolution.
[*]Pressing "Esc" while on the main menu should now be the equivalent of hitting "Back".
[*]The [b]Leaderboard[/b] now shows each player's avatar next to their names.
[*]Added a sound for when players join/leave the lobby.
[*][b]Temple[/b] is now 1-Path by default, rounding out [b]Ranked Mode[/b] to be four 1-Path maps and four 2-Path maps.
[*][b]Desert Variant[/b] paths actually make sense now.
[*]Long Paths on [b]Volcano Co-op[/b] now move at double speed (instead of triple) and only go to the halfway point instead of trying to cross the whole god darn map.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/2358c5f154b54f61df3596467d3b11ad46279ad3.jpg[/img]
[i]No more weird crisscrossing on Advanced Paths in this map.[/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where searching for a [b]Ranked Game[/b] could drop you into an empty game.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could disconnect as soon as you join a game.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could join an in-progress game.
[*]Fixed a bug where a dead lobby could happen and then wouldn't go away for a while.
[*]Fixed a bug where someone could unready at the same time as the last person readying up, causing the lobby to break. To do this, there's now a 1.5 second buffer time before the countdown starts.
[*]Fixed a bug where Level 1 Slows could extend the durations of Level 2 Slows.
[*]Fixed Teams not ordering up properly at the end score screen.
[*]Fixed Game Time continuing after the end score screen appears.
[*]Fixed Elementals stacking up the 4th path in 4-Path Co-op if you had more than 4 Players.
[*]Fixed a bug where entering lines back-to-back as fast as you could in the lobby chat would murder the chatbox.
[*]Fixed a bug where, if you have a lobby or leaderboard entry already selected, and you attempted to double-click it, it would not automatically join/open it.
[*]Potentially fixed a crash error that could occur on certain systems.[list]
[*]If you're still having crash errors, let us know!
[/list][/list]

[h2]General Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Income Upgrade[/b] no longer gives you a flat gold increase at the end of each wave. Instead, it now spawns 20% / 40% more creeps per wave.[list]
[*]If you're in [b]Co-op[/b], each upgrade will spawn 10% more creeps instead. Meaning yes, if you have 8 Players and [i]everyone[/i] gets [b]Double Income Upgrades[/b], you'll have 160% more creeps. Enjoy.
[/list]
[*][b]Diminishing Returns[/b] increased from 5% to 6% per stack[list]
[*]This is to help counterbalance the big buff that Level 1 Debuffs are receiving this patch.
[/list]
[*][b]Boss Waves[/b] will now work the same as all other waves in [b]Multiplayer[/b] - whoever clears it first starts the next wave for everyone.
[*][b]Wave Timers[/b] are now 3 seconds across the board, regardless of the difficulty. This means towers like [b]Haste[/b] and [b]Earth[/b] can't both push the wave and stay at max power.[list]
[*]Playing on [b]Same Random[/b] will reduce [b]Wave Timers[/b] by 3 seconds, meaning they're instant. [b]All Random[/b] is unaffected.
[/list]
[*][b]Total Bounty[/b] up through Wave 55 has been increased by roughly 10%.
[*][b]HP Scaling[/b] has been adjusted to be about 10% higher by Wave 55.
[*][b]Build Times[/b] increased by 0.25 seconds for all towers and upgrades. This is mainly noticeable for Buy/Sell in [b]Random[/b].
[*]The cost of [b]Level 4 Singles/Periodic[/b] are reduced from 15000 to 14000 gold.
[*][b]Wave Order[/b] has been adjusted for Waves 1 through 9.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/b797e04052a37e836361fad4c8535976f97c09b7.jpg[/img]
[i]Check it out, rainbow damage numbers! Not that you can read them any better, but at least it looks cooler.[/i]

[h2]Tower Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Arrow & Cannon[/b] now sell for 80% of their gold value, just like all other towers. This means [u]you can no longer Buy/Sell Abuse these towers in Pick[/u].[list]
[*][b]Random[/b] is unchanged.
[/list]
[*][b]Arrow[/b] damage increased from 45 to 70
[*][b]Cannon[/b] damage increased from 55 to 80
[*][b]Light[/b] damage reduced from 120 / 720 / 4320 / 43200 to 100 / 600 / 3600 / 36000[list]
[*]Consecutive damage bonus increased from 3 / 18 / 108 / 1080 to 5 / 30 / 180 / 1800
[/list]
[*][b]Water[/b] damage increased from 75 / 450 / 2700 / 27000 to 80 / 480 / 2880 / 28800
[*][b]Fire[/b] damage increased from 30 / 180 / 1080 / 10800 to 32 / 192 / 1152 / 11520
[*][b]Lightning[/b] attack speed increased from 1 to 1.5[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 200 / 800 / 3200 to 140 / 560 / 2240
[*]Bounce range increased from 1000 to 1200
[/list]
[*][b]Poison[/b] attacks now extend the duration of all existing stacks by 0.1 / 0.2 / 0.4 seconds
[*][b]Ice[/b] attack speed reduced from 1.5 to 1[list]
[*]Damage increased from 525 / 2100 / 8400 to 800 / 3200 / 12800
[/list]
[*][b]Mushroom[/b] damage increased from 115 / 460 / 1840 to 120 / 480 / 1920
[*][b]Life[/b] renamed to [b]Bloom[/b] and reworked:[list]
[*]Attack speed increased from 0.66 to 1.5
[*]Damage reduced from 1250 / 5000 / 20000 to 500 / 2000 / 8000
[*][b]New Effect[/b]: When it's not attacking, its damage grows by 20% per second, up to max of 250%. While attacking, its damage drops by 40% per second.
[/list]
[*][b]Geyser[/b] attack speed reduced from 1.5 to 1[list]
[*]Damage increased from 600 / 2400 / 9600 to 900 / 3600 / 14400
[/list]
[*][b]Astral[/b] damage increased from 1600 / 6400 to 1700 / 6800
[*][b]Laser[/b] damage increased from 4500 / 18000 to 4800 / 19200[list]
[*]Damage decrease per nearby target increased from 500 / 2000 to 600 / 2400
[*]Max damage drop increased from 2000 / 8000 to 2400 / 9600
[/list]
[*][b]Flooding[/b] damage increased from 350 / 1400 to 375 / 1500
[*][b]Wisp[/b] attack speed reduced from 1.5 to 1[list]
[*]Damage increased from 600 / 2400 to 750 / 3000
[*][b]Effect Rescaled[/b]: Each attack decreases its AoE by 10 but increases its damage by 5%. Caps out after 30 attacks at 200 AoE and 400% damage. Resets after 4 seconds of not attacking.
[/list]
[*][b]Flamethrower[/b] damage increased from 300 / 1200 to 320 / 1280[list]
[*]Napalm damage increased from 150 / 600 to 160 / 640
[/list]
[*][b]Haste[/b] max attack speed reduced from 6 to 5[list]
[*]Attack speed gain per attack reduced from 7% to 5%
[*]Instead of instantly resetting after 5 seconds, it now gradually decreases over 5 seconds.
[/list]
[*][b]Quake[/b] damage increased from 1400 / 5600 to 1500 / 6000[list]
[*]Shockwave damage increased from 2800 / 11200 to 3000 / 12000
[/list]
[*][b]Money[/b] has been reworked:[list]
[*]Attack speed increased from 0.66 to 1
[*]Damage reduced from 5500 / 22000 to 3200 / 12800
[*][b]New Effect[/b]: Gains damage equal to 15% / 30% of your Unspent Gold
[/list]
[*][b]Nova[/b] damage increased from 660 / 2640 to 700 / 2800[list]
[*]Slow increased from 10% / 30% to 16% / 32%
[/list]
[*][b]Windstorm[/b] damage-per-second increased from 500 / 2000 to 550 / 2200[list]
[*]Slow increased from 10% / 30% to 16% / 32%
[/list]
[*][b]Muck[/b] damage increased from 800 / 3200 to 950 / 3800[list]
[*]Slow increased from 10% / 30% to 16% / 32%
[/list]
[*][b]Root[/b] damage-per-second increased from 140 / 560 to 150 / 600[list]
[*]Slow increased from 10% / 30% to 16% / 32%
[/list]
[*][b]Corrosion[/b] damage amp rescaled from 15% / 45% to 20% / 40%
[*][b]Jinx[/b] damage reduced from 1200 / 4800 to 1100 / 4400[list]
[*]Bonus damage per tick rescaled from 6% / 18% to 8% / 16%
[/list]
[*][b]Polar[/b] damage increased from 1300 / 5200 to 1400 / 5600[list]
[*]HP Burn increased from 8% / 24% to 12% / 24%
[/list]
[*][b]Incantation[/b] damage reduced from 500 / 2000 to 450 / 1800[list]
[*]Base damage amp reduced from 10% / 30% to 10% / 20%
[*]Solo damage amp rescaled from 30% / 90% to 40% / 80%
[/list]
[*][b]Periodic[/b] damage increased from 40000 to 45000
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/0fbd0e736ecbb32b636f66474e5f06fbc63cde33.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Life[/b] and [b]Money[/b] have finally graduated from their WC3 versions. Rest in peace, you broken effects.[/i]


Several pages of balance notes later, annnd that's it! By far the largest balance update done to date, and in theory, this shouldn't be one-upped anytime soon. As per usual, [u]leaderboards have been wiped[/u], so have fun scaling the boards once more! In general, this patch should make the game easier for new players, and make it a more even playing ground for everyone in general.

Anywho, we hope you enjoy the [b]Damage Overview[/b] and updated balance! Up next, look forward to another highly requested feature, which will be making its way into 0.66 at the end of the month!

notes.title: 0.65 Preview - We're Balancing the Game. Again.
notes.content:
Over the course of [b]Element TD's[/b] 16 year existence, there's a handful of concepts we've tried to hold on to. Things that were iconic in the original and would still be recognizable, even now. However, some things are just inherently unbalanced by design, and until we let them go, this game will never be balanced, resulting in a lopsided multiplayer experience. Specifically:[list]
[*][b]Life Tower[/b]
[*][b]Money Tower[/b]
[*]The darn [b]Income Upgrade[/b] (formerly the [b]Interest Upgrade[/b])
[*]And in [b]Pick[/b], the ability to cheese the early game with [b]Arrows & Cannons[/b], resulting in dumb rush builds that can't be countered
[/list]

In the upcoming [b]Version 0.65[/b] Balance Patch, we'll finally be addressing those points and more. Read on for the full preview!


[h3]No More Fixing Mistakes[/h3]
[b]Life Tower[/b] has been in a spot for a while where it's broken for a specific build, and horrible for everything else. Frankly, this is just bad balance. Also, the way it can be used to "fix your mistakes" makes it frustrating to play against. Using them on [b]Co-op[/b] made it kind of easy as well.

[b]Life[/b] will be receiving a new effect:[list]
[*][b]Life[/b] renamed to [b]Bloom[/b]
[*]Attack speed increased from 0.66 to 1.5
[*]Damage reduced from 1250 / 5000 / 20000 to 500 / 2000 / 8000
[*][b]New Effect[/b]: When it's not attacking, its damage grows by 20% per second, up to max of 250%. While attacking, its damage drops by 30% per second.
[/list]

[h3]No More Easy Gold Advantage[/h3]
Meanwhile, [b]Money Tower[/b] fits into almost any build, and nets you so much extra gold you can spam it like crazy, and you'll [i]still[/i] have more gold than everyone else. Technically, this one [i]could[/i] be nerfed, but if we did, it'd end up in the same spot as [b]Life[/b] where it works fine for one build and garbage for everything else.

[b]Money[/b] will also be receiving a new effect:[list]
[*][b]Money[/b] renamed to [b]Greed[/b]
[*]Attack speed increased from 0.66 to 1
[*]Damage reduced from 5500 / 22000 to 3200 / 12800
[*][b]New Effect[/b]: Gains damage equal to 15% / 30% of your Unspent Gold
[/list]

[h3]Income Now Comes with a Cost[/h3]
And on the topic of more free money, the [b]Income Upgrade[/b] is getting replaced. Currently, you can just get this upgrade and get a major gold advantage over everyone else for no downside. Again, we could just nerf the value, but... same issue as the above two cases.

So instead, we're replacing it with [b]Extra Creeps[/b], which will spawn 6 / 12 more creeps per wave. If you manage to kill them decently, you do get considerably more gold than before, but it carries a big risk, [i]especially[/i] in [b]Multiplayer[/b]. Even in [b]Singleplayer[/b], it'll take longer to clear those creeps, slowing you down and reducing your [b]Speed Score Multiplier[/b].


[h3]RIP Buy/Sell Abuse with Arrows & Cannons[/h3]
We've long contemplated this one, but we're finally doing it. [b]Arrow & Cannon Towers[/b] will no longer sell for almost their full value and will be 80% sell, just like everything else. In exchange, their damage has been dramatically improved.

For anyone that relied on buy/selling these towers in the first quarter of the game to cheese your way into certain rush builds, that will no longer work. We're aware that this will change the early game considerably for some folks. Frankly, we should've made this change much sooner in development.

Just to be clear though, they still sell for 100% in [b]Random[/b], just like all other towers.


[h3]More Changes[/h3][list]
[*][b]Boss Waves[/b] will now work the same as all other waves in [b]Multiplayer[/b] - whoever clears it first starts the next wave for everyone.
[*][b]Wave Timers[/b] are now 3 seconds across the board, regardless of the difficulty. This means towers like [b]Haste[/b] and [b]Earth[/b] can't both push the wave and stay at max power.[list]
[*]Playing on [b]Random[/b] will reduce [b]Wave Timers[/b] by 3 seconds, meaning they're instant.
[/list]
[*][b]Total Bounty[/b] up through Wave 55 has been increased by roughly 10%.
[*][b]HP Scaling[/b] has been adjusted to be about 5% higher by Wave 55.
[*][b]Build Times[/b] increased by 0.25 seconds for all towers and upgrades. This is mainly noticeable for Buy/Sell in [b]Random[/b].
[*]The effects of [b]Level 1 Support Debuffs[/b] are roughly 50% stronger (ie 10% --> 15%).
[*]The cost of [b]Level 4 Singles/Periodic[/b] are reduced from 15000 to 14000 gold.
[*][b]Wave Order[/b] has been adjusted for Waves 1 through 9.
[*]Various buffs, most notably [b]Periodic Tower[/b]
[*]Various nerfs, most notably [b]Haste Tower[/b]
[/list]

[h3]A Fancy New Feature[/h3]
We've had a bunch of people request this feature, and it's finally happening. We're actually adding an in-game [b]Damage Tracker[/b]. As your towers deal damage, you'll see a little chart on the right tallying everything up, displaying the damage from your top ten tower types. You'll be able to switch between [b]Total Damage[/b] and [b]Per Wave[/b].

Over time, we'll have other ways to improve this feature. And as usual, expect a number of quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes.


In conclusion, if you relied heavily on specific unbalanced towers or Buy/Sell Abuse (in [b]Pick[/b]), you'll have to relearn the game to some extent. To that end, I'd like to apologize that we didn't make some of these changes sooner. However, if you didn't rely on any of those, the game should be easier overall.


[b]Version 0.65[/b] will be releasing sometime next week! If you'd like to try out these changes early, hop onto our [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Discord[/url] and check the pinned post in the #testers channel. The values listed above miiight shift a little bit, but otherwise, it's pretty close to where they'll end up. So far, the testing experience for this patch has been largely positive, despite all the big changes, so look forward to it!

notes.title: Version 0.64 - New Co-op Map, Ranked Queue, Achievements, and More
notes.content:
You've asked for it for a while, and we're finally delivering - [strike]Quad Element Towers[/strike] a new [b]Co-op Map[/b]! Also arriving in this patch are some overdue [b]Achievements[/b] for [b]Chapter 3[/b], [b]Ranked Queue[/b], [b]Atlantis[/b] actually getting skinned, bug fixes, and more. Read on for the full notes!


[h3]Volcano[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/21ce96d69b79dd2654441c74855727cc72d84e0d.jpg[/img]
Look familiar? It should, if you've played [b]Chapter 3[/b] all the way through. The map from [b]Mission 21[/b] has been converted into a [b]Co-op Map[/b]! Compared to the other two maps, it's pretty unusual, but once you get the hang of it, all the crossing paths allows for some unique co-op tactics. And if you're wondering how that 3-minute long path works, well... look forward to a speedy surprise!

[h3]Atlantis[/h3]
Of course, we wouldn't release a 3rd map for [b]Co-op[/b] without finishing the second one. It only took over half a year, but it's finally been overhauled!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/4e9d52820d94689319ddfc8d393af611bf489594.jpg[/img]
[i]A perfect blend of greenery, emerald waters, and death.[/i]

[h2]New Features[/h2][list]
[*]Added a [b]Paths[/b] setting for [b]Co-op Maps[/b]. Instead of auto-adjusting based on whether you had 1-4 Players or 5-8 Players, you get three options:[list]
[*][b]Scaling[/b]: The number of paths equals the number of players. You get 25 Lives * Player Count. This is the new default option.
[*][b]4 Paths[/b]: Forces there to be 4 Paths active, regardless of player count. You get 100 Lives.
[*][b]8 Paths[/b]: Forces there to be 8 Paths active, regardless of player count. You get 200 Lives.
[/list]
[*]Each [b]Co-op Map[/b] now comes with a [b]Reversed[/b] version, flipping where creeps spawn and exit.
[*][b]Find Match[/b] for [b]Ranked[/b] now throws you into a [b]Ranked Queue[/b], meaning you can finally go do other things while waiting.[list]
[*]When it finds a game, it should give you a [b]Ranked Notification[/b] to confirm to.
[*]Do note that if you enter an online game (whether it's singleplayer or multiplayer), it'll automatically boot you from the queue.
[/list]
[*]The option to disable [b]Interest[/b] has returned!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/2d2f1ef38fcbf560409b43f9b4915a016e93893d.jpg[/img]
[i]That's not how I remember this map...[/i]

[h2]Achievements & Cosmetics[/h2][list]
[*][b]Chapter 3 Achievements[/b] added:[list]
[*][b]Ungrounded[/b]: Beat Mission 15 on Hard without having Earth or Nature Elements in your Loadout
[*][b]Stuck Together[/b]: Beat Mission 16 on Hard with all towers built within 1 space of an existing tower
[*][b]Autumn Blitz[/b]: Beat Mission 17 on Very Hard in 24 Minutes or less
[*][b]Too Close for Comfort[/b]: Beat Mission 18 on Hard without using 1150 Range (or higher) Towers
[*][b]Impenetrable Defense[/b]: Beat Mission 19 on Hard without losing any lives
[*][b]Perfect Plan[/b]: Beat Mission 20 on Hard without selling your towers, even during Wave Breaks
[*][b]Absolute Knowledge[/b]: Beat Mission 21 on Normal using only Level 1 Towers
[*][b]Sorcerer[/b]: Clear all Missions in Chapter 3
[*][b]Triumph[/b]: Get 4 Stars on every Chapter 3 Mission
[/list]
[*][b]3 New Builders[/b] added:[list]
[*][b]Forest Spirit[/b] - Requires Level 35
[*][b]Griffin[/b] - Requires Level 40
[*][b]Lava Elemental[/b] - Requires Level 45
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/b07f203cc69247fe111fd8a3f73d251c89b4170c.jpg[/img]
[i]More builders, more ways to customize![/i]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]Loading Screen now features randomized [b]Tips[/b] and tidbits. Feel free to suggest more messages [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]on our Discord server[/url].
[*]Certain paths on [b]Map Variants[/b] now move slower, making [b]Tropical, Autumn, Wasteland, & Winter[/b] a bit more fair.
[*]Anytime someone leaks, there's now a ping on the mini-map.
[*]Adjusted [b]Chapter 4[/b] message to list the newly delayed release date of [b]March 19th[/b].
[*]The [b]Long War[/b] option is no longer on by default for [b]1v1 War[/b].
[*][b]Teams, Co-op & War[/b] now note that they're not eligible for leaderboard submissions.[list]
[*]Once again, we blame [b]Steam Leaderboards[/b] for the restriction. Eventually, we may try to fix this, but it's gonna be a while.
[/list][/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a freeze error that could happen with [b]Flamethrower, Vapor & Roots[/b] on any map with elevation changes (particularly [b]Volcano[/b]).
[*]Fixed a bug where a creep could drop to negative HP and result in an unwinnable game.[list]
[*]This potentially fixes another issue where, upon game over, the game doesn't "end".
[/list]
[*]Fixed that [b]Leaderboard[/b] crash error that kept getting reported over and over.[list]
[*]You may notice, when opening the game, the [b]Leaderboard[/b] button is greyed out for a few seconds. This is just so it has a chance to connect to Steam so that it won't explode spontaneously.
[/list]
[*]Fixed Campaign Achievements being doable on [b]Easy[/b] difficulty.
[*]Fixed creeps on the minimap flying off the map if they moved vertically up or down.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/a0b29622f3495b444912b100b1ae800cc2d16665.jpg[/img]
[i]It can get pretty hectic on the [b]Volcano[/b].[/i]

With this, that's the last content patch of [b]Early Access[/b]! We still have a few more patches in store before [b]Official Release[/b] (aka [b]Version 1.00[/b]), but in terms of pure content, this is the last batch.

In a few weeks, we'll be addressing [b]0.63's Balance[/b] changes - they were in the right direction, buuut it needs to be ironed out a bit more. We'll also finally change two specific towers that we've finally deemed impossible to balance. Classic as they may be, they're breaking the game too hard (you know which two).


In the meantime, enjoy the updates to [b]Co-op Mode[/b] and all the other [b]Achievements[/b] and improvements this patch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/deca8ad14d36c75010e5bf2158f52b44ccce55fe.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Release Delayed to March 19th + Patch Preview
notes.content:
You read that title right, folks. Instead of February 19th, the game's [b]Official Release[/b] has been delayed a month to March 19th. I know a lot of you were looking forward to trying out [b]Chapter 4[/b] sooner rather than later, but we have some reasons for this delay.

[h3]Chapter 4 Quality[/h3]
First and foremost, we want to make [b]Chapter 4[/b] [i]really[/i] stand out. Not just design-wise, but quality too. We'd also like the [b]Achievements[/b] to launch with the chapter this time, instead of some time after. In order to do all of that without burning ourselves into several weeks of overtime, we're giving ourselves a bit of breathing room to ensure [b]Chapter 4[/b] gets the love it deserves.

[h3]Is that all?[/h3]
Nope! With this extra time, there's a few more features we're trying to implement by release. On top of the [b]Co-op[/b] stuff coming soon, many folks have requested a particular feature, namely an in-game DPS tracker of some kind. In order to fit this into the game though, we're going to need to move the UI around a bit. Expect an update on this in [b]February[/b]!

Also, the most recent version brought in some experimental balance changes, and while we think they were good for the game overall, they certainly were far from perfect, so expect another balance patch in [b]February[/b] to iron it out.

[h3]Price Increase[/h3]
When we officially release on [b]March 19th[/b], there will be a price increase from [b]$9.99[/b] to [b]$14.99[/b]. The reason for this is that we've increased the game's content by a substantial amount (practically quintuple in these last 11 months), so we won't be undercutting ourselves as much. It doesn't affect anyone that's bought the game of course, but if you have any friends interested in the game, let them know that it's as cheap as it'll ever be now.

Now, with all of that said... onto to the next [b]Patch Preview[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/a0b29622f3495b444912b100b1ae800cc2d16665.jpg[/img]
[i]Incoming love for [b]Co-op Mode[/b]![/i]

[h1]Version 0.64 Preview[/h1]
Coming next patch is some love for the game's [b]Co-op[/b] mode! This will be last content release prior to the game's official launch in [b]March[/b]. In addition to a [b]3rd Co-op Map[/b], there'll be new settings to play with, as well as [b]Atlantis[/b] finally getting a darn makeover.

[h2]Volcano[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/8d24b0d954d0ca8cf07711276b83d00a920b4986.jpg[/img]
Look familiar? It should, if you've played [b]Chapter 3[/b] all the way through. The map from [b]Mission 21[/b] has been converted into a [b]Co-op Map[/b]! Compared to the other two maps, it's pretty unusual, but once you get the hang of it, all the crossing paths allows for some unique co-op tactics. And if you're wondering how that 3-minute long path works, well... look forward to a speedy surprise!

[h2]New Settings[/h2]
First up, we're finally giving you control over the number of [b]Paths[/b] in-game! Instead of auto-adjusting based on whether you had 1-4 Players or 5-8 Players, you get three options:[list]
[*][b]Scaling[/b]: The number of paths equals the number of players. This is the new default option.
[*][b]4 Paths[/b]: Forces there to be 4 Paths active, regardless of player count.
[*][b]8 Paths[/b]: Forces there to be 8 Paths active, regardless of player count.
[/list]
Secondly, each [b]Co-op Map[/b] now comes with a [b]Reversed[/b] version. Like so:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/2d2f1ef38fcbf560409b43f9b4915a016e93893d.jpg[/img]
[i]That's not how I remember this map...[/i]

[h2]Other Stuff[/h2]
In addition to the above [b]Co-op[/b] updates, expect to see:[list]
[*][b]Chapter 3 Achievements[/b] (finally)
[*]Being able to do other stuff while waiting in [b]Ranked Queue[/b]
[*]Adjustments to some of the overly difficult [b]Map Variants[/b], thanks to [b]Slow Paths[/b]
[*]The option to [b]Disable Interest[/b] has returned! Apologies for removing it in the first place, but it's back!
[*]Randomized tips and messages on the [b]Loading Screen[/b]
[*]More [b]Cosmetics[/b], cause why not
[/list]

We'll show off the updated [b]Atlantis[/b] closer to release. Expect [b]Version 0.64[/b] to release next weekend!

[h3]Afterword[/h3]
We know the delays and stuff sucks, but when we officially launch, we want it to be worthy of being called a [b]Full Release[/b], featuring a complete [b]Campaign[/b], a rich and balanced [b]Multiplayer[/b], and tons of [b]Achievements & Customizations[/b] to shoot for. Practically none of this stuff existed when we entered [b]Early Access[/b] 11 months ago, so this time, we want to put our best foot forward.

Look forward to one heck of a release!

[h3]Guides[/h3]
Lastly, one of our active community members, [b]Taencred[/b], has released a [b]Beginner's Guide[/b], in order to help new players get accustomed to the game. [b]Element TD 2[/b] is a very complex game with tons of advanced tactics, though there's admittedly a steep learning curve just to get into the game. If you post a guide, let us know and we'll help promote it!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2360427994]A Beginner's Guide to Element TD 2[/url]
