notes.title: Version 0.63 - New Maps and Balance Update!
notes.content:
Whelp, it didn't quite land at the end of 2020, but 2021 is here and we're starting you folks off with a new patch! You get Balance Updates, Optimization Options, New Achievements, New Cosmetics, Bug Fixes, and best of all... [b][u]New Maps[/u][/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/70941c35e56fdc2758ccd75b436a5b1fd8ddcf11.jpg[/img]
[i]Is that a Campaign map... in Multiplayer?[/i]

[h2]Map Variants[/h2]
Every [b]FFA & Teams[/b] map now features an alternate version of it, all based off the versions seen in the [b]Campaign[/b]. Effectively, we're adding [b][u]8 New Maps[/u][/b] to the game! These variants are generally more difficult than the standard versions, some of them supporting 3 or even 4 Paths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/975879891b6d862229d9dd34781ac2512c6425f8.jpg[/img]
[i]Remember this old gem from initial Early Access release? It's baaack![/i]

Speaking of paths, some of our maps are designed to be played as [b]2 Path[/b] maps. As such, we're adjusting the [b]Paths[/b] option. Instead of choosing between [b]1 or 2 Paths[/b], you'll now choose between:[list]
[*][b]Standard[/b]: Play the map the way it's meant to be played. It'll have 1 or 2 Paths on by default.
[*][b]Advanced[/b]: Play an advanced version of the map, containing at least 2 Paths and scaling up to 4.[list]
[*]For some of the base maps, [b]Standard & Advanced[/b] will be one and the same.
[/list][/list]
That said, you'll no longer be able to play certain maps as [b]1 Path[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/2d7fa50ca57808d5cd955c5e673e3b1d54534e49.jpg[/img]
[i]RIP Wasteland as the easiest 1-Path map.[/i]

[h2]New Achievements & Cosmetics[/h2][list]
[*]Each map now has the following [b]Achievements[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Alternate[/b]: Clear Wave 55 of [Map] Variant on Hard Difficulty
[*][b]Elite[/b]: Clear Wave 55 of [Map] Variant on Very Hard + Advanced Paths
[/list]
[*]The [b]Leprechaun & Jester Hats[/b] have been updated.
[*][b]5 New Hats[/b]![list]
[*]Ho Ho Hat
[*]Double Wreath
[*]Viking Helm
[*]College Cap
[*]Flamingo
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/dd809dd463f4d9f0d6724ee03a5ce9c5a56bc4d4.jpg[/img]
[i]It's a bit late, but Merry Christmas![/i]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*][b]VFX[/b] will no longer render off-screen, which should drastically help end-game lag.
[*]Reduced [b]Ranked Requirement[/b] from Level 20 to 15.
[*][b]Graphics Options[/b] have been added:[list]
[*][b]Anisotropic Filter[/b]: Turn it on to improve texture quality at a distance, especially when viewed at an angle. Good for screenshots. Off by default.
[*][b]Shadows[/b]: Choose between Hard and Soft Shadows.
[*][b]AO Quality[/b]: Ambient Occlusion, aka draws shadows at intersections. Choose between Off, Low, Medium, and High.
[/list]
[*]Adjusted [b]Score Thresholds[/b] for some Missions in Chapter 3. Should make 4 Stars a bit easier to do.
[*]The paths for 1-4 Players have been adjusted for [b]Atlantis[/b].
[*][b]War Mode[/b] Ability Cooldowns reduced by roughly 20% across the board.
[*]Added [b]Turkish[/b] localization.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed [b]FFA Game Notifications[/b] sometimes not turning off properly
[*]Fixed a bug where players could join an in-progress game
[*]Fixed [b]Personal Scores[/b] in Singleplayer not saving.
[*]Fixed a bug in War Mode where abilities would grow in size with each use
[*]Fixed a bug in War Mode where selecting a tower would not only hide the lingering icon, but also "pause" its remaining timer
[*]If you cast Dimensional Rift without hitting any enemies, no icon should appear
[*]Fixed builders sinking into the abyss in the middle of [b]Grand City[/b].
[*]Fixed [b]Atlantis[/b] minimap being offset.
[*]Fixed Fastest Clear stat resetting itself.
[*]Fixed a bug where if you select the Friends tab in the Leaderboard, then switch to a map where you have a replay, it'd automatically load that entry.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/eaf193e5611ebdf6842b496ac91b0f9ecaba1074.jpg[/img]
[i]A lot of work goes into making the in-between areas pleasant to look at. Take a look around sometime! Just don't die in the process.[/i]

[h2]General Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Diminishing Returns[/b]:[list]
[*]All [b]Slow & Damage Amp Towers[/b] will now have diminishing returns. How this works is, after the first debuff, for each additional unique debuff, all debuffs are 5% less effective.
[*][b]Debuff Effectiveness[/b] = 95% ^ (# of Stacks - 1)
[/list]
[*]Default [b]Wave Order[/b] has shuffled a bit:[list]
[*]Wave 7 is now Fire + Healing
[*]Wave 8 is now Water + Bulky
[*]Wave 9 is now Light + Cursed
[*]Wave 10 is now Earth + Temporal
[*]Wave 13 is now Light + Healing
[*]Wave 15 is now Earth + Shield
[*]Wave 22 is now Nature + Healing
[*]Wave 23 is now Earth + Undead
[*]Wave 25 is now Light + Bulky
[*]Wave 31 is now Light + Shield
[*]Wave 32 is now Water + Temporal
[/list]
[*][b]Tier 2 Singles[/b] cost increased from 650 to 675
[*][b]Tier 3 Singles[/b] cost increased from 2250 to 2500
[*][b]Tier 4 Singles & Periodic[/b] cost increased from 12250 to 15000
[*][b]Cursed[/b] attack speed reduction raised from 10% to 15% per stack[list]
[*]Duration reduced from 15 to 10 seconds
[/list]
[*]2-Path maps in [b]Ranked Mode[/b] no longer have +3 seconds added to the [b]Wave Timer[/b].
[*][b]Autumn's[/b] map layout has been adjusted a bit.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/571af4ff8b95ac21a1c4736ae2a2cde98c4b8d65.jpg[/img]
[i]It's almost the same, we just extended things a bit. Oh, and it looks prettier.[/i]

[h2]Tower Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Arrow[/b] damage reduced from 50 to 45
[*][b]Cannon[/b] damage reduced from 60 to 55
[*][b]Darkness[/b] damage reduced from 300 / 1800 / 10800 / 108000 to 280 / 1680 / 10080 / 100800[list]
[*]HP Damage reduced from 10% to 5%
[/list]
[*][b]Fire[/b] damage growth per second increased from 0.5 / 3 / 18 / 180 to 1 / 6 / 36 / 360[list]
[*]Reset time reduced from 4 to 3 seconds
[/list]
[*][b]Blacksmith[/b] damage reduced from 500 / 2000 / 8000 to 450 / 1800 / 7200[list]
[*]Damage buff rescaled from 10% / 20% / 100% to 10% / 30% / 90%
[/list]
[*][b]Well[/b] damage reduced from 500 / 2000 / 8000 to 450 / 1800 / 7200[list]
[*]Attack speed buff rescaled from 10% / 20% / 100% to 10% / 30% / 90%
[/list]
[*][b]Trickery[/b] damage reduced from 375 / 1500 / 6000 to 325 / 1300 / 5200[list]
[*]Clone damage rescaled from 40% / 80% / 400% to 36% / 108% / 324%
[/list]
[*][b]Infernal[/b] damage reduced from 700 / 2800 / 11200 to 650 / 2600 / 10400
[*][b]Haste[/b] reset time increased from 4 to 5 seconds
[*][b]Flooding[/b] damage increased from 320 / 1280 to 350 / 1400
[*][b]Money[/b] damage reduced from 6000 / 24000 to 5500 / 22000
[*][b]Impulse[/b] damage increased from 2000 / 8000 to 2200 / 8800
[*][b]Golem[/b] damage increased from 2500 / 10000 to 3000 / 12000[list]
[*]Downtime increased from 3 to 4 seconds
[/list]
[*][b]Nova[/b] Level 2 Slow increased from 20% to 30%
[*][b]Windstorm[/b] Level 2 slow increased from 20% to 30%
[*][b]Root[/b] Level 2 slow increased from 20% to 30%
[*][b]Muck[/b] Level 2 slow increased from 20% to 30%
[*][b]Jinx[/b] Level 2 bonus damage increaased from 12% to 18%
[*][b]Corrosion[/b] Level 2 damage amp increased from 30% to 45%
[*][b]Polar[/b] HP burn rescaled from 10% / 20% to 8% / 24%
[*][b]Incantation[/b] Level 2 damage amp increased from 20% to 30%[list]
[*]Solo damage amp increased from 60% to 90%
[/list]
[*][b]Periodic[/b] damage increased from 38000 to 40000
[/list]
As usual, with any [b]Balance Patch[/b] is a [b]Leaderboard Reset[/b]. Note this is just for the [b]Score Leaderboards[/b], not [b]Ranked[/b]. That won't be reset until the official release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/a64d9f4d4a3a731ac362fcb7bdbff9d8b9b74e3e.jpg[/img]
[i]Things may have gotten just a tad chaotic here...[/i]


And with that, we've delivered one of the last "big updates" before official release. Chapter 4 of the campaign will arrive with the official release. There'll still be updates between now and then ([b]Achievements[/b], [b]Cosmetics[/b]... a [b]3rd Co-op Map[/b]), but otherwise it'll primarily be bug fixes and quality-of-life updates. In the meantime, enjoy [strike]dying to[/strike] the new maps, [b]Happy New Year[/b], and may 2021 fair better for us all!

notes.title: 0.63 Patch Preview
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.63[/b] was supposed to release about now, but we didn't quite hit our estimates. However, we can confirm in testing that it's pretty close to done. You can expect it to release by next weekend, to ring in 2021!

In the meantime, we have a preview of what to expect below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/6eff1f88df8709cc687c249fb606d07f426f9a03.jpg[/img]
[i]By my eyes, I spot 1, 2, 3... 4 portals?[/i]

[h2]Map Variants[/h2]
Every [b]FFA & Teams[/b] map now features an alternate version of it, all based off the versions seen in the [b]Campaign[/b]. Effectively, we're adding [b][u]8 New Maps[/u][/b] to the game! These variants are generally more difficult than the standard versions, some of them supporting 3 or even 4 Paths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/975879891b6d862229d9dd34781ac2512c6425f8.jpg[/img]
[i]Remember this old gem from initial Early Access release? It's baaack![/i]

Speaking of paths, some of our maps are designed to be played as [b]2 Path[/b] maps. As such, we're adjusting the [b]Paths[/b] option. Instead of choosing between [b]1 or 2 Paths[/b], you'll now choose between:[list]
[*][b]Standard[/b]: Play the map the way it's meant to be played. It'll have 1 or 2 Paths on by default.
[*][b]Advanced[/b]: Play an advanced version of the map, containing at least 2 Paths and scaling up to 4.[list]
[*]For some of the base maps, [b]Standard & Advanced[/b] will be one and the same.
[/list][/list]
That said, you'll no longer be able to play certain maps as [b]1 Path[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/2d7fa50ca57808d5cd955c5e673e3b1d54534e49.jpg[/img]
[i]RIP Wasteland as the easiest 1-Path map.[/i]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
For the last few months, certain builds have been absolutely dominating, both the [b]Leaderboards[/b] and in [b]Ranked Mode[/b]. In particular, [b]2 Element[/b] and [b]6 Element Builds[/b]. We don't mind them being viable options, but they're strictly better than everything else right now. So, here's the general list of changes:[list]
[*][b]Diminishing Returns[/b]:[list]
[*]All [b]Slow & Damage Amp Towers[/b] will now have diminishing returns. How this works is, after the first debuff, for each additional unique debuff, all debuffs are 5% less effective.
[*][b]Debuff Effectiveness[/b] = 95% ^ (# of Stacks - 1)
[*]As a result of this change, the effects of all [b]Level 2 Slow & Damage Amp Towers[/b] will be drastically improved. This should give [b]4 & 5 Element Builds[/b] more of a chance while tampering down [b]6 Element[/b].
[/list]
[*][b]Buff Towers[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Well & Blacksmith[/b] effects are being rescaled from 10% / 20% / 100% to 10% / 30% / 90%.
[*][b]Trickery[/b] effect is being rescaled from 40% / 80% / 400% to 36% / 108% / 324%
[*]With these changes, going for the [b]Level 2[/b] early will be more meaningful, while the [b]Level 3[/b] will be a bit less efficient.
[/list]
[*][b]Cost Increases[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Single Element Towers[/b], especially the upper tiers, are cheap. Too cheap. To the extent that you can safely do [b]Level 3[/b] rush strategies with them using only [b]2 Elements[/b]. Not to mention the overwhelming power of [b]Pures[/b]. So, we're raising the costs:[list]
[*][b]Tier 2 Singles[/b] cost increased from 650 to 675
[*][b]Tier 3 Singles[/b] cost increased from 2250 to 2500
[*][b]Tier 4 Singles & Periodic[/b] cost increased from 12250 to 15000
[/list][/list]
[*][b]Wave Order[/b]:[list]
[*]Ever since the change to [b]Temporal[/b], having that be the first ability to show up is... too brutal. There were also sections that were skewed too heavily towards one element or creep type. As such, we've shuffled some of the [b]Wave Order[/b] around.
[*]Most of these shuffles are within the first half of the game.
[/list]
[*][b]Other Changes[/b]:[list]
[*][b]2-Path[/b] can be annoyingly hard to rush, so we're reducing the wave timer increase from +3 to +1 seconds
[*][b]Cursed[/b] attack speed reduction raised from 10% to 15% per stack
[*][b]Cursed[/b] duration reduced from 15 to 10 seconds
[/list][/list]
That's the general list; we have more individual changes as well. The numbers listed above aren't quite final, but they should be close at the very least.

As usual, with any [b]Balance Patch[/b] is a [b]Leaderboard Reset[/b]. Note this is just for the [b]Score Leaderboards[/b], not [b]Ranked[/b]. That won't be reset until the official release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/7c62011cd5a8461f2a2e218cfda0751878f4bba1.jpg[/img]
[i]Anyone wanna take a guess how this one works on the Advanced Paths option?[/i]

[h2]Autumn[/h2]
Although [b]Winter[/b] is meant to be the most difficult map, [b]Autumn[/b] is arguably worse, especially since the creeps branch out in opposite directions. We're not changing that aspect, but we are adjusting the map to make it more fair and improve the viability of some spots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/571af4ff8b95ac21a1c4736ae2a2cde98c4b8d65.jpg[/img]
[i]It's almost the same, we just extended things a bit. Oh, and it looks prettier.[/i]

It's already a big patch with the above notes, but there will also be [b]New Cosmetics & Achievements[/b], tweaks to the [b]Campaign[/b], new [b]Visual Options[/b], and a whole lot of fixes. Look forward to it next week!

If you want to try out these changes early, hop into the [b][url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Element TD Discord Server[/url][/b], check the [b]#roles[/b] channel, tag yourself as part of the [b]@testers[/b], and you'll gain access to the [b]#testers[/b] channel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/eaf193e5611ebdf6842b496ac91b0f9ecaba1074.jpg[/img]
[i]A lot of work goes into making the in-between areas pleasant to look at. Take a look around sometime! Just don't die in the process.[/i]

[h2]Tribute[/h2]
Lastly, one of active community members, [b]Wade[/b], has made an awesome 10-minute tribute to our game, showcasing beautiful visuals that we didn't even know were in the game. Check it out here!
[previewyoutube=ihicRYkU2gc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Version 0.62 - Chapter 3
notes.content:
Did we say first week of [b]December[/b]? Because we clearly meant the third week apparently. Anywho, after a bunch of constant mini-delays, [b]Chapter 3[/b] has finally arrived! It contains some of the toughest challenges to date, with [b]New Creep Types[/b], increasingly layered map designs, and [b]Triple Element Specializations[/b]!

Also included in this update is [b]New Music[/b], improvements to [b]Ranked Mode[/b], a bunch of fixes, and more. Check it out below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/aaeff864ad26e40597b8547bd28e32c9801fe1d8.jpg[/img]
[i]New missions, new maps![/i]

[h2]Campaign[/h2][list]
[*][b]Chapter 3[/b] has arrived, with [b]7 New Missions[/b]! Hold your ground across snowy mountains, overgrown ruins, cities of autumn, and more. Experience your hatred of [b]Cursed Creeps[/b] like never before, as well as new [b]Creep Types[/b] not seen in the standard game!
[*]All [b]Triple Element Towers[/b] now have two [b]Specializations[/b] you can choose between.
[*]Additionally, the [b]Campaign[/b] has received several other fixes and updates:[list]
[*][b]Wave Preview Icons[/b] now display individual timers, so you can tell when each sub-wave is going to spawn.
[*][b]Wave Break Messages[/b] have been updated to be more helpful, or just outright troll you.
[*]Fixed an exploit that let you gain more [b]Unlock Points[/b] than intended. This finally fixes fluctuating [b]Unlock Points[/b] for players.
[*]Fixed a bug where, if you hovered over a [b]Specialization Icon[/b] and then a [b]Tower Icon[/b], it'd continue to display the [b]Specialization Tooltip[/b] even if the tower was mismatched.
[*]Fixed [b]Wave Clear[/b] messages sometimes showing up early in a wave, if you kill all creeps while waiting on the remaining sub-waves to spawn.
[*][b]Chapter 2[/b] bounty reduced by 20%.
[*]You now start with [b]75 Lives[/b] on all [b]Chapter 2 Missions[/b].
[*]The time between waves has been about cut in half, meaning the speed-based achievements in the [b]Campaign[/b] are much more doable than before.
[/list]
[*]The following [b]Specializations[/b] have been tweaked:[list]
[*][b]Darkness Spec 1[/b] reduced from +35% to +30% damage
[*][b]Darkness Spec 2[/b] reduced from 20% to 15% HP damage
[*][b]Geyser Spec 1[/b] number of attacks need to proc effect increased from 3 to 4
[*][b]Geyser Spec 2[/b] ability AoE reduced from 750 to 600
[*][b]Life Spec 1[/b] changed to increase damage by 50% if you have 25 Lives or less
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/975879891b6d862229d9dd34781ac2512c6425f8.jpg[/img]
[i]The classic [b]Winter[/b] returns, with a few tweaks.[/i]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*][b]Builders[/b] now react with the height of the terrain.
[*][b]Fog of War[/b] is now somewhat adaptive, meaning it'll black out non-relevant parts of the map, particularly if you're playing solo or in [b]War & Team War Modes[/b].
[*]Score label in the top-right now says [b]Boss Score[/b] instead of [b]Ronald Score[/b], in case you're not using the [b]Ronald Skin[/b].
[*]The [b]Region[/b] of each player is now listed in the [b]Lobby[/b].[list]
[*]Note, this doesn't change the actual [b]Region[/b] of the hosted game, just roughly what to expect lag-wise.
[/list]
[*]In [b]War Mode[/b], when you use [b]Nuke, Frost Zone, or Dimensional Rift[/b], it'll now display an icon over the targeted location with a timer, so you know when they'll end.
[*][b]War & Team War Lobbies[/b] no longer list [b]Very Hard Difficulty[/b] in their lobby/notification description, since it's locked in anyways.
[*]In [b]Teams Mode[/b], if you're on the second slot, your [b]Elemental Bosses[/b] will now [i]always[/i] spawn out of the second portal.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/ab6504169e2fcc1c78c3f67e96d950d3179bb72a.jpg[/img]
[i]Is that a portal on the wall?[/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed an issue where you could get spontaneously disconnected from [b]Ranked Games[/b].
[*]Fixed an issue where it was possible to join the lobby of an in-progress game.[list]
[*]If this is still happening, please let us know.
[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug in [b]Ranked[/b] where the pop-up at the end of the game would display the wrong [b]MMR Calculations[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug in [b]Teams Mode[/b] where, if the first player in a team gets disconnected, all remaining creeps for that team would be permanently [b]Hyper Boosted[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug where, if a [b]Geyser Tower[/b] landed a kill on a [b]Splitter Boss[/b] with its ability, it'd partially launch it upwards, causing all of its remaining subdivisions to walk on the air.
[*]Fixed a bug where loading from checkpoint would give you the wrong wave's [b]Preview Icons[/b].
[*]Fixed a rare bug where [b]Disease[/b] could fully heal a creep or boss back to full health.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/bc7f2fb309945870eca414e74c9ca318d7cd5cb9.jpg[/img]
[i]A new tropical paradise. Looks relaxing... in theory.[/i]

[h2]Audio[/h2][list]
[*]The game's [b]Music[/b] has been updated! A bunch of new tracks were added, while some were culled.
[*][b]Music[/b] has been optimized, so even though there's more tracks overall, it should take less memory than before.
[*]Every [b]Campaign Mission[/b] now has a unique [b]Intro Theme[/b].
[*]Lastly, the sounds for [b]Game Over, Mission Clear, & Buy Customization[/b] have all been replaced.[list]
[*]RIP "That's a bad omen". It will be missed. But someday... it will return. With a vengeance.
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/13d529221860207721fb73c710d7bc001b9fa5b3.jpg[/img]
[i]Believe it or not, this is not the biggest map in [b]Chapter 3[/b].[/i]

[h2]Ranked Mode[/h2]
In an effort to prevent new players from jumping into [b]Ranked[/b] and getting slaughtered, as well as make it easier to find [b]Ranked[/b] games, the following changes are being made:[list]
[*]The [b]Level Requirement[/b] for [b]Ranked[/b] has been increased from [b]Level 10[/b] to [b]Level 20[/b].
[*]You can now receive [b]Notifications[/b] for [b]Ranked Games[/b]. Once you hit [b]Level 20[/b], this'll turn itself on by default. Like all other [b]Notifications[/b], you can toggle it off.[list]
[*]Just like the standard search queue, you'll only be notified of a [b]Ranked Game[/b] if you're within 225 MMR of the challenging player.
[/list][/list]
With these changes, over time, [b]Ranked Mode[/b] will hopefully see shorter queue times and repopulate.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/aa614b0e7747686450ca7dc8aa97ee1d2ccb238c.jpg[/img]
[i]Showing off one of the [b]Triple Specializations[/b], as well as a snippet of something greater...[/i]


And that's it for [b]Version 0.62[/b]! We meant to get a preview of this patch up ahead of time, but there was a lot more work than expected, so instead, we put that time into making [b]Chapter 3[/b] as grandtastic as possible. Now that we've given the game's [b]Singleplayer[/b] some love, expect to see a bunch of love for [b]Multiplayer[/b] next patch, which will include:[list]
[*]Balance Updates
[*]Map Variants
[*]New Achievements
[*]New Cosmetics
[/list]
Also, as many of you may well know, we were a part of [b]Jingle Jam 2020[/b] this year, and as a result, we've seen a lot of new players join the game. Online games fill pretty quickly now, and we're also seeing more activity on the [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Element TD DIscord[/url]. We hope the trend continues as we release the final updates leading up to [b]Official Release[/b]!

If you enjoy the increase in activity as much as we do, please consider leaving a [b]Review[/b] for our game (if you haven't already). Positive, negative, whatever your honest thoughts are, let us know what you think of [b]Element TD 2[/b], and what you hope to see in its future.

notes.title: Version 0.61 - Fixes, Achievements & Cosmetics
notes.content:
Welcome to yet another week of "no seriously, where's [b]Chapter 3[/b]", where once again, we deliver a patch that doesn't actually contain more of the [b]Campaign[/b]. Don't worry, it's coming for real next patch, just in time to clash with [b]Cyberpunk 2077[/b], because we're [strike]absolute geniuses[/strike] complete idiots.

Anywho, in the meantime, we're bringing up a new batch of [b]Achievements[/b], more fun [b]Cosmetics[/b], a bunch of improvements and fixes, as well as updates to [b]War Mode[/b]! Read on for the full notes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/b70971575ff07f77be151b6a539d4a982a5f5724.gif[/img]
[i]We heard you like UFOs, so we put some UFOs in your UFOs so you can UFO while you UFO![/i]


[h2]Achievements & Cosmetics[/h2][list]
[*][b]Achievements[/b]:[list]
[*][b]First War[/b] - Win 1 Game of War Mode
[*][b]War Veteran[/b] - Win 5 Games of War Mode
[*][b]Master of War[/b] - Win 25 Games of War Mode
[*][b]Elemental Diversity[/b] - Cast all six War Mode Abilities at least once in a single game in War Mode
[*][b]Total Stasis[/b] - Catch 20 creeps in stasis with a single Dimensional Rift in War Mode
[*][b]Annihilation[/b] - Blow up 10 of your Opponent's Towers at once with a single Nuke in War Mode
[*][b]Mega Killer[/b] - Kill a total of 10 Mega Creeps in War Mode games
[*][b]Full Counter[/b] - Decrease the opponent's lives by 15 in a single wave in War Mode
[*][b]Domination[/b] - Win a War Mode game without losing a single life
[*][b]Win Streak[/b] - Win 3 Ranked Games in a row
[/list]
[*][b]Cosmetics[/b]:[list]
[*][b]New Builder[/b] - Burning Skull
[*][b]New Builder[/b] - Trident Fighter
[*][b]New Hat[/b] - Trident Hat
[*][b]New Trail[/b] - Lightning Trail
[*][b]New Trail[/b] - Path of Ice
[*][b]New Trail[/b] - UFO Squad
[*][b]New Wings[/b] - Snakes of Wrath
[*][b]New Wings[/b] - UFO Guards
[/list][/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*][b]On/Off Modifiers[/b] in Singleplayer & Lobby settings changed from dropdowns to checkboxes.
[*][b]Essence[/b] in the top-right HUD now lists "Spent / Max".[list]
[*]It'll still list the actual [b]Essence Upgrade Picks[/b] in the [b]Scoreboard[/b], just like before. This is for distinguishing the total number of [b]Essences[/b] you have and are capable of getting.
[/list]
[*]In the [b]Campaign[/b], the wave display at the top now lists the total number of waves in the [b]Mission[/b].
[*]Friendly indicators replaced with a colored outline, instead of a big blocky shield.
[*]There is now a sound for when an enemy leaks, provided your viewpoint is near or on the respective portal.
[*]Minor visual improvements & optimizations on several maps.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/eea6fef6ea031a07843be0abc48b73ecfaa5f65c.jpg[/img]
[i]Lamps now properly glow on all maps, at no performance cost either![/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed drag-building letting you bypass the [b]Tower Limit[/b] in [b]Teams, Co-op, War, & Team War Modes[/b].
[*]Going past the threshold for an [b]Achievement[/b] will now award you properly for it.[list]
[*]This is retroactive, so if you're missing [b]Achievements[/b] from this bug, they should be awarded properly upon booting up the game.
[/list]
[*]As lobby host, you can no longer input any commands after the countdown starts, preventing you from doing last second changes to the settings or last second player switching (which broke the game previously).
[*]If someone quits a lobby, it'll now unready everyone else, which fixes a bug where games could start preemptively.
[*]Fixed new players in a lobby showing up as Red in the chat before they type anything.
[*]Fixed a bug in [b]Campaign[/b] where loading a checkpoint wouldn't reset the clock, thereby making the speed clear [b]Achievements[/b] an absolute pain to get.
[*]Fixed a bug where, if you joined a lobby via notification while you were in-game, the lobby would be displayed incorrectly.
[*]Fixed a bug where, if you played [b]Boss Hunt[/b] length, and then a game on a different length, the [b]Boss Score[/b] indicators in the top-right would appear from the start of the game and remain there the whole game.
[/list]

[h2]War Updates[/h2][list]
[*][b]Hyper Boost[/b] duration reduced from 5 to 2 seconds[list]
[*]Speed boost increased from 100% / 133% / 200% to 200% / 266% / 400%
[/list]
[*][b]Frost Zone[/b] duration increased from 15 / 20 / 30 to 30 / 40 / 60 seconds[list]
[*]AoE reduced from 600 to 300
[/list]
[*][b]Rejuvenation[/b] heal reduced from 50% to 25% / 33% / 50%[list]
[*]Cooldown rescaled from 150 / 125 / 75 to 120 seconds
[/list]
[*][b]Spawn Mega[/b] HP reduced from 1000% to 400% / 533% / 800%[list]
[*]Cooldown rescaled from 150 / 125 / 75 to 150 seconds
[*]Movement speed increased from 50% to 75%
[/list]
[*][b]Long War[/b] option added:[list]
[*]Increases the starting lives from 50 to 100
[*]For [b]Team War[/b], this is now the default option
[/list]
[*][b]Team War Wins[/b] stat added
[*]Hostile indicator size reduced, should no longer badly obscure towers.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Elemental Bosses[/b] were being affected by [b]Hyper Boost & Rejuvenation[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug where having a [b]Mega Creep[/b] out while someone uses [b]Dimensional Rift[/b] on the last creeps of a wave would stall it, requiring said creeps to die before next wave would start.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/3c612743f5538739c1b478c4b581c9d0201ddb48.jpg[/img]
[i]Now you can blend in with the terrain! If it's the right map...[/i]


[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
Next week, the long awaited [b]Chapter 3[/b] will finally release! We were trying to get it out before the almighty [b]Cyberpunk 2077[/b] releases, but that's looking extremely unlikely. So, if for whatever reason you're not playing [b]Cyberpunk[/b] next weekend, know that we'll have your back with 7 new missions of content. It doesn't sound like much, but in reality, the total length eclipses the first 2 Chapters combined! Plus there'll be new [b]Specializations[/b] to try out.

After [b]Chapter 3[/b] releases next weekend, we'll be working on the next balance patch. Numerous folks have noted various problems with the game's current balance, and fear not - we're well aware of them, so expect the silly [b]2 Element & 6 Element[/b] builds to no longer automatically dominate, and more love for [b]4 & 5 Element[/b] builds. There'll also be more juicy surprises in said patch, so look forward to it!


[h2]Jingle Jam[/h2]
If you're not aware, we are participating in [b]Jingle Jam[/b] this year! As a result, you may notice a surge in players over the next few weeks, especially tomorrow on [b]Saturday, December 5th[/b], when [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/yogscast]Yogscast[/url][/b] will be livestreaming [b]Element TD 2[/b] on [b]Twitch[/b]! Stream runs from [b]8pm to 11pm UTC[/b], so stop on by and show your support!

notes.title: Version 0.60 - This is War
notes.content:
It's been a while, but we're back with a new patch! With this, we're rebranding [b]Duel Mode[/b] into [b]War Mode[/b], which sees two players face off in a fast-paced match of constant counterplay, leading to cut-throat games! And if you want things even more frantic, we've added [b]Team War Mode[/b], which has 4 players in a 2v2 vying for control!

Also in this patch are improvements to [b]Lobbies[/b], some welcome fixes to [b]Ranked Mode[/b], quality-of-life updates, and a bunch of other fixes. Read on for the full notes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/591fbf2a4196e90c5e8456420c0c5b0c401c22f3.jpg[/img]
[i]Nuclear launch detected... oh, too late.[/i]


[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][h3][b]War Mode:[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Originally known as [b]Duel Mode[/b], [b]War Mode[/b] is a 1v1 mode where both players are placed in the same maze. Your towers damage enemy creeps while healing your own. Additionally, the elements you choose affect which [b]War Abilities[/b] you get, which are powerful abilities that can influence the tide of the battle![list]
[*]Rush your creeps forward with [b]Hyper Boost[/b], spawn an intimidating [b]Mega Creep[/b], or even launch a [b]Nuke[/b] to decimate a group of towers!
[*]Most games end in 15-20 Waves, and we've personally never seen games go past 25 Waves. It can also be very back-and-forth as builds get more complex. Choosing your [b]Elements[/b], positioning, and timing has never been more important.
[/list][/list]
[*][h3][b]Team War Mode:[/b][/h3][list]
[*]Because 1v1 wasn't frantic enough, you can now do 2v2s! All 4 players are on the same map, and each player has their own abilities. Coordinate with your partner to push your creeps to the end and survive the opponent's onslaught!
[/list]
[*]Players now join "slots", instead of being automatically ordered around. As a result, the [b]Host[/b] of a game can now move players around to different slots.
[*][b]Teams Mode[/b] now denotes who's on what team in the Lobby itself.[list]
[*]Instead of having to quit/rejoin in order to order yourselves, now just make the request from the [b]Host[/b].
[*]This even allows you to do [b]Solo Teams Mode[/b], where each player is on their own team.
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/0b9cba53d184dc72cac3761b4bba399d02064c14.jpg[/img]
[i]This is war.[/i]


[h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2][list]
[*][b]Host Game[/b] now looks 100% fancier.
[*][b]Creeps[/b] have received a visual update and should stand out better than before.
[*]In Multiplayer, [b]Player Nametags[/b] are now color-coded.
[*]When someone clears a wave in [b]Teams Mode[/b], it now lists the [b]Team[/b] that cleared it instead of the player.
[*][b]Pings[/b] have been made 50% more visible.
[*]Fixed a bug in the [b]Campaign[/b] where you had 1 less Unlock Point than intended.[list]
[*]Note this also fixes a longtime bug where some folks had [i]way more[/i] than intended. So if you had 30+ points before and you've noticed you're suddenly down to 22, welcome to everyone else's level.
[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug where, if you somehow passed the exact threshold for an [b]Achievement[/b], you wouldn't receive it.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/c25bcc33b33bca4c6c0577c14b66fde707cca880.jpg[/img]
[i]A fancier way to encourage playing new modes[/i]


[h2]Ranked Mode[/h2][list]
[*][b]Ranked[/b] is now restricted to players [b]Level 10[/b] or higher. New players are encouraged to try and learn the game first, before getting smashed by the difficulty of the mode itself.
[*]If the opponent quits the match, the game will now automatically end.
[*]Reduced [b]Silver[/b] threshold from 700 to 600.
[*]Reduced [b]Gold[/b] threshold from 1000 to 900.
[*]The [b]Customize[/b] button is now disabled when searching for a [b]Ranked[/b] game.[list]
[*]In the future, we'll allow you to peruse the menu as you please during search, I promise! This is just a temporary fix for now.
[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug where you could find a game and then immediately get disconnected.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Ranked Leaderboards[/b] would sometimes be flipped.
[*]Fixed the in-game [b]MMR Pop-up[/b] sometimes displaying something wrong entirely.
[/list]


That's it for this patch! I know it's been a while since the last patch, but fret not, we've got a bunch more on the way over the next month. In favor of releasing an update sooner, new [b]Achievements & Cosmetics[/b] aren't in quite yet, but don't worry, they'll be here next week. And a week after that, we'll have [b]Chapter 3[/b] finally in the game!

On top of that, we have a surprise for you coming up soon. We can't say when exactly, but it's [i]soon[/i]. In the meantime, enjoy the new [b]War Modes[/b]!


On last thing: on Sunday, November 29th at 10:00am GMT, we'll be running some server maintenance, so if you're playing online during that time and you suddenly get disconnected, that'd be why.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/30aeb1316bbd82e2fd73b2f29e14c0e1432361c1.jpg[/img]
[i]Arriving in [b]Chapter 3[/b]! This looks a bit different than I remember...[/i]

notes.title: Element TD 2 Official Launch Date
notes.content:
[h2]Release Date[/h2]
It's been a long road since the start of [b]Early Access[/b]. The scope and scale of the game has increased substantially over time. We've added a [b]Campaign[/b], new [b]Modes[/b], [b]Ranked[/b],  [b]Achievements[/b], [b]Cosmetics[/b], and so much more! Our playerbase and [url=https://discord.gg/2se8VCq]Discord[/url] have grown considerably as well. However, believe it or not, we're actually nearing release...

We're proud to announce that [b]Element TD 2[/b] will be leaving Early Access on [b]February 19th, 2021[/b]!


[h2]The Price[/h2]
Currently, the game is available for $9.99. However, when we officially release, [b]we'll be increasing the price to [u]$14.99[/u][/b], to account for the substantial increase in scale and content. So if you know any friends interested in the game, tell them to get it now!


[h2]What's Left?[/h2]
We actually have our plans for the next few versions drafted up, as well as estimated release dates:[list]
[*][b]Version 0.60[/b]:[list]
[*]Before the end of [b]November[/b]
[*]Updates to [b]Duel Mode[/b]
[*][b]Team Duel[/b] Mode added
[*]Improved [b]Lobby System[/b]
[*]Various fixes to [b]Ranked Mode[/b]
[/list]
[*][b]Version 0.61[/b]:[list]
[*]Last week of [b]November[/b]
[*]New [b]Achievements[/b] and [b]Cosmetics[/b]
[/list]
[*][b]Version 0.62[/b]:[list]
[*]Second week of [b]December[/b]
[*]Chapter 3 of the Campaign!
[*]Specializations for Triple Element Towers
[/list]
[*][b]Version 0.63[/b]:[list]
[*]First week of [b]January[/b]
[*]Balance Update
[*]New Maps (Variants)
[*]Chapter 3 Achievements
[*]New Cosmetics
[/list]
[*][b]Version 0.64[/b]:[list]
[*]Second week of [b]January[/b]
[*]Third Co-op map
[*]Proper Visuals for Atlantis Map
[*]New Achievements
[/list]
[/list]

After [b]Version 0.64[/b], we'll be focusing on bug fixes and quality-of-life updates as we work on [b]Chapter 4[/b], which will finish the [b]Campaign[/b] and signal the official release of the game.


We've got some surprises in store for you all. Some of it's arriving in the coming updates, and some of it... well, we can't tell you yet, but we do have something big coming up soon! In the meantime, look forward to the next few patches, which will increase the game's content by a considerable amount... again.

notes.title: Version 0.59.1 - Ranked Hotfixes
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Reduced MMR Search Range from a max of 450 to a max of 225[list]
[*]This should result in a lot less lopsided matches.
[/list]
[*]When searching for a [b]Ranked Game[/b], the [b]Customize[/b] button is now hidden.
[*]Fixed a bug where it was possible to send your [b]Boss Score[/b] entry to the [b]Ranked Leaderboard[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug where, if you searched for a [b]Ranked Game[/b], cancelled, and then tried to Host/Join a [b]Lobby[/b], it'd immediately disconnect you.
[*]Fixed a minor lighting inconsistency on [b]Grand City[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.59 - Ranked Mode & Stats
notes.content:
It took its sweet time, but [b]Ranked Mode[/b] is finally here! Compete against friends, random strangers, and possible developer cameos, as you climb the rankings and destroy everyone else! Or die miserably, depending on your skill level. Also included in this patch is [b]Stats[/b], some optimizations, quality-of-life updates, and bug fixes. Enjoy!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/ef87982ffbfb5052f4565be5dd313ad408f6ce98.jpg[/img]
[i]Start climbing the rankings![/i]

[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]Ranked Mode[/b] is here, complete with [b]1v1 Matchmaking[/b] and a [b]Ranked Leaderboard[/b]![list]
[*]It's split into two categories:[list]
[*][b]Ranked Pick[/b] has you playing on [b]Pick + Very Hard[/b].
[*][b]Ranked Random[/b] has you playing on [b]Same Random + Very Hard + Chaos[/b].
[*]Regardless of which you choose, map selection is randomized, and certain maps have [b]2-Path[/b] forced on.
[/list]
[*]Each category has its own [b]Leaderboard[/b], meaning that even if you're a god at [b]Pick[/b], you're not obligated to play [b]Random[/b] to raise your MMR.
[*]Unlike the standard game, a [b]Ranked Game[/b] immediately ends when one player dies.[list]
[*]That said, if you quit the game mid-match, that will count as a loss for you.
[/list]
[*]Winning more games = higher MMR = raising your [b]Division[/b], which for now, will get you slightly fancier avatar borders. We'll be expanding its rewards over time.
[/list]
[*][b]Player Stats[/b] have also been added to the game![list]
[*]You can find a list of your lifetime stats under your [b]Profile[/b].
[*]You can also view other players' profiles on the [b]Ranked Leaderboards[/b].
[*]Note, only a few of these stats are retroactive. The majority of them will be starting from scratch.
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/699ed9d99588dc62df690d102fe973133d511f04.jpg[/img]
[i]It even tracks [b]Duel Abilities[/b]. You know, that one mode no one plays.[/i]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]Desyncs should happen far less often than before.
[*]Optimized what's rendered on-screen. The game should no longer try to render stuff way off screen.
[*]Disabled numerous spammy debugs, should help performance a bit.
[*]All trees now have a little wind effect on them. No more still trees on [b]Forest[/b]!
[*]Adjusted the top-left corner of [b]Grand City[/b], in an attempt to make that path a little more fair.
[*]If you're playing 1-4 Players on [b]Grand City[/b], the bottom half of the map will now be obscured.
[*]If you're scrolling through the [b]Wave Browser[/b], it'll replace the "Next" text with said wave number.[list]
[*]It will only say "Next" if you're on the current wave.
[/list]
[*]Improved the [b]Tower Table Highlight[/b] upon getting a new Element.
[*][b]Forest[/b] has been made 10% greener.
[*][Campaign] Removed the [b]Loadout[/b] button. Instead, hitting [b]Play[/b] will now bring you to the [b]Loadout[/b] screen.
[*][Campaign] Each [b]Mission[/b] now has a few towers it suggests to help clear it.
[*][Campaign] Flipped [b]Trickery[/b] specializations.
[*][Campaign] Adjusted the sub-wave start sound to be more different from the wave start sound.
[*][Campaign] Clear Speed now uses MM:SS instead of HH:MM:SS
[*][Campaign] [b]Replays[/b] are no longer saved, due to a whole lot of bugs. We'll re-enable [b]Campaign Replays[/b] in a future patch.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/d9a34cf90c47decacf155151fe80d2b008bfec6d.jpg[/img]
[i]Poison nods its hats off to you.[/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed [b]Damage Number[/b] options not working properly.
[*]Fixed [b]Wings[/b] not showing up for other players' Builders.
[*]Fixed rounding shenanigans on the [b]Money Tower Bonus[/b] in the HUD.
[*]Fixed an error that could occur when, if you're the last to survive but you're not the actual winner, it'd count as a victory anyways.
[*]Fixed a bug where if you had [b]Turbo[/b] on in a Singleplayer/Multiplayer game, and then played a Campaign Mission, you'd be forced to play it with [b]Turbo[/b] on.
[/list]


That's it for this patch! As usual, if you wish to find more players to chat or fight against, join the [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Element TD Discord[/url], which has surpassed 1000 users!

As for you folks clamoring for [b]Chapter 3[/b], you can expect that to drop at the end of the month, alongside some other updates. We'll be announcing more details in the coming weeks. In the meantime, enjoy smashing folks in [b]Ranked Mode[/b]!

notes.title: Version 0.58 - Hats on Towers!
notes.content:
Ladies and Gentlemen, behold - [b]Hats on Towers[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/0a47f9d240398fd950f7dc555342bd602a7fa966.jpg[/img]
[i]Introducing the first [b]Tower Defense[/b] ever to let you stick hats on towers. Because we can![/i]

In addition, this patch also features a few new [b]Cosmetics[/b], a dangerous [b]No Sell Mode[/b], updates for [b]Duel Mode[/b], numerous quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, balance updates, and more!

[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]Hats on Towers![/b][list]
[*]Hats on demand! Customize each of your towers with a different hat. Just go to the [b]Customize[/b] menu, strap on your hat, and become a [strike]Valve employee[/strike] practitioner of hats!
[/list]
[*]In the [b]Cosmetics Preview Pane[/b], right-click will now rotate around the [b]Builder/Towers[/b].
[*][b]3 Cosmetics Added![/b]:[list]
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Ghost of a Chance - [i]Requires Level 40[/i]
[*][b]New Hat[/b]: Pumpkin - [i]Requires Level 25[/i]
[*][b]New Hat[/b]: Ghosty Pal - [i]Requires Level 65[/i]
[/list]
[*][b]No Sell Mode[/b] has been added![list]
[*]Turn this on to prevent anyone from selling any of their towers, and making [b]Buy/Sell Abusers[/b] cry. Or anyone that makes mistakes, really. Good luck not making mistakes!
[*]Note, since [b]Interest[/b] is no longer as silly as it used to be, this straight up replaces the [b]No Interest[/b] modifier. More [b]Modifiers[/b] is fun and all, but we try to avoid redundant ones.
[/list]
[*][b]1 New Achievement[/b]:[list]
[*][b]It Was All Skill[/b] - Beat the game on Very Hard + Random + No Sell + 2-Path in an FFA game, on any map
[/list]
[*][b][url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Our Discord[/url][/b] has been updated with a [b]#games-hosted[/b] channel:[list]
[*]Anytime anyone hosts a game, a post will be made here, telling you who hosted, as well as the settings.
[*]That way, you'll be notified of games being hosted even you don't have [b]Element TD 2[/b] open!
[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/e3da4c07eb0f27a04f1b94803493c925bbb7baa9.jpg[/img]
[i]The [b]Main Menu[/b] backdrop has been given a slightly festive makeover.[/i]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]Scaling for [b]Co-op[/b] has been applied:[list]
[*]If you're playing with 1-4 Players, it'll only spawn 4 Paths now.
[*]If you're playing with 5-8 Players, it'll spawn all 8 Paths, and you'll start with 200 Lives instead.
[/list]
[*][b]Co-op Starting Gold[/b] increased by roughly 20%.
[*]If you're playing [b]Teams, Co-op, or Duel Modes[/b], there is now a limit to the number of towers you can place, equal to the (# of Total Spots) / (# of Players):[list]
[*]This was primarily done to reduce griefing. In most cases, you won't notice this.
[/list]
[*]On the [b]Leaderboard[/b], you can now filter the rankings by [b]Global, Self, & Friends[/b]!
[*]The [b]Customize[/b] button is now hidden when you're on the [b]Lobby[/b], preventing certain menu hijinks.
[*][b]Camera Rotate[/b] hotkeys are no longer backwards.[list]
[*][b]Page Up/Down[/b] now control vertical rotation, while [b]Home/End[/b] control horizontal rotation.
[/list]
[*]Within the first 5 Waves of a game, [b]Eliminations[/b] no longer count for [b]XP & Achievements[/b]. RIP abuse shenanigans.
[*][b]Game Notifications[/b] now list the actual player that hosted.
[*][b]Game Notifications[/b] now also list what [b]Region[/b] it's hosted on.
[*]Pressing F9 to hide the UI will now hide the [b]Builder Select Circle[/b] as well as [b]Elemental Boss Nametags[/b].
[*][b]Player Nametags[/b] have been raised, they should no longer overlap most builders.
[*]Increased how close you can zoom in.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Attempt number #9000 at fixing [b]Campaign Unlock Points[/b] not transferring from saves.[list]
[*]If you're still running into an issue where you cannot progress in the [b]Campaign[/b] because you have way less [b]Unlock Points[/b] than you should, [i]please let us know[/i].
[/list]
[*]Fixed [b]XP Bar[/b] blocking input on the [b]Unlock Stuff[/b] menu, even when disabled.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Howitzer's Heavy Cannons[/b] was applying the multiplier twice. Whoops.
[*]Fixed Tower Select UI in [b]Campaign[/b] not displaying [b]Specialization[/b] icons.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Audio Settings[/b] were resetting themselves.
[*]Fixed a bug in [b]Boss Hunt Length[/b] where the [b]Essence Pick Upgrade[/b] was giving you 4 Essences instead of 2.
[/list]

[h2]Duel Mode Updates[/h2][list]
[*]New [b]Duel Mode[/b] ability: [b]Dimensional Rift[/b]:[list]
[*]Places all creeps affected in stasis, preventing them from taking damage. It also removes them from the current wave, meaning they can carry into the next wave.
[/list]
[*][b]Spawn Mega[/b] has been rescaled:[list]
[*]HP increased from x5 to x10
[*]Lives taken increased from 5 to 10
[*]It now moves at half the speed
[/list]
[*][b]Lockdown AoE[/b] reduced from 400 to 300
[*]Fixed hostile indicators not showing up
[*]Fixed creeps remaining at the end of a [b]Duel Mode[/b] game
[*]Fixed abilities not being recorded in [b]Duel Mode[/b] replays
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/d8721bd2902a57710c3d66d063150530a6b07e4f.gif[/img]
[i]Its VFX may be prettier, but its effect has been slam dunked by the nerfbat. Git gud, folks.[/i]

[h2]Balance[/h2][list]
[*]As usual, the [b]Leaderboard[/b] has been reset.
[*]Reverted the [b]Focus Targeting[/b] changes from [b]0.57[/b]:[list]
[*]The only towers that focus targets down now are [b]Light, Atom, Infernal & Flooding[/b].
[/list]
[*][b]Arrow[/b] damage increased from 45 to 50[list]
[*]Projectile speed also increased 25%
[/list]
[*][b]Light[/b] consecutive damage reduced from 5 / 30 / 180 / 1800 to 3 / 18 / 108 / 1080
[*][b]Atom[/b] damage increased from 280 / 1120 / 4480 to 300 / 1200 / 4800
[*][b]Poison[/b] rescaled:[list]
[*]Damage-per-second reduced from 70 / 280 / 1120 to 50 / 200 / 800
[*]Duration increased from 10 to 14 seconds
[/list]
[*][b]Ice[/b] rescaled:[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 750 / 3000 / 12000 to 525 / 2100 / 8400
[*]Attack Speed increased from 1 to 1.5
[/list]
[*][b]Infernal[/b] damage increased from 650 / 2600 / 10400 to 700 / 2800 / 11200
[*][b]Mushroom[/b] damage increased from 110 / 440 / 1760 to 115 / 460 / 1840
[*][b]Life[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 800 / 3200 / 12800 to 1250 / 5000 / 20000
[*]Attack Speed reduced from 1 to 0.66
[*]Number of kills needed to gain a life changed from 6 / 4 / 2 to 15 / 10 / 5
[/list]
[*][b]Howitzer[/b] damage increased from 165 / 660 / 2640 to 170 / 680 / 2720
[*][b]Laser[/b] damage increased from 4200 / 16800 to 4500 / 18000
[*][b]Astral[/b] damage reduced from 1800 / 7200 to 1600 / 6400
[*][b]Runic[/b] damage increased from 1000 / 4000 to 1200 / 4800
[*][b]Haste[/b] rescaled:[list]
[*]Attack Speed increased from 1 to 1.5
[*]Damage increased from 900 / 3600 to 1000 / 4000
[*]Projectile Speed increased by 25%
[*]Attack Speed gain per attack reduced from 10% to 7%. Still caps at 6 attacks per second.
[/list]
[*][b]Money[/b] damage increased from 5500 / 22000 to 6000 / 24000
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/fb3e551df68fbf19bbf13335ccbc81c8126f4db5.jpg[/img]
[i]Well well well...[/i]

Whew, that ended up being a lot more than we expected! Strike fear into the hearts of your enemies as you plaster [b]Tophats[/b] and [b]Pumpkins[/b] onto your towers. Make your friends regret making mistakes in [b]No Sell Mode[/b]. And if you haven't played [b]Duel Mode[/b] before, grab a friend and give it a shot; expect more improvements for it down-the-road.

Speaking of stuff coming down-the-road...

[h2]Where's Ranked Mode?[/h2]
We're actually close to releasing this one! We were trying to get it done for this week, but it's taking more time than expected; meanwhile, everything else planned for the [b]Ranked[/b] patch was done, so we decided to release [b]Version 0.58[/b] now. Expect [b]Ranked[/b] to arrive in [b]Version 0.59[/b] next week!

[h2]Where's Chapter 3?[/h2]
Admittedly, this one's kind of behind schedule. At the moment, I can only say it'll release by the end of [b]November[/b]. However, I can guarantee you that when it does arrive, it'll be packing some surprises!

[h2]When's the Launch Date?[/h2]
Well, after [b]Ranked Mode & Chapter 3[/b], we do have a [b]Chapter 4[/b] planned, among a few more things. However, compared to what's come before, it's really not too much. That said, next month, we'll be announcing the official release date for [b]Element TD 2[/b]. Look forward to it!

notes.title: Version 0.57 - Balance, UI, Achievements, and Cosmetics
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.57[/b] has arrived, folks! With it arrives a UI update, a difficulty increase (and with it, a leaderboard reset), the ability to add friends, new Achievements, new Cosmetics, bug fixes, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/51e41bab6d4526e68a29ecd68d43f5ca2ccc55f7.gif[/img]
[i]Combine some of the new [b]Cosmetics[/b] to acquire the [b]Cursed Sheep on a Cloud[/b]![/i]

[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]UI[/b] has received a bit of a facelift! The [b]Main Menu[/b] in particular should be much less monotonous than before.
[*]At the end of a multiplayer game, on the [b]Scoreboard[/b], we've added an [b]Add Friend[/b] button, next to everyone's names.
[*][b]8 New Achievements[/b] added:[list]
[*][b]Monument[/b] - Get 500 kills on a single tower
[*][b]Boss Hunter[/b] - Reach Wave 64
[*][b]How Interesting[/b] - Get 20,000 Interest in an FFA Game
[*][b]Greed is Good[/b] - Get 20,000 Money Tower Bonus in an FFA Game
[*][b]Breaking the Bank[/b] - Get 150,000 Networth before Wave 56 in an FFA Game
[*][b]In Good Health[/b] - Reach 70 Lives in an FFA Game
[*][b]Extreme Conditions[/b] - Clear through Wave 55 on Full Length + Hard + Extreme, on any map
[*][b]Perfectionist[/b] - Clear through Wave 55 on Full Length + Insane without losing any lives, on any map
[/list]
[*][b]10 New Cosmetics[/b] added:[list]
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Plague Skull
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Sheep on a Cloud
[*][b]New Hat[/b]: Cupcake
[*][b]New Hat[/b]: Well
[*][b]New Hat[/b]: Runestone
[*][b]New Hat[/b]: Om Nom Nom
[*][b]New Trail[/b]: Fairy Streams
[*][b]New Trail[/b]: Trail of Thorns
[*][b]New Wings[/b]: Spark Wings
[*][b]New Wings[/b]: Ungodly Wings
[/list][/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]The [b]Customize[/b] button is now on the main menu at all times.
[*][b]Tower Count[/b] is now displayed in the top-right corner.[list]
[*]Presently, the "cap" that you see is just the total number of build locations on the map.
[/list]
[*]You can now build over [b]Trickery Clones[/b], thus replacing them.
[*]The score column on the [b]Scoreboard[/b] now remains hidden until [b]Wave 56[/b].
[*]The [b]Wave Browser[/b] now hides itself starting from [b]Wave 56[/b] onwards.
[*][b]Periodic[/b] now lists all 6 Elements on its tooltip.
[*]You can no longer steam invite someone that's on a different version.
[*]Adjusted some XP values on the [b]Co-op Achievements[/b].
[*]Adjusted various offset [b]Cosmetics[/b].
[*][b]Trails[/b] that previously didn't have Passive VFX now do.
[*][b]Undead[/b] grave should be slightly more visible.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed [b]Unlock Points[/b] on the cloud save not transferring properly.
[*]Fixed a bug where building from the [b]Tower Table[/b] was faster than intended.
[*]Fixed a bug where killing the previous wave would not unfreeze your [b]Interest[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Nature, Astral, Runic, & Golem Towers[/b] would activate their effects before they started shooting, thus wasting part of their effect.
[*]Fixed a bug with [b]Atom Tower[/b] where, if it shot at a target, it goes out of range for a moment, and then shoots it again, its stacks would reset to 0 instead of resuming the stacks.
[*]Fixed various pop-ups not getting adjusted by [b]UI Scale[/b].
[/list]

[h2]General Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Base HP[/b] increased from 110 to 120
[*][b]HP Scaling[/b] reduced from x1.158 to x1.155
[*][b]Team HP Scaling[/b] reduced from x1.163 to x1.16
[*][b]Wave Times[/b] reduced by 2 seconds on all difficulties[list]
[*]Scaling wave time adjusted from +1 second per 15 Waves to +1 second per 20 Waves
[*][b]Extreme[/b] wave time increased from +3 to +5 seconds
[*][b]Co-op[/b] wave time increased by +10 seconds
[/list]
[*][b]Target Front[/b] has been adjusted so that it actually shoots the creeps closest to the end, instead of the oldest creeps.
[*]Most towers will now focus targets down, instead of reevaluating on every attack.
[*][b]Pick Sell[/b] reduced from 90% to 80%
[*][b]Level 2 Singles[/b] gold cost reduced from 700 to 650
[*][b]Level 3 Singles[/b] gold cost reduced from 2500 to 2250
[*][b]Level 4 Singles[/b] gold cost reduced from 12500 to 12250
[*][b]Perfection Score Bonus[/b] now only works on [b]Full Length[/b].
[*][b]Base Speed Score Modifiers[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*][b]Full[/b] increased from x4.0 to x4.2
[*][b]Short[/b] increased from x3.4 to x3.6
[*][b]Extra Short[/b] increased from x2.4 to x2.5
[/list]
[*][b]Minimum Speed Modifier[/b] increased from x0.5 to x1.0
[*][b]Temporal[/b] jump duration reduced from 0.25 to 0.2 seconds
[/list]

[h2]Tower Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Earth[/b] rescaled:[list]
[*]Shockwave damage increased from 30 / 180 / 1080 / 10800 to 45 / 270 / 1620 / 16200
[*]AoE growth reduced from 50
[/list]
[*][b]Poison[/b] rescaled:[list]
[*]Damage-per-second reduced from 90 / 360 / 1440 to 70 / 280 / 1120
[*]Duration increased from 9 to 10 seconds
[/list]
[*][b]Solar[/b] damage-per-second reduced from 150 / 600 / 2400 to 140 / 560 / 2240
[*][b]Infernal[/b] damage increased from 600 / 2400 / 9600 to 650 / 2600 / 10400
[*][b]Mushroom[/b] rescaled:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 80 / 320 / 1280 to 110 / 440 / 1760
[*]Max damage reduced from 300% to 200%
[/list]
[*][b]Geyser[/b] rescaled:[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 900 / 3600 / 14400 to 600 / 2400 / 9600
[*]Attack speed increased from 1 to 1.5
[/list]
[*][b]Blacksmith[/b] rescaled:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 400 / 1600 / 6400 to 500 / 2000 / 8000
[*]Damage bonus rescaled from 15% / 30% / 90% to 10% / 20% / 100%
[/list]
[*][b]Well[/b] rescaled:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 400 / 1600 / 6400 to 500 / 2000 / 8000
[*]Attack speed bonus rescaled from 15% / 30% / 90% to 10% / 20% / 100%
[/list]
[*][b]Trickery[/b] rescaled:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 300 / 1200 / 4800 to 375 / 1500 / 6000
[*]Clone damage rescaled from 60% / 120% / 360% to 40% / 80% / 400%
[/list]
[*][b]Astral[/b] damage increased from 1500 / 6000 to 1800 / 7200
[*][b]Runic[/b] search AoE increased from 250 to 300
[*][b]Flooding[/b] damage reduced from 350 / 1400 to 320 / 1280
[*][b]Money[/b] gold bonus increased from 25% / 35% to 30% / 40%
[/list]

That's it for this week! Apparently, [b]Insane[/b] difficulty is genuinely really difficult this patch, according to our testers; so much so that the new [b]Perfectionist[/b] achievement took quite a while even for our top players to get. We hope that the [b]Co-op + Insane[/b] achievements are possible with the tweaks this patch. If not, we'll address it next balance patch.


[h2]Where's Ranked Mode?[/h2]
Don't worry, we're still hacking away at it. We're hoping it'll be ready to release in about 2-3 weeks. We'll release more details when we get closer to release. If you'd like to test it out early, hop aboard our [b][url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]EleTD Discord[/url][/b], check the #roles channel, and tag yourself as part of the [b]@testers[/b]!

notes.title: Spontaneous Disconnects have been Fixed
notes.content:
If you were trying to play the game online yesterday and you were receiving completely random disconnects on NA (and certain other regions), we have since fixed the issue. We apologize for the inconvenience.

We've also noticed an influx of more players recently, so if low player count was ever a problem for you before, hop online and try it out again! Even if you see no lobbies, remember: hosting a game will notify everyone else online, so host away!

notes.title: Balance Update coming soon
notes.content:
Early next week, we'll be releasing [b]Version 0.57[/b]. Expect to see a balance update, which includes:[list]
[*][b]6-Element Builds[/b] no longer dominating everything (in theory).
[*]More pressure in [b]Multiplayer[/b], with shorter [b]Wave Timers[/b].
[*]Fixes to some long-time bugs.
[*]And more!
[/list]
There will also be a UI update, giving the menu a fresh coat of paint from its monotonous monotony, new [b]Achievements & Cosmetics[/b], and finally the ability to add friends in-game at the end of a match.

As for [b]Ranked Mode[/b], we're still working away at it. A lot of the backend is done, so we're expecting to get that out in a patch at the end of the month.

See you all soon!

notes.title: Version 0.56.1 - Hotfixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/65eca20994074a18066c6277a7c269e4c2b11158.gif[/img]
[i][b]Geyser[/b] ability now properly launches [b]Cows[/b] into the sky on-kill.[/i]

[h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed [b]Anti-Aliasing[/b] being flipped. If you had it on in Main Menu, it'd be off in-game, and vice versa.
[*]Fixed Speed-based [b]Campaign Achievements[/b] not giving you the achievement even if you completed within seconds of the threshold
[*]Fixed [b]Ethereal[/b] status not having a stack count
[*]Fixed [b]Nature[/b] status not listing a duration
[*]Fixed [b]Atom[/b] status not displaying correctly
[*]Fixed Mission 13 Wave 8 Temporal creeps not giving 20 Bounty
[*][b]Geyser & Quake[/b] now list their attack count on their respective [b]Ability Icons[/b]
[*]Increased the score thresholds for the first two [b]Missions[/b]
[*]Added an extra line on the [b]Mission 4[/b] pop-up to help forward you towards [b]Dual Element Towers[/b] earlier.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.56 - Status Bar, Campaign Achievements, Optimizations, and More!
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.56[/b] has arrived, complete with a Status Bar, Achievements for the Campaign, a Wave Browser, some new Cosmetics, various GPU optimizations, [u]less desyncs[/u], cloud save for the campaign, and lots of bug fixes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/e4b433d7c7c6f1df58874c22c3a2b314637d8444.jpg[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]Status Bar[/b] added! Select a tower or creep, and now you'll be able to see their [b]Buffs/Debuffs[/b].[list]
[*]You can even see stacks of stuff like [b]Poison, Wisp, & Cursed[/b], as well as their duration remaining.
[/list]
[*][b]18 Campaign Achievements[/b] have been added![list]
[*]Each [b]Mission[/b] has its own [b]Achievement[/b], which you can see on the [b]Campaign[/b] screen itself.
[*]There's also [b]Achievements[/b] for clearing each [b]Chapter[/b], and for getting [b]4 Stars[/b] on everything.
[/list]
[*]There's now a pair of arrows next to the [b]Creep Preview[/b], allowing you to browse past/future waves![list]
[*]Note, on [b]Chaos[/b], you won't be able to check out future waves.
[/list]
[*][b]5 New Cosmetics[/b] have been added:[list]
[*][b]New Builder[/b] - Necro Mage
[*][b]New Builder[/b] - Drone
[*][b]New Trail[/b] - Dark Spiral
[*][b]New Wings[/b] - From Heaven and Hell
[*][b]New Wings[/b] - Power Overwhelming
[/list][/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]Optimizations have been made, [b]FPS & GPU Usage[/b] should both be improved.
[*]You can now toggle [b]Anti-Aliasing[/b] off in the [b]Graphics Options[/b].[list]
[*]If you still have issues with [b]FPS/GPU[/b], we recommend turning it off.
[/list]
[*]There should be considerably less [b]Desyncs[/b] now! For real this time.
[*][b]Synchronizing Pauses[/b] should also be less frequent.
[*][b]Campaign Progress[/b] is now saved both locally and to the cloud.
[*]Towers and Creeps are now 25% easier to select.
[*]Adjusted how [b]Elemental Bosses[/b] spawn on [b]Atlantis[/b].
[*]Adjusted the difficulty of [b]Missions 8 & 9[/b] in the [b]Campaign[/b].
[*][b]Total Chatbox Entries[/b] are now capped at 100.
[*][b]Chatbox Entries[/b] now have a character limit of 500.[list]
[*]Sorry folks, no more breaking the chatbox with the [url=https://web.njit.edu/~cm395/theBeeMovieScript/]Bee Movie Script[/url].
[/list]
[*]If you back out to menu to the point where you have "Are you sure?" on your screen, and then hit "Esc", it'll now close the pop-up instead of keeping it plastered on your screen while the game resumes.
[*]When trying to select [b]Multiplayer, Leaderboard, or Profile[/b] while you're offline or disconnected from Steam, it'll now block you and display a message saying "You are not online".
[*]In the [b]Lobby List[/b], if there's no games found, instead of displaying "No Match Found", it'll say "No games found. Host a game to notify other players."
[/list][/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where creeps remained on the screen after dying.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could get stuck in the loading screen indefinitely.
[*]Fixed a bug involving the game randomly freezing.
[*]Fixed a bug where the [b]Chatbox[/b] would sometimes become transparent.
[*]Fixed a bug where the [b]Lobby Chatbox[/b] would automatically scroll to the bottom each time someone sent a message.
[*]Fixed a bug in [b]Campaign[/b], where having the [b]Level 2 Singles[/b] would automatically unlock the respective [b]Level 2 Duals & Triples[/b].[list]
[*]Same for having [b]Level 3 Singles[/b].
[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug where, if you're playing [b]Solo Online[/b], pausing the game wouldn't detract from the pause cap.
[*]Fixed [b]Level 3 Singles[/b] selling for more than intended.
[*]Fixed [b]Tower/Creep Select Previews[/b] not having proper post-processing.
[*]Fixed path indicators not showing up in some missions.
[*]Fixed some creeps oriented incorrectly when spawning in some missions.
[*]Fixed tooltip errors on [b]Fire, Solar & Flooding Towers[/b].
[/list]

That's the list for this patch! We're still working on [b]Ranked Mode[/b], so that'll be another few weeks at least. In the meantime, we're also working on another balance update, plus the usual batch of bug fixes and the like. Enjoy [b]Version 0.56[/b]!

[url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Also, join our Discord, if you haven't already[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.55 - Campaign & Balance!
notes.content:
After way too long, [b]Version 0.55[/b] is finally here! Comes with the first two chapters of the brand new [b]Campaign[/b], a whole host of balance changes, quality of life fixes, and more!

[h2]Campaign[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/c5049b57b75d0f097d389e5ffddee0a7847479d8.jpg[/img]
A series of missions divided among [b]Chapters[/b], each one providing a unique challenge. With each [b]Mission[/b] that you clear, you'll unlock new towers and upgrades through an interweaving tech tree. Experience new maps, mixed waves, bosses, and craft an evolving build with countless possibilities!

[h3]Progression[/h3]
Much of the standard game still applies here, but there’s a few differences. Most notably, instead of killing [b]Elementals[/b] to gain [b]Elements[/b], you now unlock towers one at a time, and it’s done between [b]Missions[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/53a287d881e9ee1e68cbcbfbf6f1ba9bc0c6869a.gif[/img]

With each [b]Mission[/b] that you clear, you’ll gain [b]Unlock Points[/b], which can be used to unlock [b]Towers[/b], as well as unique upgrades called [b]Specializations[/b]. You'll be able to freely respec between [b]Missions[/b], so experiment at will!

[h3]Map Variants[/h3]
Nearly every [b]Mission[/b] will feature a different map. Many of these are the same as the standard game, but mixed in here are some all new map layouts that use existing biomes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eq5axC1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/l3KcWG2.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zy0sLe1.jpg[/img]

[h3]And More![/h3]
As seen above, some maps feature [b]3 Portals[/b]. As a [b]Mission[/b] progresses, the [b]Portals[/b] may change positions, and some may even appear in some unconventional locations.

Lastly, it wouldn't be a proper [b]Campaign[/b] if it didn't have [b]Bosses[/b]...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/4cd4c5e0e1d7fe51f6e359cd27e32354bf0d4c3a.gif[/img]


[h2]Improvements & Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*][b]Arrow & Cannon Towers[/b] can now directly upgrade into [b]Elemental Towers[/b] for 100 Gold a piece.[list]
[*]To be clear, we're not talking new elemental versions of [b]Arrow & Cannon[/b], just adding a transition to [b]Single Element Towers[/b].
[/list]
[*]If a tower upgrade doesn't exist, it will no longer appear in the [b]Tower Select UI[/b].
[*][b]Tower Table[/b] is now labeled with an actual title.
[*]Fixed [b]Scoreboard[/b] not being up by default at the start of a game.
[*][b]Version Number[/b] on the main menu now links to [b]Patch Notes[/b].
[*][b]Geyser[/b] bounce is much smoother than before.
[*][b]Forest[/b] visuals are 50% less stony.
[*]Colored outlines on creeps are 50% more visible.
[*][b]Death Sounds[/b] updated, should sound much more consistent.
[*][b]Finnish & Czech[/b] localizations updated.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/7d85ac88966264f4f24a7dd31ad0394dfc312b45.gif[/img]
Our last patch had a lot of balance updates, some of which were risky. Overall, we think they made the game a better experience, but it helped highlight many long-running problems, like OP [b]Debuff Stacking[/b], [b]Life Tower[/b] shenanigans, the [b]Score System[/b], early game getting overpowered, etc.

With this update, it should fix the majority of these issues, and really help even the playing field for most builds.

[h3]Score[/h3][list]
[*][b]Perfection Bonus[/b] reduced from x1.2 to x1.1
[*][b]Speed Score Multiplier[/b] reduces by 0.05 every minute, down from 0.1[list]
[*][b]Full Length[/b] starting multiplier reduced from 5.5 to 4.0
[*][b]Short Length[/b] starting multiplier reduced from 5.0 to 3.4
[*][b]Extra Short Length[/b] starting multiplier reduced from 4.0 to 2.4
[/list]
[*][b]Minimum Speed Score Multiplier[/b] reduced from 0.50 to 0.25
[/list]

[h3]General Changes[/h3][list]
[*][b]Starting Creep HP[/b] increased from 100 to 110
[*][b]HP Scaling[/b] reduced from 16% to 15.8% per wave[list]
[*]By the end of Wave 55, it's the same HP as before
[/list]
[*][b]Wave 56+ HP Scaling[/b] increased from x1.2 to x1.25 per wave
[*][b]Income Upgrade[/b] increased from 15% / 30% to 18% / 36% bounty
[*][b]Atlantis Elemental Bosses[/b] now spawn left-right-left-right with higher player counts, instead of all left and then all right.
[/list]

[h3]Creeps[/h3][list]
[*][b]Timelapse[/b] creeps renamed to [b]Temporal[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Old[/b]: When it drops to 25% of its health, it resets to its health and position from 4 seconds ago.
[*][b]New[/b]: When it drops to 50% of its health, it resets to its health from 3 seconds ago and jumps forward.
[/list]
[*][b]Fast[/b] creeps now properly ignore slows during their speed burst.[list]
[*]Speed multiplier reduced from x2.25 to x2
[/list][/list]

[h3]Towers[/h3][list]
[*][b]Level 3 Single[/b] gold cost reduced from 2700 to 2500
[*][b]Light[/b] consecutive damage bonus reduced from 6 / 36 / 216 / 2160 to 5 / 30 / 180 / 1800
[*][b]Darkness[/b] overflow damage bonus reduced from 12% to 10%
[*][b]Water[/b] search radius increased from 100 to 125 AoE
[*][b]Fire[/b] damage increased from 20 / 120 / 720 / 7200 to 30 / 180 / 1080 / 10800[list]
[*]Damage growth reduced from 1 / 6 / 36 / 360 to 0.5 / 3 / 18 / 180
[*]Now caps at x3 damage
[/list]
[*][b]Earth[/b] damage increased from 70 / 420 / 2520 / 25200 to 80 / 480 / 2880 / 28800[list]
[*]Shockwave damage reduced from 40 / 240 / 1440 / 14400 to 30 / 180 / 1080 / 10800
[/list]
[*][b]Lightning[/b] bounce target priority now matches the tower's priority, instead of always bouncing to the nearest target[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 300 / 1200 / 4800 to 200 / 800 / 3200
[*]Attack speed increased from 0.66 to 1
[/list]
[*][b]Vapor[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 175 / 700 / 2800 to 170 / 680 / 2720
[*]Attack speed increased from 0.66 to 1
[*]Range decreased from 900 to 750
[*]AoE increased from 200 to 300
[/list]
[*][b]Solar[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage-per-second increased from 105 / 420 / 1680 to 140 / 560 / 2240
[*]Attack speed increased from 0.66 to 1
[*]Attack AoE reduced from 200 to 100
[/list]
[*][b]Life[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage increased from 500 / 2000 / 8000 to 800 / 3200 / 12800
[*]Attack speed reduced from 1.5 to 1
[*]Now takes 30 kills to gain a life when over 50 lives, [b]regardless of Level[/b]
[/list]
[*][b]Geyser[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 1300 / 5200 / 20800 to 900 / 3600 / 14400
[*]Attack speed increased from 0.66 to 1
[/list]
[*][b]Runic[/b] damage increased from 900 / 3600 to 1000 / 4000[list]
[*]Search radius increased from 225 to 250 AoE
[/list]
[*][b]Flooding[/b] damage reduced from 375 / 1500 to 350 / 1400[list]
[*]Consecutive AoE bonus reduced from 20 to 15
[/list]
[*][b]Wisp[/b] damage increased from 500 / 2000 to 600 / 2400[list]
[*]AoE increased from 450 to 500
[*]Effect cap increased from 50 to 60 attacks, increasing its max damage from 1500 / 6000 to 1800 / 7200
[/list]
[*][b]Haste[/b] attack speed growth reduced from 25% to 10%[list]
[*]Max attack speed increased from 5 to 6
[/list]
[*][b]Flamethrower[/b] Napalm damage increased from 125 / 500
[*][b]Impulse[/b] adjusted:[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 3400 / 13600 to 2000 / 8000
[*]Attack speed increased from 0.66 to 1
[/list]
[*][b]Quake[/b] AoE increased from 0 to 100
[*][b]Nova[/b] Level 2 Slow reduced from 25% to 20%
[*][b]Windstorm[/b] Level 2 Slow reduced from 25% to 20%
[*][b]Root[/b] Level 2 Slow reduced from 25% to 20%
[*][b]Muck[/b] Level 2 Slow reduced from 25% to 20%
[*][b]Jinx[/b] Level 2 Bonus Damage reduced from 15% to 12%
[*][b]Corrosion[/b] Level 2 Amp reduced from 40% to 30%
[*][b]Incantation[/b] Level 2 Amp reduced from 25% to 20%[list]
[*]Isolated Amp reduced from 75% to 60%
[/list]
[*][b]Polar[/b] Level 2 HP Shave reduced from 25% to 20%[list]
[*]It now returns half the HP back at the end, up from full.
[/list]
[*][b]Periodic[/b] damage increased from 35000 to 38000
[/list]


That's it for this patch! As usual, with balance updates, the [b]Leaderboards[/b] have been reset. We hope you enjoy the [b]Campaign[/b], whether you're new or experienced, and the many balance changes should fix the staleness of last patch's multiplayer. Let us know what you think on our forums or our [b]Discord[/b]!

[url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Join our Discord[/url]


[h2]What's Next[/h2]
With the first part of the [b]Campaign[/b] released, we still have a few things left before we exit [b]Early Access[/b]. Coming next, expect to see [b]Ranked Mode[/b] finally arrive! We're also working hard on getting the visuals of the [b]Atlantis Co-op Map[/b] up, as well as the next parts of the [b]Campaign[/b].

Next week, we'll be announcing the official release date for the game. Look forward to it!

notes.title: Where's the Campaign?
notes.content:

Long enough for folks on our [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Discord[/url] to coin the term [b]WindStrike Time[/b], which is akin to the famed [url=https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Valve_Time]Valve Time[/url]. Anywho, since we're "taking so long", here's another little preview of what to expect:

I think.

notes.title: Campaign Preview
notes.content:
Arriving next week will be the long-awaited [b]Campaign[/b]! Not the whole thing, mind you, but a significant chunk of it, featuring: new maps, unique tower upgrades, mixed wave types, and bosses with powerful abilities. Read on for the full preview!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/c5049b57b75d0f097d389e5ffddee0a7847479d8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Progression[/h2]
Much of the standard game still applies here, but there’s a few differences. Most notably, instead of killing [b]Elementals[/b] to gain [b]Elements[/b], you now unlock towers one at a time, and it’s done between [b]Missions[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/53a287d881e9ee1e68cbcbfbf6f1ba9bc0c6869a.gif[/img]

With each [b]Mission[/b] that you clear, you’ll gain [b]Unlock Points[/b], which can be used to unlock [b]Towers[/b], as well as unique upgrades called [b]Specializations[/b]. You'll be able to freely respec between [b]Missions[/b], so experiment at will!


[h2]Map Variants[/h2]

Nearly every [b]Mission[/b] will feature a different map. Many of these are the same as the standard game, but mixed in here are some all new map layouts that use existing biomes.

[url=https://imgsli.com/MjEwNDM][img]https://i.imgur.com/lFGXKD7.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://imgsli.com/MjEwNDI][img]https://i.imgur.com/bV4r1Mk.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://imgsli.com/MjEwNDQ][img]https://i.imgur.com/tSpytYn.jpg[/img][/url]

Although these variants are restricted to the [b]Campaign[/b] for now, expect them to eventually make their way into the standard game down-the-road.


[h2]New Mechanics[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/3c94096ee9e969cf2fb605be7b160dc4bdaa648c.gif[/img]

The core gameplay is still intact, but there’s a few new surprises to freshen up the game. Every 5 Waves, you’ll get a [b]Wave Break[/b]. During this time:[list]
[*]The spawnpoints will likely change
[*]All of your towers sell for 100% Gold
[*]You get unlimited time to figure out the new layout and reallocate your defense
[/list]


And lastly, it wouldn’t be a proper [b]Campaign[/b] if it didn’t have [b]Bosses[/b]...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/4cd4c5e0e1d7fe51f6e359cd27e32354bf0d4c3a.gif[/img]


Expect the first two [b]Chapters[/b] to release in [b]Version 0.55[/b] at the end of next week. We have a few more surprises in store for you in the [b]Campaign[/b], so look forward to it!

Additionally, in this patch, we’ll be addressing some balance problems that became particularly prominent as of 0.54. Below is a basic nutshell of the changes:


[h2]Balance[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36711703/7d85ac88966264f4f24a7dd31ad0394dfc312b45.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Arrows & Cannons[/b] can now directly upgrade into [b]Elemental Towers[/b] for [b]100 Gold[/b].[list]
[*]To be clear, these are not [b]Elemental Arrow & Cannon Towers[/b]; it just applies an easy transition from your basic towers to your [b]Elemental Towers[/b].
[/list]
[*][b]Score System[/b] adjusted so that [b]Extra Short[/b] should no longer dominate the [b]Leaderboards[/b], as well as reducing the potency of rushing.
[*][b]Income Upgrade[/b] buffed.
[*]Wave 56+ HP Scaling increased.
[*]All [b]Level 2 Triple Support Towers[/b] have their effect nerfed (x2 the effectiveness of [b]Level 1[/b], down from x2.5).
[*][b]Fast[/b] creeps ignore slows during their speed burst.
[*][b]Timelapse[/b] renamed to [b]Temporal[/b], and instead of jumping backwards, it now jumps forwards.
[*]Various towers that underperformed without heavy slows have been buffed, especially since slow stacking isn’t as effective.
[*]Various other buffs/nerfs.
[/list]


That’s it for this preview! If you’re curious to try out the [b]Campaign[/b] early, hop onto our [b]Discord[/b] and make yourself a [b]Tester[/b]. Otherwise, see you next week!
[url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Element TD Discord[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.54 - New Co-op Map, Core Balance Changes
notes.content:
A new month, a new version! Included in this patch is a new [b]Co-op Map[/b], numerous [b]Balance Changes[/b], new [b]Achievements[/b], new [b]Cosmetics[/b], and a bunch more [b]Fixes & Improvements[/b]!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/0HrGiiD.jpg[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*]New [b]Co-op Map[/b] added: [b]Atlantis[/b]! Visuals are prototype for now.
[*]16 New [b]Achievements[/b] added![list]
[*]3 based on [b]Eliminations[/b] in FFA
[*]4 based on being the first one to clear the wave in FFA
[*]2 based on clearing [b]Co-op Mode[/b]
[*]4 based on clearing [b]Atlantis[/b] on a particular difficulty
[*]3 based on getting a high score in [b]Atlantis[/b]
[/list]
[*]7 New [b]Cosmetics[/b] added![list]
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Fire Spirit
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Lich
[*][b]New Hat[/b]: Stack of Hats
[*][b]New Hat[/b]: Stack of Sandwiches
[*][b]New Trail[/b]: Spiral
[*][b]New Wings[/b]: Energy Shield
[*][b]New Wings[/b]: Jetpack
[/list]
[*]Added a [b]Join Discord[/b] button on the [b]Main Menu[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*][b]Replays[/b] now log all errors that occur in a match.
[*]More server stability improvements, you should see less [b]Synchronizes[/b].
[*]Minor visual tweaks on creeps.
[*]Minor optimizations applied.
[*]Sounds added for Ping, Player Eliminated, and Player Disconnected.
[*]Cleaned up some of the tooltips, as well as fixed consistency.
[*]You can no longer pause the game while it's synchronizing.
[*]The in-game menu will now close itself when someone unpauses.
[*]90% Sell Values in [b]Pick[/b] are now accurate.
[*][b]Bounty[/b] gold pop-up now lists "+X Gold" instead of just "+X".
[*][b]Interest[/b] gold pop-up now lists "+X Interest" instead of just "+X".
[*]Pressing F9 to hide the UI will now also hide player nametags.
[*][b]Leaderboard[/b] Duration is now based on the "Time Cleared" up through Wave 55, instead of the full length of the game.
[*]Several level requirements for various [b]Cosmetics[/b] have been shuffled around.
[*][b]Duel Mode[/b] settings have been trimmed a bit:[list]
[*]Difficulty is now locked into [b]Very Hard[/b].
[*][b]Same Random[/b] removed, all it did was remove the counterplay.
[*][b]Extreme[/b] removed, which replaced the counterplay entirely in favor of pure survival.
[/list][/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Yet even more attempts at fixing desync shenanigans.
[*]Fixed an interaction error between [b]Trickery[/b] and [b]Fire, Earth, Ethereal, & Wisp Towers[/b], such that the clone wouldn't include self-buff benefits as a result of the tower's own effect.
[*]Fixed a bug where, if the game's host left the lobby, anyone else had the ability to kick other players.
[*]Fixed a bug where too many entries in the chat log could scramble all the text on-screen.

[*]You now gain [b]Bounty[/b] from kills during the [b]Boss Waves[/b].[list]
[*]The above [b]Income Upgrade[/b] also works off this.
[*]The total amount of gold you get each wave is equal to [b]Wave 55[/b], and it does not increase.
[/list]
[*][b]Perfection Bonus[/b] Score Multiplier increased from x1.1 to x1.2
[*][b]Creeps[/b]:[list]

[/list]
[*][b]Modes[/b]:[list]
