[*]In [b]Random[/b], you can now get [b]x2 Income Upgrades[/b] on all difficulties (previously, it was restricted to [b]Very Hard & Insane[/b] only).

[*][b]Extreme[/b] increased wave time increased from +0 to +3 Seconds
[*][b]Teams Mode[/b] HP Multiplier reduced from x1.7 to x1.6
[*][b]Teams Mode[/b] Team-only HP Scaling reduced from 17% to 16.5%
[*][b]Co-op Mode[/b] Base Speed Score Multiplier increased from 5.5 to 6.5
[/list][/list]

[h2]Tower Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Arrow & Cannon[/b] now sell for 74 Gold instead of 75 Gold[list]

[/list]
[*][b]Tower Costs[/b] adjusted:[list]

[*][b]Tier 3 Single[/b] cost reduced from 3000 to 2700

[*][b]Geyser[/b] ability changed:[list]

[*][b]New[/b]: On every 5th attack, do a 300 AoE attack that launches creeps hit up into the air (this is purely visual, it's not a stun).

[*]Attack Speed reduced from 1 to 0.66

[/list]
[*][b]Solar[/b] damage increased from 100 / 400 / 1600 to 105 / 420 / 1680[list]
[*]Damage-per-second increased from 100 / 400 / 1600 to 105 / 420 / 1680
[/list]
[*][b]Mushroom[/b] damage reduced from 85 / 340 / 1360 to 80 / 320 / 1280
[*][b]Vapor[/b] damage reduced from 180 / 720 / 2880 to 175 / 700 / 2800
[*][b]Trickery[/b] clone damage reduced from 65% / 130% / 400% to 60% / 120% / 360%
[*][b]Quake[/b] AoE reduced from 100 to 0[list]
[*]Damage reduced from 1500 / 6000 to 1400 / 5600
[*]Shockwave damage reduced from 3000 / 12000 to 2800 / 11200
[/list]
[*][b]Flamethrower[/b] damage increased from 280 / 1120 to 300 / 1200[list]
[*]Napalm damage reduced from 140 / 560 to 125 / 500
[/list]
[*][b]Golem[/b] damage increased from 2400 / 9600 to 2500 / 10000
[*][b]Ethereal[/b] damage reduced from 950 / 3800 to 900 / 3600
[*][b]Money[/b] bounty bonus reduced from 35% / 50% to 25% / 35%
[*][b]Astral[/b] damage reduced from 1600 to 1500[list]
[*]Ability cooldown reduced from 12 to 9 seconds
[/list]
[*][b]Incantation[/b] damage reduced from 550 / 2200 to 500 / 2000
[*][b]Windstorm[/b] damage-per-second increased from 450 / 1800 to 500 / 2500[list]
[*]AoE increased from 550 to 600
[/list]

[h2]Challenges[/h2]
Due to the changes required to get the upcoming [b]Campaign[/b] working, [u][b]Challenges[/b] have been removed from the game[/u]. At best, they served as a tutorial, though even then, it was extremely limited in scope. In general, they weren't particularly well designed and fell below the standards of the rest of the game.

For those of you that played and enjoyed these, we apologize, but fret not: expect these to be replaced in full by the end of the month!


[h2]Leaderboard Reset[/h2]
As usual, due to numerous balance changes, [u][b]Leaderboards[/b] have been reset[/u]. With this update, the general meta should shift from "hardcore interest abuse" to a wider variety of strategies. Interest abuse is still doable, it's just no longer strictly superior to everything else. We hope you enjoy these new changes, and if you'd like to give us feedback, holler at us on our [b]Discord[/b]!
[url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Join our Discord[/url]

Also, we've finally updated our [b]Balance Spreadsheets[/b], which is what we use to help balance the game. These are now publicly viewable for anyone to read:
[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GdfCqVeudiNHhxHF1XYSUMqkyNRRkCx-loXJiNQqv4s/edit?usp=sharing]DPS/Gold Values Spreadsheets[/url]

notes.title: Core Balance Changes
notes.content:
Since the early access release of [b]Element TD 2[/b], we've been polishing the individual balance of towers and creep types, and we think we've gotten that down pretty well. However, some deeper core issues have been brought up numerous times in the past months, and in order to fix them, we'll ultimately have to mess with some of the core balance.

Below is a preview of what you can expect!


[h2]Interest Upgrades[/h2]
Depending on your skill level, the power of an [b]Interest Upgrade[/b] of [b]+0.75% Interest[/b] can be anywhere from "completely useless" to "literal god tier", netting you +100k gold (or more). Increasing or decreasing this value doesn't fix anything, and the ridiculous amount of gold you can get from it is nearly unstoppable in multiplayer without playing on [b]Very Hard[/b] or [b]Insane[/b].

It's unfriendly to new players and impossible to balance. As much as we'd like to retain the spirit of the good ol' days from the WC3 version, [u][b]Interest Upgrades[/b] have to go[/u].

However, we'll be replacing it with [b]Income Upgrades[/b]. What this will do is, when you clear a wave, you'll gain gold based on the [b]Total Wave Bounty[/b]. You can get a maximum of [b]2 Income Upgrades[/b]:[list]
[*][b]1 Income[/b]: Gain gold equal to 12% of the [b]Total Wave Bounty[/b]
[*][b]2 Income[/b]: Gain gold equal to 24% of the [b]Total Wave Bounty[/b]
[/list]
The above numbers are estimates and we may change them over the course of testing. Suffice to say, this new solution makes it so:[list]
[*]If you're new and don't know what you're doing, [b]Income[/b] won't be a useless upgrade
[*]If you do know what you're doing, you can bank some extra [b]Interest[/b] off it, just not to the extent of piercing the heavens with mountains upon mountains of gold.
[/list]

[h2]Arrow & Cannon Abuse[/h2]
Even though [b]Level 1 Elemental Towers[/b] are more powerful, [b]Arrow & Cannon Towers[/b] end up getting used more because they're effectively free. Thanks to their full refund value, not only do they result in a zero-cost defense, you get more and more [b]Interest[/b]. Within the first 5 waves, you can get a 100 gold lead over other players, and that only snowballs further throughout the game.

We don't intend on removing this outright, but as is, [u]it's overpowered[/u]. So instead of giving you a full refund:[list]
[*][b]Arrow & Cannon Towers[/b] will sell for [b]74 Gold[/b] each, down from [b]75 Gold[/b].
[*]If you're doing buy/sell abuse, you'll still get a net gain (of about +0.5% instead of +2%), but not by anywhere near as much as before.
[/list]
Just to be clear, all towers in [b]Random[/b] will still sell for 100%, including [b]Arrow & Cannon Towers[/b].


[h2]Gold from Wave 56 Onwards[/h2]
Countless times, we've been asked the question "why do you stop getting gold after [b]Wave 55[/b]?" Our answer has always been that at that point, progression stops, and whatever you have left is a test of your defense until your eventual demise. However, it's a stark contrast in playstyle, going from actively building... to watching your defense get overrun by the endless boss.

Ultimately, we still want it to end. However, [u]bounty from kills will no longer stop after Wave 55[/u]. This way, you'll continue to play actively up until the point of your demise. Some notes about this:[list]
[*]The amount of gold you get per wave won't continue to go up, so each wave will net the same amount of gold you get from [b]Wave 55[/b], which is roughly 9000 gold.
[*][b]HP Scaling[/b] of the endless boss waves will increase from +20% per wave to +30% per wave.
[/list]
As for [b]Interest[/b], that will still remain dormant. In fact, we'll be pushing it back so you stop getting [b]Interest[/b] the moment you clear [b]Wave 55[/b].


[h2]Essence Upgrades[/h2]
[b]Level 4 Singles & Periodic Tower[/b] are powerful towers... but when you only get 1 off the [b]Essence Upgrade[/b], it's incredibly underwhelming compared to the power of getting an [b]Element[/b]. In [b]Random[/b] especially, getting one can be rather frustrating; doubly so if you get random'd a second one.

Instead of buffing these uber towers, we'll be making some changes to the upgrade instead:[list]
[*]First off, getting the [b]Essence Upgrade[/b] will no longer be free. It'll summon a boss with [b]Composite Armor[/b], and it'll be a bit stronger than a [b]Level 3 Element[/b].
[*]Then, when you kill the boss, you'll get [b]2 Essences[/b] instead of just 1.
[/list]

Hopefully, these changes will make the [b]Essence Upgrade[/b] much more appealing, and help highlight the value of [b]Level 4 Singles & Periodic Tower[/b].


[h2]Cursed Creeps[/h2]
In an effort to counteract [b]Level 3 Buff Rushing[/b] (both in Solo/FFA and especially stacking it in Teams/Co-op), [b]Cursed[/b] creeps are getting some lovely tweaks:[list]
[*]AoE reduced from 350 to 250. This means instead of affecting a 5x5 area, it'll now only affect a 3x3 area. However...
[*]In addition to reducing attack speed, [b]Cursed[/b] will now instantly wipe [b]Blacksmith & Well Buffs[/b] as well as nuke [b]Trickery Clones[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Tower Changes[/h2]
Although you should expect the usual bout of tweaks in regards to specific towers, we're also messing with the costs a little bit.
[*][b]Level 2 Singles[/b] reduced from 725 to 700 gold
[*][b]Level 3 Singles[/b] reduced from 3000 to 2700 gold
[*][b]Level 2 Duals[/b] increased from 1250 to 1300 gold
[*][b]Level 3 Duals[/b] increased from 3150 to 3300 gold
[/list]
This should make [b]Level 3 Singles[/b] more usable, while nerfing the cost effectiveness of higher level [b]Duals[/b] just a bit.

You can also expect an entirely new effect from [b]Geyser Tower[/b]. It won't be anything mindblowing, just have a better fit for its role. Oh, and it finally has a visual component matching the tower:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/feN7KGX.jpg[/img]


Lastly, we'll finally be adding a second [b]Co-op Map[/b]! Here's a little preview below:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VlCNk2T.jpg[/img]


There's more balance tweaks than just that, but those are the major ones. Obviously, with a bunch of balance changes, [u]there will be a [b]Leaderboard Reset[/b][/u].

You can expect all of the above changes and more to arrive in [b]Version 0.54[/b] by the end of next week! If you'd like to try those changes early, you can join our [b]Discord[/b] and opt-in to become a [b]Tester[/b]. Just check the #roles channel:

[url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Element TD 2 Discord[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.52 - Grand City, Alt Ronald, and More!
notes.content:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/o10LZ3S.jpg[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]Grand City[/b] now has proper visuals!
[*]New [b]Multiplayer Achievements[/b] added! Noted, all of the following require at least one other player in the game:[list]
[*]Added 3 Achievements based on winning 1st Place 1 / 5 / 25 times in an [b]FFA Game[/b]
[*]Added 8 Achievements based on clearing through Wave 55 in [b]Teams Mode[/b], one for each map
[*]Added 4 Achievements based on beating [b]Grand City[/b], one for each [b]Difficulty[/b]

[/list]

[*]This also works with [b]Shift Building[/b] and [b]Drag Building[/b].
[/list][/list]

[h2]Teams Mode[/h2][list]
[*]The difficulty of [b]Teams[/b] has been rescaled:[list]
[*]Creep count reduced from 60 to 40
[*]Bounty multiplier increased from x1 to x1.5
[*]HP increased from x1 to x1.7
[/list]
[*]If you are on a team, and your ally leaves early, all future waves will use [b]Solo HP Scaling[/b].
[*]If you are on a team, and your ally leaves early, the [b]Wave 56+ Boss Waves[/b] no longer get stuck after one wave.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]The [b]Main Menu[/b] has received another coat of paint.
[*]Added option to hide [b]Ally Indicators[/b].
[*]When hovering over a tower on the [b]Tower Table[/b], its tooltip info is now out to the side instead of obscuring its related references.
[*][b]Chatbox[/b] input no longer requires pressing Enter twice to get out.
[*][b]Camera Bounds[/b] have been expanded for all maps.
[*]The amount of XP you receive from clearing a wave in [b]Co-op[/b] has been doubled.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could XP from [b]Eliminations[/b] in [b]Co-op[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Language[/b] keeps getting reset everytime you open the game.
[*]Fixed [b]Earth's Shockwave[/b] visual not showing up.
[*]Fixed [b]Teams Notifications[/b] resetting itself every time you re-opened the game.
[*]Fixed [b]Notifications[/b] listing [unknown] for the host's name.
[*]Fixed [b]Player Level[/b] on the in-game [b]Scoreboard[/b] always displaying 0 for everyone else.
[/list]

[h2]Visuals[/h2][list]
[*]Towers no longer tilt up/down towards the target.
[*][b]Cannon[/b] now rotates and animates.
[*][b]Solar & Life[/b] no longer twitch.
[*][b]Windstorm[/b] has been improved with better lightning VFX.
[/list]

[h2]Cosmetics[/h2][list]
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Chessmaster
[*][b]New Builder[/b]: Eye of the Beholder
[*][b]New Hat[/b]: Blue Veil
[*][b]New Hat[/b]: Sandwich
[*][b]New Trail[/b]: Clouds
[*][b]New Trail[/b]: Blazing Fireball

Regarding [b]Leaderboard Support[/b] for [b]Teams & Co-op Modes[/b], that was supposed to arrive this patch, but some complications came up, and we're delaying that to [b]Version 0.53[/b]. In the meantime, enjoy the new-and-improved [b]Grand City[/b], along with our other improvements!

notes.title: Reset Random Leaderboards
notes.content:
In the most recent patch, we adjusted the algorithm for [b]Random Elements[/b] so that you no longer get [b]6-Element[/b] builds every single darn game. While this came out as a positive adjustment, it came with an oversight - it screwed over the replays for all the [b]Random Leaderboards[/b].

As a result, we've had to reset them. Not the [b]Pick Leaderboards[/b], those are fine still. Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Version 0.51 - Bug Fixes and Less 6-Element Randoms
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.51[/b] is here, complete with some major bug fixes, and an adjustment to how elements are given in [b]Random[/b]. Read on for the full patch notes!


[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]Adjusted the [b]Random Elements[/b] algorithm:[list]
[*]At the start of a match, the game decides whether you're getting one of a 3, 4, 5, or 6 Element Build (with [b]Interest and/or Essence[/b] upgrades intermixed).
[*]However, the game does not tell you this, so you won't actually know which you've got until after [b]Wave 50[/b].
[*]This way, you should see a much wider variety of [b]Randoms[/b], instead of 6-Element every single game.
[/list]
[*]Adjusted the [b]HP Scaling[/b] in [b]Teams Mode[/b]:[list]
[*]If you're a solo player, you still get the default scaling, starting at 100 HP and going up 16% per wave.
[*]If you're on a team though, it'll start at 110 HP and go up 16.8% per wave.[list]
[*]By Wave 55, this ends up about 60% higher HP than default.
[/list][/list]
[*][b]Achievements[/b] can now be completed in [b]Teams Mode[/b]:[list]
[*]Except the [b]Score[/b] achievements. Even with the adjusted HP Scaling, high scores are still much easier on [b]Teams[/b] than [b]Solo/FFA[/b]. The text has been amended on them to clarify this.
[/list]
[*]Your [b]Level[/b] is now displayed in-game on the [b]Scoreboard[/b], in the corner of your [b]Avatar[/b].
[*]Killing a [b]Cursed Creep[/b] now applies a VFX over the killing tower, displaying the area affected.
[*][b]Health Bars[/b] now show up above a creep's head, instead of below them.
[*]Added [b]Portugese[/b] language option.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a major bug where someone hosting a game and then disconnecting could result in a [b]Zombie Lobby[/b], meaning it would never go away as long as there were other players in it.
[*]Fixed a major bug where [b]Temple Replays[/b] were getting assigned the wrong scene index, causing most of their leaderboard entries to be unviewable.[list]
[*][b]Temple Leaderboards[/b] have been reset to account for this. Sorry about that!
[/list]
[*]Fixed [b]Wings[/b] not staying bought.
[*]Fixed Friendly/Enemy Indicators showing up over towers while building/upgrading in [b]Teams Mode[/b].
[*]Fixed [b]Audio Channels[/b] always resetting itself to 20. It should now remember your settings.
[/list]

[h2]Cosmetics[/h2][list]
[*][b]Added[/b]:[list]
[*]2 New Builders
[*]2 New Trails
[*]4 New Hats
[/list]
[*]Shuffled some of the [b]Level Requirements[/b] around.[list]
[*]If you already have a particular [b]Cosmetic[/b] even though its requirement has been bumped up, don't worry - you'll still keep it.
[/list]
[*]Adjusted many of the existing [b]Cosmetics[/b]. Ones that were dark before should stand out better now.
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2][list]
[*]Updated some out-of-date threads on the [b]Forums[/b].
[*]Looking for a game? [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Join our [b]Discord[/b][/url], and give the pinned post in #looking-for-game a thumbs up, then ping @LFG to gather some players!
[*][b]Discord[/b] has received some emote updates. We'll be continuing to add more unique ones over time.
[/list]

We also have some updated release windows:[list]
[*]Expect the first few chapters of the [b]Campaign[/b] to release in early [b]August[/b]!
[*][b]Ranked Mode[/b] should finally be implemented in early [b]September[/b].
[*]And at last, [b]Full Release[/b] should happen by late [b]September[/b]! Look forward to it, we still have lots left to add (and fix)!
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.50 - Cosmetics, Achievements, Balance, & More
notes.content:
After over a month of work, [b]Version 0.50[/b] has been released! A lot of new stuff got added this patch, including [b]Achievements, Cosmetics, Balance Changes[/b], and more! We've also cleaned up the UI considerably and fixed a fair number of bugs. Check out our video preview below, and read on for the full patch notes!

[previewyoutube=XgBZpk6R-bA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Steam Achievements[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/O2YOGKr.jpg[/img]
Each map now has [b]13 Achievements[/b] tied to them, resulting in a total of [b]104 Achievements[/b]! These include:[list]
[*]Clear by [b]Difficulty[/b]
[*]Clear by [b]Speed[/b]
[*]Clear by [b]Random + Chaos[/b]
[*]Clear by [b]Extreme[/b]
[*]Get X Score
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yG6Rd8z.jpg[/img]
Now, as you play the game, you'll gain XP, used to increase your [b]Level[/b]. Additionally, each [b]Achievement[/b] you complete provides you with a burst of XP,

Each time you level up, you are rewarded with a [b]Shop Point[/b], which can be used to unlock [b]Cosmetics[/b] for your [b]Builder[/b]. Speaking of which...


[h1]Builder Cosmetics[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UF2qnTj.jpg[/img]
You can now customize your [b]Builder[/b]! On top of that, there's multiple accessories you can add to make them look particularly snazzy! In total, we have:[list]
[*]7 Builders
[*]7 Hats
[*]6 Trails
[*]6 Wings
[*]And an extra [b]Builder[/b] with ludicrous level requirements.[list]
[*]Don't worry, we'll fill in more [b]Cosmetics[/b] and [b]Achievements[/b] over time to fill the gap.
[/list][/list]

[h1]Map Changes[/h1]

[h2]Lava[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aOxfGAS.jpg[/img]
The oddball top-left corner has been adjusted so that it's actually buildable there, and part of the path on the right side has been removed, adding a bit more difficulty to this map.

[h2]Tropical[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PcjXSf8.jpg[/img]
The first island has been outright removed, causing creeps to immediately head down on that first bend. The path is roughly 20% shorter now, and it makes it so [b]Earth & Quake[/b] aren't superior to everything else on this map. Still useful, just not blatantly OP.

[h2]Winter[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cctofdb.jpg[/img]
Once more, the [b]Winter[/b] map has been given a new layout! The previous one wasn't bad per se, but it was sort of a repeat of existing maps and required nothing new to beat it. In this layout, creeps wrap around the sides, then circle around the middle before exiting. With this, it's back to being the most difficult map by far.

[h2]Grand City[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nbjwgqr.jpg[/img]
And lastly, the [b]Co-op[/b] map has been tweaked. The longer portals on the outside have been pulled in a bit, and the center killzone is no longer quite as generous. Its visuals are still prototype, though that may change in the coming weeks...


[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]An option has been added under [b]Graphics[/b] called [b]VFX Toggle[/b]. Turning it off will drastically reduce the amount of VFX that renders.
[*]Holding [b]Shift[/b] while [b]Drag-Building[/b] will now let you properly queue up towers.
[*]Allied towers in [b]Team & Co-op[/b] games now have an indicator hovering over them, making it easier to distinguish your towers from your allies'.
[*]If there's two players in a lobby and the host readies up while the other player leaves, it'll now unready the host.
[*][b]Elemental Boss[/b] labels now list "Level 1" instead of "Lvl. 1"
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Potentially fixed a major bug where you could somehow upgrade [b]Level 2 Duals[/b] into [b]Arrow Towers[/b].
[*]Fixed a major bug where a [b]Disease Tower[/b] could inflict near infinite damage and somehow freeze the game as a result.
[*]Fixed a bug where getting disconnected from a lobby wouldn't actually kick you out of the lobby, thus breaking the lobby and preventing anyone from readying up.
[*]Fixed a bug in [b]Co-op[/b] where way more [b]Ronalds[/b] were spawning than intended.
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed [b]Team & Co-op Scores[/b] to land on the [b]Leaderboard[/b].[list][*]When this gets added properly, they'll each have their own categories.
[/list]
[*][b]Ronald Runs[/b] can no longer submit to the [b]Leaderboard[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug where, if you kill an [b]Elemental[/b] while having the [b]Tower Table[/b] open, it wouldn't update the table properly.
[*]Fixed initial language select missing the majority of the options.
[/list]

[h2]New Tower Table[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wrRoCEf.jpg[/img]
The [b]Tower Table[/b] has received a format update. With this, everything is much better organized:[list]
[*][b]Elements[/b] run left-to-right, just like your build bar and HUD.
[*]All [b]Buff[/b] towers are now in a single row.
[*]All [b]Slows & Amplify[/b] towers are now in a single row.
[/list]
In order to apply this though, a few towers had their [b]Damage Types[/b] shuffled around...


[h2]Balance[/h2][list]
[*]All [b]700 Range Towers[/b] have been buffed to [b]750 Range[/b].[list]
[*]In particular, certain aggravations with their placement aren't as much of pain.
[/list]
[*][b]Fire[/b] damage reduced from 25 / 150 / 900 / 9000 to 20 / 120 / 720 / 7200[list][*]Damage bonus per second increased from 0.5 / 3 / 18 / 180 to 1 / 6 / 36 / 360
[/list]
[*][b]Nature[/b] damage increased from 75 / 450 / 2700 / 27000 to 80 / 480 / 2880 / 28000[list]
[*]Initial damage bonus decreased from 50% to 40%
[/list]
[*][b]Ice[/b] damage increased from 700 / 2800 / 11200 to 750 / 3000 / 12000
[*][b]Poison[/b] damage-per-second increased from 80 / 320 / 1280 to 90 / 360 / 1440[list]
[*]Duration reduced from 10 seconds to 9 seconds
[/list]
[*][b]Mushroom[/b] damage increased from 80 / 320 / 1280 to 85 / 340 / 1340
[*][b]Howitzer[/b] damage increased from 160 / 640 / 2540 to 165 / 660 / 2640
[*][b]Trickery[/b] effect tweaked:[list]
[*][b]Old[/b] - This is a Buff Tower. Every 15 seconds, it clones a Non-Buff Tower for 10 / 20 / 60 seconds. A cloned tower cannot be cloned again for 60 seconds.
[*][b]New[/b] - This is a Buff Tower. Every 15 seconds, it clones a Non-Buff Tower that deals 65% / 130% / 400% damage for 15 seconds. A cloned tower cannot be cloned again for 60 seconds.
[/list]
[*][b]Arcane[/b] renamed to [b]Infernal[/b]:[list]
[*]Damage type changed from [b]Darkness[/b] to [b]Fire[/b]
[/list]
[*][b]Electricity[/b] renamed to [b]Lightning[/b]:[list]
[*]Damage type changed from [b]Fire[/b] to [b]Light[/b]
[*]Number of bounces reduced from 6 to 4
[*]Damage decrease per bounce changed from 20% less to 15% less
[*]Bounce range reduced from 1150 to 1000
[/list]
[*][b]Wisp[/b] damage type changed from [b]Light[/b] to [b]Water[/b]
[*][b]Astral[/b] damage reduced from 1800 / 7200 to 1600 / 6400[list]
[*]However, projectile speed has been doubled
[/list]
[*][b]Runic[/b] search AoE increased from 200 to 225
[*][b]Flooding[/b] damage increased from 350 / 1400 to 375 / 1500
[*][b]Impulse[/b] damage reduced from 3600 / 14400 to 3400 / 13600
[*][b]Corrosion[/b] damage amp reduced from 15% / 45% to 15% / 40%
[*][b]Jinx[/b] damage ticks reduced from 7% / 18% to 6% / 15%
[*][b]Polar[/b] now returns the full HP removed after 15 seconds instead of only returning half
[*][b]Golem[/b] effect changed:[list]
[*][b]Old[/b] - Each time it kills a creep, this tower loses 300 / 1200 damage for 2 seconds.
[*][b]New[/b] - After attacking for 3 seconds, this tower stops attacking for 3 seconds.
[*]Damage increased from 1400 / 5600 to 2400 / 9600
[*]Projectile speed increased by 25%
[/list]
[*][b]Periodic[/b] damage increased from 28000 to 32000
[/list]
Due to the extensive balance changes as listed above, the [b]Leaderboard[/b] has been reset.


[h2]Visuals[/h2][list]
[*]The [b]UI[/b] has been cleaned up, removing most of its bulkiness in favor of a simpler look.
[*]Texture quality has been improved slightly.
[*]Updated the water shader being used on [b]Well, Flooding, Golem, & Wisp[/b] towers.
[*]Updated the visuals of [b]Lightning, Infernal, & Wisp Towers[/b] to reflect their new [b]Damage Types[/b].
[*]Various other little tweaks to reduce the overall brightness of the [b]VFX[/b].
[/list]


And that's it for today's patch! A lot got added, a lot got changed, and lot got fixed. There's a handful of things we wanted to get implemented, but just didn't have the time to for this patch. Stuff like:[list]
[*][b]Team & Co-op[/b] Leaderboard Support
[*]The ability to change your player color
[*]Improved [b]Tower Table[/b] functionality
[*]And more
[/list]
Fret not, expect these to be added in the coming weeks! In general, expect to see regular updates once more every week or so. The only reason this update took so long is because all of its systems were integrated together, requiring them to all be finished at once.


Lastly, our [b]Discord[/b] server has finally been improved with a [b]Role Bot[/b], meaning you can now opt yourself into the [b]LFG[/b] role (Looking For Game) without requiring someone to give you the role manually. Check the pinned messages under our #looking-for-game channel and give the post a thumbs up!
[url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Element TD 2 Discord[/url]

notes.title: 0.50 Patch Preview 1 - Balance Updates
notes.content:
Apologies for the lack of updates recently. The upcoming [b]Version 0.50[/b] has a lot in it, and it's not something that can be released one piece at a time. Many of its pieces rely on each other, so it's taking longer than usual. Rest assured, it should release in about a week and a half!

In the meantime, here's some balance updates to look forward to!

[h2]Map Tweaks[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aOxfGAS.jpg[/img]
For [b]Lava[/b], the oddball top-left corner has been adjusted so that it's actually buildable there, and part of the path on the right side has been removed, adding a bit more difficulty to this map.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PcjXSf8.jpg[/img]
And for [b]Tropical[/b], the first island has been outright removed, causing creeps to immediately head down on that first bend. The path is roughly 20% shorter now, and it makes it so [b]Earth & Quake[/b] aren't superior to everything else on this map. Still useful, just not blatantly OP.

[h2]Tower Tweaks[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/92qIsyg.png[/img]

The [b]Tower Table[/b] is receiving a format update! Yes, this means you'll have to relearn the tower spots, but I'm sure you'll get used to it in time. With this updated format:[list][*][b]Elements[/b] run left-to-right, just like your build bar and HUD.
[*]All [b]Buff[/b] towers are now in a single row.
[*]All [b]Slows & Amplify[/b] towers are now in a single row.
[*][b]Utilities[/b] are still scattered, but we'll fix that in a future update. Namely when new towers finally get added.
[/list]

In general, it's much more organized and consistent. Though in order to apply those consistencies, you might notice a few towers got their damage types shuffled around:[list][*][b]Electricity[/b] - Used to be [b]Fire[/b], is now [b]Light[/b]
[*][b]Arcane[/b] - Used to be [b]Darkness[/b], is now [b]Fire[/b]
[*][b]Wisp[/b] - Used to be [b]Light[/b], is now [b]Water[/b]
[/list]

While this does harm a few builds (namely two 3-element builds that were a tad too perfect in multiplayer anyways), it fixes several redundancies, like having both [b]Solar & Electricity[/b] or [b]Arcane & Disease[/b].

Lastly, two towers are getting some ability tweaks:[list]
[*][b]Trickery[/b]:[list][*][b]Before[/b] - This is a Buff Tower. Every 15 seconds, it clones a Non-Buff Tower for 10 / 20 / 60 seconds. A cloned tower cannot be cloned again for 60 seconds.
[*][b]After[/b] - This is a Buff Tower. Every 15 seconds, it clones a Non-Buff Tower that deals 65% / 130% / 400% damage for 15 seconds. A cloned tower cannot be cloned again for 60 seconds.
[*]In other words, [b]Level 3 Trickery[/b] will no longer block out the entire map from being used when you have too much gold.
[/list]

[*][b]Golem[/b]:[list][*][b]Before[/b] - Each time it kills a creep, this tower loses 300 / 1200 damage for 2 seconds.
[*][b]After[/b] - After attacking for 3 seconds, this tower stops attacking for 3 seconds.
[*][b]Golem[/b] was always meant to be a finisher tower. However, its previous effect was counterintuitive to its nature. With the new effect, its average damage is lower than before, but its burst damage is insanely high. If you can maximize its uptime and minimize its downtime, it'll be a powerful asset in your defense.
[/list][/list]

A number of other towers will be receiving balance tweaks, but they're still in testing and not quite finalized. Exact tweaks will be revealed on patch release.


And that's it for this preview! We'll have a preview out next week, which will show off the other juicy part of [b]Version 0.50[/b] - cosmetics for your [b]Builder[/b]!

If you want to stay up-to-date on previews, as usual, join our [b]Discord[/b] server:
[url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Element TD 2 Discord[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.49 - Teams, Bug Fixes, and More Localization
notes.content:
For this patch, [b]Version 0.49[/b], we've added a [b]Teams Mode[/b], which should appeal to those of you asking for the experience of [b]Co-op[/b] but with just [b]2 Players[/b], we fixed that darn freeze error (hopefully once and for all), added [b]Russian, Chinese, French, & Finnish[/b] Localization, and other improvements. Check it out below!


[h2]Features[/h2][list][*][b]Teams Mode[/b] added![list][*]2 Players to a zone, allows up to 2v2v2v2!
[*]You can even solo it, meaning you reap all the gold benefits instead of splitting it with a partner.
[*]Supports all of the existing maps, except [b]Grand City[/b], which we kept as-is for the existing [b]Co-op Mode[/b].
[/list]
[*][b]Russian, Chinese, French, & Finnish[/b] Localization Support added!
[*]Expanded the [b]Frame Cap[/b] options.[list][*]60 is still the default, but you can now select options for 90, 120, and Uncapped.
[*]FYI, if you select Uncapped, we recommend turning on [b]Vsync[/b] via [b]NVIDIA/AMD[/b].
[/list][/list]

[h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2][list][*]Fixed a major bug where [b]Jinx[/b] could sometimes freeze the game.
[*]In a [b]Co-op Game[/b], if someone leaves the game, it will now forcibly sell all of their towers, and then split their gold evenly among the remaining players.[list][*]Likewise, in the new [b]Teams Mode[/b], the respective partner reaps the rewards from someone leaving.
[/list]
[*]Optimized the tower targeting code, which should help with end-game lag.[list][*]Late-game [b]Co-op[/b] is still a lagfest; HOWEVER, going off-screen should actually help now.
[/list]
[*]During a [b]Multiplayer Pause[/b] as a result of lag or something, the game will now display "[b]Synchronizing[/b]".
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Disease[/b] could deal so much damage, it could somehow heal a creep or [b]Elemental Boss[/b] back to full.
[*]Fixed a bug where, if you built a tower from the [b]Tower Table[/b], then opened the table again, it would retain the highlights from the previous tower.
[*]Fixed a bug where having a [b]UI Scale[/b] other than x1.0 would cause a black bar to show up on the [b]Extras[/b] menu.
[*]Fixed [b]Easy Difficulty[/b] displaying a difficulty multiplier of x0 instead of x0.25.
[*]Fixed a bug where viewing a replay with a clear time longer than 55 minutes would display a speed multiplier of x0.
[/list]

That's it for this patch! Our next patch, [b]Version 0.50[/b], is looking to be a bit chunky. It's probably going to take us upwards of 3 weeks before we release it, but it should be worth the wait. A little preview of what's to come:[list][*]Cosmetic Rewards, finally!
[*]Steam Achievements
[*]Balance update, including a Leaderboard Reset
[*]Leaderboard support for Teams & Co-op
[/list]

Regarding the [b]Challenges --> Campaign[/b] overhaul, a good chunk of it is reliant on the next patch's updates, so that's still some ways away.

As we get closer to release, we'll provide a more comprehensive patch preview. In the meantime, enjoy [b]Teams Mode[/b] and the latest fixes, and as usual, if you'd like to provide feedback or are looking for games, you can join our [b]Discord[/b]:
[url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Element TD 2 Discord[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.48 - Quality of Life, Bug Fixes, and Optimization
notes.content:
We return with a patch including some quality of life updates, a bunch of big fixes, and fixing your GPU sounding like it was a wind turbine.


[h2]Features[/h2][list][*][b]Game Notifications[/b] have now been split into three categories - [b]FFA, Duel, & Co-op[/b] - allowing you to define which type of notifications you'd like to receive.[list][*]When receiving a [b]Game Notification[/b], it now displays who's hosting it.
[/list]
[*]Added an [b]Extras[/b] button to the [b]Main Menu[/b].[list][*]The menu [b]Tower Table[/b] has been moved here.
[*]Also moved the [b]Replays[/b] button here.
[*]Added a [b]Credits[/b] screen. We'll be updating this over time as we get more [b]Translations[/b] implemented.
[/list][/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2][list][*]When hovering over a creep, there's now a hover indicator.
[*]There's now a visual spawn and leak effect.
[*]Doubled default [b]Zoom In/Out[/b] speed.
[*][b]Duel Mode[/b]: In the [b]Lobby[/b], it now gives you an explanation of how the game mode works, to clarify that it [i]is[/i] different from the standard game.
[*][b]Duel Mode[/b]: When someone uses an ability, a message appears on screen.
[*][b]Duel Mode[/b]: The enemy portal is now marked with a skull marker, so that you can tell which one enemy creeps will spawn from.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*]Fixed a major bug where the game could randomly freeze, resulting in everyone's gold gradually draining, resulting in a soft-lock.
[*]Fixed a major bug where someone pausing the game and then quitting could lock everyone else in the game.[list][*]It now automatically unpauses when they leave.
[/list]
[*]Fixed a major bug where the end-game [b]Scorescreen[/b] sometimes wouldn't appear, resulting in the game next ending and thus your score not being submitted to the [b]Leaderboard[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug where it was possible to get a [b]God Mode[/b] score uploaded to the [b]Leaderboard[/b].
[*]Fixed multiplayer input lag getting to ludicrously high levels.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could pause more than 3 times in [b]Multiplayer[/b].
[*]Fixed an annoying bug where clicking on a creep wouldn't actually select or target them.
[*]Fixed a bug where creeps were doing a spin-dance turn after spawning on certain maps.
[*]Fixed the portals on the [b]Temple[/b] map floating in mid-air.
[*]Fixed one of the portals getting hidden by a mountain on the [b]Winter[/b] map.
[*]Fixed [b]Scoreboard[/b] listing [b]Builder[/b] instead of [b]Player Name[/b].[list][*]We're not sure why it said that before, nor do we know how it took us this long to notice.
[/list]
[*][b]Co-op Mode[/b]: Everyone's score is now totaled, instead of individual.
[*][b]Co-op Mode[/b]: Fixed incorrect starting gold on [b]Ronald Run[/b] length.
[*][b]Co-op Mode[/b]: Fixed only Player 1 getting the [b]Freebie Essence[/b].
[*][b]Co-op Mode[/b]: Fixed only Player 1 hearing [b]Wave Start/End[/b] sounds.
[*][b]Duel Mode[/b]: Fixed a bug where, if you have a group of towers selected and they get [b]Frost Zoned[/b], you could sell them.
[*][b]Duel Mode[/b]: Fixed a bug where, if you select a group of towers that were already [b]Frost Zoned[/b], you couldn't sell them even when the duration ended.
[*][b]Duel Mode[/b]: Fixed [b]Flamethrower's[/b] napalm not healing your creeps.
[/list]

[h2]Optimization[/h2][list][*]We've disabled [b]Vsync[/b], and instead, the framerate is capped at 60, resulting in much lower GPU usage.
[*]Certain laggy towers, like [b]Nature 3[/b] and [b]Trickery 2 & 3[/b] are slightly less shiny in favor of not halving the framerate.
[*]Projectiles have received some optimization as well.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2][list][*]In [b]Random[/b], the earliest a [b]Level 3 Elemental[/b] can spawn is now [b]Wave 35[/b] instead of [b]Wave 30[/b].
[/list]

Next week, by popular demand, look forward to [b]Teams Mode[/b], which will enable [b]2 Player Co-op[/b] on all of our standard maps. Also look forward to balance updates in the next week or so. For the time being though, the game should run better and no longer be prone to spontaneous freezes and crashes.

As usual, if you find bugs, or you're looking for games, join our [b]Discord[/b] and ask away!
[url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Join the Element TD 2 Discord[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.47 - Localization, Tower Table Filters, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.47[/b] is now out! In this release, we have [b]Localization[/b] for several langues, [b]Tower Table Filters[/b] have been added, there's our usual bout of network improvements and [b]Bug Fixes[/b], and we now have a way to preview builds on the [b]Main Menu[/b]. We also have a fancy new promo:

[previewyoutube=qYjfDzaYI8I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Features[/h2][list][*][b]Localization[/b] has been added! This is a rough first pass and more iterations are will occur for each language. The game now supports the following [b]Languages[/b]:[list][*]Spanish
[*]German
[*]Dutch
[*]Italian
[*]Swedish
[/list]
[*][b]Tower Table[/b] filters have been added, among other improvements![list][*]Filters are sorted by [b]Range[/b], and then [b]Support[/b] filters.
[*]You can also hover over an [b]Element or Tower[/b] to highlight related towers.[list][*]We're aware the pop-up info can block some of this and we'll be implementing a fix on this soon.
[/list][/list]
[*]The [b]Tower Table[/b] has also been added to the [b]Main Menu[/b]! Additionally, you can preview builds:[list][*][b]Left-click[/b] to increase an element's level.
[*][b]Right-click[/b] to decrease the element's level.
[/list][/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*]Further network improvements, as usual.
[*][b]Lobbies[/b] no longer auto-start when they hit [b]8 Players[/b].
[*]F2 now only jumps between living players.
[*][b]Duel Mode[/b]: [b]Frost Zone[/b] now prevents affected towers from being upgraded.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*]Attempt number 2 at fixing the mid-game disconnect bug.[list][*]If anyone's still running into this, [b]please let us know[/b].
[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug where trying to kick a player wouldn't actually work.

notes.title: Version 0.46 - Ronald Runs, Menu Updates, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]Ronald Run[/b] length option added![list][*]Start from [b]Wave 56[/b] with 120,000 Gold, 11 Element Picks, & A Freebie Essence
[*]You have 180 Seconds to prepare your defenses
[*]This is actually submittable to the [b]Leaderboard[/b]; however, the [b]Speed Multiplier[/b] is set to x1. Between that and 120k Gold, any decent [b]Full[/b] length run (or even [b]Extra Short[/b]) should beat out a [b]Ronald Run[/b].
[/list]
[*]Removed the unintuitive "search for game" menu for [b]Duel Mode[/b].[list][*]When hosting a game, it lets you host between [b]FFA, Co-op, or 1v1 Duel[/b].
[/list][/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*][u]Fixed random disconnect errors that would happen mid-game.[/u]
[*]When a player leaves in [b]Co-op[/b], it properly decreases the current player count for splitting the bounty.
[*]In-game difficulty score multiplier on [b]Easy[/b] properly displays x0 instead of x1.
[*]Fixed a bug where going to the [b]Audio Tab[/b] in in-game settings could mess up the UI.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Chatbox[/b] vanishes twice as fast on [b]Turbo[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug where where "You've won the game" notification would pop-up during [b]Ronalds[/b], even if you ultimately lose.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]You can no longer get randomed [b]Double Interest Upgrades[/b] when playing on [b]Easy, Normal, or Hard[/b] Difficulties.[list][*]Double Interest is only something experienced players are able to take proper advantage of and often screws over new players. If you want Double Interest on Random, start raising the Difficulty.
[/list]
[*]Further server improvements to reduce pauses.
[*]Lobby List [b]Filters[/b] are now hidden by default.
[*]Further optimizations made.[list][*]Unfortunately, late-game [b]Co-op[/b] is still a lagfest. We'll be addressing this over the coming weeks.
[/list]
[*][b]Co-op[/b] pre-game time is now doubled, instead of a flat +30 Seconds.
[*]More sounds added/updated, including Lobby [b]Ready Up & Unready[/b].
[*]After typing something in the [b]Chatbox[/b], pressing Enter again will cause it to go away.
[*]On [b]Blacksmith, Well, Trickery, Runic & Astral Towers[/b], after using their abilities, the ability icon now displays the cooldown remaining.
[*][b]Hotkey[/b] page is now up to date.
[/list]


Since the release of [b]Element TD 2[/b] on [b]Steam Early Access[/b], we've primarily prioritized [b]Multiplayer Functionality[/b], new modes, network improvements, bug fixes, and other new features; however, the [b]Singleplayer[/b] department has been sorely lacking in new content.

Over the new few months, our focus will be shifting more towards [b]Content & Accessibility[/b]. Look forward to the following:[list]
[*]A [b]Campaign[/b] with actual progress and unlocks (this will replace [b]Challenges[/b])
[*][b]Steam Achievements[/b]
[*]A rewards system, providing [b]Skins & Trails[/b]
[*]And more!
[/list]

It will take us some time to actually build out and implement these things, so don't expect them to happen immediately. In the meantime, expect our usual bout of maintenance updates, including further network improvements, performance optimizations, visual & audio updates, etc.

notes.title: Version 0.45 - Co-op Alpha, Optimizations, & Fixes
notes.content:
Since release, we've had a lot of people ask if [b]Co-op[/b] is getting added to the game. Originally, we were going to wait, due to how long it'll take to build the map's visuals out, but we've decided to forgo making it look pretty in favor of getting the mode playable and out there to you all!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/O9rzmY5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]Co-op Mode[/b] added! Up to 8 players join together on a mega map to defend against 8 incoming lanes of creeps![list][*]Starting gold and bounty from creep kills are split evenly between players
[*][b]Builder[/b] movement speed is increased on this mode, allowing you to get around the map faster.
[*]Abuse the buffing powers of [b]Blacksmith, Well & Trickery[/b] to empower your allies!
[/list]
[*][b]Major Optimizations[/b] have been applied:[list][*]Any towers making use of that fancy water shader ([b]Water, Well, Wisp, Golem, Flooding[/b], and apparently [b]Blacksmith[/b]) have been altered to use a more performant water shader.
[*][b]GPU Usage[/b] has been drastically cut down, thanks to turning off certain settings that didn't really do anything for our game.
[*]Creeps no longer have mesh colliders. We're not sure why they had them in the first place, but if you had lag when there were a bunch of creeps on screen, it should be much smoother now.
[/list]
[*]Updated the visuals of many towers, particularly their scaling.[list][*]Higher level towers have been made a bit bigger. It should be easier to tell them apart from their lower level counterparts.
[/list]
[*]Updated [b]Sound & Music[/b] selection.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]By popular request, [u]pressing 1 now selects the [b]Builder[/b][/u].[list]F1 will still do this as well.
[/list]
[*]Pressing F3 will now reset your zoom level.
[*][b]Alt+Left Click[/b] on the [b]Minimap[/b] to ping a location.
[*][b]Scoreboard[/b] is now toggled on at the start of the game by default.
[*]Playing on [b]God Mode[/b] now prevents you from getting a personal score.
[*]Added a [b]Reset Scores[/b] button in settings, which will reset all of your personal scores.
[*]Improved drag-select/drag-build responsiveness.
[*][b]Duel Mode[/b]: Increased search time from 60 seconds to 90 seconds.
[*][b]Duel Mode[/b]: Decreased [b]Lockdown's[/b] AoE from 500 to 400.
[*][b]Duel Mode[/b]: Fixed both players showing as Defeated.
[*][b]Duel Mode[/b]: Fixed the winner not getting an [b]Endgame Scorescreen[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Periodic[/b] could not be cloned by [b]Trickery[/b].
[*]Fixed the crazy visual flare on [b]Arrow Tower[/b] when it tried shooting at a creep that was leaking.
[*]Fixed a bug where, even with the builder selected, you couldn't move if you happen to right-click a creep.
[*]Fixed a bug where having the [b]Timescale[/b] increased would result in the [b]Game Notification[/b] pop-up disappearing that much quicker.
[*]Fixed reported leaderboard score being rounded differently than the score reported in the [b]Endgame Scorescreen[/b].
[*]Fixed elements being slightly offset on the [b]Scoreboard[/b] in [b]Multiplayer[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: Co-op Mode Alpha coming this weekend!
notes.content:
Coming this weekend, we're going to be releasing the Alpha version of [b]Co-op Mode[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hkENzFw.jpg[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2][list][*]A prototype map with 8 lanes, featuring 8 fantastic sides, and 8 awesome angles!
[*]Up to 8 players work together (or not) on this mega map![list][*]Bounty from creep kills is split evenly between all players.
[*]Starting gold is also split evenly between players.

[/list]

[/list]

Although we're calling this an [b]Alpha[/b], do note it'll be fully playable. Mainly what'll change over time is likely the map design itself (for the first month, as it gets publicly tested), followed by actual non-prototype map visuals. Due to the vast scale of the map, this is probably going to take upwards of 2-3 months. So in the meantime, we decided that, since people have been asking for Co-op repeatedly, that we'd forgo visuals for now and just release the mode.

Also coming in this weekend's update are a bunch of optimizations, updated relative tower scaling, visual updates, fixes, and improvements to [b]Duel Mode[/b].

notes.title: Version 0.44 - New Map, Duel Mode, Bots, And More
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.44[/b] is here, and with it, a new map, new ways to play, bots to trash, and a host of other features, fixes, and improvements! As this patch does include balance changes, including layout tweaks to some of our maps, [u][b]Leaderboards[/b] have been reset[/u].

[previewyoutube=V8LQyYDaGZw;full][/previewyoutube]

Read on below for the full details of the patch notes!

[h2]New Map: Temple[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VKiYnDa.jpg[/img]
It's fairly compact, symmetrical, and features more trees than our actual Forest map. Length-wise, it clocks in the same length as [b]Autumn & Desert[/b], so don't take it lightly!

[h2]Duel Mode[/h2]
[previewyoutube=k3LhoF_J_y4;full][/previewyoutube]
Both players are in the same area. On one side, [b]your creeps[/b] spawn, and on the other side, [b]the opponent's creeps[/b] spawn. The goal of this game is to kill the opponent's creeps while keeping yours alive, using both [b]Towers[/b] and powerful new [b]Abilities[/b].

When an opponent's creep passes by, your towers will shoot and damage it, just like in the normal game. However, when one of your creeps passes by, your towers will shoot and [u]heal it[/u]. On top of competing for build locations, you'll have to constantly adapt playstyle to counter the opponent.

Additionally, you have a pair of two abilities you can use. Each time you use one, you're given a new ability at random after a cooldown. Currently, there are [b]5 Abilities[/b] in the game:[list][*][b]Speed Up[/b]: All of your creeps are sped up by 50% for 15 seconds. [i]90 Second Cooldown[/i]
[*][b]Rejuvenation[/b]: All of your creeps are healed by 50% of their Maximum Health. [i]90 Second Cooldown[/i]
[*][b]Mega Creep[/b]: Spawn a Mega Creep from the current wave with 500% Health, which reduces Lives by 5 instead of 1. [i]60 Second Cooldown[/i]
[*][b]Frost Zone[/b]: Decrease the Attack Speed of all enemy towers in an area by 50% for 15 seconds. Also prevents them from being sold. [i]60 Second Cooldown[/i]
[*][b]Lockdown[/b]: Sell and full refund all towers in an area, preventing anyone from building there for 60 seconds. [i]120 Second Cooldown[/i]
[/list]

In order to play [b]Duel Mode[/b], go to the [b]Duel Mode[/b] tab, select your settings, and hit [b]Find Game[/b]. Just like hosting a lobby, this'll trigger a [b]Game Notification[/b], prompting anyone to answer your challenge.

[h2]New Features[/h2][list]
[*]You can now play against [b]Bots[/b] in [b]Singleplayer[/b]![list][*]Up to [b]3 Bots[/b] can be added to your game.
[*]If you're experienced with the game, odds are, you're going to trash these [b]Bots[/b]. However, if you're new and relatively inexperienced, it gives you a chance to improve your skills in an offline environment and potentially learn from them.
[*]We'll be improving and expanding upon this feature with each patch.
[/list]
[*][b]Interest[/b] can now be disabled![list][*]For those of you that want to play the game without buy/sell abuse, you can turn off the [b]Interest[/b] and make the game a match of pure knowledge and strategy.
[/list]
[*][b]Turbo Mode[/b] has been added![list][*][b]Multiplayer[/b] feel too sluggish without access to [b]Timescale Options[/b]? Fret not; just turn on [b]Turbo Mode[/b], and force the game's [b]Timescale[/b] to x2!
[/list][/list]

[h2]Map Updates[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QRjH8nY.jpg[/img]
[i]Every Map[/i] can now be either [b]1 Path[/b] or [b]2 Paths[/b]![list][*]By default, this is set to [b]1 Path[/b], even if the map itself supports two lanes.
[*]Kick it to [b]2 Paths[/b], and single-lane maps change to [b]Purple Portals[/b], while two lanes add a second set of [b]Blue & Red Portals[/b].
[*]Also, this increases the wave timer between each wave by [b]4 Seconds[/b], meaning it's actually possible to play [b]Extreme[/b] on [b]2 Paths[/b] without instantly melting now.
[/list]

Additionally, the [b]Desert & Winter[/b] maps have been updated:

[h3][b]Desert[/b][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q7KqVUx.jpg[/img]
Extra build areas were added to the Desert Map to block off parts of the path creeps weren't really walking on. In addition, the portals have been tweaked such that it's actually symmetrical this time.

[h3][b]Winter[/b][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tLfxYgw.jpg[/img]
The Winter Map has been overhauled with a new layout. Although we want this map to be difficult, the previous layout was unfair to many of the game's towers. With this update, it's still difficult, but it's much friendlier to most builds.

[h2]Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]Further improvements have been made to server stability, resulting in less pauses, reduced input lag, and hopefully no more spontaneous disconnects.
[*]Creep healthbar color changed to red.
[*]Cleaned up [b]Lobby UI[/b].
[*][b]F1[/b] hotkey functionality tweaked:[list][*]Pressing it once simply selects your [b]Builder[/b].
[*]Pressing it twice will center your camera on your [b]Builder[/b].
[/list]
[*]Bringing up the menu in-game now shows you the current game's difficulty and settings.
[*]If you're the last player alive in a [b]Multiplayer Game[/b], the game will tell you that you've won, giving you a prompt to continue playing or exit to the [b]Main Menu[/b].
[*]Camera bounds have been expanded just slightly.
[*]You can now zoom out way further than before.
 -- Beware, zooming out to the new maximum can be performance heavy.
[*]The game's shadows have been improved, particularly at a distance, meaning trees no longer look like garbage when viewing them from afar.
[*]Fixed a bug where failing to host or join a lobby would kill the UI, forcing you to [b]Alt+F4[/b] to get out.
[*]Fixed a bug where players quitting and rejoining a lobby would cause the playerIndex to get screwed over, messing up the game and the replay.
[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn't change sound settings in the [b]Main Menu[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2][list]
[*]You can now read up on the same charts that I use to balance the game here:[list][*][url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GdfCqVeudiNHhxHF1XYSUMqkyNRRkCx-loXJiNQqv4s/edit?usp=sharing]Element TD 2 DPS/Gold Values Chart[/url][/list]
[*][b]Score Multipliers[/b] updated:[list][*][b]Full Length[/b] multiplier now starts at 5.5, degrading by 0.1 per minute:
 -- If you clear the game in [b]30 Minutes[/b], you'll have a score multiplier of x2.5
 -- If you clear the game in [b]45 Minutes[/b], you'll have a score multiplier of x1
 -- If you clear the game in [b]55 Minutes[/b], you'll have a score multiplier of x0
[*][b]Short[/b] multiplier starts at 4.8
[*][b]Extra Short[/b] multiplier starts at 3.5
[/list]
[*][b]Light[/b] consecutive damage bonus reduced from 8 / 48 / 288 / 2880 to 6 / 36 / 216 / 2160
[*][b]Darkness[/b] damage bonus on death reduced from 15% to 12%
[*][b]Water[/b] damage increased from 70 / 420 / 2520 / 25200 to 75 / 450 / 2700 / 27000
 -- Bonus damage reduced from 50% to 40%
[*][b]Fire[/b] damage increased from 24 / 144 / 864 / 8640 to 25 / 150 / 900 / 9000
[*][b]Nature[/b] damage increased from 70 / 420 / 2520 / 25200 to 75 / 450 / 2700 / 27000
[*][b]Electricity[/b] now requires at least one other creep in range in order to bounce
 -- Attack Rate reduced from 1 to 0.66
 -- Damage increased from 200 / 800 / 3200 to 300 / 1200 / 4800
 -- Bounce range increased from 900 to 1150
 -- Number of bounces increase from 4 to 6
[*][b]Vapor[/b] damage bonus per creep reduced from 14% to 10%
 -- Damage increased from 150 / 600 / 2400 to 180 / 720 / 2880
[*][b]Arcane[/b] damage reduced from 650 / 2600 / 10400 to 600 / 2400 / 9600
[*][b]Atom[/b] damage reduced from 270 / 1080 / 4320 to 260 / 1040 / 4160
[*][b]Money[/b] extra bounty bonus increased from 30% / 45 to 35% / 50%
[*][b]Runic[/b] ability AoE increased from 175 to 200
[/list]

And that's it for this week's mega patch! Next week, look forward to an early version of [b]Co-op Mode[/b], complete with a prototype map. It won't look as fancy as the rest of our maps, but it'll be fully playable!

If you're having trouble finding online games, join us on our [b]Discord[/b] and request a [b]Looking-For-Game[/b] role:
[url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Join our Discord[/url]

notes.content:

notes.title: Version 0.43.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]Applied more server optimizations. This should result in less pauses, particularly in multiplayer.
[*]Server pauses no longer bring up the chatbox.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could use the [b]Game Notification[/b] to join a game after it's started or no longer exists.
 -- It will now block you from doing so, meaning if you're in a Singleplayer game, you will no longer exit it, unless the game is valid.
[*]Removed "Wave 0" column from the [b]Leaderboard[/b].
[*]Extended the double-click threshold from 0.15 seconds to 0.3 seconds
[*][b]Arrow & Cannon Towers[/b] are no longer buffable by [b]Well & Blacksmith[/b]
 -- Apparently, this was an OP tactic that unleashed their final forms, allowing them to overthrow forms of godhood.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.43 - Game Notifications
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]Game Notifications[/b] have been added![list][*]How this works is on the title screen, there's a new toggle in the bottom-left corner.
[*]If it's on, then as long as you're in the menu, playing offline singleplayer, or Challenges, you'll get a notification each time someone hosts a game.
[*]You'll see a pop-up telling you the game's settings. If you accept, it'll confirm if you want to exit your current game, and then if so, you'll instantly join the lobby!
[/list]
[*]3 New [b]Lava Challenges[/b] added![list][*]Escalation
[*]Big Bad Bosses
[*]Duos
[/list]
[*][b]Quick Play[/b] temporarily removed for now.[list][*]It wasn't doing any favors splitting the low playerbase. We'll add it back down-the-road later.
[/list][/list]

[h2]Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list]
[*][b]Arrow & Cannon Towers[/b] can no longer be cloned by [b]Trickery[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug where building a [b]Trickery Tower[/b] near [b]Arrow and/or Cannon Towers[/b] would pseudo-freeze the game.
[*]Fixed a bug where left-clicks sometimes wouldn't register.
[*]Fixed a bug where playing on [b]Random[/b] would cause it to carry over to [b]Challenges[/b].
[*]Fixed [b]Brightness Slider[/b] not doing anything in-game.
[*]Added a [b]Max Channels[/b] slider for sounds.
 -- Increasing this may result in a smoother sound experience, but it may also lag your game a bit more.
[*][b]Solo Online[/b] stability improved.
[*]Timeout window increased.
 -- This should result in less spontaneous disconnects. Please let us know if they're still happening.
[*][b]Lobby Region[/b] is now listed in the lobby itself.
[*]Improved the lighting on the [b]Autumn[/b] map.
[/list]
