We'll be hosting this on our [b]Discord[/b], which can you join here:
[url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Element TD 2 Discord[/url]

notes.title: [Reverted to 0.42.1] Version 0.42.2 - Fixed Trickery Freeze Error
notes.content:
[strike][h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where if you did drag-built a bunch of towers near a [b]Trickery Tower[/b], and the clone ended up inside the drag-build, it would pseudo-freeze the game temporarily.
[/list][/strike]

Sorry, apparently this patch broke more than we realized. For now, we've reverted this fix. We'll have it fixed by tomorrow or Saturday, along with other notable bugs.

notes.title: Version 0.42.1 - Optimizations and Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Optimized Mass Building/Selling.
 -- You should no longer get lag spikes when drag-building 50+ towers at once or selling 50+ towers at once.
[*]Default priorities of [b]Light, Atom & Flooding[/b] changed to Near
[*]Nerfed the difficulty of the following [b]Forest Challenges[/b]:
 -- Shortcuts
 -- Poisoned Forest
 -- Atomized Peninsulas
[*]And lastly, this is a bit overdue, but congrats to the previous leaderboard winners! As a reward for being the cream of the crop, you've received a little trail effect! The winners are:
 -- briboy
 -- blyat
 -- Casil
 -- GoatAss
 -- NeedM0re
 -- skug
 -- ChaosJoeyExtreme
 -- Chokes
 -- Meyrine
 -- Pazoozoo
[/list]

If you're on this list and you have not received a fancy little trail effect, please let us know so we can fix it!

In the future, we'll be expanding the rewards for top leaderboard spots, as well as providing other sorts of little rewards for other kinds of challenges.

notes.title: Version 0.42 - Drag-Build, Score System, & Balance Changes
notes.content:
Welcome to the first balance update of [b]Element TD 2[/b]! Due to the number of changes on a larger scale this build, [u]the [b]Leaderboards[/b] have been reset[/u]. For the future though, we'll be keeping these kinds of updates sparse, happening only once every month or so.

[previewyoutube=tSL3wi1xZGk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*]You can now [b]Click, Hold, & Drag Outwards[/b] to build a whole box of towers with a single click![list]
[*]In other words, your index finger will no longer die after a single game or so of buy/sell abuse.
[/list]
[*][u]That dastardly [b]Cross Region[/b] option has been nuked from the game[/u]![list]
[*]Thanks to recent network improvements, we no longer need a [b]Cross Region[/b] latency option to account for those with lesser internet speeds, which makes searching for games much easier for everyone.
[*]Input lag and the number of server pauses should be reduced from before.
[*]If you're still having problems, please let us know!
[/list]
[*]New Challenges Added![list]
[*]3 new [b]Forest Challenges[/b] and 3 new [b]Lava Challenges[/b] await you in a test of your skills!
[*]A number of previous [b]Challenges[/b] were adjusted to make them easier and scale better.
[*]Unfortunately, this did reset progress for most of the existing Challenges. We apologize about that, and we'll try to avoid this in the future.
[/list]
[*]Updated [b]Forest[/b] visuals![list]
[*]Since release, the [b]Forest[/b] map's visuals have been a little too red and not foresty enough. It's now been updated to look much cleaner and easier on the eyes.
[*]You can check out a comparison of the new version to the old version [url=https://imgsli.com/MTMxNjU]here[/url].
[/list][/list]

[h2]Score System[/h2][list]
[*][b]Duration[/b] now accounts for the time between the first wave starting a [b]Wave 55[/b] finishing
[*]There is now a [b]Speed Multiplier[/b] applied to your [b]Ronald Score[/b], based on your performance up through [b]Wave 55[/b]:[list]
[*]On a [b]Full Length Game[/b], you start with a multiplier of x3.5. Every minute, this decreases by 0.05:
 -- If you clear the game in 40 Minutes, you'll have a multiplier of x1.5
 -- If you clear the game in 50 Minutes, you'll have a multiplier of x1
 -- If you clear the game in 70 Minutes, you'll have a multiplier of x0
[*]On [b]Short & Extra Short Modes[/b], these multipliers start lower:
 -- [b]Short[/b]: Start with a multiplier of x3
 -- [b]Extra Short[/b]: Start with a multiplier of x2.25
[/list]
[*]Additionally, if you clear through [b]Wave 55[/b] [u]without losing any lives[/u], you'll gain a [b]Perfection Bonus[/b], multiplying your score by x1.1
 -- Note, if you lose lives but gain them back through [b]Life Tower[/b], this does not give you the [b]Perfection Bonus[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*][b]Border Lock[/b] option added!
 -- If you're running a dual monitor setup, and you had issues with your mouse going off-screen and throwing you out of focus, you can turn [b]Border Lock[/b] on to prevent this issue.
[*][b]Brightness Slider[/b] added!
[*]First-time players are forwarded to [b]Challenges[/b] now.
[*][b]Near[/b] targeting priority no longer focuses creeps down.
 -- However, [b]Light, Atom, Arcane, & Flooding[/b] will now always focus creeps down, allowing you to change their targeting priority without breaking their effects.
[*][b]Old[/b] targeting priority renamed to [b]Front[/b].
[*]Added a [b]Back[/b] targeting priority, which does the exact opposite of [b]Front[/b].
[*]Decreased the size of stats pop-up boxes.
[*]Damage number pop-up duration doubled.
[*]Toned down the VFX on many of the projectiles.
[*]Updated a number of tower tooltips to be generally clearer, including listing the damage formulas on [b]Disease & Mushroom[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed [b]Fire, Light, Nature, Atom, Ethereal, Golem, & Flooding Towers[/b] updating their buff numbers instead of their base numbers.
[*]Fixed a bug where the [b]Elements[/b] settings drop-down on [b]Quick Play[/b] was offset by 1.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Blacksmith's Damage Buff[/b] was not buffing certain towers properly. This included:
 -- [b]Earth's[/b] shockwave
 -- [b]Solar's[/b] damage-over-time
 -- [b]Quake's[/b] shockwave
 -- [b]Nova's[/b] shockwave
 -- [b]Flamethrower's[/b] napalm
[*]Fixed a bug where certain towers with self-buffing effects were not gaining damage on any priority except [b]Near[/b]. This included:
 -- [b]Fire's[/b] damage-gain-over-time
 -- [b]Atom's[/b] consecutive attacks
[*][b]Element Prompt[/b] no longer shows up in [b]God Mode[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug where the [b]Interest Timer[/b] would unfreeze each time you cleared a wave of [b]Ronalds[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2][list]
[*]All [b]Build & Upgrade Times[/b] increased by 0.25 seconds
[*][b]Ronald[/b] base HP reduced from 600,000 to 500,000
 -- However, [b]Ronald[/b] per-wave-scaling increased from x1.1 to x1.2
[*][b]Shield[/b] creep's ability cooldown increased from 5 to 6 seconds
[*][b]Timelapse[/b] creep's ability trigger threshold reduced from 33% to 25%
 -- Effectively, it's now an even harder counter to [b]Single-Targets[/b]
[*][b]Healing[/b] creep's ability AoE increased from 175 to 200

[*][b]Light's[/b] consecutive damage bonus reduced from 10 / 60 / 360 / 3600 to 8 / 48 / 288 / 2880
 -- Default priority changed from Near to Far
[*][b]Darkness[/b] damage bonus on bounce reduced from 20% to 15%
[*][b]Fire[/b] damage increased from 22 / 132 / 792 / 7920 to 24 / 144 / 864 / 8640
[*][b]Earth's[/b] shockwave now deals damage in a Full/Half AoE instead of a Full AoE
 -- Shockwave damage increased from 30 / 180 / 1080 / 10800 to 40 / 240 / 1440 / 14400

[*][b]Trickery[/b] now clones towers next to the cloned tower instead of [b]Trickery[/b]
 -- Its behavior now matches all previous versions of the game
[*][b]Atom[/b] default priority changed from Near to Back
[*][b]Arcane[/b] damage reduced from 700 / 2800 / 11200 to 650 / 2600 / 10400
[*][b]Vapor[/b] damage scaling per-creep-hit reduced from 15% to 14%
[*][b]Solar[/b] updated:
 -- Damage & damage-per-second increased from 80 / 320 / 1280 to 100 / 400 / 1600
 -- Attack Speed reduced from 1 to 0.66
 -- AoE increased from 100 to 200
 -- Ability AoE reduced from 300 to 200
 -- Effectively, this should perform much more consistently early on, and still scale well into the endgame
[*][b]Mushroom[/b] effect reworded to not be a confusing mess.
 -- Although its numbers have changed, its balance is identical to before
[*][b]Howitzer[/b] effect reworded to deal bonus damage on close-up creeps, instead of half damage to far away creeps.
 -- Although its numbers have changed, its balance is identical to before
[*][b]Geyser[/b] updated:
 -- AoE increased from 0 to 200
 -- Attack Speed reduced from 1.5 to 1
 -- Damage reduced from 360 / 1440 / 5760 to 300 / 1200 / 4800
 -- Damage bonus per creep reduced from 360 / 1440 / 5760 to 150 / 600 / 2400

[*][b]Nova[/b] damage increased from 500 / 2000 to 600 / 2400
[*][b]Wisp[/b] updated:
 -- Damage increased from 450 / 1800 to 500 / 2000
 -- AoE increased from 400 to 450
 -- Damage gain per attack reduced from 50 / 200 to 20 / 80
 -- AoE loss per attack reduced from 10 to 5
 -- Damage & AoE now cap after 50 attacks, stopping at 1500 / 6000 damage and 200 AoE
[*][b]Runic[/b] damage increased from 850 / 3400 to 900 / 3600
[*][b]Polar[/b] default priority changed from Strong to Back
[*][b]Flooding[/b] damage increased from 330 / 1320 to 350 / 1400
 -- Default priority changed from Near to Back
[*][b]Corrosion[/b] damage amp increased from 15% / 40% to 15% / 45%
[*][b]Flamethrower[/b] Napalm AoE increased from 300 to 400
[*][b]Impulse[/b] damage reduced from 3600 / 14400 to 3500 / 14000
[*][b]Golem[/b] damage increased from 1300 / 5200 to 1400 / 5600
[*][b]Quake[/b] Shockwave damage reduced from 4500 / 18000 to 3000 / 12000
 -- Shockwave now deals full damage to nearby creeps, instead of pretty much half across the board
 -- Shockwave still deals half damage to creeps at the edge of its range
[*][b]Money[/b] bounty bonus increased from 30% / 40% to 30% / 45%
[*][b]Periodic[/b] damage increased from 26000 to 28000
[/list]

To celebrate the new patch, we'll be hosting a [b]Community Night[/b] on [b]Saturday, March 13th[/b]. Join us for some games at 6pm GMT, and later at 10pm GMT!

We'll be setting it up on our [b]Discord Server[/b]. [url=https://discord.gg/W7FWK8w]Click here to join[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.41.1 - Server Finding Fix
notes.content:
[h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed how the [b]Region Bypass Filter[/b] works. You can pry from [b]non-Cross Region[/b] into [b]Cross Region[/b], but you can no longer pry from [b]Cross Region[/b] to [b]non-Cross Region[/b].
 -- Essentially, if your internet isn't particularly stable, this prevents you from entering games that would cause a spam of [b]Server Pauses[/b].
 -- We're well aware this whole [b]Cross Region On/Off[/b] thing is super confusing, so we're looking into alternatives and further improvements for next week.
[*]Added the ability to [b]Reset to Defaults[/b] for [b]Settings[/b].
[*]Fixed [b]Quick Play[/b] on "Any" settings not actually searching for "Any" settings.
[*]Fixed [b]Timescale[/b] controls not accurately updating.
[*]Fixed being unable to access the [b]Menu[/b] during a [b]Server Pause[/b].
[*]Fixed a number of typos.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.41 - Network Optimizations & Easier Game Searches
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*]Network stability improved and optimized![list]
[*]You should no longer receive spontaneous [b]Disconnects[/b], short of your internet going out too long.
[*]Reduced server pauses.
[*]Reduced input lag.
[*]We're still working to improve and optimize it further, so if you run into any issues, please let us know!
[/list]
[*][b]Bypass Region Filter[/b] added![list]
[*]Instead of having to go back and forth between the [b]Settings[/b] and the [b]Lobby List[/b] to change your [b]Region/Cross Region[/b] settings, you can now bypass it with a handy little checkbox! Now, regardless of any hosted game's [b]Region/Cross Region[/b], you can see and join it!
[*]This is on by default. Note, actual [b]Region/Cross Region[/b] settings are based on the host.
[/list][/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]A [b]Hotkeys[/b] tab has been added in [b]Settings[/b].
 -- It doesn't let you change hotkeys, it just tells you what they all are.
[*]Your [b]Personal High Score[/b] is now listed on each map.
 -- This does include your [b]Offline[/b] score attempts. We'll build something out later to make this more in-depth.
[*][b]Wave Clear[/b] messages have been shoved to the side and are kindly out of your way now.
[*][b]Time Scale[/b] controls changed:
 -- From: x1, x2, x3, x5, x7
 -- To: x1, x2, x4, x7, x10
[*]The [b]Offline[/b] setting in [b]Singleplayer[/b] now remembers your preference between play sessions.
[*]If you have the [b]Tower Table[/b] open, right-clicking anywhere on-screen will close it.
[*]Double-clicking a [b]Leaderboard Entry[/b] now opens the replay.
[*][b]Leaderboards[/b] now show the [b]Top 100 Entries[/b], up from 50.
[*][b]Dual Spawn Maps[/b] now only have one [b]Path Indicator[/b] per spawn, but the trail length is doubled.
[*]Color [b]vibrance[/b] level has been increased.
[*]Performance increases around tower and creep rendering.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed the game over pop-up covering a part of the [b]Scoreboard[/b].
[*]Upgrading to a higher level tower no longer resets the [b]Kills[/b] counter.
[*]Hovering over the upgrade icon on a [b]Tier 2 Triple[/b] no longer gives you a tooltip implying that there's a third tier.
[*][b]Geyser & Flooding Towers[/b] should no longer set your computers on fire, despite being water towers. Huge performance gains here!
[/list]


Regarding [b]New Challenges[/b], we'll be adding a few by this weekend, so look forward to them!

notes.title: Version 0.40.3 - Challenges are actually possible now
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes & Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]The following challenges have been neutered in difficulty and should actually be possible to beat on [b]Insane[/b] now:
 -- Shortcuts
 -- Forest Peninsulas
 -- Poisoning the Forest
 -- Basics: Expendables
[*]Fixed a bug where, after playing a solo online game, the checkbox for "Offline/Online" would be flipped.
[*]Fixed a bug where the screen would flicker each time you exited an online game.
[*]Added a confirmation prompt for restarting the game in singleplayer.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.40.2 - More Hotfixes
notes.content:
[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]In [b]Quick Play[/b], all options now default to "Any". This means you can boot up the game and just hit "Find Game", without having to change any settings.
 -- This should drastically improve the frequency of finding other games.
 -- You're welcome to still rig your settings up, but if you don't care and just want to play, just hit "Find Game" without changing anything.
[*]When the host leaves a lobby, it unreadies everyone.
 -- This fixes a bug where the lobby could end up bugged out, and people could join an in-progress game.
[*]In [b]Singleplayer[/b], your choices for [b]Elements[/b] is just between [b]Pick[/b] and [b]Random[/b] now.
[*]Doubled the amount of path indicators.
[*][b]Leaderboard[/b] scroll speed increased.
[*][b]Leaderboard[/b] entries no longer display [b]Interest & Essences[/b] that are 0.
[*]In-game loading timeout in multiplayer decreased from 120 seconds to 60 seconds.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the in-game chat would have everyone spamming the text "HEARTBEAT".
[*]Fixed [b]Autumn Map's[/b] second exit being slightly offset.
[*]Fixed in-game chat scrollbar being reversed.
[*]Fixed hover-over tooltip in [b]Settings[/b] getting stuck on your screen and never going away.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.40.1 - Server Stability
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Red text error log no longer shows up in the bottom-left corner.
[*]Improved server stability, decreasing the chances of disconnects.
 -- Note, this does increase input lag. We'll be trying to optimize this over time, ideally reducing disconnects and input lag.
[*]You can no longer join a game that's in-progress.
[*]Difficulty now lists [b]Score Multipliers[/b] in the tooltip.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Update!
notes.content:
[b]Element TD 2[/b] is finally going public today! Spread the word, tell your friends, and especially invite your enemies, so that you can trounce them yourself!

[i]This update contains the combined changelogs of [b]Version 0.39 and 0.40[/b][/i]

[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]Main Menu[/b] has a fancy new backdrop!
[*]The game has been optimized:[list]
[*]The initial boot-up might end up slower than before, but in-game loading speeds should be much faster than before, even if you're on a HDD.
[*]This should result in a much more stable online experience and prevent infinite hangs on loading online games.
[/list]
[*]Servers have also been optimized. Playing online should be considerably more stable than before.
[*]You can now directly invite your friends to a [b]Lobby[/b]![list]
[*]If your friend is in a [b]Lobby[/b], you can also join them without an invitation. Just open the [b]Steam Overlay[/b], right-click your friend, and hit [b]Join Game[/b].
[*]Note, it will use the host's [b]Region & Cross Region[/b] settings, so via this method, you don't have to align region settings to join a friend. However, we recommend it for a more stable playing experience.
[/list]
[*][b]4 New Challenges[/b] have been added!
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]Menus now quickly fade in and out, instead of instantly appearing and disappearing.
[*]Added new icons for tower stats.
[*][b]Essence Cost[/b] is now noted in the upgrade tooltips for [b]Tier 4 Singles & Periodic Tower[/b].
[*]The game's [b]Music Selection[/b] has been updated.
 -- Two of the heavier, upbeat tracks were removed, as they felt out of place.
 -- Seven new tracks have been added.
[*]When someone dies or disconnects, their name is now colorized, and it's listed in the game chat.
[*]Tweaked a number of hover-over tooltips in the in-game UI such that they no longer hang to the side.
[*]Updated [b]Cross Region[/b] tooltip to clarify what exactly it does.
[*][b]Wisp Tower[/b] now has a new base, instead of a flattened version of [b]Well Tower[/b], just in time for release!
[*][b]Flamethrower Tower[/b] is now on fire to account for its lack of animation. Hopefully it doesn't explode on you!
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Leaderboard[/b] entries recorded the player index incorrectly, resulting in a different replay than intended.
 -- Unfortunately, this isn't retroactive.
 -- As a result, [u]all existing [b]Leaderboard[/b] entries have been nuked[/u].
[*]Fixed a bug where if you played a game of [b]Extreme Mode[/b] and then tried playing a [b]Challenge[/b] afterwards, it would soft-lock the game.
[*]Fixed [b]Fire Tower Level 3[/b] not animating while idle.
[*]Fixed [b]Wisp Tower's[/b] AoE not updating in real-time when selecting the tower.
[*]Fixed the "spash" typo.
[*]Fixed a typo on [b]Impulse Tower[/b] where it actually stated "the further the damage, the greater the damage".
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Solar[/b] damage and damage-per-second increased from 75 / 300 / 1200 to 80 / 320 / 1280
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.38 - Quick Play, F2, and other Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]Quick Play[/b] added! Set your modes, hit "Find Game", and if you find other people playing the same settings, you'll be on your way to a new game![list]
[*]The game will wait up to 60 seconds. If don't find a game within that time, the game bounces you back.
[*]Note that until the game officially releases, this feature is admittedly kind of useless.
[/list]
[*]Pressing F2 now bounces your camera to other players' zones, instead of their builders.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]The [b]Tower Table[/b] has gotten a little reskin and should be sleeker than before.
[*]Hovering over an upgrade you don't have access to will now display the tooltip.
[*]When a lobby fills up all the way, it will now automatically start, regardless of if everyone's [b]Ready[/b] or not.
 -- We'll update this later so it doesn't trigger in [b]Private Lobbies[/b].
[*]Updated [b]Geyser's[/b] water shader, this should hlep optimize the tower, though it'll still get laggy if you get more than 30 on-screen at once.
[*]When someone quits or disconnects from a game, their quit message is now posted in the chat, and their name is colorized.
[*]During a [b]Server Pause[/b], the [b]Menu[/b] button no longer shows up on-screen.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would tell you [b]Victory![/b] even if you had lost.
[*]Fixed a bug where the game completion message would trigger for everyone each time someone cleared [b]Wave 55[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug where you could kick someone in a lobby after the countdown starts.
[*]Fixed the random box covering part of your view when you were dead.
[*]Fixed certain buttons on the [b]Main Menu[/b] not making a sound.
[*]Fixed [b]Life Tower's[/b] tooltip listing "kils" instead of "kills".
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]Builder & Elemental Text[/b] would invert colors when in the top-left corner of the screen.
[*]In-game [b]Scroll, Zoom, & Rotate[/b] sliders now reduce to a minimum of 10%, matching the [b]Main Menu[/b] versions.
[*][i]Potentially[/i] fixed a bug where you could hang infinitely on the loading screen.
 -- If you run into this bug still, please let us know.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.37.2 - Hotfix for Challenges Freezing the Game
notes.content: -- Fixed a bug where opening any [b]Challenge[/b] level would freeze the game.

notes.title: Version 0.37.1 - Replay from Leaderboard
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*]You can now view [b]Replays[/b] from a leaderboard entry! To do so, simply click on any leaderboard entry, and hit the [b]Replay[/b] button.[list]
[*]Once you're in, you can even [b]Timescale[/b] it up to x7.
[/list]
[*][b]South America[/b] added to the [b]Region Select[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Playing with [b]Cross Region[/b] enabled now actually lets you play with people on other [b]Regions[/b].
[*]Fixed in-game chat being buggy and an absolute pain to deal with.
[*]Fixed a bug where leaderboard entries based on [b]Random Map[/b] were not uploading properly.
 -- Unfortunately, this isn't retroactive, so these entries were nuked.
[*]Updated descriptions on existing [b]Challenges[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Solar[/b] damage and damage-per-second increased from 75 / 300 / 1200 to 80 / 320 / 1280
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.37 - Leaderboards & Balance
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]Leaderboards[/b] are now accessible![list]
[*]For any game that you play online and reach [b]Ronalds[/b] (killing at least 1), your score will be submitted to the [b]Leaderboard[/b].
[*][b]Leaderboards[/b] are first divided into [b]Pick & Random[/b], and then by map, effectively providing [b]14 Different Leaderboards[/b] to compete for.
[/list]
[*]You can now rotate the camera on the [b]X Axis[/b], using the [b]Home & End[/b] buttons.[list]
[*]Like before, [b]Page Up/Down[/b] still rotate the camera on the [b]Y Axis[/b]. Use [b]F1[/b] to reset your camera rotation.
[/list][/list]

[h2]Optimizations & Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where game would infinitely hang on the loading screen.
[*]Improved network stability, resulting in far less [b]Server Pauses[/b] and [b]Disconnects[/b].
[*]Rebaked and optimized lightmaps, shaving about 1 GB off the game size.
 -- This should help with excessive load times.
[*]Updated texture compression and mip maps; this should improve in-game performance.
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks & Improvements[/h2][list]
[*]The first time the game loads, you'll be prompted to select your [b]Region[/b].
 -- You can always change this in [b]Settings[/b].
[*]Renamed [b]Latency[/b] to [b]Cross Region[/b].
 -- By default, this is set to [b]Disabled[/b].
[*]In-game time is now displayed in the bottom-right corner, above the [b]Minimap[/b].
[*]Your [b]Builder[/b] now shows up as a blip on the [b]Minimap[/b].
[*]When you return to the [b]Main Menu[/b], you now return to the last location you were at instead of the [b]Title Screen[/b].
[*]When you beat [b]Wave 55[/b], you receive a congratulatory message.
[*]If you're playing by yourself in an online game, it will no longer tell you "Victory!" if you die before Wave 55.
[*][b]Missions[/b] have been renamed to [b]Challenges[/b].
[*]You are no longer locked to playing [b]Challenges[/b] in order.
[*][b]Extreme Mode[/b] tweaked:
 -- You can no longer random [b]Interest Upgrades[/b] in [b]Extreme Mode[/b].
 -- When a creep leaks, it no longer freezes the [b]Interest Timer[/b].
 -- You now get the [b]Element Pick[/b] when the respective wave finishes spawning, not when you kill it.
[*]All [b]Maps[/b] now list a short description.
[*]Applied a new icon for the [b]Tower Table[/b].
[*]Fixed a visual discrepancy where selecting your [b]Elements[/b] could sometimes cause the element icons in your HUD to be darker than intended.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2][list]
[*][b]Cursed[/b] creeps effect AoE increased from 200 to 350
 -- This effectively causes it to hit all towers up to 2 spaces away
 -- Effect amount decreased from 15% to 10% per stack
 -- Effect duration increased from 10 to 15 seconds
[*][b]Earth[/b] ability starting AoE increased from 50 to 100
 -- Fixed Reset time not being 3 seconds
[*][b]Arcane[/b] damage reduced from 720 / 2880 / 11520 to 700 / 2800 / 11200
[*][b]Vapor[/b] damage reduced from 160 / 640 / 2560 to 150 / 600 / 2400
 -- Bonus damage per creep hit increased from 14% to 15%
[*][b]Geyser[/b] AoE reduced from 100 to 0
 -- Bonus damage per creep within its 200 search AoE increased from 120 / 480 / 1920 to 360 / 1440 / 5760
[*][b]Poison[/b] damage-per-second reduced from 90 / 360 / 1440 to 80 / 320 / 1280
 -- Duration increased from 8 to 10 seconds
[*][b]Solar[/b] attack speed decreased from 1.5 to 1
 -- Damage & damage-per-second increased from 65 / 260 / 1040 to 75 / 300 / 1200
 -- Primary attack AoE increased from 0 to 100
 -- Effect altered from "Primary target receives a stacking debuff" to "Targets hit receive a stacking debuff"
[*][b]Mushrooom[/b] attack speed increased from 1.5 to 3
 -- Damage reduced from 240 / 960 / 3840 to 150 / 600 / 2400
 -- Effect altered from "This tower deals 1% additional damage for every 1% of HP the target has" to "This tower deals up to 50% more damage against max health enemies and down to 50% less damage against low health enemies".
 -- Its maximum DPS is about the same as before, but it doesn't deal as much damage to lower health creeps early on, preventing it from steamrolling the early-game with minimal effort
[*][b]Impulse[/b] damage reduced from 3800 / 15200 to 3600 / 14400
[*][b]Flooding[/b] bonus AoE per attack increased from 18 to 20
[*][b]Nova[/b] damage increased from 400 / 1600 to 450 / 1800
[*][b]Windstorm[/b] damage-per-second increased from 450 / 1800 to 500 / 2000
[*][b]All Tier 1 Slows[/b] reduced from 12% to 10%
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.36
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*][b]Main Menu[/b] has received some welcome visual updates, particularly in the backdrop.
[*][b]Missions[/b] have been added! You can find this under [b]Singleplayer[/b].[list]
[*]These are short levels with a smaller number of waves and usually preset [b]Elements[/b].
[*]The 6 that have been added so far help teach the basics of the game. Do note they are designed for [b]Normal Difficulty[/b], so if you want a challenge, crank them up to [b]Very Hard[/b] or [b]Insane[/b].
[/list]
[*]Add a [b]Replays[/b] feature.[list]
[*]Every game you play will always store a [b]Replay[/b]. To check out your latest game, click the [b]Replay[/b] button, sort by [b]Last Modified[/b], and select the top-most [b]Replay[/b].
[/list]
[*]The old [b]Pop-Up Tutorial[/b] has been removed.[list]
[*]It's been replaced by the far superior [b]Missions[/b].
[/list]
[*][b]Extreme Mode[/b] has been changed![list]
[*]Before, all it did was reduce you to [b]1 Life[/b].
[*]Now, when a wave finishes spawning, the next wave immediately starts. In other words, it's [b]Rush Mode[/b] from the [b]Dota 2[/b] version.
[/list][/list]

[h3]Tweaks & Fixes[/h3][list]
[*]Temporarily disabled the [b]Quick Play[/b] feature.
 -- It'll return soon.
[*]You can no longer drag the camera out-of-bounds using the minimap.
[*]Your [b]Steam Avatar[/b] is now displayed next to your name on the [b]Scoreboard[/b].
[*]There is now an indicator for when you hover the mouse over a tower.
[*]The [b]Tower Table[/b] button now lists the [b]Space[/b] hotkey.
[*]Fixed a bug where hitting [b]Restart[/b] in [b]Singleplayer[/b] would play the [b]Menu Music[/b].
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3][list]
[*][b]Interest[/b] now rounds down instead of up.
[*]Reverted [b]Total Bounty[/b] decrease from 0.35
[*][b]Solar[/b] damage increased from 60 / 240 / 960 to 65 / 260 / 1040
[*][b]Life[/b] damage increased from 480 / 1920 / 7680 to 500 / 2000 / 8000
[*][b]Mushroom[/b] damage decreased from 250 / 1000 / 4000 to 240 / 960 / 3840
[*][b]Flamethrower[/b] damage decreased from 300 / 1200 to 280 / 1120
 -- [b]Napalm[/b] damage decreased from 150 / 600 to 140 / 560
 -- [b]Napalm[/b] no longer expires after 5 seconds
[/list]
